purpose: Read-only integration inventory; PRs are not independent studies; no effect recomputation

prs.body:
## New empirical work (independent of chocho)

For the first time in `gesui`, this branch queries **live GBIF all-Plantae speciesKey occurrence facets** rather than butterfly larval-host-only records. It keeps every original positive island/port/butterfly result intact. Source facility selection is completed **before** consulting any plant records.

### Real, source-pinned results (2026-11-07)
- Original **58,502 HydroWASTE facilities**, immutable Git blob `0506f873f6541c5f324478894a9731290d722bce`.
- **3,518** facilities pass predetermined status, flow, coastal geography, quality and disjoint outfall/facility-buffer screens; five countries support source-matched high/low wastewater water-fraction pairs (AUT,CHE,CZE,DEU,DNK): **10 WWTPs**, **20 GBIF 2-km sites** (2011–2024 Plantae, accepted speciesKey facets).
- Nine facilities meet the frozen species-keyed-record depth gate at both outfall and WWTP positions; **4** of the five country pairs have both strata qualified. CZE high outfall had 11 plant records, insufficient for the ≥30-record threshold.
- Exact hypergeometric rarefaction to **30 species-keyed GBIF occurrence records**: model water-flow fraction vs `log1p(rarefied outfall richness) - log1p(rarefied WWTP richness)` Spearman **rho = −0.150**, **n=9**, exploratory two-sided **p = 0.7001**.
- Within-country high-minus-low differences (each defined from outfall-versus-WWTP record-index contrast): mean **−0.0831** on log1p expected richness, 4 qualified pairs; negative in all four. **There is no stable positive vegetation signal in this pilot**, but it does not test the true wastewater N mechanism.

### Permanent source evidence and verification
- [Live source-run SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42364079195), 3 geometry/rarefaction math tests passed.
- [Source-artifact preservation SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42364335031), copied all three original source JSON files by bytes to `results/wwtp_plantae_gbif_outfall_pilot_20261107/` alongside an SHA256 manifest and `RESULTS.md`.
- `scripts/audit_plantae_pilot_source.py` independently recomputes the 30-record hypergeometric expected richness, the facility deltas, paired-country comparisons and rank correlations **without external APIs**, and compares all original source file digests. Offline CI is the gate.

### Limits: not upstream/downstream; not a sewage N effect
- The **WWTP** point is not a hydrologically matched upstream control; estimated outfall and facility are different urban/river habitats with different botanical recording effort. GBIF absence and site richness are imperfect observation indices, not abundance.
- “Plantae” is not restricted to vascular plants, and river source topology, independent water quality / N dose, flow seasonality, independent urban/cropland controls and cross-catchment generalization have **not** been established.
- The parallel directed-river source gate is blocked by **official HydroRIVERS HTTP 403** and third-party ArcGIS **503 access denied**; neither a real downstream ecological response nor a nutrient-causation claim is made. Downstream H1 remains **not tested**.

**Proposed action:** Keep as **Draft**, retain exploratory null in the repository. Next independently verify receiving-reach geometry and obtain properly matched upstream/downstream plant data, not a post-hoc search for positive signs. No GEB manuscript changes.

## UPDATE — 2026-11-07: Source coverage blocker resolved for exploratory river geometry

A new [source-locked HydroRIVERS v1 EU GeoParquet run succeeded](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42364866919) using [an independently hosted Europe GeoParquet conversion](https://huggingface.co/datasets/cassini-team-todo/hydro-rivers-europe), fixed SHA-256 `5e6327c6dd34a81bd7768d840f25c0569d4361b7e078065a97214563bd01b32f`. The original HydroWASTE 58,502 WWTP CSV was reverified against Git blob `0506f873f6541c5f324478894a9731290d722bce`.

**New real results:** all **4,713/4,713** quality-filtered European HydroWASTE facilities linked by original HYRIV_ID to this mirror, **4,497** consecutive U2→U1→outfall-reach→D1 directed chains, **3,569** candidate chains after 1-km site-buffer spacing, and **16** source-only selected outfall units (**four per AUT/CZE/DEU/DNK; eight high/eight low modeled water fractions**). Selected outfall-to-referenced-line geographic offset median **0.0250 km**, maximum **0.0467 km**. The complete original source-only coordinates and QC are [committed](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/river-source-gate-20261107/results/hydrorivers_eu_source_gate_20261107) with sha256 receipt and no plant outcomes.

**Remaining critical caveat:** this third-party converted GeoParquet is **not independently byte/topology verified against the official original HydroRIVERS release**. Facility-to-reach ID and 16 selected location checks are positive correspondence diagnostics but not that validation. WWTP presence or modeled effluent fraction is not an N mass load. No biological differences have been inferred by this source-only PR. A [separate source-frozen 48-site all-Plantae analysis](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/river-plantae-directional-20261107) follows, predeclared before GBIF requests.

---

## Original initial source access limitations (historical, superseded for source-only feasibility)

## Outcome: real source gate prepared, source access currently blocks river-matched ecology

This branch does **not** claim an executed upstream/downstream plant test, a valid river sample count, or a wastewater-driven habitat corridor.

### Verified positive engineering/provenance
- Original **HydroWASTE v1** 58,502 source-row CSV **downloaded and Git blob verified** (`0506f873f6541c5f324478894a9731290d722bce`).
- Actual directed river-chain design implemented in `scripts/gesui_river_source_gate.py`: consecutive **U2→U1→outfall-reach→D1** based on `HYRIV_ID` and `NEXT_DOWN`; 1-km non-overlapping pilot sites, source-only high/low water fractions, no GBIF-biological outcome inspection.
- Dedicated source/maths unit tests passed **3/3**; original provenance and schema suite in offline CI [passed after separating optional geospatial imports](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42363822996).

### Source blocker, documented from actual Actions logs
- Official HydroRIVERS Europe/Middle East ZIP `https://data.hydrosheds.org/file/HydroRIVERS/HydroRIVERS_v10_eu_shp.zip`: HTTP **403** on the runner, even after pinning the source and successful HydroWASTE retrieval.
- Clearly labelled third-party FSC ArcGIS FeatureServer global HydroRIVERS mirror: JSON **503** `User couldn't access this resource 'hosted/optimized_hyrdo.mapserver'`. Thus no real matching reach/chain sample can be certified from either method.
- [Actual fallback source run](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42363801175) shows the 403/503 and source-run failure. This is an external data-access failure, **not a biological negative effect**.

### Independent result on a separate branch
Real plant recording feasibility was successfully analyzed separately in [Draft PR #2](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/2) (20 live GBIF Plantae sites; source-only high/low water fractions, **not hydrologic controls**). PR #2 cannot substitute for the blocked directed H1 geometry.

### Next acceptance gate
Require a legitimately licensed, version-locked and topology-compatible HydroRIVERS river network with source `HYRIV_ID` joins, or another openly available hydrologic layer whose exact join/correspondence is verified, **before** claiming upstream/downstream tests or running plant response models.

Keep this PR **Draft**. No changes to `chocho`, no marine wastewater current, and no manuscript assertions.

prs.body:
## First independent river-structured plant-community test in gesui (2026-11-07)

**New actual data collected:** 16 source-blind wastewater outfall units; real directed rivers U2→U1→outfall-associated reach→D1, matched by HydroWASTE HYRIV_ID and an independently hosted, SHA256-locked HydroRIVERS Europe v1 conversion. Fixed 16 source-selected outfalls across AUT/CZE/DEU/DNK, eight high/8 low modeled effluent-water fraction.

- **48/48 pre-selected biological survey centers returned GBIF Plantae 2011–2024 occurrences** at 1km radius.
- New fully versioned original aggregate dataset: **1,402 distinct GBIF speciesKeys, 5,394 site × plant-species rows**, 48-site registry with georeferenced river reach IDs, source quality and modeled water fraction. All original source facets, data CSVs, estimator locking, and SHA-256 receipts are retained in [results/directed_river_plantae_20261107](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/river-plantae-directional-20261107/results/directed_river_plantae_20261107).
- Independent upstream-only background is observed from U2→U1, then the outfall-associated reach is crossed from U1→D1. These are *observational river spatial gradients*, NOT a causal effluent comparison or a plant-dispersal path.

### Source-frozen primary and sensitivity outputs

Predeclared **30-record exact hypergeometric rarefaction**, ≥30 species-keyed records and ≥6 species at *all three* sites, and max/min species-key-record depth ≤10: **12/16 outfalls qualified**.

Primary response was the change *across the outfall reach* minus the previous upstream change of log(1+rarefied GBIF plant species). Source water-flow fraction vs this observation-index contrast: **Spearman rho = +0.125874; n=12; exploratory two-sided p=0.69668**. No robust positive or negative source association.

- Sensitivity 30 records without balance restriction: same n=12 and rho.
- Predeclared low-depth sensitivity 10 records (≥10 resolved records; ≥4 species per site): **n=14, rho = +0.173626, p=0.55277**.
- High vs low source-fraction strata among strict qualified outfalls: mean difference **−0.05968** log-richness contrast (7 high and 5 low), not supporting a positive trend.
- Jaccard site-composition companion recorded but not promoted to sewage effect: mean extra U1→D1 vs U2→U1 species-set turnover ~+0.00964 (9/12 positive) but **segment distances differ markedly**, GBIF detection effort varies, and no clean non-discharge controls exist.

### Inspectable provenance

- [Original real HydroRIVERS geometry and source-blind location selection, SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42364866919)
- [Original actual 48-site GBIF source and predefined analysis, SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42365305227) (4/4 offline unit tests).
- [Immutable original GBIF artifact copied into this branch, SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42365522199).
- [Independent offline stdlib source-byte, 5,394-row, 1,402-key, rarefaction, Jaccard, and Spearman audit SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42365622805), zero new GBIF queries.
- See [predeclared protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/river-plantae-directional-20261107/docs/RIVER_PLANTAE_DIRECTIONAL_PREDECLARED_V01.md).

### Interpretation gate: limited biological inference

This is a **new, verifiable and reusable all-Plantae river-observation dataset**, but **does NOT support an effluent-driven N/P diversity mechanism** from the present sites. The third-party HydroRIVERS v1-derived GeoParquet has a matching SHA, all 4,713 prefiltered HydroWASTE river IDs and small selected outfall line offsets, but not independent official original validation. Actual N concentrations, land-use/urbanization, sampling effort, river discharge seasonality, other upstream discharges, and unequal U2–U1 vs U1–D1 distances are missing/confounding. GBIF kingdom Plantae is not equivalent to a complete vascular-plant abundance survey.

Previous chocho positive resource, port, island, AIS and wind results remain intact and independent. The wastewater-specific next step is independent source-measured N/P and properly matched reference streams; **do not tune site choices or thresholds based on this null**.

**Stacking:** Draft PR against the [physical river gate PR #3](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/3), so the manuscript-free scientific source and response layers stay separately reviewable.

prs.body:
## Actual source-backed nutrient verification, 2026-11-07 (NOT sewage causation)

**Research purpose:** distinguish the archived original 16 GBIF Plantae river sites from independently source-monitored nutrient series. Upstream/downstream, not nearest straight-line only. Keep original `chocho` positives intact and earlier `gesui` richness null intact.

### Source identification and verification
- Original public Peters et al. 2026 Global Nutrient Yields data: [versioned Figshare v5](https://doi.org/10.25400/lincolnuninz.30546371.v5), **CC BY 4.0**. Metadata and 4 observational TN/TP CSV+year sources MD5-verified, original 19,424 TN sites, 41,639 TP sites. **WRTDS/model-estimated fields not substituted for unavailable raw observations**.
- [Live source metadata SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42369418945), [48-site proximity/source coverage SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42369645480).
- Within **1 km** of 48 fixed plant sites, **zero** TN or TP monitoring sites; within **10km**, 12/48 plant sites have TN monitoring nearby, 16/48 TP. Straight-line distance alone cannot prove hydrological connectivity.
- [Directed river topology source run SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42369909177) snapped source stations within 500m to SHA256-verified third-party HydroRIVERS conversion, classified NEXT_DOWN upstream and downstream. Within ≤25 river-network km **only ONE /16 old outfalls** has both up/down TN and TP site *metadata*, WASTE_ID 24249 (Austria).

### An actual positive observational TP result, **separated from hypothesis of WWTP causation**
- Source-predeclared 24249 upstream WQ976406 and downstream WQ977059 present in **measured** TP v5 harmonized ZIP, original source MD5 verified.
- 2012–2013: **24 same-calendar-month paired TP medians** and downstream/upstream median ratio **1.1667**. The predeclared extended 2008–2022 sensitivity yields 179 matched months, median ratio **1.40625**.
- Critical limitation: model wastewater contribution ~1.71×10⁻⁶ of river discharge; station distances are ~23.54km upstream, ~8.59km downstream; other watershed sources are uncontrolled. **This is a positive TP river nutrient gradient, NOT a wastewater P release effect**.
- Preselected corresponding TN sites WQ016702/WQ016695 have `WQ.available=0`, are explicitly in source **unavailable ID** list and absent public harmonized original; **joint TN/TP claim cannot be estimated**. [Original real measured source analysis SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42370327128). Frozen source reports and monthly TP table [archived here](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/nutrient-source-coverage-20261107/results/peters2026_tntp_frozen16_20261107).

### Independent new monitored-source cohort without any outcome-based cherry-picking
- Original 3,569 nonoverlap river-source candidates, exclude 16 GBIF-observed outfalls -> **3,553**.
- Peters v5 site data and actual public source-file existence combined with directed-network location and year envelope: **0** outfalls have all four independently available TN/TP up/down site files within 25 river-km. No combined causal/source effect study is possible on this criterion.
- **TP-only source availability:** 46 candidate outfalls, 40 in Germany; original stratified six chosen source-only initially reuse monitoring stations.
- Independent source-only repair: enforce **12 distinct TP station IDs, 6 separate HydroBASINS L12, ≥30 km between outfalls** before inspecting TP concentration or new GBIF outcomes; resulting **6 German outfalls** (3 high/3 low modeled WW-water fraction; observed minimum distance **57.28 km**). [Original source-only re-selection SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42371319376), [original artifact frozen in results](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/nutrient-source-coverage-20261107/results/independent_deu_tp_source_cohort_20261107).
- Separate [independent cohort's measured TP + new plant pilot](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/deu-independent-tp-plants-20261107) is explicitly predeclared before outcome inspection; results are NOT promoted on this PR until an audited source run passes.

### Scientific limit and status
Geometric connectivity + public station metadata ≠ measured N flux from outfall. The third-party converted HydroRIVERS EU vector has known sha and matches old outfall river IDs but remains unverified against the official original release. These are **Draft independent exploratory data-quality and small-river gradient studies**, not a causal N/P effect on plants nor globally representative observations.

All former `chocho` host/port/island resource positives, and `gesui` original 16-outfall plant richness null, are retained unchanged. No edits to GEB manuscript or main plant results.
prs.title: Source-locked 2026 measured TN/TP monitoring: river connectivity, positive TP gradient, and independent six-outfall cohort

prs.body:
## Completed first independently monitored six-outfall TP × all-Plantae pilot, 2026-11-07

**Do not conflate these six new rivers with the earlier 16-outfall river-plant cohort.** Source-only environmental data fixed the six WWTP outfalls *before* inspecting TP concentrations or new GBIF plant records. These six are all Germany, 3 high/3 low model wastewater-fraction source strata, six distinct HydroBASINS L12, twelve distinct TP water quality stations and a minimum 57.28km outfall separation. Original 16 WWTPs are excluded.

### Source-backed observational TP and a new positive association
- Original public Peters et al. 2026 Figshare v5 CC BY4, ID 70896288, MD5 `b596dbe9833c49426147a99f10f3fe31`, **2,500 positive TP river station measurements 2011–2022**, **836 upstream/downstream matched calendar months** across six independent pairs (each pair 124–143 matched months).
- Observed river TP downstream/upstream monthly median ratios per WWTP: **21144 0.266, 21712 0.746, 21737 0.869, 21749 2.083, 21945 0.792, 21413 1.071**. Both negative and positive river gradients.
- **Source-modeled effluent water fraction × actual TP river-gradient** Spearman **rho +0.82857**, n=6, ordinary asymptotic p=0.04156. Crucial independent **exhaustive 720 rank permutations**: **two-sided exact p=42/720=0.05833** (does *not* pass 5% exact threshold); leave-one-out rho **+0.70 to +1.00**. This is an *exploratory positive signal*, not a proven causal wastewater phosphate release. River monitoring sites are 7–25km away and other agriculture, tributaries and WWTPs are unaccounted for.

### New all-Plantae river outcomes, not selected after TP effects
- All **18/18** source-preselected U2/U1/D1 river sites received live GBIF 2011–2022 Plantae speciesKey occurrence facets, no larval-host filtering.
- **Prespecified primary** exact 30-species-record rarefaction plus balanced site recording: only **3/6** complete, so a TP→vegetation association is **not testable** at the strict primary observation-quality threshold.
- Prespecified 10-record sensitivity: **6/6** complete; TP gradient versus richness curvature `[D1−U1]−[U1−U2]` Spearman **rho −0.02857, n=6, descriptive p=0.95715**. No positive link with this weak botanical index.
- GBIF Plantae is not a complete vascular-plant survey, doesn't estimate abundance or ecological colonization. Stream segment lengths and observation effort differ; no field N/P load or independent urban/agriculture controls. All are German rivers; n=6 is not a robust macroecological sample.

### Reproducibility
- [Source-blind 3,569→3,553 candidate and strict six-independent-outfall gate, SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42371319376), original byte and metadata source receipts in `results/independent_deu_tp_source_cohort_20261107/`.
- [Actual 2,500 TP records + 18 GBIF site measurements, SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42371970951).
- [Results archived, original file SHA256, and exact 720-permutation check, SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42372241439), source-derived monthly TP and all original GBIF speciesKey datasets in [results/independent_deu_tp_plantae_20261107](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/deu-independent-tp-plants-20261107/results/independent_deu_tp_plantae_20261107). Institution-licensed raw 2,500 station-date TP observations were not redistributed; source original data and digest enable independent rebuild.
- [Independent network-free code recomputes all monthly TP, plant rarefaction, source hashes, rho, 42/720 exact p](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42372402396) **SUCCESS**.

### Boundaries
Original `chocho` positive island/port/host resource results and `gesui` original 48-site observational null are not changed or contradicted. Prior joint TN+TP monitoring source gate did not support any new four-station independent outfall; this branch is TP-only. The observed positive rho describes **covarying hydrographic TP and modeled infrastructure water fraction**, not attributable effluent P, ecological nutrient enrichment or its mechanism. Keep Draft, do not rewrite the paper as causal.
prs.title: Six independent German TP rivers: 2,500 measured samples, 18 new Plantae sites, exact small-n audit

prs.body:
## New source-backed European river macro analysis (2026-11-07)

**Main scientific question:** Does source-locked WWTP treated-water volume flowing *upstream* of independently measured river sites predict measured nutrient concentration beyond geographic and hydrological patterns? This is descriptive prediction, **not WWTP N/P discharge mass or causal fertilizer/land-use inference**.

### Source-only sampling locked before reading measured chemistry

- Original 58,502 HydroWASTE facilities, blob `0506f873f6541c5f324478894a9731290d722bce`; 6,354 flow/location-quality and network-compatible source WWTPs in European study domain.
- Europe HydroRIVERS v1-derived third-party GeoParquet SHA256 `5e6327c6dd34a81bd7768d840f25c0569d4361b7e078065a97214563bd01b32f`; official original still not independently verified.
- Peters et al. Figshare v5 `10.25400/lincolnuninz.30546371.v5`, original **measured** `TP.2_-_Harmonised.zip` and `TN.2_-_Harmonised.zip`, MD5 checked. Station observation periods **2011–2024**, ≥12 positive observations across ≥2 years, source station within 500m of projected river line. **No RF modeled concentrations, WRTDS, or outcome columns `C_mean/C_median/L/Y` used as predictors.**
- Directed upstream WWTP total modeled effluent water (m³/day) within 50km river path, same-reach source excluded (unknown within-reach ordering); compare physically noncausal downstream-WWTP water-volume placebo. Geodata source-only [SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42371629424).
- A [predeclared protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/monitored-river-macro-pilot-20261107/docs/EU_TNTP_WWTP_MACRO_PREDECLARED_20261107.md) fixed all prediction features and five **3° geographic block** holdout folds before measured source outcomes were fit.

### Primary observational result: **no reproducible positive upstream-volume prediction**

- **TP 1,418 independent river monitoring stations**, 28 spatial blocks, **85 with upstream registered WWTP source**. Raw Spearman source upstream WW volume versus measured TP rho **−0.001924** (p 0.942 descriptive). Fixed 5-fold grouped Ridge(alpha=10), baseline geography+river size/flow MSE **0.688815** vs plus upstream WW source **0.716350 (4.00% worse)**; downstream-WWTP negative-control model **0.671810 (2.47% better)**.
- **TP 510** with published independent cropland and population covariates, **73 with upstream registered WWTP source**; baseline MSE **0.508205**, plus upstream **0.513739 (1.09% worse)**, downstream placebo **0.507646 (0.11% better)**. First-run covariate-screen bug mistakenly required a nonexistent TP `N_deposition` column and yielded n=0; this was **repaired based on public source schema** to the two predeclared TP crop/pop covariates, before rerunning on exact same observed source data, no outcome-based variable search.
- **TN 236** measured river sites, only **13 upstream source-exposed**; baseline MSE 0.694129 vs upstream 0.698730 (0.66% worse). Published crop/pop/N-deposition complete panel n=20 and only **1 exposed**, hence no robust land-adjusted test.

These are negative/weak patterns for **one simplistic upstream effluent-water-volume proxy**, not demonstrations that wastewater has no nutrient or ecological effects. The downstream placebo outperforming upstream source in all TP sites is a key potential geographic/urban confounding warning.

### Source and independent audit

- [Original measured outcome fixed-model run SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42372235775).
- [Original source-only hydraulic cohort run SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42371629424).
- [Independent offline source-digest, station identity, Spearman and all spatial-group CV statistics SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42372545545) — from **verified 1,418 TP / 236 TN station source panels**, no additional measured TN/TP queries.
- Public stable aggregate source receipts, numerical comparison and independent audit: [results/eu_monitored_nutrient_wwtp_macro_20261107](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/monitored-river-macro-pilot-20261107/results/eu_monitored_nutrient_wwtp_macro_20261107). Station-level raw original dates/concentrations not unnecessarily republished.

### Scale sensitivity: distinct local observation, **not a general law**

[Independent German six-river TP study PR #7](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/7) reports a **positive** modeled effluent-water-fraction vs actual up/down TP-gradient rho +0.82857 among **six independent source-selected German river pairs**, with exact two-sided permutation **42/720 = p0.05833** (asymptotic p0.04156), *not significant by exact 5% threshold*. Its new GBIF plant index does not show a positive TP-gradient→richness link (rho−0.0286, n6). This does not invalidate the broad macro negative source-prediction result or establish causation.

**Why keep Draft:** WP/WWTP discharge water is not measured TN/TP mass, treatment-stage data are uncertain, river access third-party derived, historical status mismatch and agricultural/urban sources not fully controlled. Need independent WWTP-specific N/P loads (not only proxy volume) and new catchment-matched comparison before stronger inference.

No change to frozen chocho GEB host-resource +54.9%, prior positive port/all-plant correlations, or the distinct original 16-outfall plant null.
prs.title: European observed river TN/TP vs upstream WWTP flows: 1,418 TP sites, spatial-block CV and negative control

prs.body:
## New 2022 wastewater-load-to-river chemistry research (Draft, 2026-11-07)

**Key distinction from prior gesui macro PR #8:** no use of a WWTP's modeled wastewater *water volume* as if it were N/P discharge. Instead, this study uses the official EEA UWWTD 2022 **reported measured annual N and P discharge masses** (metric tonnes/year) tied to unique discharge points coded as direct freshwater (FW), and Peters 2026 v5 **original measured river TN/TP concentrations** in the same calendar year. This is observational source-to-receptor modeling, NOT causal effluent attribution.

### Source/river positive achievements

- Official [EEA UWWTD public API](https://water.discomap.eea.europa.eu/arcgis/rest/services/WISE_UWWTD/TreatmentPlants_2022/MapServer/0) reports **22,554 WWTPs**, of which **5,492** have both positive measured N and P loads; [24,416 public discharge points](https://water.discomap.eea.europa.eu/arcgis/rest/services/WISE_UWWTD/DischargePoints_2022/MapServer/0).
- Source-only join on *complete official repCode and uwwCode* (a first version incorrectly restricted the reporter key to a two-letter prefix; repaired before any recipient chemistry), exclusion of multi-outlet facilities to avoid duplicating source mass, **direct FW** outfall codes only. **2,969** reporting outfalls snap <=500m to the version-locked HydroRIVERS Europe graph.
- Only directed upstream reach paths **<=50km** connect sources to original Peters monitoring stations, excluding source on the same reach due to uncertain within-reach order. Negative-control exposures use physically downstream WWTP annual loads. [Original source-only real run SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42374105184); source SHA `79641d984b28fdbc11dbf02e32f32cda2818ec256f219439a1ccfae601da7dc3`.

### Actual 2022 river chemistry results — modest and not independently predictive

Original 2022 Peters measured TN/TP site-date records only, >=4 positive valid station samples over >=3 distinct months in **2022**. **TP 1,291** valid monitoring sites (53 with 2022 upstream reported WWTP P load); **TN 159** (26 with 2022 upstream reported WWTP N load). All statistical predictions are on station-level 2022 median log(mg/L), **not on daily pseudo-independent samples**. The predeclared 5-fold 3-degree regional block Ridge(alpha=10) shares identical station denominators across model families.

| Model | TP full n=1291 | TN full n=159 |
|---|---:|---:|
| M0 lat/lon/riverQ/drainage baseline MSE | 0.721242 | 0.786210 |
| M1 + actual 2022 reported measured *upstream source mass* MSE | 0.735449 (**1.97% worse**) | 0.812399 (**3.33% worse**) |
| M2 + downstream-source negative control MSE | 0.720317 (+0.13% better) | 0.819693 (4.26% worse) |
| Raw Spearman rho(source mass, measured river median) | −0.06044 | −0.18594 |

For TP with **446 independently observed crop/population source covariate-complete stations** (46 with upstream P-load support): baseline MSE **0.583402**, +real source P mass **0.591134 (1.33% worse)**, downstream control **0.588351 (0.85% worse)**. TN crop/pop subset n=13 with only 2 source-exposed is below coverage gate. **No strong positive held-out predictive result from recorded WWTP N/P loads.**

### New physically grounded dilution diagnostic (exploratory, not an attributable fraction)

If all reported source mass from facilities <=50km upstream were delivered and uniformly mixed using **mean** river Q (without retention), the implied nominal mixed P concentration among the 53 TP exposed monitoring sites has median **0.00228 mg P/L**, with per-station median ratio **4.07%** of the corresponding actually observed TP median; 14/53 nominal ratios exceed 10%, none exceed 100%. For TN 26 exposed sites, median nominal **0.04866 mg N/L**, per-station ratio median **2.39%**; 3/26 exceed 10%, none exceed 100%. This is a **model-derived annual-mean scenario**, not measured effluent attribution, and NOT a seasonal impact bound: dry season Q and unregistered sources can change relationships substantially. Explains why source input alone need not track ambient concentration strongly.

### Fully source-authenticated and independently verifiable

- [Original 2022 measured-run SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42375542151) after a transparent fix to per-record invalid-count vector summation; no change to sites or models.
- [Independent code MSE/source SHA reproduction SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42376191822).
- [Portable replay using **exact saved original holdout block IDs**, SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42376519412). Original runner NumPy 2.4.6 / sklearn 1.9.1 GroupKFold tie handling may differ from earlier installed versions, so the original fold membership is frozen and re-used rather than silently trusting group assignment defaults.
- [Archive and permanently store original 2022 station summary CSVs, source-only EEA load features, original fold labels, both independent audits, SHA256 receipts and report, SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42376711759) in [results/eea2022_measured_nutrient_load_river_20261107](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/eea-wwtp-nutrient-load-source-20261107/results/eea2022_measured_nutrient_load_river_20261107). The original full daily measurement archives remain with the source providers.

### Limits and next explanatory test

EEA discharge-year 2022 is NOT a historical 2011–2024 exposure series; source treatment/operation status imperfect; use of an independently hosted **third-party converted** HydroRIVERS v1 EU graph not yet validated against official original bytes; river reach order and annual mean discharge cannot locate exact low-flow pulse exposures; agriculture/other inputs remain confounded; 53 TP and 26 TN supported upstream records are sparse. Interpreting EEA reported mass as *cause* of recipient concentration is unsupported. Build a new source-selected **dry-season / lower-dilution** validation cohort with **actual load-to-receptor spatial alignment, field water chemistry and independently recorded plant traits**, not posthoc picking positive residuals.

The [separate independent six German TP stream pairs positive exploratory rho +0.8286, exact p=0.0583](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/7) is retained; it does not contradict the large regional 2022 null because source metric, scale, and geography differ. Original chocho island/port/host positives untouched.

**Keep Draft; no automatic merging into main or revision of frozen manuscripts.**
prs.title: Real 2022 EEA WWTP N/P loads × measured river TN/TP: 1,450 sites, dilution gate and portable spatial validation

prs.body:
## First reported EEA measured wastewater-P-source to independently acquired all-Plantae river study

This new 2026-11-07 independent plant survey extends [EEA 2022 measured N/P WWTP-load macro study PR #9](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/9) to vegetation. Source positive means an officially reported positive **measured WWTP P annual discharge load in tonnes/year** assigned via unique FW discharge point and HydroRIVERS directed 50km upstream reach; source zero means **no eligible officially registered both-measured positive-load WWTP source** in that 50km source graph, *not* absence of all wastewater or pollution. The biological response was never used to select sites.

### Source-only pre-outcome matched sampling
- Before any NEW GBIF query, fixed [source run SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42377235104): original 1,418 TP monitoring stations, 510 with independent crop2/pop_density covariates, 46 with positive EEA source P. Pair source positive and zero within identical 3-degree geographic block, similar river mean Q and drainage area (ratios <=3), crop cover difference <=0.2, log population density difference <=1.5, 5–180km between paired sites, all 36 sites separated >=5km, no repeated station IDs.
- **18 pairs, 36 independent river sites, 8 spatial blocks**, 75 initial source-only candidate pair matches. Original source design [COMMITTED to the branch before plant query](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42377321868), with SHA256 receipts and original 2022 source-only EEA monitoring registry hash `79641d984b28fdbc11dbf02e32f32cda2818ec256f219439a1ccfae601da7dc3`.
- Source selection did not look at the 2022 measured river TP concentration or at any new or original GBIF plant richness or composition.

### Genuine NEW biological observations
- [Live GBIF Plantae source survey SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42377454765): exactly **36/36 fixed river sites**, 2022–2024, radius 1km, full kingdom Plantae (not butterfly larval-host-only), coordinate-present speciesKey facets; **1,006 distinct GBIF Plantae speciesKeys** across fixed sites.
- Prespecified **primary 30 species-key-record exact rarefaction** plus source/control record-depth ratio <=10 and >=6 species per site: just **5/18 pairs** satisfy observation support (4 source-positive-richness directions, 1 negative), **below the preregistered >=10-pair / >=4-block inference support gate**. Do not report a primary sign-test p.
- **Prespecified 10-record sensitivity**, >=4 species per site, no strict effort-balance: **11/18 pairs** (6 spatial blocks) qualify; 7 positive vs 4 negative; paired exact two-sided sign **p = 0.548828125**; mean source-positive-minus-control log richness **−0.01699**. No reproducible direction of higher recorded richness at EEA-source-positive sites.

### Reproducibility and limits
- [Full source-original GBIF faceted records, pair outcomes, frozen thresholds, source receipt and independent stdlib no-network reproduction SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42377732661) committed under [results/eea2022_p_matched_river_plantae_20261107](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/eea2022-matched-river-plantae-20261107/results/eea2022_p_matched_river_plantae_20261107). Code checks all 36 sites, exact input hashes, original 1,006 speciesKey union, both rarefactions and n=11 sign p without SciPy or network requests.
- **NOT causal source P effects**: GBIF records index observation, not plant biomass, colonization or coverage; all Plantae includes nonvascular groups; positive measured facility P mass is not measured floodplain P exposure, controls can receive unregistered wastewater, agriculture and fertilizers; source 2022 and GBIF 2022–24 are not repeated before-after ecological observations; recorder effort and habitat may be unmatched.
- A nutrient-enrichment hypothesis often predicts **functional-trait/assemblage turnover**, not necessarily higher species richness. The next independent trait test should first map the 1,006 GBIF speciesKeys to taxonomically validated regional vascular plants and *externally sourced* Ellenberg N or measured nutrient affinity, with explicit trait-coverage and geographical bias QC **before** fitting trait enrichment. Do NOT invent trait values from species names.

**Maintain Draft and retain original positive chocho host/port and independent six German river TP gradient results as distinct previous findings. This result does not establish absence of wastewater ecosystem effects.**
prs.title: 18 response-blind EEA measured-P source river pairs × 36 new GBIF Plantae sites: 1,006 taxa and audited support limits

prs.body:
## Source-locked vegetation trait result and independent bias audit (2026-11-08)

**Question:** When a fixed European river station has registered 2022 EEA **measured wastewater P annual load** on its upstream 50-km graph, is the recorded plant community richer in nutrient-demanding species? The [18 pairs / 36 GBIF site cohort in PR #10](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/10) was fixed *before* collecting any new GBIF plants and before mapping the traits. No pair or control was swapped based on the NUTRI results.

### Real independent source join
- Source: [Tichý et al. 2023 European harmonized Ellenberg-type nutrient indicator NUTRI](https://doi.org/10.1111/jvs.13168), Europe EIV CSV fixed SHA256 `ffeb2a5f45c95886625f970734e431098587c65baad7def786d35364a761dbba`; **8,908** species rows; **7,195** numeric NUTRI entries in the downloaded source snapshot. EIV NUTRI is ecological nutrient preference/productivity, not measured P discharge, plant chemistry or river TN/TP concentration.
- Original **1,006** GBIF speciesKeys queried individually from the GBIF taxonomy API, with **zero API failures**; 911 accepted vascular speciesKeys and **624 unambiguous EXACT accepted-species binomial matches with numeric NUTRI**. No genus/fuzzy synonym fallback and no guessed trait values.
- **25/36 biological sites** pass frozen ≥10 EIV-rated taxa and ≥40% all-Plantae speciesKey EIV coverage. But only **9/18 complete source-positive/source-zero pairs** pass versus the preregistered **minimum 10 pairs in ≥4 spatial blocks**. Accordingly, **the prespecified ecological effect/sign test is NOT supported**.
- Descriptive n=9 accepted pairs: mean species-equal source-positive minus source-zero NUTRI **−0.2552**, median −0.4715; 3 positive vs 6 negative. A posthoc diagnostic exact sign p 0.5078 is supplied for transparency, **not a valid prespecified test**. GBIF-record-weighted sensitivity mean −0.1383 (4 positive / 5 negative).

### Important new method result: trait coverage is nonexchangeable
- **14/18 source-positive** versus **11/18 source-zero** sites pass site quality, but matching fraction (rated/all-Plantae recorded speciesKeys) is **lower at source-positive in 15/18 matched pairs**. Exploratory QC exact sign **p=0.00754**, median within-pair matching-fraction difference **−0.0970** (9.7 percentage points).
- In **13/18** pairs the source-positive has more GBIF plant occurrence records than the source-zero (posthoc sign p 0.0963), yet it has lower EIV matching fraction. Treat this as missing trait coverage / taxonomy / survey-effort bias, *not a mechanism of wastewater treatment*.
- The European harmonized indicator source was constructed with Euro+Med nomenclature and omitted many rare/casual alien species and aggregated difficult taxa; that may contribute to differential missingness, but **alien composition has not yet been independently tested**. Original [Tichý et al 2023](https://doi.org/10.1111/jvs.13168).

### Immutable reproducibility
- [Original trait and GBIF taxonomy source run SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42378520227).
- [Independent no-network source-hash verification and re-computation of all 36 site NUTRI means, 18 pair differences, trait coverage asymmetry and posthoc exact sign statistics SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42430531522).
- The [committed research results](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/eea2022-eiv-trait-coverage-20261107/results/eea2022_p_eiv_nutri_traits_20261108) contain per-site/per-pair summarized NUTRI, all 1,006 source GBIF taxonomy IDs and taxon-status/match flags, original sha256 receipts and an independent QC audit. They **do not redistribute the full third-party European EIV table or 624 source species-level numerical scores**. The original source SHA permits an independent re-join under the provider's terms.

### Scientific interpretation and next gate
The current strict EIV data cannot identify a positive or negative source-N/P mechanism. The robust finding is **observational trait metadata coverage imbalance** across river-source/control sides; this can distort trait-value comparisons when choosing complete-case sites. For a credible next step, predefine new independent vegetation-survey effort / flora sampling with complete species-site lists, validated Euro+Med/GBIF accepted taxonomy mapping and matched actual receiving-water chemistry, *before observing new trait responses*. GBIF absence is not vegetation absence; neither site recorded species count nor EIV NUTRI is plant abundance or P uptake.

Previous chocho island/port/larval-host positive evidence, original European N/P macro null and six German P river exploratory positive result (exact p=0.0583) all remain unchanged. Keep Draft, do not force merge into main or promote QC p-values as ecological tests.
prs.title: European EIV NUTRI audit of 36 matched EEA P-source river plant sites: 624 exact taxa, trait missingness asymmetry

prs.body:
## Critical 2026-11-08 independent source-bias correction: see [Draft PR #16](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/16)

The original positive model MSEs are independently reproducible, but the official EEA Biology numeric-EQR eligibility is **strongly country/source selective**: among 3,282 benthic source-only candidates, 807 Polish sites have no original raw or normalized numeric EQR; **247/394 (62.7%)** registered upstream WWTP-source-positive candidates are thereby excluded. For phytobenthos 802 Polish and 77 Austrian source sites are missing original numeric EQR, **293/403 (72.7%)** of the originally source-positive candidates. The original model excluded them correctly but a nullable-pandas QA counter incorrectly displayed zero invalid EQR; [official source audit](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42438230754) and NA-safe correction are separate from the model fit.

Independent publicly reported agricultural P load exists for just **142** benthic source candidate sites in **Lithuania and Netherlands**, only 20 with registered upstream WWTP load; values are **modelled RBD/subunit-level NP1 diffuse emissions**, not local measured pollution. Cross-country crop-P correction is therefore untestable with this source. [Source-only gate](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42439118473).

A further **posthoc** source-amount permutation diagnostic preserves country, WWTP registration and river-Q strata while shuffling 199 annual source-load assignments among positive sites. Among 147 observed benthic source-positive sites (146 movable), **0/199** permutations outperformed original reported P or N assignment, in either null design; exploratory finite Monte Carlo extremeness 0.005, **not a confirmatory or causal p-value**. [Original conditional-null results](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42439198765). The apparent source-magnitude specificity is limited to the observed country-selective panel and cannot identify P-vs-N effects (rho≈0.882 between source masses).

**Do not generalize PR #14 to missing Polish/Austrian sites or treat this as demonstrated sewage-driven biodiversity change.** The positive incremental prediction and its severe missingness/causal caveats are both retained.

---

## First fully source-backed multi-taxon aquatic ecology extension in `gesui`

**Research question:** Do EEA 2022 officially **reported measured** WWTP annual nitrogen/phosphorus discharge loads (tonnes/year) provide independent geographical predictive information about the normalized biological condition (EQR) of freshwater benthic invertebrates, phytobenthos, and fish?

**Important distinction:** Positive prediction increment is NOT a causal effect; the sign of EQR association is not “wastewater benefits biodiversity.” Source N/P annual loads are strongly correlated and other agricultural/urban inputs remain unresolved.

### Source-lock before reading biological outcomes
1. [EEA Waterbase Biology 2026 official original 132.2MB archive source inventory](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42430869887), internal file schema (2025_1 tables within official 2026 release) and source-member SHA256; dynamic outer Nextcloud ZIP container hash is not stable, but all 12 original internal member sizes and CRCs matched across fetches.
2. [Real 2022 biological source QC SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42431407415): original 176,075 all-year EQR rows; 14,874 river rows in 2022, 5,976 uniquely geolocated source sites with numeric normalized EQR in initial source gate. BQE codes frozen **before** fitting any EQR: `EEA_13-01-4` InvertebrateEQR_G, `EEA_124-04-9` PhytobenthosEQR_E, `EEA_14-02-8` FishEQR_H.
3. [Source-only reported EEA nutrient-mass → direct-FW discharge → HydroRIVERS directed river → biological monitoring site matching SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42432030617). **No numerical EQR values read in the source-only step.** Each original site, 3-degree block/fold, source WWTP N/P tonnes/year, hydrology, country and method were frozen. Three preregistered exposure/geography gates: ≥100 monitor sites, ≥20 upstream source-positive, ≥5 total reporting countries, ≥3 source-positive countries, ≥10 regional blocks.
4. A [separate preregistered protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/eea2026-waterbase-biology-bqe-20261108/docs/EEA2026_BIOLOGY_BQE_PREOUTCOME_GATES.md) fixed a five-fold spatially heldout Ridge(alpha=10) baseline with latitude/longitude, mean river flow, drainage area and country×biological assessment-method. M1 adds **hydrologically upstream** EEA 2022 reported P (separately N) load; M2 adds a **downstream-WWTP load** negative control; M3 adds both.

### Actual original normalized aquatic EQR, year 2022

- **Benthic invertebrates:** **2,475 benthic-element site records** from 13 countries/45 regional blocks, 147 upstream registered source-positive. Original baseline heldout MSE **0.0583380**. Plus upstream P mass **0.0576946 → +1.103% prediction gain**; upstream N mass **0.0575233 → +1.397%**. Downstream-source negative-control MSE **0.0585409 for P (0.348% worse)** and **0.0585898 for N (0.432% worse)**. Raw source–EQR rank rho ~**−0.072**, i.e. not a beneficial ecological direction.
- **Phytobenthos:** **2,784 phytobenthos-element site records** from 12 countries/44 regional blocks, 110 source-positive. Baseline MSE **0.0359344**, adding upstream P or N improves by only **0.163% / 0.176%**, not materially general.
- **Fish:** **1,243 EQR sites** from only four reporting countries, violating the frozen ≥5-country inference gate. No predictive model fit.
- Unrecognized or unpaired biological source-site values are not silently filled: source-only invertebrate candidate site count was 3,282 but only 2,475 linked numeric original outcomes, with **807 Polish source sites absent from numeric analysis**; phytobenthos 3,663 source candidate sites vs 2,784 numeric outcomes (802 Poland, 77 Austria). Need original raw status/identity audit before assuming missing EQR vs identifiers.

[Original completed empirical study SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42432384196).

### Independent reconstruction and geographic robustness
- [Independent zero-network source SHA and four-model fixed-fold replay for BOTH N and P, SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42436814278) matches original MSE (tolerance <4×10^-6), data types, original 2022 samples, source-only original fold membership and site load values. Upstream gain is positive in **32/45 P** and **31/45 N** invertebrate regions (fixed-fold block diagnostic). 5000 posthoc block bootstrap samples of **fixed heldout squared-error differences** are positive; these are NOT bootstrap confidence intervals of causal sewage effect. N/P source loads correlate strongly even among invertebrate exposed sites (**Spearman ρ=0.882**, n=147); cannot separate mechanism by nutrient.
- [Posthoc transfer and source-positive-only diagnostics SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42437061882), clearly separated from original predeclared analysis. On the **same original spatial CV predictions**, relative MSE improvement is **14.41% P and 18.83% N among 147 source-positive invertebrate sites**, versus 0.31%/0.36% among 2,328 registered-source-zero sites. Country-left-out exploratory validation gives **+2.47% P, +3.00% N** overall; nonlinear quadratic geography still yields **+0.79% P, +1.00% N**. Country effects are heterogeneous (e.g., Italy and Croatia do not consistently improve). Phytobenthos country-left-out and nonlinear geographic tests fail to sustain its tiny original gain.
- Original site-level EEA-derived source/biological normalized-EQR CSVs, original full results, original source-only folds, independent audit, posthoc sensitivity receipt and file hashes are permanently versioned in [results/eea2022_biology_bqe_20261108](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/eea2026-waterbase-biology-bqe-20261108/results/eea2022_biology_bqe_20261108). The 132MB EEA raw source is not rehosted.


### Additional independent posthoc source **mass vs registered presence** falsification

[Separate source-locked auditor SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42437488249), full [numeric receipt](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/eea2026-waterbase-biology-bqe-20261108/results/eea2022_biology_bqe_20261108/POSTHOC_WWTP_MASS_VS_PRESENCE_COUNT_AUDIT.json): source-only registry provides the count of eligible **EEA both-positive measured N/P WWTPs** within 50km upstream. Using original 2,475 benthic BQE sites, exact same five source-frozen spatial folds and baseline, compare newly specified **binary source presence**, **registered source count**, **annual reported measured mass**, and **mass beyond presence/count**. This is a **posthoc mechanism-discrimination diagnostic**, not a preregistered test.

| Benthic 2022 EQR additional predictor | Spatial heldout MSE change versus same M0 baseline |
|---|---:|
| Any eligible upstream registered WWTP: yes/no | **+0.627%** |
| Number of registered upstream measured-load WWTPs | **+0.423%** |
| Reported P annual mass (t/yr) | **+1.103%** |
| Reported N annual mass (t/yr) | **+1.397%** |
| Presence **plus** reported P mass | **+0.965%** |
| Presence **plus** reported N mass | **+1.354%** |

Within this one observational indicator panel, **source amount has more predictive information than a single registration flag or facility count**. Adding P or N mass beyond the source-present binary improves the already source-presence model by another **0.34%/0.73%** respectively. This does **not** isolate pollutant toxicity, because annual WWTP N and P mass are very correlated, other urban/agricultural outputs are unavailable, original source sample requires both-positive reported measured N/P and regional EQR method/monitor-selection bias persists. For phytobenthos the same magnitude tests are small/nonrobust.

### What can be concluded (and what cannot)

**Source-backed positive predictive finding:** measured 2022 WWTP loads from hydrologically upstream reaches carry **small, apparently direction-specific additional predictive information for the reported ecological condition of benthic macroinvertebrates**, beyond country/method/hydrological baseline. This is **not** evidence that P or N specifically drives an EQR decline, nor that the discharges make biodiversity better/worse. Country/method calibration, EEA source-coverage bias, source-zero contamination, third-party HydroRIVERS derived graph, agriculture/urban effluents, and 2022 source vs actual water-body delivery remain unresolved.

The user explicitly wants positive results retained where justified; this finding should be kept alongside prior **non-supporting** river TP/N predictions, GBIF-plant nutrient trait 9/18 data-quality failure, and local positive German TP gradients — not force them into a single false causal narrative.

**Keep Draft, require review of source geolocation and method harmonization before a publication claim. Do not merge to `main` or alter frozen `chocho` GEB results.**
prs.title: 2022 EEA WWTP N/P load predicts benthic-invertebrate EQR (+1.1–1.4% heldout gain): 5,259 BQE site-records audited

prs.body:
## Independent falsification of the prior positive BQE prediction (2026-11-08)

This separate source-locked investigation retains the positive exploratory WWTP-reported-load → benthic-invertebrate 2022 EQR prediction in [PR #14](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/14), while evaluating source-data missingness, independently reported agricultural emissions, and conditional source-load permutation. The original BQE sites, WWTP loads, national assessment methods and five geographic folds were never changed or re-selected.

### 1. Major nonrandom biological data attrition

[Actual official EEA Biology2026 source and ID/EQR audit SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42438230754). These are genuine missing original raw and normalized numeric EQR, not failed geographical joining:

| Biology | Source river site candidates | Measured EQR model sites | Missing upstream-WWTP-source-positive candidates |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Benthic invertebrates | 3,282 | 2,475 | 247/394 = 62.7% |
| Phytobenthos | 3,663 | 2,784 | 293/403 = 72.7% |
| Fish | 1,300 | 1,243 | 43/98 = 43.9% |

Benthic EQR omissions are all **807 Poland** sites; phytobenthos **802 Poland + 77 Austria**. Original model rightly excluded those missing records, but incorrectly counted zero invalid normalized EQR due to pandas nullable Boolean NA propagation. A new NA-safe quality-count repair is committed on this branch, without changing fit sample selection or original model performance. This country/exposure-dependent coverage strongly limits geographical generalization of the original positive signal.

### 2. Independent agricultural nitrogen/phosphorus source coverage

[EEA Waterbase Emissions 2026 original inventory](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42438505287), [2022 source table](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42438695309), and [exact region/year source-to-BQE-site crosswalk](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42439118473). Official NP1 denotes diffuse agricultural emissions; values are in kg/a or t/a and reporting method is retained. Available 2022 NP1 total-P emissions are **modelled and reported by RBD or subunit**, not at local river-reach scale.

- Benthic river sites: only 142 with agriculture-P source from Lithuania/Netherlands, of which 20 are WWTP-source-positive.
- Phytobenthos river sites: only 184 with agricultural P source, from Lithuania alone, 20 WWTP-source-positive.
- No defensible multi-country agriculture-P-adjusted ecological prediction can be fitted; missing source values are NOT pollution-free zeros.
- [WFD 2022 significant-pressure source schema](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42438360158) also exists; its regulatory classifications may partly derive from ecological status itself and cannot simply serve as independent causal controls.

### 3. Exploratory conditional source-mass permutation

[Original 199-permutation × two null designs × two nutrients × two biological groups source-locked SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42439198765). Preserve source-positive/source-zero site identity, country, original held-out folds and for the stricter null river-flow strata, then permute only WWTP annual reported load amounts among originally exposed stations.

- **Benthic macroinvertebrates**: P and N observed source-load arrangement yielded a lower heldout MSE than **all 199** country-only and all **199** country×river-Q-stratified permutations for each nutrient (finite Monte Carlo extremeness 0.005). The original positive gains +1.10% P, +1.40% N thus include apparent information about reported LOAD MAGNITUDE beyond source registration, under this limited posthoc permutation design.
- **Phytobenthos**: country×Q null beat or tied original for P 42/199 (0.215), for N 2/199 (0.015). The original EQR predictive gain is just +0.16–0.18% and does not survive other geographical transfer sensitivity tests.
- This is explicitly **posthoc**, conditional exchangeability is unverified, and these are NOT causal tests, prospective significance claims or evidence distinguishing independently acting P from N (strong source P–N collinearity). Agriculture, urban runoff, hydrology, country-specific EQR scales and incomplete national source reporting are serious confounders.

### Immutable source evidence and limits

[Original source QC, 2022 agricultural regional source station crosswalk, source digests, conditional permutations and detailed audit](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/bqe2022-missingness-wfd-pressure-20261108/results/eea2022_bqe_falsification_20261108) committed; [independent archive integrity success](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42439431892). EEA full raw ZIPs are not rehosted; original chocho island/port/butterfly host results and gesui positive/negative findings are retained separately.

**Keep Draft.** Need independent crop/urban inputs on matched river/reach scale, original HydroRIVERS validation, independent monitoring countries/years and treatment/mixing evidence before claiming wastewater causes a biological change.
prs.title: 2022 aquatic EQR falsification: 63–73% source-positive EQR missing, sparse agriculture data, conditional load permutation

prs.body:
## Independent source-year temporal replication of 2022 benthic wastewater-load prediction

**Scientific novelty:** The preselected **2018** EEA UWWTD annual *measured* WWTP nitrogen/phosphorus loads were physically linked to original **2018** EEA Waterbase Biology river EQR, using entirely different 2018 original discharge reports from the earlier [2022 ecological study PR #14](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/14). Both 2018 biological monitoring sites and 5 regional heldout folds were fixed and committed BEFORE numeric 2018 EQR was opened; do **not** claim a prospective field experiment or causation.

### Strict source provenance and source-only sample lock

- [EEA UWWTD 2017–2018 Waterbase archived official v07/r01](https://sdi.eea.europa.eu/data/dbbccc77-ec41-4b19-8ec5-093bba1ba7a8) original 93.2MB/23 files [source inventory SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42440990345). 30 reporting countries and report year 2018; original `uwwNDischargeMeasured` and `uwwPDischargeMeasured` **separate from calculated and estimated fields**. Critical false-positive source counter from nullable pandas `.all()` fixed **before** 2018 EQR analysis: **2,507** plants with BOTH finite strictly positive measured annual N+P; 1,889 uniquely matched direct-FW discharge outlets in Europe study bbox. [Original measured source QC SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42441852933). Outer ZIP dynamically repackaged; original 23 inner CSV file CRC/size/source SHAs verified.
- [Source-only 2018 Biology site IDs/methods and 3-degree regional blocks SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42441464939): 2,944 benthic sites/15 countries, 2,971 phytobenthos/13 countries, fish 1,119/3 countries, *no original 2018 numeric EQR read*.
- Hash-locked HydroRIVERS EU third-party v1-derived network (original official topology not independently reproduced), source outlet ≤500m river snap, downstream-directed graph and ≤50km upstream path; same-reach source excluded for unknown ordering. **1,422** of 1,889 source outlets attached to source graph; 2018 BQE river source candidates: benthic **2,639** including **204** source-positive, phytobenthos **2,676** including **222** positive; fish only 3 positives fails predeclared group source test. [Physical source ONLY run SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42441999786).
- **Source-only cohort, original annual N/P loads, downstream negative controls, original 5-fold regional assignment and exact SHA permanently COMMITTED BEFORE any numeric 2018 EQR**: [independent frozen sample source and receipt](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/uwwtd2018-independent-bqe-validation-20261108/results/eea2018_independent_source_frozen_20261108), archive run [SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42442109868). [Original prespecified 2018 model protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/uwwtd2018-independent-bqe-validation-20261108/docs/EEA_UWWTD_2018_TEMPORAL_BQE_PREOUTCOME_FREEZE.md).

### Actual predeclared 2018 biological replication: positive for benthic invertebrates

**Original 2018 measured EQR** n**2,634** across **15 countries, 52 regions**, with 202 2018 measured WWTP source-positive stations and only five original-source EQR missing after geographic selection.

Original regional heldout fixed fivefold Ridge(alpha=10): M0 baseline lat/lon, log river mean Q, log drainage area, country and country×original BQE assessment-method; M1 add hydrologically upstream 2018 reported measured WWTP annual N or P mass; M2 add hydrologically physically *downstream* N/P mass placebo.

| Benthic 2018 EQR | M0 baseline heldout MSE | M1 upstream source MSE | M2 downstream placebo MSE | M1 relative MSE improvement |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Reported measured P annual load | **0.05291482** | **0.05239541** | **0.05274940** | **+0.9816%** |
| Reported measured N annual load | **0.05291482** | **0.05228501** | **0.05289798** | **+1.1902%** |

Both M1 beats M0 and its physically downstream placebo. Hence **the fixed independent-year temporal-prediction direction is reproduced**, matching the 2022 positive predictive result +1.10% (P) and +1.40% (N). Observed rank correlations between upstream reported WWTP load and in-river benthic biological quality are **negative**, ρ(P)=**−0.1314** and ρ(N)=**−0.1320**; **not wastewater improving biodiversity**.

### Cross-taxon boundaries and independent audits

- **Phytobenthos 2018:** 2,670 numeric EQR sites (220 exposed). Adding upstream P improves just **+0.0085%**, N **+0.1254%**, and the physically downstream placebo performs BETTER than upstream source for both. Predeclared temporal specificity criterion **FAILS**. Fish only two valid source-positive sites in two countries; no ecology model fitted.
- [Original 2018 real EQR model SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42442266935).
- [Independent separate-code, no-network SHA/audit of all four 2018 models for P and N, five source-only folds, original year source and site identities SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42442571053): 2018 positive MSE direction in benthic geographic blocks **36/52 for P, 35/52 for N**, but only 7/15 countries individually show improvement for P, indicating country heterogeneity. Among 202 observed exposed 2018 sites, source N/P masses are collinear (Spearman **0.767**), so N-vs-P biological mechanism is still **unidentified**.
- [Original 2018 observed source-aligned EQR site CSVs, fixed cohort receipts, source SHA, independent audit, complete per-country/regional diagnostics](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/uwwtd2018-independent-bqe-validation-20261108/results/eea2018_independent_temporal_bqe_20261108) are versioned permanently; original huge official EEA raw ZIPs remain with source publishers. A cross-year exact monitoring-site overlap and source-report change QC is additionally implemented (interpretation must distinguish temporal response from repeat observations on the same geographical sites).


### Posthoc exact monitoring-site overlap between source years

[Independent original-frozen EQR site and year-source identity comparison, SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42442841272), retained in [CROSS_YEAR_MONITOR_SITE_OVERLAP_AND_REPORTING_QC.json](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/uwwtd2018-independent-bqe-validation-20261108/results/eea2018_independent_temporal_bqe_20261108/CROSS_YEAR_MONITOR_SITE_OVERLAP_AND_REPORTING_QC.json). This audit is **posthoc descriptive**, and does not refit favorable ecology models.

- Benthic EQR: **1,167/2,634 (44.3%)** original 2018 biological monitoring sites reappear among the 2,475 original 2022 sites (47.2% of 2022 sites). Exactly **17/1,167** have a qualifying upstream registered measured WWTP source in **both years**; source report-presence transitions are 2018 absent→2022 present **7**, present→absent **4**, neither **1,139**. This is source eligibility, **not verified plant construction/closure or changing effluent dose**.
- Phytobenthos: **1,412/2,670 (52.9%)** original 2018 monitoring sites reappear in 2022; 12 source-positive in both years, 13 newly reported source-positive, 4 newly source-zero, 1,383 absent in both.
- EQR among shared benthic monitors in two years correlates strongly (Spearman rho **0.807**), as might be expected for persistent spatial/ecological and assessment-method variation. Exact biological assessment method code is unchanged in **1,148/1,167** shared benthic sites; original HydroRIVERS reach IDs match **1,167/1,167**. At the **same stations**, biological EQR differences are NOT an instrumented change in WWTP source exposure.
- Because the same EEA Biology 2026 source provider is used for both years and monitoring locations overlap materially, the 2018 vs 2022 finding is an **independent source/reference-year temporal directional replication**, **NOT a fully independent biological sampling cohort or causal before/after design**. Different national source reporting/source-available populations also mean observed P/N mass-site relationships are not directly comparable longitudinal interventions.


### Additional STRICT monitoring-site-disjoint cross-year model-transfer stress test (posthoc)

[Actual independent EEA 2018→2022 and reverse-site temporal transport, SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42443038497), original model/source result [committed with source hashes](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/uwwtd2018-independent-bqe-validation-20261108/results/eea2018_independent_temporal_bqe_20261108/SITE_DISJOINT_TWO_YEAR_MODEL_TRANSPORT_POSTHOC.json). **The transport test was designed after both year-specific original predictions became known, so it is strictly posthoc; it is not the predeclared year-2018 confirmation.** It uses exactly the original Ridge(alpha=10) country+assessment-method+hydrogeo model, original independent reporting-year load masses, no hyperparameter tuning, and **excludes every EEA monitoring site ID seen in training year from the opposite-year test set**.

| Benthic ecological EQR site-disjoint model transfer | Evaluation original EQR sites (registered upstream source) | +WWTP reported P mass MSE improvement vs transferred M0 | +N mass improvement | downstream-load placebo P/N gain |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Train 2018 → test **2022-only** sites | **1,308 (123)** | **+1.124%** | **+1.365%** | +0.544% / +0.519% |
| Train 2022 → test **2018-only** sites | **1,467 (181)** | **+2.578%** | **+2.095%** | +0.604% / +0.362% |

Thus a **separate measurement-year and EEA-site-ID-disjoint** evaluation shows a similar small source direction-specific information gain for benthic EQR, albeit not an independently pre-registered confirmatory validation. **Critical transport limitations:** 553/1,308 of the 2022-only test sites and 791/1,467 of the 2018-only test sites have country×assessment-method combinations unseen in the training year (handled by training-only OneHotEncoder unknown=ignore). National EQR scale and geography covariate shift remain very serious.

For phytobenthos, 2018→2022-only source transfer gains **P −0.042%, N −0.128%** (worse than baseline), while the reverse 2022→2018-only improves P +0.814%, N +1.173%; this directional inconsistency does **not** meet a two-way transfer generality criterion. A positive benthic prediction is not a nutrient-specific causal WWTP ecological effect, and source-positive eligibility / facility measurement method differ by reporting year.

### Interpretation and remaining falsifiers

**Two original reporting years, 2018 and 2022, provide a positive and small direction-specific predictive association between hydrologically upstream WWTP reported annual load and benthic-invertebrate EQR.** This is **temporal reproducibility** of *predictive information*, not independent geography/institution or proof that wastewater harmed or benefited fauna. Some sites can recur across years; EQR comes from the same 2026 Biology harmonized release. National assessment methods, historical reporting/source-registration selection, agricultural/urban nutrient stress, river engineering, seasonal flow and unknown actual pollutant delivery confound causal attribution; HydroRIVERS mirrored topology is not validated against official original data. Historic source population differs from 2022 (2,507 vs 5,492 both-measured positive WWTPs). No 2018 causal treatment or randomization, and measured source P and N remain collinear.

Preserve prior [2022 missingness and external agricultural-source limitations PR #16](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/16), separate [chocho](https://github.com/zuizui0223/chocho) island/port/butterfly-host positives, and the gesui older negative ambient-chemistry and plant-richness results independently. **Keep Draft, do not auto-merge to main or promote this into a sewage-nutrient mechanistic paper.**
prs.title: Independent 2018 WWTP N/P temporal replication of benthic EQR upstream prediction (+0.98–1.19%), source-frozen

## 2020 third-year source-only investigation — **NO 2020 biology/EQR result yet**

Continues [Issue #18](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/issues/18) as a **stacked Draft PR on the 2018/2022 source-frozen research branch**, preserving all original 2018/2022 positive and sensitivity findings.

### Scope and original-source discipline
- Search only official EEA public 2019–2020 UWWTD historical tabular sources, full provenance/HTTP access and archive/schema discovery.
- If a public original 2020 table is available, next verify actual plant-level **measured** annual 2020 N/P discharge mass, reporting year and unambiguous FW outfall. **Never** substitute 2018/2022 masses or treat missing as zero.
- Before accessing *any* 2020 biological EQR numerical outcome: freeze source-only station IDs, country × procedure classes, 3° geography, hydrological upstream ≤50 km P/N mass, downstream placebo, report-source coverage and pre-specified 50 sites / 5 country compatible-site gate.
- The script presently queries official publicly indexed EEA URLs only, not Biology/EQR source data; it records negative access findings rather than claiming an ecological effect.

### Reproducible provenance
- Probe: `scripts/gesui_probe_2020_official_uwwtd_sources.py`
- Workflow: `.github/workflows/gesui-2020-source-access-probe.yml`
- Manifest: `results/eea2020_source_only_20261108/OFFICIAL_2020_UWWTD_PUBLIC_SOURCE_ACCESS_GATE.json` once run.
- Original positive 2018/2022 results remain unchanged and unmerged: [PR #17](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/17); [PR #14](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/14).

**This branch makes no 2020 ecological prediction, performance claim or inference about wastewater causality until the source-only data can be independently checked and the pre-outcome freeze is committed.** Keep Draft; do not merge to `main` or alter `chocho`.

## Research branch: wastewater × Lycaenidae adult/larval life-stage discordance

**This is a hypothesis/source-interpretation Draft, not a measured wastewater × butterfly result.** No original `chocho` files or `gesui` main/benthic EQR models were changed.

### Existing verified positive, retained without causal inflation

Using exact public Git blob SHA1s at immutable `chocho` main commit `e8b8f86c7a889b6a3224a4ef69ffe5e0c7738660`, the audit reproduced the original 239-species host opportunity table and the original Lycaenidae family summary: **22/25 (88%)** lycaenid species have more reconstructed larval-host resource regions after introduced host distributions, versus preexisting 206/239 across all butterflies. Lycaenidae median added **73 units**. This is preexisting positive **potential host resource geography**, NOT new sewage benefit or actual butterfly occurrence.

Potential informative focal examples from original species table (illustrative/posthoc): `Lycaena phlaeas` **140→224 (+60%)**, `Polyommatus icarus` **128→207 (+61.7%)**, `Brephidium exilis` **242→267 (+10.3%)**. Extreme `Pseudozizeeria maha` 16→275 has original **host_taxonomy_lower_bound_adequate=False** and cannot anchor the main hypothesis.

[SHA-locked audit JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-wastewater-stage-contrast-20261108/results/lycaenidae_chocho_frozen_reference_20261108/CHOCHO_LYCAENIDAE_FROZEN_RESOURCE_AUDIT.json) — [successful workflow](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42446278997).

### New falsifiable ecological program

A key distinction from *naive* sodium-based puddling claims: Beck et al. 1999 tropical experiments found adult male Lycaenidae disproportionately attracted to **albumin/protein** compared with the NaCl preferences of many Papilionidae/Pieridae (PMID 28308154). This is not evidence that inorganic WWTP total N = bioavailable protein. Host plant nutrient enrichment can instead reduce larval survival (fertilization experiment incl. `Lycaena phlaeas`, PMID 30288608); some Lycaenidae also depend on mutualist/host ants (Pellissier et al. 2012 PMID 22725645).

**Mechanistic idea:** Adult puddling resource or water subsidy may rise while larval resource quality/survival fails or reverses; ant-associated species have extra potential constraints. All proposed wastewater mechanisms and ant responses remain *untested*.

A complete falsifiable program, data layers, prospective observation/effort checks, EEA 2022 source exposure versus actual chemical Na+/organic-N distinction, upstream/downstream/matched urban-river controls, and stop conditions are recorded in [LYCAENIDAE_WASTEWATER_STAGE_CONTRAST.md](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-wastewater-stage-contrast-20261108/docs/LYCAENIDAE_WASTEWATER_STAGE_CONTRAST.md).

**Do not** treat GBIF observation as puddling, 2022 reported N mass as lab-measured organic protein at a butterfly feeding substrate, a globally introduced host as butterfly breeding evidence, or all Lycaenidae as ant obligates. New sample/gate must be frozen before asking about actual WWTP effects. Keep Draft, do not merge into the `chocho` main manuscript.
prs.title: Lycaenidae × wastewater: adult protein puddling vs larval host quality and ant gates (source-locked legacy positives)
