## New independent exploratory cohort: previous-year Plantae-effort-screened 2022 Lycaenidae photo reporting near mapped WWTP river stations

**Stacked Draft on PR #20.** This is a new 5-km *landscape-level* accessibility/observation-effort test. The original 24 paired 1-km study failed its prior photo-support gate (1/24) and remains unchanged and reportable as such.

### Phase A — completed BEFORE either observational effort or 2022 butterfly outcomes
- Original no-numeric-EQR 2022 EEA BQE river station metadata SHA locked (blob `16f6b531e29ed09f070f9fb86f7d8feb899108ed`).
- Source labels: 2022 EEA reported measured both-positive N/P from hydrologically upstream qualifying WWTPs within 50 km vs **no registered qualifying source**, which is NOT wastewater-free.
- Matched stations with identical country/3° geographic block, river flow and catchment area preference, nonoverlapping 5-km buffers (≥10-km separation); cap 16 pairs/country and 96 globally, no butterfly or plant observational outcomes used.
- **78 pairs / 156 stations across 10 countries fixed**: AT13 BE2 FR4 HR5 IT16 LT6 LU2 NL9 NO5 PL16. [Source-only workflow SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42453851208).

### Phase B — explicitly prespecified before any 2022 butterfly queries
- Independently query only **2021 Plantae** public/photo georeferenced, research-grade iNaturalist counts within 5 km at every fixed station. This is an imperfect prior-year citizen-science sampling-opportunity proxy, not a measure of plant biomass, nutrient enrichment, or butterflies.
- A source pair qualifies with ≥8 2021 plant-photo records at **both** stations and smaller/larger count ratio ≥0.20. Rank passing pairs solely by smaller 2021 plant-photo count, fixed source ID tie-breaker. Take at most 32 pairs, ≤8 per country.
- Need ≥12 pairs across ≥3 countries before stage C is allowed. Any API failures are NA, not biological absence; retain all fixed originally eligible/failing pair-level source records.

### Phase C — coded but **not executed** until Phase B frozen
- Same 5-km circle and year 2022, verified official Lycaenidae, Pieridae, Papilionidae IDs, researcher-grade photo/open GPS ≤500 m. Count observer photo *records*, not butterfly individuals or behavior.
- Require ≥5 photos among these three families **on both sides of a matched pair** and ≥12 photo-qualified pairs across ≥3 countries to report descriptive paired Lycaenidae photo-reporting-share differences. No ecological claim or causal significance without independently measured urban, nutrient form, wetland habitat, observer effort, and larval hosts.
- Separately verify genuine visible puddling actions by photo annotation before claiming adult feeding; the mixed iNaturalist observation field #17428 and text keyword `puddling` are not behavior-validated.

[Prospectively written detailed protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-effort-rich-river-cohort-20261108/docs/LYCAENIDAE_2022_PRIORYEAR_PLANT_EFFORT_SCREEN_PROTOCOL.md).

**Crucial:** even a positive association would mean only butterfly *photographic reporting share* at landscape scale, not wastewater causing butterflies, nor puddling or larval nutritional benefit. The preexisting `chocho` 22/25 potential larval-host resource expansion is retained with its separate biological estimand. Keep PR Draft, do not merge into `main` or revise `chocho`.
prs.title: Lycaenidae × wastewater: 78→17→4 source/effort/photo cohort and open SeBMS 2022 proximity gates (Draft, no causal effect)

prs.body:
## New independent 2022 Norway/Flanders public BMS × official measured WWTP N/P, strictly PRE-outcome

**Stacked Draft PR** on #21. Finds and audits openly available standardized national monitoring sources, retaining exact source-year geography, public licences, real source year mass, and observation hierarchy. **No butterfly species/count outcomes, puddling behavior, or numerical EQR responses have been read.**

**Positive data-quality advance:** Original 2022 Norway NINA CC-BY data contain **4,411** Event rows (4,199 public precise 5m points) corresponding to **70 independent original Lucas grids × 20 original 50m sections each**, not 1,400 independent replicates. All 70 have ≥2 repeat dates; 68/70 have three dates. This is source-sha-locked to original publisher public DwC-A. 2022 Flanders INBO CC0 has **3,573** Event rows but all published site GPS uncertainties are **7,071m** under protected public UTM generalization; no exact near-outfall source comparison can be performed without access to original fine data.

**Same-year original WWTP source verification:** EEA 2022 original public data, 5,492 plants both measured positive N/P + 24,416 outfalls, deduped by full reporter+plant key and exactly one original FW outlet. **43 Norwegian** official `NO_UWWTD_2022` FW outfalls and **15 Belgium** official `BE-2022` FW outfalls confirmed from source-side fields and geography, without inspecting butterfly outcomes.

**Physical proximity support:** Source-frozen independent Norway grid centroid ± full original 50m-section footprint ± 5m published GPS. Strict ≤2km **0/70** near; prespecified sensitivity ≤5km **2/70** near (one county); registered source remote ≥10km **63/70** (seven counties). **Both prespecified gates FAIL** the ≥10 near / ≥10 far across ≥2 shared counties requirement. Do **not** open butterfly species counts, compute a source-associated Lycaenidae effect, or interpret failure as no biological wastewater effect.

The existing `chocho` Lycaenidae 22/25 introduced-host potential resource expansion remains independently positive but **not wastewater**; likewise earlier 2018/2022 `gesui` aquatic EQR prediction gains remain separate.

[Full source-gate report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-norway-belgium-ebms-source-20261108/results/lycaenidae_norway_flanders_2022_source_only/RESULTS_AND_PREOUTCOME_SOURCE_GATE.md)

Provenance: [original public Event source QA](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42455632989), [independent Lucas unit validation](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42455790667), [EEA source and spatial gate](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42455925114).

**Keep Draft**, do not merge source-only work into `main` or change `chocho` until a genuine fine-location, repeated, supported sample and independent chemistry/land-use controls are available.
prs.title: 2022 Norway & Flanders BMS Event-only sources × real EEA WWTP: 70 independent grids, 43 outfalls, support gate

prs.body:
## Germany/Austria 2022 source-only handoff after successful Norway/Flanders support audits

**Stacked Draft PR** onto #22. This changes only source-discovery/documentation, official EEA public outfall source-data audit, and UNSENT research data-request templates. **No butterfly species outcomes, individual abundances, adult puddling images, protected transect locations or numeric EQR scores accessed.**

### Executed original-source findings

1. **Official GBIF dataset registry**: 12 predefined search terms; 101 distinct public metadata records. One Germany-published SAMPLING_EVENT candidate with title *DNA metabarcoding data of arthropods captured with different traps in the southwestern German agricultural landscape*, **not standardized butterfly transect monitoring**. **Zero 2022 DE/AT butterfly Event-core archives verified** in the bounded metadata search; this does *not* demonstrate no data exist, and official TMD/eBMS details are governed by a separate permission procedure. [Metadata workflow SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42457612371). [Frozen registry QC](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-de-at-public-event-discovery-20261108/results/lycaenidae_de_at_2022_source_only/GBIF_PUBLIC_DE_AT_BUTTERFLY_EVENT_DATASET_REGISTRY_QC.json).
2. **Official 2022 public EEA UWWTD source provenance**: original REST 5,492 WWTPs with `uwwNDischargeMeasured>0` and `uwwPDischargeMeasured>0`, 24,416 discharge points. Exact full reporter + facility join; exclude multiple outlets, all non-FW destinations and invalid coordinates. Source-validated **DE `DE_UWWT_2022`: 630 freshwater facilities/outfalls; AT `AT_UWWTD_2022`: 526; total 1,156**. This is public reported measured **annual outfall load**, *not* protein/Na/nutrient chemistry in a butterfly feeding substrate, nor year-individual laboratory sampling verified.
   - [Original EEA source QC GitHub Actions SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42457798469).
   - [Public 1,156-site FW outfall coordinate and N/P manifest](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-de-at-public-event-discovery-20261108/results/lycaenidae_de_at_2022_source_only/EEA2022_DE_AT_PUBLIC_BOTH_NP_MEASURED_ONE_FW_OUTFALLS.csv), SHA256 `926ab310904be048d5d36bbfebd5eabfe0b318279800142f2e2a86bee924f4ce`.
   - [Detailed provenance and reporter-code/source quality receipt](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-de-at-public-event-discovery-20261108/results/lycaenidae_de_at_2022_source_only/EEA2022_DE_AT_PUBLIC_WWTP_NP_SOURCE_QC.json).

### Next *real* dependency, ready for user-reviewed outreach

[**Two complete unsent privacy-safe source-only coordination requests**](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-de-at-public-event-discovery-20261108/docs/LYCAENIDAE_DE_AT_2022_BMS_SOURCE_FEASIBILITY_UNSENT_REQUESTS.md) are prepared for:
- German **Tagfalter-Monitoring Deutschland (UFZ/TMD)**;
- Austrian **Viel-Falter**, with explicit historical 2022 caveat (national 400-site expansion was 2023; existing 2018+ regional programmes only).

They ask coordinators to *internally* compute **aggregated independent 2022 repeated-visit sites within ≤2 km, ≤5 km, and remote ≥10 km of public EEA original FW outfalls**, by suitable geographic region, without releasing sensitive transect coordinates or butterfly species/counts. Prespecified feasibility gate retained from source-only #22: ≥10 independent near and ≥10 remote sites in at least 2 common subregions, with 2 dated visits and ≤500m original site/route location uncertainty. Results not yet available, and without them no species-level outcome should be opened.

**No email sent.** An attempted Gmail draft creation was not authorized, so no Gmail draft was saved; the full unsent templates are committed to this Draft PR for review. Recipient addresses must be verified from official contact directories, never invented.

All prior positive `chocho` Lycaenidae 22/25 *potential host resource geography* and `gesui` 2018/2022 benthic EQR source-specific prediction gains are retained unchanged. Nor is the old 1km/5km photo support failure or 2022 Norway source-support failure overwritten. Keep Draft/unmerged.
prs.title: 2022 DE/AT Lycaenidae source-gate: 1,156 verified EEA FW outfalls, open-event audit and UNSENT TMD/Viel-Falter requests

prs.body:
## New independent DE/AT 2022 *landscape photographic reporting* test of Lycaenidae vs WWTP source intensity (Draft)

**This is a new 1° geographic, observational source-associated photo-*reporting* question** nested under the already completed 2022 1km/5km butterfly photo and standardized Norway/Flanders support failures. **Not** a rescue sensitivity, causal wastewater effect, direct protein/sodium puddling, larval host quality or actual butterfly abundance test.

### Prospective source/effort freeze, verified BEFORE any 2022 butterfly photo-query

- Prior official original 2022 EEA reported *both-positive measured* N/P WWTP + exactly one direct freshwater outfall, published coordinates, **DE 630 / AT 526** sources. All **53** previously source-frozen public 1° WGS84 geographic cells (DE32 / AT21), spanning all source count intensities, were declared as the cohort. Original 1,156-outfall manifest SHA256: `926ab310904be048d5d36bbfebd5eabfe0b318279800142f2e2a86bee924f4ce`.
- Exclude all non-Germany/Austria adjacent-country butterfly observations from cross-border geographic cells using separately confirmed official iNaturalist place IDs **Germany=7207, Austria=8057**; original Plantae kingdom taxon **47126**. That country-source restriction is not an inference about habitat.
- Independent **2021**, strictly non-butterfly *Plantae* publicly georeferenced research-grade/photo/≤500m original iNaturalist counts retrieved at **all 53 cells**. **52/53** satisfy prospectively fixed ≥40 2021 plant-photo records, with DE32 / AT20, **22 country×2° blocks**, qualifying all 3 predeclared EEA source-count bands in both countries. **Source/nonfocal effort gate passed and is already GitHub committed**. All public requests completed successfully. [Official 2021 nonbutterfly source audit SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42462421091). [Full 2021 source/effort response-blind manifest](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-de-at-2022-landscape-source-photo-20261108/results/lycaenidae_de_at_2022_macro_source_photo/2021_PLANT_ONLY_SOURCE_AND_EFFORT_GATE.json).
- [Full predeclared ecological/photo measurement protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-de-at-2022-landscape-source-photo-20261108/docs/LYCAENIDAE_DE_AT_2022_MACRO_REPORTING_ASSOCIATION_PREOUTCOME_PROTOCOL.md) was committed before opening 2022 butterfly response data.

### Separate 2022 photo-response study

Prospectively fixed 2022 April–October public iNaturalist **taxon descendants** Lycaenidae 47923, Pieridae 48508, Papilionidae 47223 photo-source counts at exact same country×1° source cells. Target = Lycaenidae / sum of these three families' **photo records**, NOT abundance/individuals/confirmed adult puddling. Minimum ≥20 three-family photos per grid, ≥25 qualifying cells total, ≥10 per country and ≥10 independent country×2° blocks. If fails, STOP before fitted effect model.

If supported: exploratory OLS on cell log-odds of Lycaenidae photographic share, source-count log1p normalized within country, controlling for independent 2021 plant photo effort, latitude, longitude, country; report source P and N annual mass in separate models, country-specific Spearman, 2° block resampling and highest-source-cell exclusion. No outcome-driven radius/source bands/season changes. Independently measured urban/rural land-use and observation effort are still missing and prevent attributing any fitted spatial coefficient to sewage chemicals.

Current source scripts:
- `scripts/gesui_2021_de_at_plantae_effort_before_butterfly.py` — completed/pinned nonfocal gate.
- `scripts/gesui_de_at_2022_lycaenidae_photo_share_after_source_gate.py` — coded before execution; references committed source gate.
- `.github/workflows/gesui-de-at-macro-2022-butterfly-photo-reporting.yml` — original public source count execution, results archived to `results/lycaenidae_de_at_2022_macro_source_photo/`.

**Guardrails:** All original chocho 22/25 potential host resource positives and 2018/2022 gesui EQR predictive positives preserved, old local photo sample failures still reported, no main merge, no false wastewater/Lycaenidae causality. Keep Draft.

## New 2021 ESA WorldCover categorical raster *land-use confounder* test of 2022 DE/AT Lycaenidae photos (explicitly POSTHOC)

**Stacked Draft on #24.** WorldCover original 2021 categorical COG over original Natural Earth 50m DE/AT land masks is a legitimately independent environmental-data update. **The analysis is posthoc (2022 WWTP/photo positive association already seen), not independent confirmatory causal evidence.**

### Original source-only QA, executed and committed BEFORE this new landcover-adjusted model
- ESA WorldCover 2021 **v200 original 10m *categorical* 3° COG** raw class pixels (40 cropland, 50 built-up, 80 water, 0 NoData), anonymous public AWS HTTP-range windows at 512×512 per one-degree cell, not WMS RGB images.
- Natural Earth **50m country boundaries**, source SHA256 `3e458fc036ad0a66411f2c1e6cac49c5d7bfb81cb1123bc513b22511a2b7fdeb`, exclude cross-border pixels, surface water and NoData. Weighted by cosine of latitude for approximate country terrestrial class area.
- **All original 53** source-positive DE/AT country×1° cells read from **11 original COGs**, 48/53 pass preregistered ≥5% country terrestrial coverage/≤5% original NoData; all 53 pass 512×512 vs 256×256 classification resolution sensitivity. Country land source QA [SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42464211489). Original 2022 photo supported 44 cells; only **one original source cell** excluded due predeclared 0.94% German land fraction; new comparable **43 cells (DE28/AT15), 22 country×2° blocks**. Exact source and photo SHA audited.

### Posthoc 2° region-heldout changes on exact SAME 43 cells

**Baseline no-WWTP (2021 Plantae photo effort, coordinates, country)** MSE **0.195713**. Adding **independent WorldCover 2021 built fraction, crop fraction and country terrestrial land area** reduces baseline heldout MSE to **0.156538 (+20.02%)**.

| EEA 2022 reported source addition | Before landcover, same43 source MSE improvement | After independent landcover |
|---|---:|---:|
| Registered WWTP count | +3.90% | **−1.52%** |
| Annual reported measured N mass t/year | +4.55% | **+8.03%** |
| Annual reported measured P mass t/year | +16.56% | **+13.67%** |

P+landcover model MSE **0.135137** versus its exact landcover baseline **0.156538**. Country breakdown DE+**10.44%**, AT+**24.81%**. Original WorldCover 256-pixel alternative P+**12.36%**; excluding each country's maximum original P source mass cell P+**11.02%**. **Source count no longer provides predictive increment after land cover**, consistent with its being a settlement/vegetation/recording proxy.

### Explicit spatial falsifiers (do not omit)

- Original source P mass vs 2021 WorldCover built share: Germany ρ+**0.423**, Austria ρ+**0.568**. Built and agricultural pattern still confounds wastewater source geography.
- **199 country-preserving shuffles** of P source values: observed P gain is greater than most shuffled sources, tail **0.005** (not randomized exposure).
- **199 within-original-country×2° shuffles**: tail **0.350**, so fine 1° source assignment is **NOT distinguishable from 2° regional spatial structure**.
- 999 bootstrap draws of original 22 source-block CV error grouped samples: descriptive P-gain 95% interval **[−14.18%,+33.04%]**, includes zero/no gain. Original P/N annual source-mass correlation ~0.888.
- Therefore **no proof of local wastewater-driven P effects on butterfly numbers, adult mud-puddling, ants, host plant performance or nutrient chemistry**; the response is country×1° public iNaturalist family **photo recording share**. Independent butterfly observer effort, source reporting, urban/crop heterogeneity below 1°, host plant populations and actual substrate protein/sodium/nutrient chemistry are missing.

**Reproducible originals:**
- [Source-only ESA WorldCover 2021 53-cell quality](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-worldcover2021-urban-crop-20261108/results/lycaenidae_worldcover2021_source_only/ESA_WORLD_COVER_2021_DE_AT_ALL53_COUNTRY_MASKED_SOURCE_QC.json)
- [Heldout 43-cell landcover vs source P/N/count, original bootstrap/permutations](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-worldcover2021-urban-crop-20261108/results/lycaenidae_worldcover2021_source_only/2022_LYCAENIDAE_ESAWC2021_DE_AT_URBAN_CROP_LANDAREA_POSTHOC_BLOCKCV.json)
- [WorldCover-adjusted predictive test GitHub Actions **SUCCESS**](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42464582745)
- [Full explicit scientific and QA report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-worldcover2021-urban-crop-20261108/results/lycaenidae_worldcover2021_source_only/RESULTS_AND_WORLDCOVER2021_LANDCOVER_FALSIFICATION.md)

**Do not merge to main or modify chocho manuscript**. Previously retained `chocho` Lycaenidae 22/25 added *potential* host-resource geography and aquatic benthic EQR independent 2018/2022 prediction stay separate. Local 2022 butterfly photo proximity sample support failures remain failed. Next potential **posthoc** test is prior-year 2021 butterfly photo composition in exactly same regions to test stable observer/landscape confounding; this would still not identify a sewage effect.

prs.body:
## 2021 historical Lycaenidae photographic reporting explains much of the original 2022 P-source geographic prediction (posthoc, noncausal)

**Stacked Draft PR onto #25**. This is a **POSTHOC source- and date-locked historical photographic reporting test**, **not** a new pollution experiment or eBMS population/behavioral result. Keep original positives and limitations together.

### Full new public source, frozen before this year's comparison fit
- Reused exactly **43 original 2022 DE/AT country×1° EEA source-positive 2021 WorldCover country-clipped quality-supported photo cells**; no location re-selection.
- Official public iNaturalist 2021 April–October photographed, research-grade, geographically open records with ≤500m source uncertainty, country place IDs Germany7207/Austria8057, descendant taxa Lycaenidae47923/Pieridae48508/Papilionidae47223. All **129/129** official API count queries succeeded; original public source URLs + response SHA pinned, no photographs/user IDs downloaded.
- **2021 original 3-family photo records among all 43 cells:** Lycaenidae **2,237**, Pieridae **1,768**, Papilionidae **353**, total **4,358**. Prespecified historical sample support ≥15 photo-records in ≥30 source cells, DE≥18, AT≥9, at least 12 2° blocks: **42/43 cells** pass (DE**27**, AT**15**). Source original photo count file was Git-committed BEFORE temporal model. [Historical 2021 public source acquisition SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42465101895).

### New same-42 source-cell historical comparison

- 2021 and 2022 Lycaenidae public photographic recording log-odds at identical original source areas correlate: **Pearson r +0.514**, **Spearman rho +0.511**. These are *photos*, not actual populations or adult feeding events.
- 2° country-spatial-block heldout OLS (training-only scaling, same 42 photo-eligible cells/WWTP source values, country, lat/lon, 2021 original ESA WorldCover built/crop/land and 2021 Plantae photo-effort baseline):

| Original source outcome/model | Heldout baseline MSE | +2022 EEA reported source P MSE | source-P incremental gain |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2022 family photo composition, landcover/geography/2021 Plantae photo effort | 0.158674 | 0.142221 | **+10.37%** |
| 2022 family composition with **2021 same-site Lycaenidae photo composition and 2021 3-family observer photo opportunity** also included in baseline | 0.155528 | 0.149778 | **+3.70%** |
| 2021 historical family composition using 2022 P-source geography and landcover control | 0.258837 | 0.280651 | **−8.43%** |

The source-P gain after history is **DE +1.37%, AT +8.75%**. The originally positive 2022 spatial recording signal **shrinks substantially** after accounting for persistent previous-year local butterfly photo composition/effort.

**Important caution:** An EEA-reported 2022 effluent mass may arise from infrastructure present for years, so 2021 is NOT a confirmed no-WWTP exposure/negative intervention. These analyses cannot isolate source P chemistry, butterfly abundances or adult puddling. The use of actual 2021 butterfly family history is a **posthoc observational reporting-stability test**, not preregistered independent ecological confirmation.

[Full original source/quality and scientific result report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-prioryear-butterfly-composition-20261108/results/lycaenidae_2021_prior_butterfly_photo_source/RESULTS_AND_HISTORICAL_2021_COMPOSITION_FALSIFICATION.md) · [2021→2022 same-region blocked CV SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42465437203).

All prior source-only local 1km/5km photo support failures, official 2022 Norway/Sweden/Flanders standardized BMS near-source inadequacy, original 2021 WorldCover landcover-adjusted +13.67% 43-cell posthoc P photo predictive improvement, `chocho` introduced-host *potential* resource geography 22/25 Lycaenidae, and `gesui` 2018/2022 benthic EQR predictive gains remain separate and unchanged. Do not merge Draft into `main` or infer sewer-P-caused butterfly benefit.
prs.title: Prior-year 2021 Lycaenidae photo composition explains much of 2022 WWTP P reporting signal (+10.4%→+3.7% OOS, posthoc)

prs.body:
## 2023 public butterfly-photo new-year falsification of the original 2022 WWTP P-source geography

**Nested Draft PR on #26 (2021 historical photo study); no `main` merge or `chocho` change.** This is a separately committed, **explicitly POSTHOC** new-year source-coverage and geographical prediction test designed after the 2022 P-reporting association was known. Its exact 43 source-positive EEA2022/WorldCover2021 land-QC cells, photos/geo-quality requirements, April–October 2023 window, ≥20 family photo support gate and same-group heldout baseline were fixed **before reading new 2023 photo family counts**. It is **not** new 2023 WWTP discharge chemistry, adult feeding or observed butterfly abundance.

### Source and cohort verified

- Official original public iNaturalist observations (aggregate `total_results` only), Lycaenidae taxon47923, Pieridae48508, Papilionidae47223, original Germany/AT country ID and country×1° bounds, georeferenced/photographed/research-grade/noncaptive/accuracy≤500m. All **129/129** 2023 family-count queries succeeded on the immutable **43** original 2022 land-QC-valid cell geography.
- **42/43** country×1° cells met photo-count support (DE27 / AT15), **22 country×2° original regional holdout blocks**, same historical 2021 photo data support. Photo observations on these same 42 cells: **2021 Lycaenidae2237 / all three families4356**, **2022 Lycaenidae2988 / all5714**, **2023 Lycaenidae2926 / all5780**. These are photos/reporting events **not organisms/population counts**. Original 2022–2023 photo log odds spatial correlation Pearson **+0.5877**, Spearman **+0.5856**.
- [2023 original public source/QC SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42465810381).

### Same 42 cells / same 22 original 2degree-region heldout 2022 P-source predictive comparison

Identical 2021 WorldCover categorical original land-cover, previous-year 2021 Plantae photo effort, geography and country baseline; source addition *2022* EEA official reported annual P source mass at original qualifying direct FW outfall locations:

| Photo year and baseline | + original EEA2022 P-source relative 2° block-heldout MSE improvement |
|---|---:|
| Predict **2022** Lycaenidae photo-recording share without previous butterfly photos | **+10.37%** |
| Predict **2023** Lycaenidae photo-recording share without previous butterfly photos | **+5.19%** |
| Predict **2023** photo share with **2022 Lycaenidae photo share AND 2022 total butterfly-family photo recording** already in baseline | **−7.41%** (both DE −7.91%, AT −5.81%) |

The source P geography can predict some cross-sectional photographic record composition, but its extra predictive information for 2023 **fails and worsens prediction** when the prior year's photographic butterfly community/recording opportunity is already known. In prior #26 2021 historical comparison, the original source P also worsened predicting 2021 photo share (−8.43%); 2022 photo share with 2021 Lycaenidae previous composition/effort reduced P's extra improvement from +10.37% to +3.70%.

**Ecological interpretation:** These data support mainly a persistent **geographic photographic recording/community composition** component rather than a proven 2022 wastewater-P biochemical effect. Do **not** interpret 2023 or 2021 as untreated counterfactuals: a WWTP officially reported in 2022 may have already operated for years and does not represent known year-2022 exposure change. Still no direct water-substrate protein/sodium, larval resource fitness, ant partner, observer-time or actual Lycaenidae census. Standardized WWTP-near butterfly spatial sample continues to fail its local support gates, retained unchanged.

**[Full result and methodological/falsification archive](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-2023-photo-time-negativecontrol-20261108/results/lycaenidae_2023_photo_temporal_source/RESULTS_AND_2021_2023_FALSIFICATION_REPORT.md)**

- [2023 same-geography 129/129 count source SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42465810381)
- [2023 original source-locked 2° heldout and prior-year community control SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42466025267)
- Original `chocho` Lycaenidae 22/25 introduced-host **potential** resource geography and original `gesui` 2018/2022 aquatic EQR prediction results preserved, not conflated.

**Keep Draft**, explicitly treat as a new *posthoc* falsification, and do not merge into the original `chocho` manuscript or advertise wastewater causing butterflies.

### 2026-11-09 follow-up: exact same 42 cells × three-year P-source photo-composition differencing (**strictly POSTHOC**)

This directly reuses *all already source-locked* 2021, 2022, 2023 photographed family counts, original 2021 ESA WorldCover/independent Plantae recording effort, and identical **2022** reported WWTP P-source geography. No new butterfly or sewage measurements have been collected; 2022 reported P is **not** a time-varying exposure. It tests whether the earlier positive photo-share level is accompanied by a robust year-to-year change, not a WWTP treatment effect.

- Same **42 country×1° cells / 22 country×2° groups** (DE27, AT15), with 2021/2022/2023 Lycaenidae photographs respectively **2,237/2,988/2,926** out of all 3 family's **4,356/5,714/5,780**.
- Adjusted same-source P mass slopes of Lycaenidae photo-share log odds: **2021 +0.061** (descriptive 2° block 95% −0.232 to +0.208), **2022 +0.154** (−0.022 to +0.283), **2023 +0.116** (−0.097 to +0.231). 2022 coefficients are a **new balanced-panel estimate**, not replacements for original 44-cell +0.186.
- Source-mass slope for **2022−2021 photo-share change +0.093** (−0.092 to +0.324); **2023−2022 −0.039** (−0.208 to +0.113); **2022 minus mean of adjacent years +0.066** (−0.085 to +0.241). All cross zero in 3,000 deterministic block bootstrap draws, despite LOO block sign retention.
- **Family-composition caveat:** 2022 Pieridae −0.083 (−0.255 to +0.099); Papilionidae −0.232 (−0.486 to +0.077). The three-photo-family denominator sums to one, so the Lycaenidae positive is **not** independently established family-specific population benefit.
- **Decision:** retain a bounded positive landscape *photographic reporting* association in 2022, but no demonstrated wastewater-induced temporal Lycaenidae increase or biologically supported P→river TP→adult/larva mechanism. Do not present this as a treatment-time DID, independent confirmation, or null biological effect.

**New independent reproducible audit SUCCESS**: [GitHub Actions 42615147981](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42615147981) · [SHA-locked result JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-2023-photo-time-negativecontrol-20261108/results/lycaenidae_2023_photo_temporal_source/2021_2023_POSTHOC_FIXED_2022_WWTP_P_FAMILY_DIFFERENCING_AUDIT.json) · [full interpretation and reproducibility](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-2023-photo-time-negativecontrol-20261108/results/lycaenidae_2023_photo_temporal_source/POSTHOC_THREE_YEAR_P_SOURCE_DIFFERENCING_AND_FAMILY_COMPARATORS_20261109.md). Existing original PR outcomes are retained unchanged.


### 2026-11-09 spatial falsification: WWTP source P and Lycaenidae photo-composition between vs within 2° regions (POSTHOC)

[Source-locked replay SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42616805707) · [Full original-source report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-2023-photo-time-negativecontrol-20261108/results/lycaenidae_2023_photo_temporal_source/POSTHOC_LYCAENIDAE_2DEG_WWTP_P_SCALE_DECOMPOSITION_20261109.md) · [JSON: source hashes, coefficients, 4,000 cluster bootstraps and 3,999 source shuffles](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-2023-photo-time-negativecontrol-20261108/results/lycaenidae_2023_photo_temporal_source/POSTHOC_2021_2023_LYCAENIDAE_SOURCE_P_WITHIN_BETWEEN_2DEG_AUDIT.json).

This **strictly posthoc** audit reuses exactly the 42 original 2021–2023 photographed DE/AT country×1° cells and reported **2022** WWTP-P source mass. There are 22 country×2° blocks, only 11 with more than one photo-eligible 1° cell (**31 within-identifying cells**).

- **2022 between 2° group means** P→Lycaenidae relative photographic log-odds, controlled for country/geography/plant photo effort/WorldCover built/crop/area, coefficient **+0.2036**; country-stratified group bootstrap descriptive 95% **[−0.0603, +0.4598]**, 22/22 group-LOO estimates positive, but interval crosses zero.
- **2022 within 2° groups**, raw P coefficient **+0.0212**, adjusting same independent land/observation variables **−0.0430**; group-bootstrap 95% **[−0.2780, +0.3776]**, within-block source-label shuffle diagnostic 2-sided fraction **0.702** (not randomized causal p-value). With within-region latitude/longitude added it is **+0.0080** with a wide zero-overlapping interval.
- **2021–2023 photo year mean within-block** adjusted P slope **−0.1073** [−0.2847, +0.0958]. Independently evaluated 2022 within-block N and source-count slopes were also not positive after adjustment. This is a compositional photograph endpoint, not a biological census.
- Different between- vs within-block models/uncertainty, only 11 usable multi-cell regions, and fixed same **2022** reported P for all years rule out a causal WWTP treatment-time claim.

**Decision:** preserve original 2022 P source-positive coarse spatial photographic relationship, but the same dataset does **not support a positive finer within-region association** or demonstrated local wastewater/larval/adult mechanism. This does not disprove a real wastewater butterfly effect; it limits claims possible from this observational frame. Remains Draft/unmerged; unrelated chocho resource-geography results and gesui aquatic EQR evidence are retained.
prs.title: 2023 DE/AT Lycaenidae photo reporting: 2022 WWTP-P predictive gain +5.2% → −7.4% after last-year photo share (posthoc)

prs.body:
## New 2022 EEA WISE6 **actual measured river Total Phosphorus** × publicly reported WWTP P × Lycaenidae photo composition bridge (Draft)

**Completed November 9, 2026.** Source-original actual independent 2022 river water quality, not just WWTP annual discharge masses, was obtained and measured at 184 qualified monitoring station-years across DE/AT. The complete resulting **source-area environmental pathway does NOT support** the previously proposed causal narrative. All model comparisons are observational geography and explicitly POSTHOC relative to prior source-photo positives. **Not evidence that particular upstream WWTPs cannot elevate TP**: actual directed hydrological connectivity between individual outlets and original water-quality sites has **not** been built.

### Actual official original sample evidence, with pre-numeric source gates

- Previously frozen original 2022 WWTP 1,156 qualified unique reported measured N/P direct-FW outfall sources, DE630 / AT526, and original historical 2021–2023 country×1° Lycaenidae/Pieridae/Papilionidae public photographic reporting source area frame.
- Original full EEA Waterbase Water Quality ICM **2026**, 2,024,284,753 compressed byte **DisaggregatedData** source ZIP, original SHA256 `2a2ef2a43a16ec068b7974a80ae5fca49e44697660a46ce3b91fb1813abe62d2`. Official original 36,043,700,357 byte WISE6 individual CSV, **102,569,057** measurement rows *streamed*. Explicitly original 2022 river water Total-P CAS_7723-14-0, **mg{P}/L**: DE3,690 and AT1,281 original sampled measurements.
- **BEFORE reading any TP numerical concentrations** a source-only station/date census with original country+station ID+scheme and NaturalEarth50m boundary was committed and confirmed **187 sites** across previously fixed 42 DE/AT photo cells, **38 1° cells** with ≥2 actual 2022 river-TP stations, **DE23 / AT15**, 21 country×2° blocks. Strict source gate ≥20 (DE≥10 AT≥6 and ≥10 spatial blocks) **PASSED**.
- Then source-gated first numerical read: **184/187** sites satisfy ≥4 quantified distinct 2022 sample dates in ≥3 months, below-LOQ ≤50% and no belowLOQ imputation. **2,471** original at-site TP sample rows, **53 belowLOQ** measurements excluded, 3 of 187 rejected. Original median of **daily medians** per station, then equal station-year median per 1° cell. Original **38** cell median measured TP range **0.0049–0.200 mg P/L**, median **0.0615 mg P/L**. The 38 1° region TP numeric sample-support gate remains PASSED.
- [Original source-only national WISE6 TP measurement dates & 187-station eligibility SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42572788975).
- [Original individual WISE6 TP numeric, LOQ, 184-site medians SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42574036643).
- [Numeric-opening and hypothesis rules committed before TP numerical values](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-2022-measured-river-P-source-20261109/docs/LYCAENIDAE_EEA2026_NUMERIC_TP_OPENING_AND_CROSS_LAYER_GEO_CV_LOCK.md).

### Real 2022 river TP physical concentration link does NOT support proposed WWTP-P mediated Lycaenidae pathway

Country×1° **source-positive** (not treated-vs-untreated) photographic reporting/TP geographic cells, **38** total and **21 original country×2° spatial-block holdouts**. Baseline in environment: country, lat/lon, **independent ESA WorldCover2021 built/crop/land fraction**; response `log1p(real observed river TP mg P/L)`. Add each WWTP reported P/N annual source mass, or original unique WWTP count, separately. Photo-response baseline also adds **2021 Plantae observation opportunity, 2021 Lycaenidae photo share and 2021 total butterfly target-group photos**. All train-only centered/scaled; no geographic test-fold leakage.

| Source predictor / new measured TP relation | Out-of-region MSE improvement (positive=better) | Descriptive block prediction-error bootstrap 95% |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| **WWTP 2022 reported P t/year → observed 2022 river TP** | **−10.22%** | [−17.52%, −0.68%] |
| WWTP 2022 reported N t/year → observed 2022 river TP | **−10.83%** | [−26.31%, +4.84%] |
| Number qualified WWTP outfalls → observed river TP | +3.59% | [−10.10%, +16.12%] |
| **Observed 2022 river TP → 2022 Lycaenidae photo reporting share** | **−10.38%** | [−25.04%, −1.42%] |
| **Observed 2022 river TP added AFTER 2022 WWTP P source to photo model** | **−14.04%** | [−32.38%, −1.08%] |
| Original WWTP P source added to historical/land/photo baseline for 2022 photo share (same 38 cells) | +7.59% | [−32.77%, +32.79%] |

By country, unadjusted WWTP P mass vs actual 2022 TP rank Spearman **DE −0.282 / AT +0.604**, and TP vs Lycaenidae photographic log-odds **DE −0.223 / AT +0.418**. Thus no country-consistent chemical-photographic association emerges at this unit. Source P photographic association persists weakly but is not robust to 2° prediction-error region resampling and not explained by observed in-river TP.

[**Actual three-layer measured riverTP/WWTP P/Lycaenidae geographic block CV SUCCESS**](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42574919214).

### Accurate mechanism boundary / next unresolved condition

This is **not a formal mediation test**: summing facility load and monitored river concentrations in the *same broad country×1° geographic cell* does **not** guarantee that any particular EEA outfall drains upstream into the sampled river reach. TP in river water is not sodium/protein in adult puddling substrate, and iNaturalist family **photo-recording composition is not organism population size**. A legitimate physical source→receptor test must use **directed river network upstream/downstream, 2022 source-report site ids, river flow/dilution and actual water-station IDs**, then separately validate butterfly photo/behavior or standardized censuses. The original EEA2026 `resultObservationStatus`/expert-QC flags are **not yet audited beyond LOQ/date validity**, so current numerical source remains preliminary for formal publication.

## Same-directed-river WWTP-before/after real 2022 WISE6 TP monitoring: SOURCE-ONLY feasibility study

**New stacked DRAFT from gesui PR #28's directed river source analysis.** This is explicitly POSTHOC relative to known 2022 WWTP P vs butterfly photographic reporting geography. No observed TP concentration value was used to select stations or river paths, and no butterfly photographs/individual abundance/puddling behavior have been inspected.

### Stage A completed and frozen: true same-flowline original monitoring pairs, ≤50km

Reused already SHA-frozen 187 original 2022 WISE6 river TP source-qualified monitoring stations, of which 174 have unambiguous original public 500m snaps onto the original pinned third-party converted HydroRIVERS EU v1 directed network (original SHA256 `5e6327c6dd34a81bd7768d840f25c0569d4361b7e078065a97214563bd01b32f`, **not** independently byte/topology verified against original HydroRIVERS).

Exactly 79 **same-country, different-reach, directed upstream-to-downstream** monitoring station pairs are within original full-reach-route sum ≤50km. Greedy shortest-network-path and SHA-order, with no repeated source stations, returns **36 independent candidate pairs**: **DE21 / AT15** in **15 original country×2° regions**. This passes the prespecified ≥10 independent, ≥3 each DE/AT, ≥4 spatial blocks Stage-A geographic sample gate. The source record also reports all 79 candidate original site hash IDs and connected directed reach/length chain metadata.

**Important:** 26 of the 36 had a larger *registered upstream source count* at the downstream monitor, but this source-count difference is **NOT proof that a WWTP outfall physically lies between the two sites**: original source counts have 50km windows and tributary/same-reach ordering issues. We do not claim 26 intervention pairs.

[Stage-A original network candidate source-only verification SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42582467073), [fully inspectable source-only candidate geometry and sampling gate](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/wise6-2022-TP-same-river-site-pair-feasibility-20261109/results/wise6_2022_same_river_stationpair_sourceonly/2022_WISE6_TP_SAME_DIRECTED_RIVER_50KM_SOURCE_ONLY_PAIR_GATE.json).

### Stage B: genuine EEA original 2022 direct-FW discharge outlets strictly BETWEEN monitoring reaches

The source-outlet follow-up is written to restore exactly the same original 5,492 both-positive measured N/P UWWTD plant rows and 24,416 outlet records, check all 31 original EEA source REST page SHA receipts (matching original previously completed river-source work), and link original direct-FW outfalls to river reach IDs with 500m snap. For each real station pair, it classifies an outlet as **strictly between** only if its original directed path merges into a reach *internal* to that monitor-to-monitor path, never merely the same upstream/downstream monitor reach where order is unknown. Tributary inflows joining an internal reach are separately counted. Potential sources on either monitor reach or first entering the downstream monitoring reach are flagged **ambiguous**, not called source-zero.

**Predeclared Stage-B go/no-go**: ≥8 site-disjoint real-intervening-original-WWTP pairs and ≥8 site-disjoint no-qualifying-registered-intervening-source/no-ambiguous-reach controls, from two countries across ≥4 original 2° regions. No site may be used in more than one selected pair; choose source-zero controls first based on original source-only reach distance and hashed site ID, then source-confirmed pairs. Exact source-only results are to be archived before any new within-pair numeric TP comparison. Fail retains sampling findings and DOES NOT trigger a paired ecological effect model.

If later Stage B passes, only then compare the previously independently QC-qualified source-locked 2022 original measured water TP site-year medians within fixed pairs. A positive source source-to-river TP difference would still NOT identify butterfly adult protein/sodium feeding, larval effects or wastewater causality without field substrate/host/detection data.

### Existing evidence retained, not altered

The previous 171-station 2022 actual WISE6 TP + original HydroRIVERS modeled Q/WorldCover vs strictly upstream reported WWTP P source test gave **−1.84%** original 2° heldout MSE gain, downstream P negative control **−2.23%**; strict original 9 meta-U station exclusion (162 sites) upstream P **−1.68%** and downstream P **−2.62%**. The original `chocho` **22/25** potential introduced-host resource geography expansion remains a separate positive unrelated to sewage.

Original gates required ≥5 quartets/4 blocks for 2km, or ≥4 quartets/3 blocks for 5km, and all four arms with ≥5 prior Plantae photos and min:max ≥0.15. **Both failed.** We did **not** request the 2022 Lycaenidae/Pieridae/Papilionidae outcomes or calculate any butterfly effect.

**Observation-heterogeneity audit:** source versus registered-zero difference of mean log1p prior plant photo records across original eight quartets was +0.705 (2km, exact signflip fraction .3125) and +0.293 (5km, .6641); this is observational effort/plant documentation, not a causal ecological effect. Original photo availability is highly heterogeneous, making direct local butterfly source-effect inference inappropriate.

[Full source-locked report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-2022-WISE6-directed-quad-photo-support-20261109/docs/RESULTS_LYCAENIDAE_WISE6_DIRECTED_QUARTET_PREBUTTERFLY_SOURCE_GATE_20261109.md) · [Original 64-query public source retrieval SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42624332297) · [Independent offline replay SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42624963127) · [SHA/source/32-site aggregate JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/lycaenidae-2022-WISE6-directed-quad-photo-support-20261109/results/lycaenidae_2022_wise6_directed_32_station_photo_sourceonly/2019_2021_ORIGINAL32_2KM_5KM_PLANT_ONLY_PREBUTTERFLY_GATE.json).

**Scientific boundary:** the original positive source-P versus Lycaenidae *coarse photographic composition* remains intact. This new physically directed 32-site effort audit cannot establish or reject a biological wastewater effect, adult puddling, or larval host improvement. Source-zero means no **registered qualifying** intervening WWTP, not pristine waters. Keep **Draft**, unmerged; do not change chocho or gesui main.

## New independent source/observation opportunity test — 2026-11-10

**Strictly source-locked before any NEW 2022 butterfly photo response, exploratory POSTHOC relative to prior Lycaenidae × annual WWTP-P 1° photo positives. No Lycaenidae/Pieridae/Papilionidae photo result was opened.**

### Original nationwide source frame (not chosen on butterfly responses)

Reused complete original EEA2022 UWWTD reported N/P and converted HydroRIVERS WISE6 DE/AT **115** same-directed-river monitoring pair candidates. Selected Germany solely because it alone has source-positive and unequivocal *no qualifying registered interposed source* controls:

- Original **73 Germany river pairs** (33 with confirmed qualifying interposed freshwater outlet, 40 registered qualifying sourcezero, not wastewater-free).

[Original 73 pair / 100 station SHA source lock SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42728062401).

Only **21/73 original source pairs** pass each-arm ≥5 photographs, within-pair min:max ≥.15 and two circles nonoverlapping: 9 source-interposed + 12 registeredzero. Source-photo-supported, four-arm independent 3° matched quartets **2** across 2 regions; nationwide distinct selected pairs **4 source + 8 registeredzero**, 3° class-overlap **1**. **Both pre-outcome gates FAIL.**
- **5km:** 100 station prior photo records min/median/max **0/40/2,622** (1 zero). **35/73 original pairs** pass: 14 source +21 registeredzero. Distinct 3° matched four-arm quartets **5** across 3 regions; nationwide distinct selected pairs **8 source +15 registeredzero**, only **3** 3° regions have both statuses. **Both gates FAIL** (quartets required ≥8/3 regions, national pairs ≥10 each and other spatial requirements). Larger radii cannot rescue inference after the fact.

Annual effluent source mass is not measured local protein/sodium availability, N/P exposure, host plant performance or butterfly population. No cause, no sign, and no puddling behavior inferred.

**Decision:** Stop tuning 2/5km circles in these same data. An independent next research frame must use genuinely standardized repeated butterfly transect/15-minute survey events with valid source-to-receptor spatial positions, biological/observer effort, measured substrate chemistry and hosts. ## Independent Denmark standardized butterfly count panel × original 2022 EEA reported WWTP outfalls (Draft, POSTHOC)

**First actual 2023–24 eBMS individualCount contrast, not citizen-science photo share.** Original Denmark eBMS v1.4 licensed CC-BY-NC DwC-A SHA fixed, source/visit/spatial support and blinded GBIF scientificName family mapping all frozen and successful BEFORE reading any original family individual counts. Fixed 2022 EEA DK2022 official qualifying freshwater both-positive reported N/P source has **203** outfalls in national Danish envelope (older **69** was Sweden-box clipped; correction before counts audited). Relative to already-known German photo positive this entire study is exploratory, not a pre-registered causal test.

### Source-only independently verified eligibility
- Original Event 15,606 rows, Occurrence extension 21,617 rows; all original Event/Occurrence joins **100%**, 107 repeated 2023/24 site coordinate groups with >=2 distinct dates in both years and original positional uncertainty <=500m.
- 2022 registered source distance: <=2km **0 sites** (STOP); <=5km **23 public site-coordinate rows**, remote >=10km **38**; original >=3 one-degree regions with both => **5km source gate PASSED**.
- Critical pseudoreplication: 23 near site rows are only **4 distinct WWTP-outfall clusters** (7/7/5/4); remote38 are eight spatial groups at 0.5km. Source site is not actual biochemical exposure or 23 independently exposed source systems.
- Original GBIF species mapping before counts: Lycaenidae 21, Pieridae 7, Papilionidae 1 accepted species; 2023/24 original 214 site-year target-family count panel fully source-audited.

### New measured individualCount—no replicated positive

| Standard survey year | <=5km source near Lycaenidae/(Lyca+Pieridae+Papilionidae) | >=10km remote |
|---|---:|---:|
| 2023 | **74/202 = 36.63%** | **387/742 = 52.16%** |
| 2024 | **34/185 = 18.38%** | **494/975 = 50.67%** |

Lycaenidae individuals per original survey day near vs remote **2023 0.7255 vs 1.0238**, **2024 0.1553 vs 0.8006**. These are pooled descriptive unadjusted observations, not 4-source independent samples or significant WWTP effects. Papilionidae had **zero** recorded individuals in the qualified original 107-site panel, so the 3-family numerator is effectively a Lycaenidae/Pieridae comparison. Near source sites with any three focal-family records: 11/23 (2023), 18/23 (2024); remote28/38 and31/38.

**Source-region fixed comparison (three 1° cells):** 2023 2 of 3 near source cells have zero counts of all three focal families, so no three-region/year effect is estimable; the third region Lycaenidae near-vs-far log-odds **−1.038**. 2024 three cells estimable: site-equal within-region log-odds differences **+0.622, −0.474, −1.658**, 3-region equal mean **−0.503**, leave-one-region-out [−1.066,+0.074]. Signs heterogeneous; one apparent positive region has **zero Lycaenidae near counts**, continuity correction caution. No confirmatory p or causal effect justified.

**Scientific conclusion:** the former positive *DE/AT iNaturalist photo composition geography* **does not replicate as a positive standardized Denmark butterfly-count signal**. This does not mean sewage harmed butterflies: 2022 static registered effluent report is not actual 2023/24 downstream butterfly substrate exposure, only **four independent WWTP-near outfalls**, species–host/ant ecology, land use and urban recording differences unresolved. Do not alter source radius after the results; no substantive causal WWTP effect established.

### Full independently verified receipts

[Complete original 2023/24 standardized count and scientific interpretation report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/ebms-denmark-wwtp-source-feasibility-20261110/docs/RESULTS_DK_EBMS_2023_2024_LYCAENIDAE_ACTUAL_COUNTS_WWTP_DISTANCES_20261110.md)

- Four source-outfall clusters prior to effects SUCCESS run [42757948325](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42757948325)
- Blind GBIF family taxonomy SUCCESS run [42758342905](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42758342905)

- Independent source-locked count replay SUCCESS [42759571075](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42759571075)

This is a **Draft nested research PR**, no main/chocho merges. Preserve prior German original positive photo and other geochemically source results, distinguish object-level effect and observation effort.

prs.body:
## POSTHOC Denmark eBMS 2023–24 same-calendar-month repeat-site audit

**New source-locked, independently reproduced sensitivity of existing Danish standardized individualCount results, not a wastewater treatment effect.** Keeps all previous DE/AT positive photographic associations, DK annual descriptive negative comparison, and their scientific caveats untouched.

- Original Denmark eBMS v1.4 CC-BY-NC 4.0 archive SHA fixed; 15,606 Event records and 21,617 Occurrence records independently rejoined at original calendar month and **exactly reproduced all 214 source-locked site-year family sums and survey-day counts**. Only matched-calendar-month aggregate summaries were archived, not occurrence records or observer IDs.
- Fixed 107 repeated 2023/24 public monitoring sites, 23 at <=5km from 2022 EEA reported qualifying WWTP freshwater outfalls (just **four independent near-source outfalls**), 38 remote >=10km; original 2km support gate stays failed. All matched-site months are those surveyed in *both* 2023 and 2024 at the same site.
- **2023 -> 2024 Lycaenidae survey counts:** near **73 in 95 distinct visit days -> 20 in 134**, remote **386 in 372 days -> 437 in 346**. 2024/2023 per-visit rate ratio near **0.194**, remote **1.217**, near/remote change **0.160**. May–August sensitivity **0.158**.
- Family negative/control comparisons relative annual rate ratios: Pieridae **0.458**, Nymphalidae **0.994**, Hesperiidae **0.419**. Lycaenidae is not the only family with a relative decline. Original Papilionidae records are absent in the focal panel.
- Only **two** of the four near-outfall groups had any 2023 Lycaenidae counts (44 -> 17; 29 -> 2); the other two are 0 -> 1 and 0 -> 0. Leave-one-outfall-out relative year rate ratios **0.048–0.237**, all below 1, but 4 correlated source units and nonrandom exposure cannot justify a confirmatory p-value or wastewater causality.
- The 2022 EEA reported source presence/mass is time invariant across 2023 and 2024, site-distance is not real river downstream exposure, and matched months do not remove habitat, exact flight phenology, other family population heterogeneity or observer/urban confounding.

### Inspectable results / reproducibility

- [Full new ecological result and limits](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2023-24-season-aligned-families-20261110/docs/RESULTS_DK_EBMS_2023_2024_SAME_SITE_MONTH_SOURCE_CLUSTERS_20261110.md)

- [Independent arithmetic QC](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2023-24-season-aligned-families-20261110/results/ebms_denmark_2023_2024_WWTP_source_only/DENMARK_2023_2024_SAME_MONTH_ORIGINAL_FAMILY_INDEPENDENT_REPLAY_QC.json)
- [Licensed original source SHA-locked re-run SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42762375670); [independent stored-aggregate replay SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42762613405).

**Scientific conclusion: only a descriptive source-proximity by-year signal in 2023–24 standardized observations; NO causal claim that wastewater harmed or benefited butterflies.** Keep Draft, do not merge into main or chocho.

prs.body:
## Denmark EBMS 2025 source-locked out-of-time Lycaenidae and publication completeness (POSTHOC Draft)

The original **107 2023/24 sites** and 2025 survey opportunity were frozen in an independently successful Event-only run **before reading 2025 family counts**. The licensed Denmark eBMS v1.4 archive remained byte-identical (CC-BY-NC 4.0, ZIP SHA256 `2cc64ec352754223db06a92eef5b01803968eac94bae34057c17f1abdb6da79b`); all 214 previously verified 2023/24 site-year accepted family counts and visit dates were replayed unchanged. Source is static original **2022 EEA registered** WWTP geography (203 national qualifying outlets), *not* year-varying wastewater exposure or treatment.

### Original pooled out-of-time direction (2025)

- Same 23 sites within **5km** of original qualifying outfalls (only **FOUR independent near-outfall clusters**), 38 remote sites >=10km, and 46 intermediate sites; 2km original source gate remains failed.
- Lycaenidae original 2025 accepted individualCount **95 / 198 original Event visit days = 0.480 per day** near, **585 / 577 = 1.014** remote; conditional focal three-family count share **95/(95+148) = 39.1%** near versus **585/(585+324) = 64.4%** remote. Both fixed descriptive **near-lower** directions persist from 2023/24, not proven WWTP effects.
- **Opposite temporal result to sustained decline:** 2024->2025 near Lycaenidae rate **0.155 -> 0.480 (3.09x)** vs remote **0.801 -> 1.014 (1.27x)**; near/remote year rate-ratio ratio **2.441x**. Original source-locked site and month sensitivity: common-2024/2025 calendar-month ratio **2.294x**, May–Aug **2.095x**. Do not claim monotonic sewage-driven decline.

### Major independent original Event-to-Occurrence quality check

- Original DwC-A Event core (15,606 rows) and Occurrence extension (21,617 rows) joined on original core IDs. In **2025 near-source** original 215 Event rows, only **113** had any published Occurrence row; **8/23 site-years had none**. In 2025 remote, original 706 Events, **301** had any Occurrence; **6/38 sites had none**. Events without extension rows **cannot be assumed valid zero-butterfly detections**.
- Critically **one complete registered near-WWTP group of 7 repeated site-coordinate rows / 28 original 2025 Events had zero linked Occurrence rows**. That outfall group provides no verified 2025 presence/detection information; 2025 results cover **at most 3 near-source groups with actual 2025 occurrence publication**.
- Strict **posthoc** documented-opportunity same-site sensitivity: retain sites with >=2 distinct dates containing ANY original Occurrence in both 2024 and 2025, giving **14 near / 27 remote**. Original linked-days near **112 -> 112**, Lycaenidae **34 -> 95**, remote **300 -> 292**, Lycaenidae **494 -> 585**. Near 2025 count/share **0.848 per linked day and 39.1%** remains below remote **2.003 and 64.6%**; near/remote 2024->2025 recovery ratio **2.297x**. This any-Occurrence filter is also a selection-biased observational reporting proxy, *not* true detection probability.
- The stricter all-three-year repeated linked-day sites are **10 near and 26 remote**; trend is nonmonotonic, with near Lycaenidae per linked date **1.276 -> 0.330 -> 0.979** (2023/24/25) and remote **1.559 -> 1.675 -> 2.049**. The source status never varied, so these cannot identify change in WWTP effluent dose.

### Decision and inspectable records

Retain both pooled full original Event-day and linked-Occurrence-day results. **Do not interpret absent original Occurrence records as biological zero**. Denmark standardized repeat data show a multi-year *relative family recording difference*, but 3–4 source clusters, publication missingness, geographic nonrandom exposure and no true hydrologic dose cannot establish a positive OR negative causal wastewater effect. Earlier DE/AT photographic positives remain intact and are not independently confirmed in Denmark.

- [Full report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2025-outoftime-lycaenidae-20261110/docs/RESULTS_DK_EBMS_2025_OUTOFTIME_AND_EVENT_OCCURRENCE_MISSINGNESS_20261110.md)
- [Original preoutcome 2025 source gate SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42763653472)
- [Original licensed 2025 family source replay SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42764050376)
- [Original Event-to-Occurrence publication missingness SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42764322441)
- [Independent posthoc linked-day aggregate sensitivity SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42764730112)

Remain **Draft**. No merges to `main` or the independent `chocho` paper, no raw individual records republished.
### 2026-11-10 additional season × ORIGINAL published-Occurrence-link QC (independent run)

**New original licensed archive rejoin, strict POSTHOC after all 2025 outcomes were observed.** Every matched site-month now must have >=1 original Event date with **ANY published Occurrence extension** in BOTH 2024 and 2025. Denominator is the original distinct date linked to at least one published occurrence, never an Event-only day with unknown reporting. Original 15,606 Event and 21,617 Occurrence archive rows, SHA, original source geometry and 2025 site-year accepted family totals all reverified.

- **2024 vs 2025 same-site/same-calendar-month with published records:** 15 near sites, 28 remote. Original Lycaenidae counts/day near **32/97 -> 95/105**, remote **489/280 -> 579/275**. Near 2024->2025 per-linked-day rate ratio **2.743**, remote **1.206**, ratio-of-rate-ratios **2.275**. Despite rebound, 2025 near source rate **0.905** remains lower than remote **2.105**.
- **May–August only with same qualification:** near/remote rate-ratio-of-ratios **2.185**. At <=5km only **3 independently identified WWTP outfall groups** retain any published 2025 records; leave-one-outfall-out 2024->2025 relative ratios **1.965–2.426**. These are descriptive checks, not WWTP treatment experimental replication.
- **Stricter 2023/24/25 same calendar month with published records all three years:** 11 near sites, 27 remote, but only **TWO independent near source systems**. 2024->2025 ratio-of-ratios **3.843**, and no independent population-level or sewage causal inference is possible.
- A separate stricter >=2 published-Occurrence-linked dates in BOTH 2024 and 2025 (14 near/27 remote) independently yielded **2.297**. The exact sample size and estimates vary because these posthoc observation-opportunity definitions are distinct and can select on biological recording effort. **Do not interpret as unbiased detection correction.**

[Updated original-source report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2025-outoftime-lycaenidae-20261110/docs/RESULTS_DK_EBMS_2025_LYCAENIDAE_OUTOFTIME_AND_EVENT_COMPLETENESS_20261110.md) · [original Event+Occurrence same-month licensed aggregate](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2025-outoftime-lycaenidae-20261110/results/ebms_denmark_2023_2024_WWTP_source_only/DENMARK_2025_SAME_MONTH_OCCURRENCE_LINKED_FAMILY_SENSITIVITY.json) · [independent stored-source arithmetic QA](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2025-outoftime-lycaenidae-20261110/results/ebms_denmark_2023_2024_WWTP_source_only/DENMARK_2025_OCC_LINKED_SAME_MONTH_INDEPENDENT_QC.json) · [original source replay SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42765483684) · [independent QC SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42765741358).

**Causal and effective-sample verdict UNCHANGED:** near-source Lycaenidae recorded rate is lower in 2025 but relative rebound from 2024 is observable; just 3 (or 2 under three-year same-month) near outfall systems with documented outcomes, no receiving-water dose, no verified zero at absent original Occurrence, no wastewater-induced direction identified. Keep Draft without retuning radii or changing original source frame.

prs.body:
## Denmark EBMS 2025: entirely NEW 399 sampling sites after excluding earlier 107, wider 20-WWTP source frame and denominator/region inversion

**Original NEW-site eBMS individualCount data, explicitly exploratory/posthoc after older German 2022 photographed positive and older Danish standardized count results. Not a wastewater nutrient-dose experiment, nor source randomized treatment.**

### Pre-2025 butterfly outcome stage (succeeded, independent and source-hash committed)

- Licensed original Denmark eBMS v1.4 CC-BY-NC 4.0, original SHA256 `2cc64ec352754223db06a92eef5b01803968eac94bae34057c17f1abdb6da79b`; 15,606 complete Event and 21,617 complete Occurrence rows. Species-to-family accepted GBIF taxonomy was blind-frozen before earlier source outcomes.
- Source-only 2025 Event metadata: 506 sites with >=2 visit days, <=500m coordinates; **exclude all prior 107 analyzed sites**, retain exactly **399 new**. Original WWTP source remains 203 original official registered 2022 DK2022 positive measured N/P one-freshwater-outfall sources; near <=5km, remote >=10km. Nearest original 20 distinct WWTP IDs for new 2025 sites; outfall 5km connected group count 19 before observer support.
- Read ONLY original Event IDs and matched Occurrence coreid (no butterfly taxon/counts) before outcome: original new399 has 100 near, 127 remote, 172 intermediate; at least 2 dates with any original published Occurrence row leaves **70 near, 92 remote, 124 intermediate**, six same-1° geographic blocks with both source classes and **17** near outfall spatial components. Source-only response-access gate PASSED and was committed before any new 399 family counts.

### What the independent original butterfly-family 2025 counts actually show

| Observed quantity | Near registered WWTP <=5km (70 new sites) | Remote >=10km (92 new sites) |
|---|---:|---:|
| Original documented survey days | **539** | **757** |
| Lycaenidae individuals | **382** | **644** |
| Pieridae individuals | 680 | 2,602 |
| Nymphalidae individuals | 3,822 | 3,544 |
| Hesperiidae individuals | 372 | 192 |
| Lycaenidae / documented original date | **0.709** | **0.851** |
| Relative Lycaenidae share **3-family** (Lycaenidae+Pieridae+Papilionidae) | **36.0%** | **19.8%** |
| Relative Lycaenidae share **5-family** (plus Nymphalidae+Hesperiidae) | **7.27%** | **9.22%** |

**Scientific positive is entirely compositional:** pooled THREE-family odds ratio near/far **+2.270**, yet Lycaenidae records per documented date are **LOWER near** (rate ratio 0.833), and including the other available butterfly families flips to FIVE-family pooled odds ratio **0.772 (near lower)**. Only 0 Papilionidae individuals in these two strata, so the active four reported family categories explain the denominator switch.

### Six-region sensitivity and effective WWTP source units

- At same original country×1° region, the near 3-family proportion is higher in **2/6** region comparisons; the five-family near proportion is higher in only **1/6**. Equal-region geometric mean OR (near/remote) **0.908 for 3-family**, **0.404 for 5-family** (pooled 3-family OR 2.270). Site-equal within-region family log-odds comparison similarly gives 3-family OR **0.547**.
- Six-region 10k bootstrap descriptive 95% for three-family logOR **[-1.308,+1.313]**, five-family logOR **[-1.727,-0.061]**. Not a source-randomized interval; small six-region, posthoc denominator and geographic confounding prevent an independent WWTP effect claim. 3-family leave-1-region-out OR **0.520–1.494**, direction unstable; 5-family leave-region-out **0.297–0.553**.
- Only **17 registered near-WWTP point-source 5km spatial components** after original publication gate; original 92 remote site points themselves form only **19 geodesic 5km components**. Source site rows are not independently dosed environmental units.
- Remote top five **Pieridae-recorded** sites account for **1,321/2,602 (50.8%)** of remote Pieridae individuals. Excluding these *outcome-ranked* high-count sites posthoc changes 3-family pooled OR from **2.270 to 1.260**, illustrating concentration, not an alternative confirmatory comparison.
- The OLD 107 original 2025 sites (excluded from this new study) have near/remote **3-family** Lycaenidae fractions **39.1/64.4% (near LOWER)** and **5-family** **7.14/14.58% (near LOWER)**. New399 sample reverses the three-family comparison, while five-family near-low direction recurs in both disjoint site-coordinate cohorts. Some WWTP source IDs overlap; not independent treated WWTP replications.

### Decision, falsification and inspectable receipts

Do not claim sewage improved or harmed Lycaenidae: 2022 EEA source geometry is not 2025 actual wastewater chemistry or hydrologically downstream larval/adult exposure. Observer/taxon selection, habitat/urban source correlations, year phenology, source clustering and denominator conditioning can all shift direction. This is a **robust quality/falsification finding about spatial aggregation and family-composition endpoints**, not an ecological source effect. No radius/time/outcome thresholds tuned after opening new399 counts. Original positive DE/AT citizen-science photographs and older Denmark time course kept unchanged.

- [Complete original-source study, all counts, methods, limits](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2025-new399-source-coverage-20261110/docs/RESULTS_DK_2025_NEW399_LYCAENIDAE_3VS5FAMILY_SIMPSOn_SOURCE_REPLICATION_20261110.md).
- [Original source-only site and publication support SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42767545683).
- [Full frozen-taxonomy accepted family individualCount SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42768171519).
- [Region/source-component/posthoc leverage numerical calculation SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42768830966).
- [Independent region and original 107-exclusion verification SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42769157021).
- [Independent 3-vs-5 family denominator sign verification SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42769550575).

**KEEP DRAFT**, no changes to gesui main or independent chocho manuscript. Only privacy-safe licensed aggregate data, hashes and code committed.
### Independent second original 399-site family-count parser: zero disagreements

The original NEW399 source-only sample and blinded GBIF family mapping were re-processed using a **separate Python original Event/Occurrence reader** and a fully independent offline audit rather than relying exclusively on the previously successful original family-count workflow. Across **399/399 distinct original site IDs**, source band, nearest registered source ID, 1degree region, 5km and 10km source component, all original Event dates, all published-Occurrence-linked dates, and **every one of the SIX accepted butterfly family individual counts** matched EXACTLY (**0 mismatches**).

Independently calculated from the second source-locked pipeline: Lycaenidae per documented date near/remote **0.83308**; pooled Lycaenidae 3-family near/remote odds ratio **2.26971**; same original observations with five-family comparator **0.77173**. Across the **six matched 1degree regions**, geographically equal-weighted odds ratios are **0.90798** (3-family; positive in 2/6 regions) and **0.40446** (5-family; positive in 1/6).

[New standalone source and method QA report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2025-new399-source-coverage-20261110/docs/RESULTS_DK_2025_NEW399_LYCAENIDAE_DENOMINATOR_AND_SCALE_SIGN_REVERSAL_20261110.md) · [Independently parsed original eBMS counts and original source SHA](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2025-new399-source-coverage-20261110/results/ebms_denmark_2023_2024_WWTP_source_only/DK_EBMS_2025_NEW399_ORIGINAL_FAMILY_COUNT_BEFORE_DISTANCE_CONTRAST.json) · [Final exact original 399×6 source/family/region audit JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2025-new399-source-coverage-20261110/results/ebms_denmark_2023_2024_WWTP_source_only/DENMARK_2025_NEW399_TWO_ORIGINAL_PIPELINES_EXACT_AND_DENOMINATOR_SIGN_QA.json) · [Source original additional parser SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42769441143) · [Independent final arithmetic QA SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42769955628).

**No substantive inference upgrade from these checks**: repeated parsing of the same original CC-BY-NC licensed dataset is **not an independent biological replication**; an additional source-proximate negative/positive WWTP effect is still not demonstrated. Strictly descriptive, multiple posthoc denominator comparisons, no actual 2025 effluent-to-butterfly exposure; preserve the sign reversal and stop chasing a preferred sign.
### Added 2026-11-10: calendar month × 1° region-matched 2025 NEW399 sensitivity

The original licensed Denmark eBMS v1.4 Event/Occurrence archive was independently re-read on the frozen NEW399 and 286 2+-published-date sites, matching all prior **399×5 family counts** and original unique observation dates EXACTLY. This seasonal/geographic robustness is **POSTHOC after the 2025 pooled 3-vs-5 sign was known**. It is not another independently observed biological replicate.

- Source-only original country×1° region × calendar month stratum included if **BOTH near<=5km and remote>=10km had at least 2 dates with ANY published Occurrence**. Six 1° regions, **32** shared strata (May–Aug: **24**), source near/remote documented dates 446/521 (May–Aug: 374/440). Within each source/stratum, recorded original family individuals divided by original documented dates, then both source classes weighted identically by MIN of the two source groups' documented dates. This is overlap-day weighting **NOT equal region weighting**, and not a wastewater exposure correction.
- **ALL shared months**, source-date-balanced 2025 near/remote Lycaenidae absolute recorded rate **0.709**; **3-family Lycaenidae-share OR 1.819 (positive)**; **5-family OR 0.586 (negative)**. May–Aug **0.733 / 2.042 / 0.598** respectively. Thus the denominator sign reversal survives geography and calendar-month support matching, but absolute recorded Lycaenidae does not increase near.
- Six source region-cluster 4,000-resample **descriptive** 95% intervals for the ALL-months ratios: absolute Lycaenidae **[0.204,1.250]**, 3-family OR **[0.368,6.234]**, five-family OR **[0.263,1.167]**. **All include 1; not confirmatory or randomized tests.** Six-region leave-one-out 3-family OR **0.738–2.573** (crosses 1), five-family **0.399–0.720**. Compare to earlier EQUAL-1°-REGION weighted 3-family OR **0.908**, opposite date-overlap weighted **1.819**. Both are correctly computed DIFFERENT spatial weights and show inference is not stable to observational estimand choice.
- The new month×region parser and a **SEPARATE independent offline arithmetic implementation** agree exactly for all 32/24 source-matched strata, all 5 family rates, odds, 6-region LOO and source SHA. These checks are method verification, not independent biology.

[Full updated study report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2025-new399-source-coverage-20261110/docs/RESULTS_DK_2025_NEW399_LYCAENIDAE_3VS5FAMILY_SIMPSOn_SOURCE_REPLICATION_20261110.md) · [Month/region source licensed original aggregate](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2025-new399-source-coverage-20261110/results/ebms_denmark_2023_2024_WWTP_source_only/DENMARK_2025_NEW399_1DEG_MONTH_MATCHED_LYCAENIDAE_3VS5_FAMILY_QC.json) · [Independent offline arithmetic/source audit](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2025-new399-source-coverage-20261110/results/ebms_denmark_2023_2024_WWTP_source_only/DENMARK_2025_NEW399_REGIONMONTH_3VS5_INDEPENDENT_QA.json) · [Original re-read SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42772627586) · [Independent audit SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42772945381).

**Bottom line remains negative for causal inference:** no measured 2025 wastewater-to-butterfly nutrient pathway; observational source distance is static, 6 regions and source clustered localities, published Occurrence date selection, original 5-family composition and regional weighting all limit generalization. Keep Draft/no merges.

**Draft, strictly POSTHOC** after the old Germany/Austria 2022 photographic-positive and 2025 Denmark NEW399 composition reversal were known. The 2022 reported wastewater source does not establish 2025 nutrient dose, downstream transport, or an experimental butterfly outcome.

### New independent source-only environment measurement, no butterfly data in extraction stage

- Original NEW399 2025 eBMS frame, old107 previously examined sites excluded. Original 286 sites with >=2 calendar dates linked to any published Occurrence (70 WWTP-near<=5km; 92 remote>=10km; 124 intermediate), originally source-frozen BEFORE this external habitat extraction.
