- **2021 near vs remote mean fractions** built **9.58% vs 3.73%** (+5.85 percentage points), cropland **13.50% vs 32.38%** (−18.87), trees **42.23% vs 30.66%** (+11.56), grass **33.95% vs 32.34%** (+1.61). Landcover is NOT larval food-plant species, true 2025 habitat, adult puddling substrate or sewage organic/nutrient exposure.

### Independent 2025 family-recorded site comparison: ONLY six areas with BOTH near and remote

Original **six 1° areas, 139 site rows** (61 near, 78 remote) have both source bands and complete 2021 WorldCover data; 3-family composition has n=133 nonzero-original-family site rows, 5-family composition and family recorded-date rates n=139. Unweighted site-level OLS compares original near dummy with 1° region FE and log documented original 2025 survey days; the habitat variant also adds original 2021 built, crop, grass and tree land fractions. Outcome per-day log(count+.5) or eligible log odds with +.5 continuity. Exponentiated near coefficient is NOT an independently randomized treatment effect.

| Recorded endpoint | region + survey days | + genuine 2021 land cover | 3,500 whole-region bootstrap descriptive 95% on habitat model |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Lycaenidae recorded-date rate | 0.573 | **0.522** | [0.224,0.988] |
| Lycaenidae vs Pieridae/Papilionidae **3-family** | 0.670 | **0.511** | [0.225,0.985] |
| Lycaenidae vs other four **5-family** | 0.446 | **0.377** | [0.283,0.492] |
| Pieridae recorded date | 0.836 | 0.967 | [0.592,1.510] |
| Nymphalidae recorded date | 1.372 | 1.469 | [0.675,2.359] |
| Hesperiidae recorded date | 1.590 | 1.658 | [1.073,2.387] |

**No stable wastewater-positive Lycaenidae inference:** pooled 2025 NEW399 3-family composition OR +2.270 arises under a different observer/region/individual-count weighting, while equal-region raw 3-family OR was 0.908, standardized date×region OR 1.819, and the same-region site-equal habitat-adjusted OR **0.511**. Altering numerator/denominator and sample weighting can reverse the observational sign. Habitat controls do NOT resurrect a positive site-level coefficient.

### Robustness and restrictions

- Independent pure-Python normal-equation implementation reproduced all **6 endpoints × 2 model families** from numpy OLS exactly, with original SHA and 139 eligible within-six-area sites verified. Six-region leave-one-region-out habitat-adjusted OR3 **0.374–0.644**, OR5 **0.333–0.407**, Lycaenidae rate ratio **0.355–0.643**. Removing one 5km-source component retains 14 identifiable original subgroup fits (OR3 0.399–0.562).
- Whole-1°-area 3,500 bootstrap intervals are **descriptive only**, based on six broad geographic clusters and posthoc methods, NOT confirmatory p-values. Two or more registered WWTP points can share hydrology and near sites are not randomly sampled. WorldCover 2021 landcover cannot be assumed to mediate 2025 wastewater effects.
- **Final scientific boundary:** relative reporting composition can be made apparently positive in the absence of actual absolute Lycaenidae recording increases. Real recipient-water nutrient/Na/organic chemistry, larval hosts and hydrologic downstream connections remain UNMEASURED. Do not infer positive or negative sewage benefit, and do not tune buffers/denominators further to chase a sign.

## Source-only physical exposure audit: DK 2025 eBMS butterfly monitoring points vs 2022 registered WWTPs on directed HydroRIVERS

**Strictly posthoc source-feasibility study after ALL previous Lycaenidae photo/family and 2021 landcover outcomes were already known. This new PR does NOT access ANY new Lycaenidae/family individualCount and cannot claim sewage benefits or harms.** It is the needed test whether eBMS survey centroids are even near verified receiving-water stream segments downstream of registered EEA freshwater outfalls.

### Original source-vetted observation population

- Exactly **286 original public Denmark eBMS 2025 NEW399 non-overlapping old107 site centroids** with >=2 previously reported ANY-Occurrence survey dates: 70 <=5km from qualifying 2022 WWTP, 92 >=10km, 124 intermediate. **203** original Danish EEA 2022 registered outfalls with unique reporter/plant and one FW outlet, both positive measured annual N/P loads; previously frozen source SHA/IDs unchanged.
- Reused the exactly SHA-checked **third-party HydroRIVERS Europe v1-derived GeoParquet** and **15,045 directed reaches** within the expanded Denmark border. Its official original byte equivalence remains **unverified**. Independently snap eBMS public site points and FW outlets <=500m to a river reach in EPSG:3035, tie-break by snap distance then reach ID. Use **NEXT_DOWN direction** for strict source-to-site river paths <=10 network-km, explicitly **exclude SAME REACH** as direction-unknown. No visual proximity called downstream exposure.

| Original physically grounded source availability | Actual eligible count |
|---|---:|
| eBMS survey points within 500m of HydroRIVERS | **60/286** |
| 2022 FW outfalls within 500m of HydroRIVERS | **125/203** |
| Originally <=5km source-near eBMS points with 500m river snap | **20/70** |
| Original near source-outfall/site pairs, multiple outfalls per site possible | **92** |
| Pair site fails river snap | 69 |
| Outlet fails river snap after site available | 2 |
| Both snapped but not related on directed graph <=50km | 3 |
| Same reach, within-reach order unknown | 4 |
| STRICT **DOWNSTREAM <=10 network-km** pairs | **10** |
| STRICT **UPSTREAM <=10km** negative-direction pairs | **4** |

**Critically, the downstream 10 survey point centroids represent only TWO registered WWTP outfall SHA IDs AND just TWO downstream river reach IDs.** One source accounts for seven sites on one receiving reach, the other three on another reach; only two 1° areas have downstream coverage. The four upstream source candidates similarly collapse to two outfalls and two river reaches. This defeats the pretence of 10 independent treated streams.

### Explicit source-only STOP before any new butterfly effect

Precommitted gate required >=12 directed downstream site points, >=8 independent original registered WWTP outfalls, >=5 separate 5km source components and >=3 1° areas, PLUS upstream <=10km controls >=8 sites, >=4 independent outfalls and >=3 regions. **Observed 10/2/2/2 downstream and 4/2/2 upstream: ALL insufficent. STOP.** No positive/negative Lycaenidae downstream response fitting, inferential p-values or causal phosphorus/salt/larval-host claims.

**Important limitation:** 500m from a river CENTERLINE does not mean original standard butterfly transect follows the streambank, nor confirms adults/larval hosts have contact with effluent. HydroRIVERS misses smaller drainage streams, and current converted source is not verified against official original. An outfall's original positive reported 2022 load is not 2025 actual water concentration. Therefore this is an exposure-*availability* failure, not evidence of biological zero or no pollution.

### Reproducible evidence

- [Full original source-only physical network report and study boundaries](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms2025-hydrorivers-outfall-exposure-gate-20261110/docs/RESULTS_DK2025_286SITE_203WWTP_HYDRORIVERS_DIRECTED_EXPOSURE_GATE_20261110.md).
- [Frozen BEFORE graph inspection network criteria and explicit biological-effect STOP rules](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms2025-hydrorivers-outfall-exposure-gate-20261110/docs/DK2025_ORIGINAL286_EEA2022_HYDRORIVERS_DIRECTED_SOURCE_ONLY_GATE_20261110.md).
- [Exact original cohort/203 source/15,045 river directed-reach source relation JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms2025-hydrorivers-outfall-exposure-gate-20261110/results/ebms_denmark_2023_2024_WWTP_source_only/DK2025_NEW399_286SITE_203WWTP_SHA_LOCKED_HYDRORIVERS_DIRECTED_SOURCE_FEASIBILITY.json) — [original geospatial source run SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42779582374).
- [Independent local arithmetic/identity/reach integrity: 10 downstream sites = 2 river reaches](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms2025-hydrorivers-outfall-exposure-gate-20261110/results/ebms_denmark_2023_2024_WWTP_source_only/DK2025_NEW399_286SITE_203WWTP_HYDRORIVERS_SOURCE_DIRECTION_OFFLINE_AUDIT.json) — [independent OFFLINE QA SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42780093058).

**Interpretation of existing PR #40/#41 unchanged:** 2025 near WWTP coarse 3-family photographic composition OR 2.270 but five-family OR 0.772 and Lycaenidae counts per published site-date ratio 0.833; within 6 areas + genuine WorldCover2021 500m habitat three-family site-level adjusted OR 0.511, not a stable sewage-positive result. Physically directed downstream exposure cannot be independently tested from this eBMS public site-frame. Do not alter denominators, buffer sizes or source IDs to seek significance.

**Keep Draft; no gesui main or chocho merges.** 2025 standard butterfly/source sites and original water network are not a butterfly dispersal graph.

prs.body:
## Which butterfly species actually produce Denmark's 2025 pooled 3-family-positive vs 5-family-negative WWTP proximity sign reversal?

**Original eBMS species-level source counts, real 2021 WorldCover local habitat, and original independent arithmetic. Strictly POSTHOC and NONCAUSAL.** Previous 2025 family outcomes and the original HydroRIVERS directed river exposure FAIL (10 apparent downstream eBMS points = 2 distinct outfalls/reaches) were already known. Nothing here upgrades the unsupported WWTP nutrient/hydrology effect or falsifies earlier descriptive DE/AT photos.

### Whole original 2025 source sample / taxonomy reconciliation

- Original official Danish eBMS v1.4 CC-BY-NC Darwin Core Archive original SHA, **15,606 Event / 21,617 Occurrence rows**. Original NEW399 sites (old107 excluded), 286 eligible with 2+ ANY linked days (70 near <=5km, 92 remote>=10km, 124 intermediate). Source EEA is registered 2022 WWTP spatial location, not actual 2025 water chemistry.
- Original frozen strict GBIF source-blind taxonomy: **65 accepted source scientific-name entries → 63 canonical accepted usageKeys** (two synonym pairs). Accepted unique taxa: Lycaenidae20, Pieridae7, Nymphalidae28, Hesperiidae7, Papilionidae1. **All original 399 source-site×five-family individualCounts and recorded survey days reconciled exactly** before any species-level result. All taxa including original zero records included.

### New ecological composition mechanism (not a wastewater mechanism)

| Original 2025 accepted species | Near individualCount | Remote individualCount | Fractional dominance |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| *Pieris brassicae* (Pieridae) | **145** | **1,439** | **55.3% of remote Pieridae**, 21.3% near |
| *Maniola jurtina* (Nymphalidae) | **1,828** | **870** | **47.8% of near Nymphalidae**, 24.5% remote |
| *Polyommatus icarus* (Lycaenidae) | **142** | **363** | **56.4% of remote Lycaenidae**, 37.2% near |
| *Plebejus argus* (Lycaenidae) | 63 | 0 | **All 63 on one near monitoring coordinate** |

- Pooled original Lycaenidae vs Pieridae+Papilionidae **three-family source OR = 2.270**, but vs all four other butterfly families **five-family OR = 0.771**. Papilionidae has no records in the focal near/remote original sample.
- Algebraic delete-one-species from BOTH source groups, no actual ecological removals: remove **P. brassicae** changes 3-family OR **2.270 → 1.289** (attenuates positive); remove **M. jurtina** changes 5-family OR **0.771 → 1.065** (reverses sign); remove **P. icarus** changes 5-family **0.771 → 1.111**. Species distribution and comparator denominator, NOT universal Lycaenidae enrichment, dominate the apparent positive photo/share finding. The complete 63-taxon influence table is archived.

### Actual external habitat and same-region standardized species checks

On **six original country×1° regions / 139 eBMS source sites** with both near and remote, same-source model log((species recorded individualCount + 0.5)/ANY-published-source survey days), original 1° region fixed effects and log days, plus **genuine ESA WorldCover2021 10m land-cover 500m fractions** of built, crop, grass, tree. Preidentified taxa selected by species mass contribution, not sign. **3,000 geographic region-block bootstrap** descriptive, only six spatial groups.

| Taxon | original near/remote per-day ratio (all 70/92) | 1° region + 2021 landcover site-equal ratio | descriptive 95% region bootstrap |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| *Pieris brassicae* | 0.142 | **0.411** | [0.216, 0.760] |
| *Maniola jurtina* | 2.951 | **1.815** | [0.793, 3.641] |
| *Polyommatus icarus* | 0.549 | **0.662** | [0.473, 0.980] |

The original remote sites have more mapped 2021 cropland (32.4% vs near 13.5%), a plausible source-geography alternative for Brassica-feeding *Pieris*, but **Brassica hosts, actual 2025 environment and effluent substrate exposure have NOT been observed**. *Maniola* larvae use grasses; *Polyommatus* larvae use Fabaceae and can be ant-associated. These natural-history associations do not constitute a measured host-mediated model. WorldCover classifications are not species-level foodplant data. All regressions exploratory, six region clusters, no confirmatory source p-values.

### Traceable source audit and safe handoff

- [Complete source-linked report and biological limits](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/dk-ebms-2025-species-composition-decomposition-20261110/docs/RESULTS_DK2025_NEW399_SPECIES_3VS5FAMILY_COMPOSITION_2021_HABITAT_20261110.md)
- [Original species counts, all 63 canonical species, source-family exact reconciliation, original leave-species-out odds](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42786494070) — SUCCESS.
- [Independent all-63 species arithmetic audit](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42786902576) — SUCCESS.
- [Top-three species original 2025 count × WorldCover2021 habitat model with 3000 region resamples](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42787364808) — SUCCESS.

**KEEP Draft, do not merge main or chocho.** The only justified mechanism here is a **recorded species-composition and observational denominator shift**; actual wastewater effects remain untested because flow-connectivity source gate failed with only 2 independent downstream outfalls.

prs.body:
## Return to the MACRO question: original positive 2015 modeled wastewater generation × plant-record composition across 1,055 ports/42 countries

**The aim is to preserve existing positive co-geography and find out whether it survives geographic transfer; explicitly POSTHOC after original positive. No Lycaenidae local-site chasing, no new wastewater-causal claims, no main/chocho manuscript change.**

### Fully source-reproduced original positive

- Recovered **all THREE still-available original successful `chocho` GitHub Actions CSV artifacts**: original 1,596 WPI+HydroWASTE port sources, PANGAEA Jones2015 5arc WWproduction+collection+treatment+reuse at ports, ESA WorldCover2021 10m city built/crop source. Original 1,596 port IDs, 142 countries, WorldCover1,241 sites and **identical 1,055 source-qualified ports/42 countries** confirmed. Original source CSV SHA pinned in new output.
- Re-fitted the original country-FE OLS on recorded **introduced/native CANDIDATE BUTTERFLY HOST PLANT species-richness ratio**. WWp beta **+0.0586977992697**, country-cluster 95% **[+0.013103565,+0.104292033]**, exact old intercept/country/WWTP covariates, model R² 0.64775 **independently reproduced**. IMPORTANT: original WWp is **2015 MODELED wastewater GENERATED**, not actual outflow nutrient mass; indexed candidate hosts are NOT **ALL plants** or actual larval food use, no causal plant response.

### NEW prespecified macro holdouts (after original positive known)

| Model validation | Real holdout sample | WWp forecast gain (relative MSE reduction) |
|---|---:|---:|
| Deleting one source country and refitting SAME country-FE slope | 42/42 country deletions | all β **positive**, range **+0.05062 to +0.08061** (influence, NOT unseen-country transfer) |
| Within original country, 5 deterministic 2° geographic block folds | 996 ports / 37 countries / 446 original country×2° blocks | **+1.277% country-equal** / +0.542% port-pooled; 23/37 countries benefit |
| Strict unseen-country leave-one-country-out, correctly WITHOUT unlearned country FE | 1,055 ports / 42 countries | **−1.225% country-equal** / −0.619% port-pooled, 42-country descriptive bootstrap95 **[−3.641%, +1.196%]** (includes zero) |

Within eligible original countries, raw WWp vs plant-indexed relative-recording Spearman is positive in **20/30** and negative in **10/30**. Both indexed candidate introduced and native plant richness have positive WWp slopes **+0.2286** and **+0.1754** respectively on same area/WWTP controls, consistent with common observation/settlement intensity confounding. Pooled beta is real source-verified but not proof of universal country transfer or nutrient enrichment.

prs.body:
## Global 1,055 port, 42-country WWp × Plantae observational study: are positive botanical GBIF records part of a cross-kingdom recording gradient?

**This is a macroecological recording-process diagnostic, NOT further butterfly species/outfall splitting. Explicitly POSTHOC after the 2025 all-Plantae full-cohort results. Keep original positive results, do not claim actual wastewater nutrient effects.**

### Why

The exact prior original 2015 *modelled wastewater generated* + 2021 WorldCover + WWTP count + 38 country FE yielded on the **752 source-quality-eligible global all-Plantae sites**: **raw Plantae indexed speciesKey β +0.17567** [95CI +0.06685,+0.28449], total Plantae GBIF indexed RECORD count **β +0.29411** [+0.12871,+0.45952], and **50-record-rarefied Plantae richness β +0.01256** [−0.00088,+0.02599], n752/38. This suggests dense botanical data may drive much of the apparent positive source gradient.

### Entire original source cohort and independent comparison

- Reuse EXACT originally frozen 1,055 WPI port IDs/42 countries, original same 752 Plantae QC samples/38 countries, original **2011–2024** year and **5km** public port site footprint. The 2015 Jones WWp is **generation volume** not measured 2015 or 2025 river/soil effluent N/P dose.
- NEW official GBIF `/v1/occurrence/search?limit=0` indexed **Animalia taxonKey=1** and **Fungi taxonKey=5** counts on each original port, with original coordinate/year/geospatial/presence filters unchanged. Four deterministic source-parallel port shards; original plant records not requeried. Full API request URLs, source response SHA and errors archived; API error is **missing not zero**.
- Freeze pre-effect support conditions: >=1002/1055 both kingdom API-complete, >=700/752 original plant-quality sites with both taxon counts, >=30 countries and >=25 within-country WWp-varied groups; failing these means STOP/no model, not changing the original port selection.
- After source support passes, match exact country cases and estimate log(1+GBIF record count) source WWp slopes for Plantae/Animalia/Fungi, plus plant-to-other record ratios and raw/rarefied Plantae species richness with Animalia+Fungi recording covariates. 38-country clustered CIs. Species diversity of Animalia/Fungi is NOT measured. These are cross-kingdom *recording comparators*, **NOT proven wastewater-unaffected negative-control organisms**.
- A genuinely cross-kingdom positive association would support human-observation/settlement concentration as a plausible common gradient; it does not prove no plant ecology, and even conditioned models are POSTHOC and cannot isolate sewage causal pathways.

### Reproducible stage/status

- [Precommitted source/biology reporting and interpretation contract](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/global1055-crosskingdom-effort-controls-20261110/docs/GLOBAL1055_WWp_PLANTAE_ANIMALIA_FUNGI_RECORDING_CONTROLS_PRE_NEW_DATA.md).
- [Exact 1055-port source-independent Animalia/Fungi count extractor](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/global1055-crosskingdom-effort-controls-20261110/scripts/gesui_global1055_GBIF_Animalia_Fungi_record_counts_source_shards.py).
- [Initial official GBIF source run](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42815168725) — **running when Draft was opened**. Results and numeric sign will be added only when computed and independently audited.
- [Prewritten original source-matched country regression script](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/global1055-crosskingdom-effort-controls-20261110/scripts/gesui_global1055_WWp2015_Plantae_vs_Animalia_Fungi_recording_models.py) and [independent no-statsmodels original WPI/source/arithmetic validator](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/global1055-crosskingdom-effort-controls-20261110/scripts/audit_gesui_global1055_crosskingdom_GBIF_count_11countryFE.py).

**Keep DRAFT and base only PR #46 branch; do not merge to `gesui/main` or `chocho`. No success claims about new taxa or plant causal gains before actual source quality gates and model outputs.**
### 2026-11-10 COMPLETE: all 1055 original port × Animalia/Fungi response counts, 11 country models + independent audit

**All original GBIF 2011–24 queries completed:** exactly 1,055 source-fixed WPI public port sites/42 countries queried **2 kingdoms** on the identical footprint and date range, **2,110 source counts SUCCESS, 0 API missing**; the original full-Plantae QC sample 752 sites /38 countries remains intact without re-selection or imputation. The 4-shard source-run commit and independent GBIF API URL/response SHA inspection passed.

| Original 752 sites, 38-country FE, same 2015 modeled WWp, WWTP count, ESA2021 built/crop, lat/lon | β_WWp | 38-country cluster95 |
|---|---:|---:|
| **Plantae indexed GBIF RECORD count** | **+0.29411** | [+0.12871,+0.45952] |
| **Animalia indexed GBIF RECORD count** | **+0.37115** | [+0.06924,+0.67306] |
| **Fungi indexed GBIF RECORD count** | **+0.38012** | [+0.13648,+0.62377] |
| Plants minus Animalia LOG recording ratio | −0.07704 | [−0.26886,+0.11478] |
| Plants minus Fungi LOG recording ratio | −0.08601 | [−0.24720,+0.07517] |

**Same 752-site source model with both non-plant recording covariates added:** raw Plantae indexed speciesKey richness β **+0.17567 → +0.04117** (new CI [−0.01400,+0.09633]); Plantae record count β **+0.29411 → +0.05169** ([−0.03446,+0.13783]); exact 50-record rarefied Plantae species β **+0.01256 → +0.00626** ([−0.00430,+0.01682]). All three adjusted intervals cross zero. Medians: Animalia record count 17,386.5, Fungi 39 (65 site-count zeros), Plantae 1,023. Thus unlike a simple plant-specific nutrient subsidy, recorded biota across multiple kingdoms show positive co-location with high WWp.

**NEW all-1,055-port raw-record quality sensitivity:** explicitly include the 303 GBIF plant-low-count sites rather than selecting only 752 quality sites. Full original **1,055 sites /42 countries** beta for raw Plantae GBIF records **+0.31556** CI [+0.18161,+0.44951], raw Plantae speciesKey richness **+0.22884** [+0.10938,+0.34831]. Both remain positive in **all 42/42 leave-one-country refits**. This confirms a global *record concentration* positive not driven by selecting the 752 high-count ports. No 50record species richness estimate is valid at low-count sites.

**CRITICAL BIOLOGICAL QUALIFICATION:** Animalia/Fungi are *cross-kingdom RECORDING comparators*, NOT proven wastewater-unaffected biological negative controls. WWp (2015) is a **MODELED GENERATED wastewater VOLUME**, not measured downstream 2015/2025 N/P/salt dose. Animalia/Fungi ecology may also respond to urbanization/effluent, and conditioning on their counts can create overcontrol/collider bias; this is not an instrument or formal detection process estimate. The sign-stable positives across kingdoms support a broad population/monitoring/settlement spatial gradient, not causal enrichment of all Plantae.

**Independent implementation succeeded:** a separate NumPy country-FE design and country-cluster sandwich covariance reproduces all 11 statsmodels WPI/GBIF β and 95CI (not only reprinted original outputs); exact original 1,055 source port URLs, Animalia/Fungi taxonKeys, 2011–24 time, 5km radius and source SHA checks. **Artifacts:** [Full macro study and interpretation](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/global1055-crosskingdom-effort-controls-20261110/docs/RESULTS_GLOBAL_1055_WWp_CROSSKINGDOM_ALLPLANTAE_RECORDING_QA_20261110.md) · [1055 × 2 original cross-kingdom GBIF source SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42815168725) · [11 source-matched cross-kingdom models SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42816661951) · [independent 11 regression and GBIF source QA SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42816863696) · [all1055 positive plant record/richness quality sensitivity SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42816488762).

**Keep DRAFT. No main/chocho merge. Do not regress more tiny butterfly species or call observed positive GBIF record co-geography a sewage-induced biodiversity increase.**

prs.body:
## Major macroecological comparison: modeled wastewater production's global GBIF-record positives versus actual standardized wetland vegetation biodiversity

**Focus remains macroscale, not splitting Lycaenidae or individual WWTPs.** Source-only gates, real official original-data downloads, 48-state plant community responses and independent numerical QA are completed. The original 2015 WWp is **modeled generated wastewater volume**, not direct N/P effluent at plant sites; the U.S. wetlands' actually measured TN/TP have **NOT been traced to WWTP sources**. **No positive/negative causal sewage vegetation effect is claimed.** This project synthesis is POSTHOC after earlier global positive GBIF results.

### First large-scale positive recording result retained

- Original **1,055 WPI ports /42 countries** globally: 2015 modeled WWp vs 2011–24 public all-Plantae GBIF **record count** β **+0.31556**, country-cluster95 [+0.18161,+0.44951], **raw recorded speciesKey richness** β **+0.22884** [0.10938,0.34831]. Both remain positive after deleting each country. Do not call this more plant biomass or actual flora richness.
- On quality-matched **752 ports /38 countries**, exact rarefaction to 50 original GBIF plant records shrinks β to **+0.01256**, 95CI [−0.00088,+0.02599]. On SAME sites Animalia record count β **+0.37115** and Fungi **+0.38012** also positive. With both nonplant record counts controlled, unrarefied plant speciesKey β becomes **+0.04117** CI crosses zero. Source regional survey/observer bias remains serious. Original [all-Plantae macro PR #46](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/46) and [cross-kingdom record-comparison PR #47](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/47).

### NEW standardized real vegetation evidence and source feasibility

- sPlotOpen source-only original 2024 mirror 95,104 plot headers passed exact 25MB LFS SHA, 42,677 globally listed vascular plants; fixed original **2000–2015, all vascular protocol, area1–1000m2, coordinate precision<=1000m** leaves only **8,311 sites /14 countries**, dominated by Australia/US, and only **12 plots within 25km** of original WPI1055 ports. Precommitted >=15-country minimum **FAIL**. We **STOPPED BEFORE READING SPECIES/WWp AT PLOTS**. No sPlotOpen plant biodiversity coefficient invented. [Original source-only result](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/global-splotopen-2015-WWp-plots-feasibility-20261110/results/global_splotopen_WWp2015_20261110/ORIGINAL_SPLOTOPEN95K_2000_15_PLOT_SOURCE_ONLY_GEOGRAPHY_QC.json) · [source-only workflow SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42832317681).
- U.S. **EPA 2021 National Wetland Condition Assessment** **official 4 original CSVs**, vegetation Shannon all plants H_ALL, native vs alien diversity, FQAI plus actual water `NTL_RESULT` **mg N/L** and `PTL_RESULT` **µg P/L**, source SITE_ID + VISIT_NO. Probability survey sites with actual weight and location quality **920**, joint original vegetation+water sample **568**, and fixed nutrient QA + Shannon valid **499 wetland plots, 48 states, 9 NWCA ecoregions**. This is a real standardized ecological response dataset, unlike GBIF. [Original independently SHA-frozen SITE_ID-only gate](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42833429529) SUCCESS.

| Actual 2021 standard wetland response | Original result | State-cluster 95%CI |
|---|---:|---:|
| Unadjusted TN vs all-plant Shannon Spearman | **−0.30062** | — |
| Unadjusted TP vs all-plant Shannon Spearman | **−0.29651** | — |
| **TN only** with wetland class/ecoregion/latitude | **−0.20251** H per 10× TN | [−0.33955,−0.06546] |
| **TN + TP** simultaneous: TN beta | −0.19051 | [−0.39357,+0.01254] |
| **TN + TP** simultaneous: TP beta | −0.01330 | [−0.18341,+0.15681] |
| NWCA survey-weighted TN + TP joint: TN | −0.25644 | [−0.63334,+0.12045] |

- The original 499 measured nutrient+Shannon coefficients, all site IDs/official source hashes and **48-state cluster 95CI replicated using a completely separate NumPy least-squares implementation**, not just copied the original statsmodels output. The one/multiple nutrient CI was adjusted for the correct original 16-column small-sample covariance while the rank is 15 (fixed in audit code only, no original outcome/sample changes). [Original wetland model SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42834025457) · [Independent 499-site source/CI audit SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42834918331).

### New exploratory hydrologic source-class and conductivity stress tests — AFTER first nutrient sign seen

- **INLAND wetland n=369 /48 states**: actual TN+TP joint-adjusted TN beta **−0.26923**, 95CI **[−0.48386,−0.05460]**; TP beta +0.04651 CI crosses zero. **TIDAL n=130 /20 states**: TN beta +0.02055, CI [−0.27054,+0.31164], TP beta −0.20754 CI crosses zero. This split is POSTHOC and no formal inland×tidal interaction test is presented.
- Original same 499-site actual `COND_RESULT` (specific conductivity) additional adjustment reduces TN+TP joint TN beta to **−0.15634** CI **[−0.35596,+0.04327]** (zero-spanning). Conductivity reflects multiple ion/salinity sources, not WWTP-specific exposure. [Source-frozen inland/tidal/conductivity run SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42835309877).

### Scientific synthesis / STOP mechanistic overclaim

**What is actually positive:** modeled WWp is associated with global **opportunistic recording concentration of Plantae, Animalia and Fungi**; this is replicated across the original port geography with different source quality gates. **What is not shown:** a global increase in equal-record plant richness, standardized wetland plant diversity, or sewage-driven nutrient enrichment in vegetation. The US wetland TN/TP measured at sampled sites have no confirmed sewage-source attribution, so their negative recording/biodiversity association CANNOT be subtracted from or meta-analytically combined with modeled WWp positive coefficients.

Detailed [full macro synthesis](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/us-nwca2021-wetland-plant-chemistry-source-20261110/docs/MACRO_WASTEWATER_GLOBAL_GBIF_RECORD_POSITIVE_VS_NWCA2021_STANDARDIZED_VEGETATION_TNTP.md). The next source-backed ecological experiment needs standardized multi-year plant community counts and **measured/verified receiving-water WWTP effluent with flow routing**, plus habitat/observer controls. No more tiny butterfly or outfall subdivisions. **Keep Draft, base PR #46 branch, do not merge to `gesui/main`/`chocho` without user request.**

## U.S.-wide standardized wetlands + official registered sewage discharge locations: survey weighting reverses the observed botanical association

**2026-11-10, DRAFT / STRICTLY observational.** This uses **real NWCA2021 plant Shannon and wetland TN/TP measurements** and an official **Nov 8, 2026 EPA NPDES registered municipal sewerage outfall point inventory**, not modeled Jones WW-production. All biological signs are reported, **no confirmed hydrological connection or actual FY2021 wastewater emission yet**. This is posthoc after earlier NWCA nitrogen–plant negative and global GBIF positives were known.

### Independent SOURCE-ONLY national geometry audit before near vs far ecology

- Original 2021 nationwide **568 EPA NWCA probability-sampled first-visit wetlands** with already frozen matching plant-community and water-chemistry official source IDs. NPDES ECHO official weekly ZIP, source SHA `f0d1310b1c07085c42527e2ede5cf97ab83d517d50548b7dadb7621a44aa6160`, raw **866,359 NPDES rows**, sewage source classification strictly **NAICS 221320 OR SIC 4952**, **LATLONG_TYPE='Permitted Feature' only**, permit effective <=2021-12-31 and not expired/terminated before Jan 2021. **10,865 qualified permitted-feature coordinates, 5,176 distinct administrative NPDES permits**. This historical date rule is *plausibility*, NOT proof discharge happened in 2021.
- Original 568 NWCA sites: strict municipal POTW geodesic **near5:52, near10:128** (32 states; 160 distinct registered administrative permits), **far>=20km:311**. Precommitted geography source gate passed: >=25 near sites, >=15 administrative sources, >=8 states, >=60 far matched in original state/eco groups, >=6 states with both. All geometry was calculated without opening newly associated plant H_ALL outcome.
- Same NWCA **state × NWCA ecoregion** overlap gives **240 original wetland plots /27 states /32 country-state ecoregion strata** (103 near10, 137 far>=20). All site IDs/family data original official EPA file SHA stable, no geographic buffer tuning or cherry-picked H_ALL outcome sites.

### New actual standardized plant communities — exact ORIGINAL 240 plots

| NWCA2021 H_ALL total plant Shannon near10 vs far20 | Coefficient β | 27-state-cluster 95% CI |
|---|---:|---:|
| **Equal-site OLS, original 32 matched state/eco strata + wetland class/hydrology + latitude** (main) | **−0.12043** | **[−0.25058,+0.00971]** |
| **NWCA original survey-design acreage-weighted WLS** on same 240 source sites | **+0.18062** | **[+0.01038,+0.35087]** |

| POSTHOC weight upper-tail capped at top 5% | +0.14358 | **[−0.02982,+0.31697]** |

**A positive spatial association does exist in the design-weighted model, but the SAME 240 standardized plots show the opposite sign under equal site weighting.** Equal-site and acreage-weighted estimates target different populations, and simple subset WLS **is not an EPA-complete national wetland-area probability design estimator** without proper complex survey treatment. Six state-level robust clusters is not a limitation here (27 states), but area weights are HIGHLY unequal: **Kish effective n=61.32 despite 240 original sites**, near 103 sites effective n25.54 vs far137 n36.54; near top5 sites carry 34.4% of total near area-weight. One-state deletion reproduces weighted positive **27/27**, site-equal negative **27/27**, illustrating estimand structure rather than one influential state. 95th-percentile weight clipping CI crosses 0, so **do not present the weighted nominal interval as confirmatory wastewater benefit**.

Other ALL plant metrics (same 240 source plots, equal-site) are not robustly positive: native Shannon **−0.10959** CI [−0.229,+0.010], alien Shannon **−0.06134** CI [−0.211,+0.088], FQAI_ALL **−0.74842** CI [−2.535,+1.038]. Source-fixed near5 km sensitivity n39 near/n137 far H_ALL β **−0.04595** CI crosses 0; no cherry-picking radius.

### Actual SAME-SITE measured 2021 wetland water TN/TP (not proven WWTP-derived)

Previously QC-supported measured N/P+vegetation subset of **204 original wetland plots /27 states** (84 near registered POTW site within10km, 120 far>=20km). With original same-state/eco/wetland/hydro/lat controls: water log10 TN(mgN/L) near source coefficient **+0.0862**, CI [−0.1516,+0.3241]; water log10 TP(mgP/L) **+0.2242**, CI [−0.02685,+0.47529]; H_ALL with concurrent TN/TP **−0.1537**, CI [−0.3255,+0.0180]. None identifies a measured nutrient subsidy or direct source-to-wetland route.

### Original/source and independence

- [Full original source-data, result, interpretation report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/us-nwca2021-npdes-potential-exposure-source-20261110/docs/RESULTS_NWCA2021_US_27STATE_NPDES_WETLAND_SHANNON_POSITIVE_WEIGHTED_NEGATIVE_SITE_EQUAL.md)

**Stop causal escalation:** 2026 registration + permit dates ≠ actual 2021 release, permitted-feature coordinates may not be correct in-water locations, wetland-to-receiving-water hydrologic paths unverified, measured TN/TP not source attributed. Need official EPA FY2021 DMR source-matched discharge records and NHDPlus receiving network + independent source controls BEFORE nutrient effects on plant communities can be claimed. ## Actual calendar-2021 U.S. municipal sewage discharge monitoring source audit (SOURCE ONLY)

**2026-11-11, Draft.** Earlier original NWCA2021 same-region 240 wetlands/27 states showed **area-weighted +0.18062 H_ALL** (95%CI +0.01038,+0.35087) but **equal-site −0.12043** (CI −0.25058,+0.00971) for near10 registered municipal outfall vs far20. **THIS IS NOT AN EXPERIMENT OR VERIFIED HISTORICAL EXPOSURE.** Study now checks historic **EPA DMR actual reporting availability** before attributing any plant ecology result to effluent.

### Frozen sources and exact regulatory period

- Original official NWCA2021 **568 probability wetland visits** with 2021 vegetation+water chemistry site IDs. Original ECHO 2026-11-08 nationwide registered NPDES outfall SHA256 `f0d1310b1c07085c42527e2ede5cf97ab83d517d50548b7dadb7621a44aa6160`, `LATLONG_TYPE='Permitted Feature'`, POTW **NAICS221320/SIC4952**, permit dates *plausibly* spanning 2021. - **Official historical ICIS-NPDES Discharge Monitoring Reports (DMR):** [EPA FY2021/FY2022 downloads](https://echo.epa.gov/tools/data-downloads), two annual source ZIPs (~580MB each), Jan–Sept2021 from FY2021 and Oct–Dec2021 from FY2022 (true **calendar 2021**, not one arbitrarily chosen fiscal year). A permit's DMR from a different outfall does NOT establish the nearby outfall actually discharged. Quantity units and concentration units are NOT combined. This stage only counts **coverage and missingness**, not effluent concentration/loads.

### Stop gate (set before new 2021 DMR output)

Even if all pass, **none of the wetlands is confirmed hydrologically downstream** from any source, so no effluent-caused plant diversity model can be claimed without independent source-to-receptor network.

**Pipeline is running**: [official two-year source-only data retrieval and join](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42928692962). **Keep Draft**, base the prior source PR #49 and never merge main/chocho without explicit instruction.

The two public EPA ICIS NPDES national FY2021/FY2022 archives were both acquired, their exact original ZIP SHA256 pinned, and only monitoring periods ending **Jan–Sept2021 (FY2021) and Oct–Dec2021 (FY2022)** extracted. Records were scanned nationally and restricted to the ORIGINAL 160 near10 source permit IDs and corresponding registered NPDES feature numbers **without opening NWCA vegetation H_ALL/FQAI or measured wetland N/P response**. NODI no data/no discharge is NOT a numeric effluent. EXO external permitted features and true gross/net effluent sample locations are separated from generic facility permits. Source study entry n568 and previously observed n240 site/source response groups untouched.

| Original registered sewage permit within10km, 2026 geo layer and dates potentially 2021 | **128** | **160 permits** | 32 |

Do not increase candidate outfall radius, pool nitrate/phosphate with total TN/TP, count permit source rows as independent NWCA wetlands, or reselect outcome-favorable sites to rescue it.

## Three actual EPA NWCA nationwide vegetation survey years vs registered sewage outfall proximity — historical permit dates challenge apparent positive reproducibility

**Draft, strictly POSTHOC after 2021 weighted-positive/site-equal-negative outcomes known. Original historical EPA source and 2026 ECHO archive preserved, NO biological claim of sewage-caused plant diversity increase.**

### Independently acquired original macro vegetation surveys and pre-H_ALL source-first gates

- Official EPA NWCA2011/2016 source files independently obtained and SHA verified. The site/vegmetric first-visit probability-weighted eligibility gates yielded **2011 967 original plots/48 states**, **2016 966 plots/48 states**. Vegetation metrics `H_ALL` exist in both original years; geographic source was frozen **before** opening these H_ALL values. The originally audited 2021 source compared 240 original same-state/ecoregion sites/27 states.
- The **EXACT SAME Nov8 2026 ECHO POTW permit-feature registration** selection used in previous 2021 study (NAICS 221320/SIC4952, plausible permit as of 2021, 10km near vs >=20km far, original state×ecoregion overlap) yielded **2011: 167 near/314 far across 29 states/32 cells**, **2016: 145 near/338 far across 32 states/41 cells**, **2021: 103 near/137 far across 27 states/32 cells**. Registered feature coordinate ≠ hydrologically verified receiving wetland.

### The original observed positive pattern under the SAME modern outfall-definition (not historical actual wastewater exposure)

| Survey year | EPA NWCA probability design-WEIGHTED H_ALL difference near−far (95% state cluster) | SITE-EQUAL H_ALL difference near−far (95%) |
|---|---|---|
| **2011** n481 | **+0.1343** [−0.0466, +0.3151] | +0.0783 [−0.0506,+0.2072] |
| **2016** n483 | **+0.1918** [−0.0702, +0.4539] | −0.0181 [−0.1972,+0.1609] |
| **2021** n240 (previously audited) | **+0.1806** [+0.0104,+0.3509] | −0.1204 [−0.2506,+0.0097] |

All 3 modern-registered outfall-point *DESIGN-WEIGHTED* coefficients are observationally positive; **2011/2016 intervals cross zero** and SITE-EQUAL changes sign. Independent NumPy LS + state cluster CR1 reproduced original 2011/2016 coefficients and CI exactly. Leave ONE US state out: weighted coefficients remain positive 2011 **29/29**, 2016 **32/32**, 2021 **27/27** (previous independent source). These are within-sample leverage checks, not a temporal randomized wastewater treatment experiment.

### KEY NEGATIVE SOURCE VALIDITY AUDIT: EPA 2026 latest permit effective dates do not reconstruct 2011/2016

Strict historical source eligibility on the SAME 2026 official NPDES archive (EPA ECHO original source ZIP SHA f0d1310...) requiring registered permit effective date by original survey year, not retroactively by 2021, yields:

- **2011: 12 near vs 99 far** matched, 5 states /5 areas (previous 2021-source-proxy original near sites with any eligible 2011 permit only **6/167=3.6%**). **PRESET SUPPORT FAIL; no 2011 historic-permit effect estimated.** Absence of old permit in current 2026 register is NOT proof that sewage treatment plants did not discharge in 2011.
- **2016: 50 near vs 162 far**, 19 states/23 areas, 44 original permit IDs; only **29/145=20%** original source-proxy near sites still near an asof2016 permit. Strict year-plausible 2016 sample source IDs frozen BEFORE recalculating source-sensitive H_ALL.
- On this asof2016 source-proxy sample, DESIGN-WEIGHTED 2016 H_ALL **β=−0.2409**, state cluster95 **[−0.6785,+0.1968]**; SITE-EQUAL **β=−0.0410**, 95% [−0.2966,+0.2146]. The 2016 +0.1918 positive coefficient therefore **FLIPS SIGN when the source permit year requirement is tightened**. Neither coefficient is confirmatory (both 95% intervals cross zero). Independent NumPy verification matches weighted/equal β and state-cluster95 exactly, and 18/19 state-omission weighted coefficients remain negative.

**Crucial limitation:** ECHO 2026 original NPDES table largely contains **current/latest permit records**, so many genuinely existing historical WWTPs likely have reissued newer permit dates; a 2026 permit validity filter is a source AGE sensitivity, not an accurate reconstruction of 2011/2016 actual discharge. EPA offers original FY2011/2016/2021 DMR annual monitoring data separately. Nothing here verifies observed historical wastewater N/P, effluent transport to the wetland, or true exposure. Thus we cannot call the initial 3/3 WLS positive sign robust *wastewater ecology temporal replication*.

### Source receipts and paper-ready summary

- [Full comparative research report with exact independent source ages, site weights, outputs, reproducibility](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/us-nwca-2011-2016-2021-potw-plant-replication-20261111/docs/RESULTS_NWCA2011_2016_2021_POTW_PROXIMITY_POSITIVE_WLS_TEMPORAL_PERMIT_FAILURE_20261111.md).
- [2011/2016 genuine EPA first-visit NWCA plant source QA SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42926506331); [old year source geometry n167/314, n145/338 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42926811864).
- [Three-year actual plant H_ALL original fitted regressions SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42927279548); [independent NumPy old-year beta,95CI, 29/32 state LOO SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42927633613).
- [Source-only 2011/2016 historical ECHO permit-year mismatch QC SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42927951457); [2016 strict-year source-first n50/162 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42928402125).
- [2016 stricter year plausibility weighted H_ALL −0.241 / site-equal −0.041 original results SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42928702826); [independent NumPy original source/CI/19-state LOO SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42928961109).

**Scientific disposition:** preserve the **real, descriptive** 3-year design-weighted positive *modern-source proximity* signal, and the global WWp×GBIF recording positives. But its source historical misalignment, weight sensitivity and 2016 strict-date sign reversal **prevent attributing an ecological positive to actual sewage**. Next independent source is EPA FY2011/FY2016/FY2021 DMR actual discharge records and hydrologically verified receptor paths, not more radius/subset tuning. Draft only, base previous POTW PR #49, no main/chocho merges.

### Observed 2021 standardized real-plot botanical results (all fixed 239 wetlands)

| EPA NWCA vegetation response near10 vs far20; original state×eco, wetland/hydro and latitude controls | EXO-only source near β | 27-state-cluster95CI |
|---|---:|---:|
| H_ALL Shannon **site-equal** | **−0.15183** | **[−0.28261,−0.02105]** |

| H_ALIEN alien plant Shannon site-equal | −0.06417 | [−0.20533,+0.07699] |
| FQAI all plants site-equal | −0.99950 | [−2.63550,+0.63651] |

**The previously nominal positive area-weighted +0.18062 [0.01038,0.35087] attenuates to +0.14505 with CI now spanning zero. Equal-site contrast becomes more negative (−0.12043→−0.15183) with CI excluding zero.** Sign reversal between site-equal and design-weighted estimands persists, NOT a stable positive plant response to sewage.

### Original NWCA probability weights and independent QA

- The design weights are extremely unequal: original 239 sites **Kish effective N 60.42** (near 99 sites N_eff **24.12**; far 140 N_eff **37.09**), near source top5 sites represent **36.4%** of total near-area weight. Capping upper **1%** of weights β+0.14336 CI [−0.02987,+0.31659]; upper **5%** β+0.09151 CI [−0.08134,+0.26436]. BOTH include zero. These weight caps are posthoc diagnostics, not official national survey estimators.
- Omit any ONE of 27 states: site-equal slope **27/27 negative** (β −0.1755 to −0.1226); weighted slope **27/27 positive** (β +0.0781 to +0.1713). This is a population/weighting estimand difference, not confirmed treatment replication.
- **Independent original source plus numeric model QA SUCCESS**: all 568 original source NWCA IDs, EXO-only near99/far140, five plant responses, area-weighted models, 204 measured water TP/TN models, country-state cluster CIs, 95/99%-weight clipping and leave-one-state arithmetic exactly reproduced by independent NumPy code.

### SAME-site wetland TP positive co-geography, but NOT WWTP-attributed phosphorus

- In original 2021 field-measured chemistry+vegetation **204 wetlands (near81, far123)**, actual total phosphorus **log10 TP concentration** near/far difference **β+0.24854** [state 95%CI +0.00990,+0.48717] ≈ **1.77×** in near registered external outfall geography; actual TN difference β+0.10767 [−0.11255,+0.32789]. Do NOT label observed TP as sewage-derived; upstream stream/hydro/wetland receiving water path not established.
- Source-measured TN+TP adjusted H_ALL near effect −0.18963 [−0.35878,−0.02048] in 204 plots is posthoc observational conditioning, NOT evidence of toxicity/mediation.
- Original [FY2021+FY2022 real 2021 EPA DMR source-only PR #50](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/50) found only **26** NWCA near wetland sites have actual monitored both total N and total P for SAME nearby EXO feature, failing its preregistered **>=30** sites; external subtype correction does not rescue actual source-to-wetland nutrients or causality.

### Evidence

- [Full research report and exact source limitations](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nwca2021-EXO-external-only-source-20261111/docs/RESULTS_US_NWCA2021_EXTERNAL_OUTFALL_ONLY_239_PLOTS_WEIGHT_SIGN_TP_20261111.md)
- [SOURCE-only exact SUB_TYPE_DESC and original 568 wetland NPDES geometry](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42952511619) **SUCCESS**.
- [Original 2021 standardized vegetation/water response on exact corrected 239 sites](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42952825188) **SUCCESS**.
- [Independent original 239-site 5 plant + 204 TP/TN + state-weight QA](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42953223758) **SUCCESS**.

**Keep Draft, base prior DMR source PR #50. No merge to gesui main, chocho, or existing original macro positive evidence.** 2026 registered outfall is not actual 2021 environmental exposure; earlier 2011/2016/2021 timing [PR #51](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/51) further challenges causal positive generalization.
prs.title: US wetland WWTP robustness: External Outfall-only 239 plots weakens weighted-positive Shannon; actual TP near higher (Draft)

prs.body:
## Historical EPA DMR 2021 reporting availability at the **exact same outfall feature** as original NWCA2021 wetlands

**Draft / source-only until official DMR and independent QA complete.** Builds on the 27-state/240-standardized-wetland PR #49, which found **area-weighted positive β_H_ALL +0.1806** but **site-equal β −0.1204** near official registered POTW points (same 240 wetlands, 32 state×ecoregion source overlap). The sign reversal is real, but NO actual FY2021 outfall discharge or wetland downstream water delivery has been verified yet.

### New source milestone: success BEFORE historical DMR files were read

- Replayed exactly the original 568 probability NWCA2021 wetland first visits and original 2026-11-08 EPA ICIS-NPDES municipal sewage registered points. ECHO original source ZIP SHA `f0d1310b1c07085c42527e2ede5cf97ab83d517d50548b7dadb7621a44aa6160`, *NAICS 221320 or SIC 4952* + strict feature coordinates + plausible 2021 permit date.
- Original **128** study wetlands had at least one registered point within **10km**, including **103 near** within the original 32 state/ecoregion matched 240-plot ecology support. The exact source geospatial replay identifies **160 distinct administrative permits, 344 distinct permit-feature numbers and 392 original wetland–feature candidate pairs**. Per-site permit-hash sets and distance candidate counts exactly match the original pre-biology source-only JSON. This step reads ZERO NWCA plant H_ALL / TN / TP outcomes.

[Source 160-permit/344-feature reproducible manifest](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/us-nwca2021-2021dmr-feature-source-20261111/results/us_NWCA2021_plant_TNTP_20261110/NWCA2021_568WETLAND_160POTW_EXACT_PERMIT_FEATURE_SOURCE_BEFORE_2021DMR.json) · [source crosswalk run SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42957873427).

### Actual 2021 effluent monitoring source: data are being validated, NOT assumed present

- Official EPA national **FY2021 and FY2022** DMR archives from ECHO, separate ~0.6GB original ZIPs each, to cover CALENDAR monitoring-period end dates **Jan 1–Dec 31, 2021**. The exact source filter retains **same `EXTERNAL_PERMIT_NMBR` AND `PERM_FEATURE_NMBR`, `PERM_FEATURE_TYPE_CODE=EXO`**; measuring a different facility outfall is NOT confirmation at the wetland-proximate registered feature.
- Fixed pollutants before inspecting values: original reported total nitrogen **00600**, total phosphorus **00665**, flow context **50050**. Distinguish DMR reporting obligation from non-NODI, uncensored **numeric measurement**, from numeric positive vs zero; preserve `DMR_VALUE_QUALIFIER_CODE`, units, value type and monitoring end dates. Do not sum mg/L as kg/year, impute missing as zero, assume a documented 2026 permit necessarily released wastewater in 2021, or infer outfall-to-wetland hydrological flow.
- PREDECLARED source-sample support: ≥20 near wetlands with some exact-feature 2021 TN/TP measured + ≥12 independent registered permits in ≥8 states; ≥12 wetland sites with **BOTH** N/P at the exact same feature + ≥8 permits and ≥5 states; ≥10 previously matched original near wetland sites with both, preserving 137 far controls. **If not, STOP without using the biological H_ALL values again.** This gate is not a source-to-wetland hydrologic causal design.

[Fixed source and biological STOP protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/us-nwca2021-2021dmr-feature-source-20261111/docs/NWCA2021_27STATE_NPDES_EXACT_OUTFALL_FY2021_FY2022_DMR_PRE_RESPONSE_GATE_20261111.md) · [Official EPA DMR documentation](https://echo.epa.gov/tools/data-downloads/icis-npdes-dmr-summary) · [ECHO public national archive](https://echo.epa.gov/tools/data-downloads).

### Current execution / provenance

Original official bulk DMR matrix run [FY2021+FY2022 source pipeline](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42958837187); original two ZIP file checksums, monitoring-year record counts, strict source-only gate and independent offline arithmetic QA will be posted upon actual completion. The original 2026 ECHO→NWCA source and H_ALL positive/negative PR #49 stays untouched; this branch targets ONLY its analysis branch, not `gesui/main` or unrelated `chocho`.

**Critical limitation:** Even positive historical 2021 external-outfall TN/TP DMR records would prove at most the source reported a measured contaminant at a registered external outfall. It would NOT prove receiving-water transport to a wetland, historical actual 2021 emitted mass or sewage-mediated increases in standard vegetation diversity. Proper NHDPlus routed water-path and annual load/flow matching remain necessary.
### Final original FY2021+FY2022 DMR source-only numerical result (2026-11-11)

**BOTH official original EPA national FY archive scans SUCCESS** with source bytes hashed: FY2021 SHA `2a28acdd4e98cc8cfee7a4ee8bfcc71a6aa266477d7898599a3297d6482c2c10` / **25,346,436 nationwide DMR rows**; FY2022 SHA `2bf892143d6f95afa2b0246c8b6ce028b4bf107a2e2c665a06367c32dcc8bc0d` / **25,686,059 rows**. Filter to *monitoring period END in actual calendar 2021*, exact original source permit AND same registered `PERM_FEATURE_NMBR` AND EPA EXO feature type, total nitrogen 00600 and total phosphorus 00665; no imputed zero for EPA NODI.

| Observed historical 2021 monitoring at previously frozen 344 near-wetland registered EXO features | Verified site/feature/source count |
|---|---:|
| Original external outfall features with valid numeric TN 00600 | **35** |
| Same features with valid numeric TP 00665 | **93** |
| Exactly SAME feature with BOTH total N and P numeric records | **32**, from **30 permits** |
| Original NWCA wetland centroids <=10km from a feature with 2021 N OR P valid measurement | **77 wetlands /88 permits /28 states** |
| Wetlands near features with BOTH N and P in 2021 | **26 wetlands /30 permits /16 states** |
| Those BOTH-monitored source-associated wetlands in original **32 matched NWCA state×ecoregion groups** | **21 wetlands /24 permits /12 states** |

All **precommitted DMR monitoring opportunity source gates PASS**. Note this is a source-availability diagnostic, **NOT evidence discharge water was transported to the wetland**, or actual nutrient mass. DMR unit types include mass/concentration and period statistics that cannot be summed indiscriminately. The 2026 registered-source permit status does not independently prove 2021 activity; presence of a 2021 reported monitor at the same feature is a stronger historical record but still not exposure.

**Independent audit SUCCESS:** original exact 568 wetland site IDs, original 128 near and 103 source-matched near wetland cases, 160 administrative permits/344 features, 2021 calendar unique numeric monitoring date union across FYs, 35N/93P/32both source features and all original site/permit/state gate counts independently replayed from prior source-only JSON, **no NWCA H_ALL/FQAI outcomes reopened**. [Source DMR original scan run](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42958837187) · [Independent source-only report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/us-nwca2021-2021dmr-feature-source-20261111/results/us_NWCA2021_plant_TNTP_20261110/NWCA2021_EPA_2021DMR_160POTW_344EXO_SOURCE_OFFLINE_INDEPENDENT_QA.json) · [independent QA SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42959159548).

**Next honest boundary:** compare this 21-site prospective historical DMR source support to the original 137 far sites *within the SAME original state×ecoregion strata*, and count independently supported states/streams BEFORE any new observational plant Shannon result. NHDPlus wetland routing remains unmeasured. This DRAFT does not authorize causal effluent enrichment claims.
### Biological NWCA2021 result after original 2021 DMR source PASS (independently audited)

On previously frozen NWCA2021 probability 568 wetlands, exact original **2021 EPA DMR monitoring end dates** for matching municipal `permit ID AND EXO feature number` across FY2021+FY2022 prove **numerical TN/TP monitoring existed** at selected registered discharge features, not that source water reached a wetland. Report ALL signs. **Fully independent original NWCA CSV parser + NumPy state-cluster sandwich audit SUCCESS** for the same plant responses.

| Registered POTW nearness definition (same original state×NWCA ecoregion) | Original standardized wetlands | H_ALL equal-site β, 95CI | H_ALL original design-weight WLS β, 95CI |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Original current EPA NPDES 2026 registered feature near10 vs far20 | 240: 103 near / 137 far, 27 states | **−0.1204** [−0.2506,+0.0097] | **+0.1806** [+0.0104,+0.3509] |
| Actual 2021 DMR **TN OR TP** numeric at EXACT feature near10, state/eco far20 | **177**: 57 near/120 far, **24 states** | **−0.0656** [−0.2108,+0.0797] | **+0.0541** [−0.0706,+0.1789] |
| Actual 2021 DMR **BOTH TN AND TP** numeric at SAME exact feature near10, state/eco far20 | **75**: 21 near/54 far, **12 states** | **+0.0053** [−0.2268,+0.2374] | **+0.0306** [−0.1462,+0.2074] |

**Independent source gates:** original 160 registered permits and 344 feature numbers, 2021 numeric TN from 35 and TP from 93 source features, BOTH from 32 features. The 21 near wetland sites with 2021 both-monitored features are source-matched to 54 far sites in 12 *identical state/ecoregion strata*. These thresholds were locked BEFORE new H_ALL effects. The strict n75 survey-weight Kish effective sample is **only 22.36**, reflecting high leverage/underpowered 12-state comparison. It does not support a definitive positive (or definitive negative) biological response.

Secondary recorded 2021 NWCA wetland water: strict n65 actual NWCA water + H_ALL subset TN median near **1.835** vs far **1.800 mgN/L**, TP median near **0.274** vs far **0.264 mgP/L**. Reported outfall TN/TP and wetland TN/TP have not been linked through receiving-water flow and cannot be treated as a calibrated same-source nutrient dose. Strict n75 FQAIALL β **+1.534** CI **[−2.122,+5.191]**, again not a robust positive vegetation result. All five plant outcome directions were tested, not selectively favorable taxa.

**Main scientific decision:** the original **weighted positive** +0.1806 near *current registered* POTW features is real as a descriptive conditional estimate; it **shrinks to +0.0306 and becomes statistically uncertain** when restricting to genuine 2021 TN+TP monitored SOURCE features. That change is partly due to sample attrition (240→75), not proof wastewater contributed no benefit. Critically, no 2021 NHDPlus directed source-to-wetland transport/actual annual pollutant mass is verified, so do not claim causal sewage-induced plant enrichment. Global 1,055-port positive *GBIF record* co-geography remains separate and retained.

**Report and reproducibility:** [Complete original US 2021 DMR→NWCA wetland results](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/us-nwca2021-2021dmr-feature-source-20261111/docs/RESULTS_NWCA2021_2021DMR_TNTP_EXACT_SOURCE_REGISTERED_WEIGHTED_POSITIVE_WEAKENED.md) · [same-region source sample SOURCE-ONLY gate SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42959584541) · [original 2021 monitored outfall/plant source match and state models SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42959856900) · [independent NumPy reproduction of both n75/n177 all vegetation coefficients and state-cluster CIs SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42960255524).

Keep Draft; preserve earlier PR #49 unmodified and do not merge to main or chocho. All sites, family denominators and original source files remained unchanged.
prs.title: NWCA2021 wetlands × actual 2021 EPA DMR: 160 POTW/344 exact EXO nutrient-monitoring source gate (Draft)

prs.body:
## 2021年実測排水報告（EPA DMR）を、標準化湿地植物調査の近接登録放流口番号まで独立照合

**Draft／SOURCE-ONLY／事後的観測研究。植物多様性への下水の正負効果はまだ推定しない。** 元の2021 NWCA確率標本・568植物＋水質結合湿地、既存PR #49の240地点/27州植生モデル（等重みShannon β−0.12043、原調査面積重みβ+0.18062）の値と結論は変更しない。

### 厳密に原本を固定した全国規模の調査対象

- 2026-11-08 EPA ECHO全国登録POTW放流点（NAICS 221320またはSIC 4952、Permitted Feature座標、2021年許可存続の可能性あり）について、元の**568湿地中128湿地／32州が10km以内**。その地点に対応する**160個の独立NPDES許可ID**を実測DMRの取得前にSHA固定。
- 原EPA ECHO ZIP SHA256 `f0d1310b1c07085c42527e2ede5cf97ab83d517d50548b7dadb7621a44aa6160`から、許可IDだけでなく**344個の登録放流口FEATURE番号**と**392湿地×放流口ペア**を別途原本照合して固定。2026年登録地点であり、2021年稼働/湿地への排水到達の証明ではない。

### EPA公式FY2021＋FY2022全米DMR原本を実際に取得して2021暦年へ統合

- 両国勢的年度ZIPを原本SHA確認し、各年度全米DMR CSVをストリーム読込。対象は固定160許可、モニタ期間末日が2021年、総窒素`00600`・総リン`00665`・別建て流量`50050`、外部放流口`EXO`＋許容測定場所で数値非NODI・非不等号。報告数値の単位や統計期間が異なるため負荷の勝手な換算はしない。
- **許可単位**の報告：TN **34**、TP **79**、TN+TP両方**31**、流量**117**許可。TNまたはTPを報告した許可が近くにある湿地は**76/128**だが、**同一許可の別放流口が測定されている危険**があるためこれを厳格な曝露人数とは呼ばない。
- **許可番号＋登録放流口FEATURE番号の厳格一致**：344近接登録放流口のうち**86放流口**で2021年の数値TNまたはTP報告（TN **34**、TP **83**、同一放流口でTN・TP両方 **31**）。同じ放流口の流量報告もあるものは**76/86**。
- この86放流口に**10km以内の元湿地71地点／26州／81許可**が対応。従来の同州×生態地域で比較した240湿地（近接103／遠隔137）に限定しても、**近接側51地点**の候補を確保。四半期1〜4に実測DMRがある。

### 事前固定したSOURCEゲートの結論と因果の限界

近接湿地≥20、行政許可≥10、州≥6、四半期≥2、同一放流口で流量あり≥50%という**2021実測報告の可用性ゲートはPASS**。元の344登録放流口・392ペア・2021実測報告条件は、別の純Python実装で独立再計算し完全一致、すべてGitHub Actions SUCCESS。**これはNHDPlusによる流下方向確認を進めるためのゲートで、植物群集の下水由来栄養塩効果を主張するものではない**。

依然として2026登録放流口座標が2021の水中放流点と同一か、そこから湿地まで水文的に届くか、希釈/混合/流量は未確認。実測DMRの報告存在は実際の湿地曝露ではない。これをNWCAの植物Shannon H_ALLに機械的に回帰しないことを明記。全球の『下水発生量×GBIF記録』の正相関とは別の測定尺度として保持。

### 原本と結果

- [全国マクロ研究としての詳細報告](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nwca2021-POTW-DMR-2021-source-20261111/docs/RESULTS_NWCA2021_NATIONWIDE_2021_MEASURED_POTW_TNTP_344FEATURE_71WETLAND_SOURCE.md)
- [160許可の測定前SOURCE](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42960834382) SUCCESS、[344登録放流口番号原本照合](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42961350082) SUCCESS。
- [元のFY2021＋FY2022測定値資料を再利用して暦年結合](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42961956869) SUCCESS。
- [344登録放流口の実際の2021 N/P測定報告番号の完全一致](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42962030306) SUCCESS、[完全独立したSOURCE監査](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42962369321) SUCCESS。

**Draft維持、baseは元のNWCA2021 PR #49の分析ブランチ。`gesui/main`にも`chocho`原稿にもマージせず、元の植物・水質解析結果を上書きしない。**
prs.title: US wetlands 2021: measured EPA POTW TN/TP DMR at exact 86 outfalls near 71 NWCA plots (Draft)

prs.body:
## 2021年の実測N/Pを持つPOTW登録放流口と標準化湿地を、USGS NHDPlusV2の下流流路で検証（Draft）

**SOURCE-ONLY、事後的な水文曝露の適格性診断。植物Shannon/FQAI/実測湿地TN/TPの新しい効果推定は行わない。** 元のEPA NWCA2021確率標本（568湿地）、2026 ECHO登録POTW 344放流口、2021年DMR実際のTN/TP報告を持つ**86放流口・71湿地・26州**をデータ取得前に固定。旧PR #49の240標準化植生比較における等重みの負傾向と面積加重の正傾向はそのまま保持。

### 公式USGSの河道ネットワークで明確に分ける判定

- 公式 <https://api.water.usgs.gov/docs/nldi/> の NLDI（NHDPlusV2）位置APIを利用。`comid/position`は流域内の河道IDの推定であり、**河川への物理的接触を測定しない**。別の`hydrolocation`で元の放流口座標・NWCA湿地座標から河川区間上の位置までの距離を計算。公開USGS既知例でendpoint・レスポンス・COMID・下流DM/flowlines APIの応答を先に検証済み（[official API public-example success](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42963556338)）。
- 主要判定は**放流口と湿地の双方がNLDIの対応河道から200m以内**、catchment COMIDとhydrolocation COMID一致、**COMIDが異なる**、放流口から下流方向`DM`で50ネットワークkm以内に湿地COMIDが存在すること。same COMIDは流下順序が不明として除外。`DD` diversionと500m source modellingは別の感度確認、ゲートを救うためには使わない。
- 事前固定ゲート：下流候補**20湿地以上**、実測N/Pのある元の登録放流口**15か所以上**、独立許可**10件以上**、**8州以上**、原の近遠比較の同州×生態地域で遠隔対照30湿地以上。どれか失敗すれば新しいWWTP-植物多様性係数は作らない。
- 現代の登録放流口座標は2021年放流点と完全同一とは未検証。NWCA湿地が河川沿いにあっても地表水の流入・塩水・地下水・滞留を直接測定していない。河道での下流流路と湿地への**実際の放流水供給は別**。

### Source-onlyデータ・進行状況

- [元86放流口・71湿地を再選択せず、公式USGSで座標を200m以内に照合する再現コード](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nwca2021-POTW-2021-USGS-NLDI-direction-source-20261111/scripts/gesui_NWCA2021_USGS_NLDI_71wetland_86POTW_source_position_shards.py)。
- [4つのUSGS original response shardを結合し、十分な直接河道支持がある場合だけDM/DDの下流流路を調べるSOURCE gate](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nwca2021-POTW-2021-USGS-NLDI-direction-source-20261111/scripts/gesui_NWCA2021_USGS_NLDI_join4_source_route_DM_DD.py)。
- [生物アウトカムを見る前の固定閾値・解釈の制限](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nwca2021-POTW-2021-USGS-NLDI-direction-source-20261111/docs/NWCA2021_2021MEASURED_POTW_86OUTFALL_71WETLAND_NLDI_SOURCE_GATE.md)。
- [公式NHDPlusV2地理位置・下流の原本照合 Actions](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42964085386)（source取得中、数値結果は成功・原本照合後にのみ追記）。[別実装で元4シャードと200m河道支持を独立監査するコード](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nwca2021-POTW-2021-USGS-NLDI-direction-source-20261111/scripts/audit_gesui_NWCA2021_USGS_NLDI_71WET_86POTW_source_offline.py)。

**2021年の公式DMR報告を実際の植物曝露・栄養塩供給と同一視しない。PRはDraftのまま、`gesui/main`、既存PR #54、`chocho`原稿にはマージしない。**
### 結果確定（2026-11-11）：2021実測TN/TP源は確保できても、200m直接河道接続の標本支持が不足

**USGS NLDI NHDPlusV2の元157地点、200m河道近接性／COMID／技術欠測の完全照合と別実装監査がSUCCESS。植物Shannonの新しい下水影響係数は作成していない。**

| 原本で確認できたSOURCE条件 | 湿地 | 同じ2021TN/TP数値DMRを持つPOTW登録放流口 |
|---|---:|---:|
| 元の10km以内SOURCE候補 | **71** | **86** |
| USGS hydrolocationとcatchment一致＋河道200m以内 | **20** | **35** |
| 元の実測源×湿地のペア、双方200m以内、かつ**異なる河道COMID** | **10** | **11** |

- 実測DMR元の71湿地×86放流口の候補は、現況2026年登録地点と2021年の報告存在であり、実際の流下輸送の証拠ではない。元100候補ペアのうち11ペアだけが異なるCOMIDかつ双方200m条件を満たし、同じCOMID1ペアは前後順不明。
- **事前規定の20湿地／15放流口には達しない**（実測sourceの独立許可11件／州8／遠隔対照137は条件通過）。このため**下流DM／DDの流路探索を開始せず停止した**。下流ネットワーク接続が0だったという意味ではない。SOURCE JSONでは下流件数は**null/NOT RUN**であり、実測下水の効果を示す植物回帰は実施していない。
- **重要な技術的不確実性：USGS NLDI hydrolocation API応答が157地点中70地点で未取得（湿地28／放流口42）**、一方catchment COMIDは71/71湿地、83/86放流口で取得。河川から遠いと断定できない地点が多いため、10/11は現在確認できた候補数であり物理的な接続の上限や流路の不存在ではない。500mのモデル位置に16ペアあっても、勝手に本解析へ格上げしない。

**独立監査SUCCESS:** 元のUSGS4シャードを丸ごと再取得し、71/86/157各元ID、200m厳格/500m感度、同一COMIDの曖昧判定、技術的API欠測、10湿地/11放流口、SOURCE stopを別コードで再現。

[完全結果・各段階の原本URL・解釈を統合した日本語報告](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nwca2021-POTW-2021-USGS-NLDI-direction-source-20261111/docs/RESULTS_NWCA2021_71WETLAND_86POTW_NLDI200M_SOURCE_STOP_20261111.md) · [元157地点USGS NLDI4分割取得成功](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42964085386) · [下流探索未実施をnullとした同じ原本4シャード再集計](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42965476361) · [完全独立したSOURCE/HTTPエラー詳細監査 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42965721292)。

**研究主線の判断**：元の全球下水発生量×生物記録の正の関連と、NWCA2021の重み依存の正負結果は保持。ただしこの71湿地を恣意的に広げて下水による植物種多様性増加を主張しない。全国・全球の標準化された実測N/P排出源と受水域が一致するより大きなsource-first標本を次の独立解析に据える。Draft維持／`gesui/main`・`chocho`・PR #54の結果は変更しない。

prs.body:
## 2016年の欧州EEA河川底生EQRとJRC GREENの地域モデル点源N/Pを、標本独立・数値原本独立で検証

**2026-11-11：SOURCE先行・2016年実際のEQR評価結果・独立原本NumPy監査まで全てSUCCESS。既知の2018/2022実測WWTP負荷の後に始めたPOSTHOC解析。Draftを維持。**

### Scientific question and critical separate exposure definitions

Do GREEN *2014–2018 average MODELLED domestic+industrial point-source N/P tonnes per km²* carry geographic information about **2016 measured EEA river biological EQR**, especially benthic invertebrates, beyond country×assessment-method, lat/lon and NUTS2 area? **This is NOT actual monitored 2016 WWTP measured discharge mass**. The 2018/2022 previously positive WWTP mass prediction (+0.98–1.19%, +1.10–1.40%) remains distinct. The official older 2019–20 EEA GPKGs had **zero 2016 reporter-code source rows**; missing 2016-specific loads were not replaced.

### Real original site/source and region-independent model

- Official EEA 2016 aquatic Biology (original 2026 Waterbase): source EQR-unopened 2,496 benthic stations/13 countries; GISCO **2016 NUTS2** polygons overlay **2,469 benthic station/79 NUTS2/13 countries** with exact original JRC GREEN source ID, source accepted before 2016 EQR numerical values.
- Official JRC [GREEN ArcGIS MapServer](https://water.jrc.ec.europa.eu/arcgis/rest/services/inmap/Losses_to_water_MIS/MapServer), exactly **44 country** point N/P observations, **337 NUTS2** point N and P both completely downloaded; 71,779 basin values deliberately count-only, not falsely sampled/zero-filled. The original downloadable JRC 47MB GDB CDF compression is unreadable by OpenFileGDB; public MapServer is the independently verified alternative.
- **Frozen NUTS2-disjoint 5fold** assignments before any 2016 EQR scores. Original outcome validation retained **2,435 numeric benthic EQR /12 countries /73 NUTS2** (34 missing/invalid, DK23/AT11) and **2,161 phytobenthos EQR /12 countries /58 NUTS2**. Fish 1,022/2 countries, 5-country outcome gate FAIL, no model.

### New actual outcomes, positive *predictive contribution*, NOT positive biological effect

| 2016 EEA real normalized river EQR, frozen NUTS2-out-of-sample Ridge(alpha10) | +2014–18 modeled point N MSE gain | +2014–18 modeled point P MSE gain |
|---|---:|---:|
| **Benthic invertebrates (n2435/73 NUTS2)** | **+2.287%** | **+1.402%** |
| **Phytobenthos (n2161/58 NUTS2)** | **−1.317%** | **−1.268%** |

- Benthic site-mean MSE M0 **0.051622667**, +N **0.050441939**, +P **0.050898679**. NUTS2 region-equal gains N **+3.450%**, P **+2.804%**, but region bootstrap 999 95% gains N **[−0.258%,+7.047%]**, P **[−1.053%,+6.907%]** include zero. Country-equal bootstrap 95 intervals also include zero.
- EQR biological health **correlates NEGATIVELY** with point source exposure: benthic NUTS2-level region-equal Spearman source N–EQR **−0.390**, P–EQR **−0.457**. Adjusted source-only model slope for N alone **−0.329** NUTS2cluster95 [−0.505,−0.154], for P alone **−2.108** [−3.554,−0.661]. But original N/P source density collinearity **ρ=+0.913**; when jointly entered both coefficients CI span 0. NOT causal sewage toxicity and not nutrient-specific.
- Geographic heterogeneity: **7/12** benthic countries benefit for N and P each, 2/5 frozen NUTS2 folds **worsen** for each nutrient. Existing predictions reweighted after leave-one-country-out yield positive gains N 12/12 and P 11/12 (influence ONLY, not unknown-country training). Phytobenthos doesn't reproduce raw predicted benefit.

### Two independent complete audit levels, all SUCCESS

- [Official EEA2016 source-only sites](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42967265841) · [full genuine JRC official model N/P source values](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42971548719) · [GISCO2016 station-source match](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42972083942) · [NUTS2-disjoint 5fold source manifest frozen](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42972556306) · [first real EEA2016 EQR model](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42973036165).
- [Independent source regional original MSE, country heterogeneity, N/P ρ QA](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42973468951) SUCCESS.
- [**STRONG independent audit: re-download actual EEA 2016 Biology original archive, original SHA-verification and 5-fold CV reimplementation with manually centered NumPy Ridge(alpha10), WITHOUT sklearn/statsmodels**](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/42974132590) SUCCESS; all baseline/N/P site MSE and NUTS2-equal MSE reproduced exactly for both benthic/phytobenthos.
- [Full detailed Japanese empirical results](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/eea2016-thirdyear-benthic-NP-source-20261111/docs/RESULTS_EEA2016_REAL_BENTHIC_EQR_JRC_GREEN_NUTS2_MACRO_20261111.md), [original 2016 EQR model JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/eea2016-thirdyear-benthic-NP-source-20261111/results/eea2016_thirdyear_source_20261111/2016_EEA_RIVER_BENTHIC_EQR_JRC_GREEN_MODEL_POINTNP_NUTS2_HELDOUT_RESULTS.json), [independent country/fold audit](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/eea2016-thirdyear-benthic-NP-source-20261111/results/eea2016_thirdyear_source_20261111/2016_REAL_BENTHIC_EQR_JRC_GREEN_NUTS2_INDEPENDENT_COUNTRY_FOLD_QA.json), [independent raw 2016 EEA source NumPy5fold audit](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/eea2016-thirdyear-benthic-NP-source-20261111/results/eea2016_thirdyear_source_20261111/2016_EEA_BENTHIC_JRC_POINTNP_RAW_SOURCE_INDEPENDENT_NUMPY5FOLD_QA.json).

**Major limits:** JRC GREEN averaged 2014–18 DOMESTIC+INDUSTRIAL modeled N/P regional source is not measured 2016 WWTP discharge, not verified received dose at original 2016 EEA river site. Region-level source assigned to numerous sites; effective exposure replication is NUTS2 regions (73/58), NOT 2435/2161 independent treatments. Country×method EQR normalization, region population/agriculture and model collinearity confound. Results POSTHOC exploratory. Primary scientific contribution = benthic-specific macro predictive pattern plus explicit algae falsification/heterogeneity, NOT sewage-induced species diversity or causality.

**Keep DRAFT stacked on older PR #19 2020 source branch; do not merge or overwrite `gesui/main`, `chocho`, original PR #14/#17/#19 results.**

## New strictly POSTHOC original-data robustness (not a wastewater treatment effect)

This Draft is stacked on **PR #56**, not `main`, and keeps the source-year 2016/2018/2022 results completely unchanged. Source input Git blob SHA-pinned: 2016 NUTS2 JSON `108ac711...`, 2018 original site CSV `0f30bfbc...`, 2022 original site CSV `325f199e...`. One read-only Node.js audit and an offline CI test included.

**New 2016 NUTS2 regional reanalysis (73 regions / 12 countries):**
- JRC GREEN 2014–18 **MODELLED domestic + industrial** N / P, not actual 2016 WWTP measurement.
- Country-demeaned, equal-region Pearson vs actual 2016 benthic EQR mean: **N −0.34105**, **P −0.35631**.

**New 2018–2022 shared-site check (2,634 / 2,475 original annual sites):** exact **1,167** same station keys. Qualifying upstream **reported** source present 2018→2022 groups:

| Reported source | Shared sites | mean EQR2022−2018 |
|---|---:|---:|
| 0→0 | 1,139 | −0.033985 |
| 1→1 | 17 | +0.031569 |
| 0→1 | 7 | −0.034430 |
| 1→0 | 4 | +0.010495 |

1,148/1,167 share same EQR classification method. Only **11 reporting-status changes**, not WWTP treatment installations/closures, so no underpowered DID/biological improvement claim. Original **2018 and 2022** small positive out-of-region WWTP N/P EQR forecast gains are preserved, not converted into mechanistic effects. The 2016 modelled source is **not a third independently measured WWTP year**.

New files:
- [Full interpretive study](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/benthic-regional-temporal-robustness-20261111/docs/RESULTS_BENTHIC_REGIONAL_TEMPORAL_POSTHOC_20261111.md)

**Decision:** the recurring finding is **small incremental spatial predictability and a negative coarse point-source/EQR gradient**, not wastewater-driven increases/decreases in richness or a resolved nutrient mechanism. Keep **DRAFT**, do not merge to `main`, `chocho`, or alter original positive and negative studies. Next independent study needs measured point-source discharges, adequately supported directed receiving-water links, agricultural confounders and genuinely uninspected response geography/year.
