prs.body:
## First stage: do ecosystem service linkages really have a shared empirical geography?

This is a **strictly pre-outcome, source-first** study stacked on PR #57; no merges to `main` or `chocho`. It does not claim wastewater increases butterflies, directly improves ecosystems, or causes water-to-land flux.

### The question
When are river biotic integrity, the *potential* production/export of aquatic insects, terrestrial plant host/flower-resource availability and butterfly/predator occurrence geographically coupled versus decoupled by nutrient/WWTP pressure?

### Published foundations
- Europe EEA 2018/2022 actually reported WWTP load × benthic EQR small but reproducible regional predictive information, with explicit source missingness and no causal claims (`gesui` #14/#17/#56/#57).
- EPA NARS 2018–2019 publicly provides **same-visit** national benthic taxon, feeding guild, site/region and actual stream TN/TP data. This is an independent United States functional baseline; **not** a verified upstream WWTP-source effect.
- Schürings & Olden (2026), DOI 10.1038/s41559-026-03041-1, demonstrated 14,177 U.S. river EPT–riparian bird co-geography. **No eBird data will be used here.** We target a different question about aquatic feeding guilds and pollinators/plant resources.

### What has been committed
- [Pre-source protocol with frozen outcomes, thresholds and explicit noncausal scope](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/aquatic-terrestrial-functional-coupling-source-20261111/docs/AQUATIC_TERRESTRIAL_FUNCTIONAL_COUPLING_SOURCE_CONTRACT_20261111.md)
- [Official EPA source-only original metadata / joint site / taxonomy coverage QA](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/aquatic-terrestrial-functional-coupling-source-20261111/scripts/gesui_aquatic_terrestrial_NRSA2018_2019_source_gate.py)
- [GitHub Actions acquisition and file-SHA / support gate](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/aquatic-terrestrial-functional-coupling-source-20261111/.github/workflows/gesui-nrsa-1819-source-gate.yml).

### Initial support gate
Joint original BERW + real TN/TP chemistry >=300 native site-visits, >=25 states, >=6 eco groups, FFG and taxonomic field support, original state/ecoregion key quality. Source-only counts/sha in artifact, no ecological-response regression before passing the gate. Alternate sample types are NEVER pooled to rescue support.

If it passes, **freeze the exact eligible site/visit IDs before reading TN/TP numerical associations**, then separately test guild composition and EPT/Chironomidae vs water nutrients, and match GBIF plant/butterfly observations to those same river coordinates with effort controls. If it fails, source-only STOP and report why; do not fabricate a multi-taxon service cascade. Study remains Draft; PR #57 and all previous results remain unchanged.


## 2026-11-11 ACTUAL RESULTS — SOURCE-FROZEN RIVER EPT + REAL N/P (completed)

The same official original 2018–19 EPA NRSA data were acquired and the **native UID-based 1,221-visit / 1,125-physical-site / 48-state / 729-HUC8 pre-outcome source manifest** frozen **before** any nutrient-versus-taxon numerical effect. The first composite SITE_ID+VISIT_NO gate failed on two non-duplicate UID keys; this post-source key correction is documented, not concealed. From 1,220 complete-case visits, adjusted for state, eco9, latitude, longitude, year, stream order and conductivity, **EPT benthic counted-individual fraction** had a negative partial relationship to measured **river** TN and TP. In HUC8-disjoint fivefold ridge validation, adding **TN+TP** reduced held-out EPT fraction MSE by **+2.354%**. HUC8-cluster descriptive joint EPT slopes / log10 unit: **TN −0.05032** (95% [−0.09160,−0.00905]), **TP −0.04775** ([−0.08222,−0.01327]). This is benthic composition, not emergence, pollination, actual wastewater dose or a causal effect.

**Independent second original-source NumPy implementation EXACTLY reproduced original joint slopes**; posthoc stricter measured nutrient flags + count and repeated-visit checks: TP slope remains negative with zero-excluding descriptive HUC8 intervals in **all five** sensitivity specifications (all n1220, clean-NARS n969, ≥250 individuals n1005, both n796, first-visit only n1124); TN loses interval separation with ≥250 counted individuals. Multi-FFG codes apply to **18.5%** of recorded count mass, so primary strict exact-code FFG nulls are NOT valid evidence against functional services.

* [Full exact numeric and scientific result](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/aquatic-terrestrial-functional-coupling-source-20261111/docs/NRSA1819_RIVER_NUTRIENT_EPT_FUNCTIONAL_PROXY_REAL_RESULTS_20261111.md)
* [True original-data functional models SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43035012808)
* [Independent original-data EPT regression and QA sensitivity SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43035675111)
* [Pre-outcome native UID source manifest SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43034107486)

**Empirical stage reached:** same-site river TN/TP → benthic functional *composition*. **NOT YET REACHED:** river→riparian plant host and butterfly same-location records; aquatic insect emergence flux; ecosystem services. This Draft must remain noncausal/unmerged.

## New measured SAME-US-river bridge; keep each ecosystem layer's causal status separate

**Draft only.** Stacked on `analysis/aquatic-terrestrial-ffg-gbif-support-audit-20261112`; never merge `gesui/main`, `chocho`, or replace older source-locked positives.

**Provenance:** EPA NRSA 2018–19 original 1,221-UID BERW+chemistry source, original PHab same-UID 1,220-visit source frozen **before inspecting new habitat values**. Independent source SHA checks for 4 authentic CSV files. Predeclared 5fold HUC8 region holdout, fixed Ridge alpha10, identical 2018–19 visits across models.

**Primary n1,184 / 1,091 physical sites, 48 states, 722 HUC8 (original prespecified XGVEG<=1 specification)**:
- geographic+river+conductivity+field human-disturbance baseline → +real TN/TP: **+2.354% out-of-HUC8 MSE improvement**, HUC8 block descriptive95 [0.568,4.091]%.
- baseline → +3 original riparian field structure measures: **+1.535%**, 95 [−0.317,3.281]%.
- after TN/TP, +3 riparian: **+1.284%** heldout, 95 [−0.453,2.919]% (UNCERTAIN; does NOT establish independent ecosystem-function mediation).
- after riparian, +TN/TP: **+2.105%** heldout, 95 [0.393,3.793]%.
- extra TP×ground cover: **+0.315%** heldout, 95 [−0.504,1.165]% (NOT robust). Interaction descriptive OLS beta+0.13393 HUC8 cluster CI [0.0481,0.2198], **not** a demonstrated buffering mechanism.
- Main adjusted EPT fraction × TP partial OLS beta **−0.04659** [−0.08172,−0.01147], TN uncertainty overlaps zero.

**Independent source-value QA (posthoc, reproducible):** Original EPA `XGVEG` >1 for 35 visits, because the metric is **exactly XGH+XGW**, not a mutually exclusive 0–1 cover fraction; EPA metadata has no maximum. These are real source values, do not treat as fabricated / absent. The **original n1,184 predeclared analysis is preserved**, and a transparent **n1,219 /1,123 physical site raw-uncapped sensitivity** finds riparian-after-nutrients +1.482%, TP×ground interaction +0.3077% OOS, beta+0.13361. The stricter NARS-clean+>=250 counted n795 sample produces TP×ground interaction **−0.210% heldout gain**, CI on OLS slope crosses zero. Thus riparian moderation is hypothesis-generating, not confirmed ecological benefit.

**Taxon/functional barriers**:
- EQR in Europe has small WWTP-source predictive information for 2018/2022, but no measured source-specific exposure in these US rivers. European/US studies are **triangulation, not a single mediated panel**.
- XGVEG/XPCAN/XFC_OHV are **structural field vegetation**, not flowering plant richness or butterfly larval hosts.
- Same-river GBIF Lycaenidae taxon key corrected from iNaturalist47923 to GBIF5473, but **only 9 of original 360 sites** reach fixed plant >=50 and butterfly >=20 support: no valid matched butterfly regression.
- No actual aquatic insect adult emergence, predator diet, pollination or seed set. Service chain **unproven**.

[All evidence links and comprehensive manuscript-safe interpretation](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/aquatic-terrestrial-riparian-coupling-20261112/docs/AQUATIC_RIPARIAN_FUNCTIONAL_LINK_EVIDENCE_SYNTHESIS_20261112.md).

[Original same-UID new result SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43050507703) · [independent source-value and full-range sensitivity SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43050963972). Both source-manifest SHA locked.

prs.body:
## New source-frozen measured aquatic→terrestrial export *measurement* calibration, NOT wastewater causation

Stacked Draft on PR #59's `analysis/aquatic-terrestrial-riparian-coupling-20261112`. Preserves European WWTP-EQR positives, US actual river TN/TP→EPT results, EPA riparian same-UID work, and failed same-river GBIF butterfly support. No merge or `chocho` edits.

**Original independent field dataset (official H.J. Andrews Forest LTER AS015 v2, 2022):** exactly 17 Oregon first/second-order streams, 9 intermittent/8 perennial; each 23 sampling periods × four emergence groups (Ephemeroptera, Plecoptera, Trichoptera, Diptera/Chironomidae), 391 site-period events and **1564 original rows**; all data valid and original CSV MD5 **f3e6e400990da883ae0d341731431749**. Original row source manifest SHA `51354ce5cc3ab3acc63aecc28dd93534438ab3ffaf09b86ab2b0994b51874923` **frozen BEFORE adult emergence magnitudes opened**. EDI PASTA returned 403, then exact publisher's original official EML-linked CSV was downloaded and independently MD5/SHA verified. No alternative artificial data.

**Actually measured adult-emergence calibration results, independent unit stream n17**:
- Site-season mean EPT adult abundance fraction versus **total emergence biomass g dry mass/m² per collection interval**: Spearman **ρ−0.1618**, 20k label permutation descriptive 2-sided fraction 0.5318, 10k whole-stream boot descriptive95 **[−0.708,+0.457]**. **Not proof of zero ecological association**.
- Total adult emergence biomass site-season range **0.01450 to 0.14338 g/m²**, **9.89×** across these 17 streams while EPT adult mean fraction ranges **0.682–0.990**.
- EPT share versus emergence abundance ρ−0.1789, wide CI.
- Across 9 intermittent/8 perennial streams, mean biomass **0.06977 vs 0.04029 g/m² per collection interval**; exact 24,310 regime-label reference fraction 0.0547. Not an experiment, not confirmation.
- Independent pure-Python rank and LOO audit reproduces original ρ exactly. But **proportion definition matters**: EPT fraction pooled across count occurrences gives ρ**+0.0539**, mean EPT *biomass* fraction ρ**+0.1569**, biomass-pooled EPT share ρ**+0.3873**; 16/17 leave-one-stream-out estimates of original metric are negative, 1 slightly positive. Source covers only 17 streams in one catchment, and counts/biomass partly share denominators.
- 18/391 periods have zero total adult abundance, correctly omitted only from EPT ratio, **not** set to zero EPT proportion.

**Ecological meaning:** A loss in relative benthic EPT representation cannot be converted to a specific loss in adult emergence biomass without actually measuring the same aquatic→terrestrial flux. This adult data does **not** link directly to EPA NRSA 2018–19 benthic EPT (different sites/years), nor to WWTP pollutants or pollination; cross-study multi-stage mediation remains **UNIDENTIFIED**, no claim of ecosystem services improved/degraded.

Full original-CRC audit and methodological interpretation: [AS015 emergence report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/aquatic-emergence-calibration-as015-20261112/docs/RESULTS_HJA_AS015_REAL_EMERGENCE_EPT_SHARE_EXPORT_CALIBRATION_20261112.md).

**Draft stacked on PR #60**; preserves all prior wastewater→EEA benthic EQR, NRSA US river nutrient–EPT, same-UID riparian vegetation, and HJA EPT-share/biomass results without modifying them. No merges to `main` or `chocho`, no eBird.

### What is original-data new and source-pinned
- Original official HJ Andrews AS015 v2 **17 streams ×23 sampling intervals ×4 taxa = 1564 original rows**, 9 intermittent /8 perennial. Actual EPT / Chironomidae adult emerging dry mass and abundance recorded in 2022. Published EML and CSV byte checks verified (source original SHA256 `c8ae00e91e7b210fbc86f5b08c6047ceaeade30bb2d410c3748f495fea0de4b2`, pre-numeric stream×period manifest `51354ce5cc3ab3acc63aecc28dd93534438ab3ffaf09b86ab2b0994b51874923`). This **new seasonal covariance/continuity question is POSTHOC** after earlier average EPT ratio–biomass results were seen.
- **Median 50.0%** of the total across 23 intervals occurs in just the **5 largest emergence periods**, versus 21.7% of sampling time (median **2.30× time-proportional share**). Across streams range 37.1–70.4%; total emergence biomass temporal CV median 0.871.
- EPT share of emerging **dry biomass median 98.81%**, despite EPT share of **abundance median 93.12%** (median per-stream difference +6.08 percentage points); never convert counts directly to supplied biomass.
- EPT and Chironomidae period-level dry biomass covariance positive in **16 of 17 streams**; no strong positive temporal compensation. Median `C = −2cov/(varEPT+varDiptera)` **−0.0181** (tiny magnitude), and group synchrony φ median 0.975 is strongly influenced by overwhelmingly EPT biomass. Circular-shift resource variance less than shift-median in only 1/17; **not** evidence of adaptive synchronization or actual riparian predator diet.
- **Independent pure Python, no-numpy** numerical arithmetic confirms all original site-level variance identities and results (max identity residual ~1.7e-18). Still only **one Oregon basin**, not macro independent basins.

[Original SHA-pinned field reanalysis SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43142773724) · [independent arithmetic QA SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43143044572).

### Actual field consumers: two genuine independent studies discovered and source-audited, raw outcome replication STOP

- **Ontario 29 original field sites**: Dryad `doi:10.5061/dryad.sbcc2frfk`, 9 original files confirmed (bird, emergence, benthic, environmental). Field insect emergence and bird point counts in **2022**, original water chemistry/benthic sampling in **Sep 2023**, so not a same-year N/P→larva→emergence→bird causal experiment. Original authors published aquatic-insect/bird Procrustes 0.44 and non-support of strong direct emergence quantity→insectivore fraction. **Not newly reanalyzed.**
- **Quebec 20 original sites nested in TWO rivers**, Dryad `doi:10.5061/dryad.v6wwpzh8z`: original `File_3.zip`, `README.md`; original authors' 2026 isotope study reported spider aquatic dietary proportion mean **52%** (18–85% range), smaller emergent insect body sizes with urban land cover and stable exported biomass. **Not newly reanalyzed.**
- Dryad official public API responded HTTP200 for both original dataset metadata/version/file IDs/9+2 file original hashes, **but download of actual published original data files returned HTTP401 without authorization**. We stopped; no scraping access challenge, guessed input data, ecological coefficients or false claim of user-original consumer-site replication. Sources: [original source-only acquisition/HTTP401](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43142032918), [public per-file metadata complete inventory SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43143134955).

### Honest synthesis and next-test definition

Source-backed [FULL scientific results and measured/unmeasured link matrix](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/field-linked-emergence-riparian-consumers-dryad-20261112/docs/RESULTS_AQUATIC_TERRESTRIAL_QUALITY_QUANTITY_TIMING_SOURCE_SYNTHESIS_20261112.md). No pooled 17+20+29 fictitious independent watersheds or serial SEM.

**Current central scientific finding:** benthic taxonomic integrity, potential adult emergence mass, adult body-size/trait composition, emergence timing and realized terrestrial consumer response are **distinct ecological endpoints**. **Not shown:** wastewater-induced ecological benefit, a water-to-pollinator causal service cascade, nor a proven universal decoupling relationship. Immediate independent confirmation requires original accessible site-matched adult emergence + consumer data, preferably from multiple river catchments with concurrent chemistry and measured upstream WWTP source attribution.

| Additional new reported source | EEA benthic EQR improvement | Plant GBIF speciesKey S50 improvement | GBIF Lycaenidae five-family share improvement |

[Actual original 454 same-basin three-layer reported 2018/2022 N/P models SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43223533195).

### Critical source availability sensitivity: France FAILS to replicate N positive OOS

Independent second original source-program reproduces the original 3-layer full model baseline and N-added CV exactly. But only **4/56 positive-load H7-period reports** are French whereas FR represents **299/454 of all basin-periods**. Thus:
- **All454 reported N→EQR +0.928%** OOS gain

- **France-excluded n155 /82 basins with n52 source-positive: +3.618%** OOS gain

[Independent exact numeric source replay, source-positive/country/year leverage audit SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43224180601).

### Scientific bottom line and next physical source

The earlier *static registered wastewater source geography* EQR negative spatial signal has a small **source-specific real reported N/P analogue** in non-France reporting-positive geography. It is NOT pan-European independent replication or an annual within-basin causal time response. French underreporting or source-coverage mismatch is severe, N/P r0.936, and source zeros are mostly unverified. Source intensity helps original benthic EQR EEA prediction modestly but not GBIF-based flora and butterfly observation proxies. ## Genuine station-specific HydroRIVERS point-source routing, before ecological modeling, and macro three-layer geographic falsification (DRAFT)

Stacked on [PR #67](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/67), preserving unchanged original 232 European Level7 river basins /454 H7×period source rows, 2018/22 EEA benthic EQR, native source-indexed plant 50-rarefied richness, five-family Lycaenidae recording proportions, HydroATLAS upstream cropland/urban/flow, original reported EEA N/P and all previously registered positive/negative results.

### Original hydraulic network actually acquired (not a port-buffer proxy)
- Authentic HydroRIVERS v1 **Europe/Middle-East SHP/DBF source**, **938,544 native `HYRIV_ID` reaches** with genuine `NEXT_DOWN` chain, fully acyclic, publisher original ZIP SHA256 `500da7d36ceee0aa4c82dd625f5c53d80ba2f7ac14ad022cd3a6601bf55068e5`.
- Original HydroWASTE 58,502 global registered plants, 27,143 native registered outfall reach IDs matched to this original EU network, `WASTE_DIS` m³/day original modeled/mixed quality. Existing original EEA source files 2018 and 2022 **both have exact site `HYRIV_ID`**, and **3,525 /3,525 source original site-year records** in this exact 454 cohort match the EU river network (2,382 distinct receiver reaches).
- Under an independent **outcome-blind SOURCE gate**, distinguish source-reaches upstream of original monitored reach vs the same reach (**excluded, unresolved source/station order**) vs downstream ≤50km geographic control. Exact source **301/454 H7-period rows** have ≥1 registered source on strictly upstream reaches, **300/454** within conservative full-reach ≤50km, 168 unique H7 basins; **438/454** have at least one registered **downstream** source-reach ≤50km. Source quality/not reported means *registered source*, not confirmed operational facility or chemical dose.
- Source run/source manifest [SUCCESS #43340832143](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43340832143), derived 454 JSON SHA256 `d50eba0f934278cb28eb403af7b84d4da5a19af209a6d05be312a2ee44ad6d6d`; raw copyrighted original HydroRIVERS ZIP/DBF **not redistributed** (only derived study-level source features/QA).

### Main same-original-source 90 native HydroBASINS H6 parent heldout 5fold regression

Country, EEA assessment method, year, original EEA site count/river flow, GBIF reporting opportunity, land cover/natural flow held identical. **Same n454 H7×period, n232 H7, n90 H6 parent geographic blocks**. Original H6 invalid parent geometry 207 polygons explicitly repaired only after no-repair source gate FAILED, and 16 otherwise unassigned original H7 were restored via outcome-blind `make_valid`; no change to biological sample.

| Incremental old or newly routed static source vs common environment baseline | Original EEA benthic EQR OOS MSE gain | Original GBIF Plantae S50 gain | Original GBIF Lycaenidae 5-family share gain |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **PR67 old source to H7 basin OUTLET** | **+11.129%**, H6 bootstrap95 **[+3.94%,+18.27%]** | −0.196% | −0.762% |
| **NEW strictly UPSTREAM of actual monitored reach** | **+1.434%**, **[−0.58%,+3.58%]** | −1.297% | +0.449% |
| NEW strictly upstream conservatively ≤50 km | +1.275% | −2.414% | +0.252% |
| **NEW DOWNSTREAM** source within 50km, direction-control | **+5.782%**, **[−1.84%,+12.86%]** | +0.614% | +1.977% |

True receiver-upstream adds only **+0.464%** further EQR MSE improvement *on top of old basin-outlet source*, confidence band crosses zero. Downstream source adds **+3.456%** beyond old outlet source, also uncertainty includes zero. Original annual actually reported upstream N source adds **−0.491% (worsens)** when a strict receiver-upstream static model is the baseline, compared with +0.687% when old basin-outlet source is the baseline. All are **POSTHOC predictive associations**, not pollutant effect sizes or realized services.

**Country-heldout** (11 effective H7-stable country groups, without unknown country FE): original EQR old outlet +0.953% improvement, new upstream +1.544%, new upstream 50km +1.116%, and **downstream +11.432%**. The downstream source is not a matched randomized negative control (registered plants are much more common downstream) and cannot be interpreted as a reversed causal effect. It does, however, challenge source-direction specificity of the old modelled wastewater geographic predictive signal.

[Real network → original same-receiver 3 biological response H6/country CV SUCCESS #43341517792](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43341517792).

### Independent numerical/source-quality check, important reporting limit

An independent **sklearn Ridge/SVD** recomputed the complete previous manual NumPy Ridge study **3 response families×12 original same-source exposure specifications×2 geographic validations = 72 CV MSE numbers**, all identical. Genuine original source signal/quality:
- 299/454 H7×periods have **positive estimated strict upstream** discharge within 50km versus 300 with ≥1 facility; 434/454 source periods have positive modeled downstream discharge vs 438 registered source presence.
- **Only 68/454** have positive source-reach flow within 50km from original `QUAL_WASTE=1` (flow marked actually reported).
- Exactly **0/454** have a strictly upstream ≤50km registered source whose status explicitly says `Operational`. This is **unknown / not reported facility operation**, NOT proof that zero plants operated. 471 of 3,525 original site-year records have unresolved same-reach facility.
- True upstream H7 log-pressure vs old basin-outlet model log-pressure original Pearson **r≈+0.299**, and true upstream vs downstream log-pressure r≈−0.009, so source definitions are physically noninterchangeable.

[Separate original-source 72-fit sklearn numeric/source quality audit SUCCESS #43342095959](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43342095959).

### Honest research interpretation

**The older +11.1% predicted EQR quality result is a basin-outlet *regional geography* predictor. A strict monitoring-reach UPSTREAM model supplies only +1.4% uncertain incremental geographic signal, while a DOWNSTREAM geographic index also predicts EQR (+5.8%).** Thus robust direct source–receiver wastewater nutrient causation, pan-European ecological transfer and a sewage→benthos→plant→butterfly or pollination **ecosystem service chain** are NOT established. Source registration/urban river networks, absence of verified operational status and original country/BQE-method/GBIF observation bias are major competitors. Preserve old positive predictive associations without mislabelling them as causal effects.

[Full authentic original network audit, all 3-layer signed positive/negative results, uncertainty, country transfer and source-license restrictions](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/20261113-hydrorivers-receiver-specific-wwtp-source/docs/RESULTS_20261113_HYDRO_RIVERS_TRUE_EEA_RECEPTOR_UPSTREAM_VS_BASIN_OUTLET_WWTP_3LAYERS.md).

| Model source geography added to same environmental baseline | Real EEA benthic EQR MSE gain | Plant S50 indexed source | Lycaenidae 5-family indexed record log odds |
|---|---:|---:|---:|

## NEW genuinely matched 2022 in-stream TP and EEA benthic I2M2 quality at the SAME RIVER STATIONS — 74 French catchments (DRAFT)

**EXPLORATORY POSTHOC relative to earlier wastewater/EQR findings**, stacked on [PR #69](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/69). Preserves all previously reported source-geography positives and nulls, no merge or old-file overwrites. The strongest new fact is **physical 2022 water-chemistry↔benthic same-site association**, NOT registered WWTP causality.

### Source-first original 2022 site crosswalk: truly observed water chemistry and biology

- **Original real measured 2022 TP** 1,291 Peters et al WQ field stations, each at least 4 observations over ≥3 months (source original v5 doi `10.25400/lincolnuninz.30546371.v5`). **Original EEA 2022 numeric benthic quality** 2,475 native monitoring sites. Sources separately Git blob SHA1 `a75a4cf140de64fd6038079a3fac6756a461f3f8` and `325f199e985d9862ffee5b0edb205c61a7be3833`.
- Outcome-blind independent source gate matched exact original `HYRIV_ID`, original point distance **≤250 m**, one-to-one WQ↔EEA closest source sites and fixed previous 454 H7×period sample. Entire EU source 473 1:1 same-site pairs; **original 227 H7 with 2022 EEA in the existing macro frame** contributes **273 original matched real TP + benthic EQR sites across 74 genuine H7 basins**, **ALL France and SAME EEA benthic `I2M2` assessment method**. 239 sites have identical original coordinates. `TN` co-location in fixed H7 population just **one field site**; do NOT invent a comparable nitrogen result.

- Exact 74 source H7 basins fall into **24 genuine HydroBASINS Level6 parent hydrologic geographic blocks**, original outcome-blind fixed 5fold counts 15/15/15/15/14 H7, source-only [SUCCESS #43370462196](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43370462196).

### Real measured TP to real river EQR — robust observational negative co-response

- Across **74 original H7 watershed averages**, source mean log actual **measured river TP2022** vs equal original same-station I2M2 benthic EQR Spearman **ρ −0.698329** (original 273 site-pair descriptive Spearman **ρ −0.545866**, no independent-station p claim).
- Between the **241 physical station pairs nested within 42 H7 catchments** with ≥2 matches per catchment, within-H7 site-demeaned EQR slope vs measured logTP **−0.11634**, original 2000 H7 parent bootstrap descriptive 95 **[−0.16043,−0.07206]**.
- Original EQR adjusted for true HydroATLAS **upstream cropland/urban/natural outlet flow**, original river modeled site flow, H7 local area and n source-matched TP/EQR river sites: for +1 SD original logTP exposure, **EQR β −0.10076** (24 H6 parent cluster descriptive95 **[−0.13610,−0.06541]**).
- Original pre-source H6-group disjoint 5fold fixed Ridge(alpha10), train-only scaling: baseline I2M2 EQR MSE 0.029539 → **+measured TP MSE 0.022809**, **+22.7826%** heldout gain, parent bootstrap95 **[+9.1618%,+37.2604%]**.
- Separate independently implemented NUMPY manual Ridge (vs original sklearn SVD) reproduces all **3 biota response ×3 baseline/+TP/+modeled WWTP =9 original CV MSE** and raw physical-site/basin rank correlations/within-H7 slope exactly. **Leave each of 24 entire H6 hydrological parents out separately**: real TP→EQR **+22.271%** MSE gain with H6 bootstrap95 **[+7.592%,+38.296%]**. Original HydroWASTE **modelled** outflow to H7 outlet alone predicts EQR **−2.722%** (worse), and adding W after real TP worsens EQR **−3.270%**; real TP after W +21.857%.
- Modeled registered HydroWASTE to H7 outlet vs real measured TP basin means raw ρ **+0.357**, but adding modeled W to crop/urban/flow controls predicts real TP only **+2.71%** under source-frozen H6 5fold (uncertain interval) and **+0.03%** under independent stricter 24-parent leaveout (H6 bootstrap95 **[−8.10%,+6.17%]**). This **does NOT validate a source-specific WWTP→TP mechanism**.
- Main source-authentic observed outcomes [SUCCESS #43370847415](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43370847415), independent NUMPY/24 H6 leave-parent-out [SUCCESS #43371398070](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43371398070).

### Higher co-location precision sensitivity, posthoc transparent

At original exact `HYRIV_ID` but stricter **≤10m station coordinate difference**, source kept **255 original TP+I2M2 pairs in 72 H7 /same 24 H6 parents**, measured TP–EQR H7 ρ **−0.67492**, within H7 site-demeaned slope **−0.12517** and H6 5fold TP-added EQR prediction **+18.946%** (H6 bootstrap95 **[+4.162%,+34.601%]**). [Strict original 10m source quality sensitivity SUCCESS #43371662688](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43371662688). This was inspected AFTER the 250m TP/EQR result, not an independent replication.

### Different measurement layers in exactly the same 74 H7 (not actual realized services)

Original genuine H7×2020–2022 GBIF plant source specimen speciesKey 50-rarefied S50 and Lycaenidae log odds within five published butterfly-family indexed counts, same landuse controls plus original GBIF observation-opportunity covariates. H6 group heldout:
- Measured water TP added to predict **indexed plant S50: −3.761%** MSE gain (worse); indexed Lycaenidae **+0.229%** gain (bootstrap crosses zero).
- Old modeled HydroWASTE BASIN OUTLET source index in this **selected French n74 subpanel** predicts GBIF indexed plant S50 **+17.493%**, bootstrap95 [+5.688%,+24.925%]; in independent 24 H6 leaveparent-out +15.438% but bootstrap95 **[−0.129%,+23.838%] includes zero**. It contrasts with weak/worse full n454 EU plant results and may reflect urban vegetation/GBIF sampling processes.
- Old modeled HydroWASTE source for Lycaenidae **−6.648%** group-CV MSE gain; no stable butterfly positive at any level. No actual floral hosts, visits, pollen export, adult emergence or seed set are observed in these same H7 units.

### Correct scientific conclusion

**YES:** actual receiving-river TP and macroinvertebrate EQR show a strong, independently numerically reproducible **negative co-response** at original physically matched FR sites, same BQE assessment system and heldout hydrologic parent regions. This is currently a stronger direct ecosystem **condition** result than the older modeled source geography.

**NOT ESTABLISHED:** treatment plant discharges caused the observed TP, TP caused the observed EQR, index plant/butterfly co-response equals actual ecosystem service provision, or this one-country n74 result generalizes across Europe/world. Even strong source-locked TP–EQR can be confounded by agriculture/urbanization/habitat and chemistry/EQR sample date mismatch. Direct wastewater source actual annual P and observed river P require better independent source tracing.

[Complete report: authentic sources, observed and modeled three-layer outcomes, original SHA, all positive and null signs, and quality-gate boundaries](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/eea2022-same-station-measured-TP-EQR-3biota-20261113/docs/RESULTS_20261113_FRANCE_I2M2_MEASURED_2022_RIVER_TP_EQR_273SITES_74H7_THREE_LAYERS.md)

- Original parent sample: **273** source-preselected actual measured 2022 TP + EEA I2M2 EQR station pairs at native identical HydroRIVERS reach IDs and ≤250m; 74 French H7/24 H6 ([prior source gate #43370128446](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43370128446)).
- **263 of those stations have EXACT identical native 2018 and 2022 EEA site IDs** and country FR + assessment method I2M2, original source H7=73 and H6=24. All 263 same WQ IDs have real *observed 2018 AND 2022 TP samples* ≥4 positive datewise measurements in ≥3 distinct months **in BOTH years**, verified in the original author Figshare v5 `TP.2_-_Harmonised.zip` (25,003,722 bytes, original published MD5 `b596dbe9833c49426147a99f10f3fe31`, original archive SHA256 `26f2af11f4972987ee6f7c3f497ad902820f145851f71919d4f45b589e1d809e`). Source selected before new 2018 TP+EQR numeric effects, SHA256 `2190ac905326f4f2f4f278eb0debb4a7bfda7c4c71347d4941b54cc19d3de264`. [Original 2018 measurement coverage SOURCE success #43373061409](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43373061409).
- **Actual treatment-plant effluent P source attribution gate FAILED**: in the original n273 2022 matched WQ/EEA field sites, only **4 sites/2 H7/2 H6** have original EEA *reported, matched upstream* 2022 WWTP annual measured P mass; original recording zeros are not true "no wastewater" controls. Source gate [#43372659602](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43372659602). **NO WWTP→TP→benthic causal mediation test fit**.

### Original biologically measured SAME physical sites over 2018→2022

Real 2018 and 2022 TP year medians recomputed from dated positive source records, all original n263 2022 medians independently matched the saved original TP2022 values; original `numeric_EQR_2018` and `normalised_EQR` both same I2M2 method and country/site key. One equal-site-averaged **Δlog real measured TP** and one **ΔEQR** per original H7 watershed; 73 independent H7 rows /24 H6 geography blocks (source original folds were frozen before outcomes).

| In the SAME 73 catchments, 263 physical EEA stations | Outcome |
|---|---:|
| Δlog(TP 2022/2018) vs ΔI2M2 EQR 2022−2018, H7 Spearman | **ρ−0.126** |
| Source site-level Δ correlation among 263 repeated physical stations | **ρ+0.003** |
| Source within-H7 station-demeaned temporal ΔTP→ΔEQR slope | +0.03225, H7 bootstrap95 [−0.0386,+0.0961] |
| Original static HydroATLAS upstream cropland/urban/natural flow, river site Q, H7 area, nsites, **Δ measured TP sample effort** source-controlled 24 H6-parent Group5fold Ridge10: adding Δreal measured TP to predict ΔEQR | **MSE improvement −0.409%** (worse), H6 parent bootstrap95 **[−6.290%,+3.782%]** |
| Strict leave EACH of 24 H6 parents out separately | **−1.181%** MSE improvement, H6 bootstrap95 [−8.439%,+2.466%] |
| Adjusted original EQR Δ per 1 SD source ΔlnTP | −0.01843, H6-cluster descriptive95 [−0.05545,+0.01859] |

**NULL for simple 4-year within-site coupling, not absence of nutrient response**. Main true source original outcome/action [SUCCESS #43373639391](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43373639391) retains source original 263 river site-year data, H7 73 response and all original GBIF indices.

### Independently recomputed YEAR-BY-YEAR spatial association in exact same n263 /n73 panel (POSTHOC)

A separate **NumPy Ridge10** implementation reproduced all previous 4 original n73 H6 5fold and 24fold leaveout ΔEQR/ΔTP MSE values *exactly* vs original sklearn SVD and independently reproduced original n73 H7 and n263 station correlations and within-H7 slope. It additionally checked year-specific spatial EQR–measured TP on the **same** original 263 sites in both years (not independent re-sampled stations).

| Same physical field stations & original 73 H7 units | TP–I2M2 EQR H7 Spearman | H6 5fold+measured TP predicted EQR improvement | Leave-one-of-24 H6 out |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **2018 cross-sectional real TP + I2M2 EQR** | **−0.73285** | **+30.812%**, parent bootstrap95 [+6.40%,+43.54%] | +30.668% |
| **2022 cross-sectional real TP + I2M2 EQR** | **−0.69719** | **+22.667%**, parent bootstrap95 [+9.17%,+37.65%] | +22.556% |
| **2018→2022 exact physical within-river changes** | **−0.12597** | **−0.409%**, parent bootstrap95 [−6.29%,+3.78%] | −1.181% |

Original 2018 vs 2022 TP geographic ranks **ρ+0.95409**, I2M2 EQR geographic ranks **ρ+0.84864** — strongly persistent geographic structuring with weak 4-year change coupling. Original between-station two-year means TP vs EQR ρ **−0.746**. This does not identify a time lag, biological adaptation, causal pollution or universal macro scaling.

[Independent numerical and year-separated original spatial/temporal evidence SUCCESS #43374058129](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43374058129). This is independent CODE, not independent field sites/countries.

### Original two-period GBIF terrestrial index tests on identical 73 H7 units

The same original H7×2017–19 and H7×2020–22 periods contain independently original GBIF-indexed Plantae speciesKey **50-record rarefied S50** and Lycaenidae **log odds among five butterfly-family occurrence counts**. After original GBIF observation opportunity changes + same HydroATLAS/environment covariates, true river ΔTP added to H6-parent CV:
- **Plant S50 change:** source rho−0.089, **−2.135%** predictive MSE gain (95 [−6.223%,+0.229%]), stricter LOHO −2.395%.
- **Lycaenidae five-family indexed share change:** source rho+0.103, **+0.451%** predictive gain (95 [−3.658%,+5.258%]), stricter LOHO +0.569%.

Neither measures riparian flowering, actual larval host or realized pollinator/plant ecosystem services; no supported serial sewage→river TP→benthos→plants→butterflies mediation.

### Research decision

**Keep BOTH kinds of ecological evidence:** robust original two-year **spatial** ambient phosphorus–benthic integrity negative association in one France-specific BQE system, and **lack of 4-year temporal transfer** at *exact same monitored river stations*. Posthoc spatial-year replays are not two independent ecological experiments. Unknown river-weather seasonality, original measured TP/EQR year sampling dates, EQR normalization, long-term site habitat, lagged/threshold response and genuine source reporting missingness prevent causal assignment.

[Complete signed source result and sample/date checks](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/fr2022-measured-P-source-coverage-longitudinal-source-20261113/docs/RESULTS_20261113_FR_REAL_2018_2022_TP_I2M2_263_SAME_SITES_SPATIAL_TEMPORAL_DECOUPLING_3BIOTA.md).

## NEW observed 2018→2022 TP month-matched validation, same 263 original French river field stations (DRAFT, exploratory)

Stacked on [PR #71](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/71), preserving its main positive spatial TP–I2M2 EQR result and weak within-site four-year changes, original 2018/22 EEA and Peters WQ sources, no modification of older figures/cohorts.

### New source-only outcome-blind calendar month eligibility

Original author actual positive TP measurements from `TP.2_-_Harmonised.zip` (Peters v5, original ZIP publisher MD5 `b596dbe9833c49426147a99f10f3fe31`, original SHA256 `26f2af11f4972987ee6f7c3f497ad902820f145851f71919d4f45b589e1d809e`). EXACT original **263 WQ+EEA physical monitoring station IDs** with 2018 and2022 I2M2 quality and positive 4+ TP readings /3+ months per year; **73 native HydroBASINS Level7 catchments and 24 Level6 hydrological parent blocks**.

Outcome-blind source stage [SUCCESS #43378522025](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43378522025) found **every one of the 263 sites has ≥3 common calendar months sampled in 2018 and2022** (3–12 months range; 250/263 sites ≥6 common months), and no original duplicate sampling dates. **No changes to original 263-site, 73-H7, 24-H6 cohort** when using month-matched TP. Frozen original month membership SHA256 `a02a9f724fb1b1671a9f248ed169620bc25db8b9a5914be566f6728e25b2c4f1`.

### Genuine month-comparable actual TP vs same-site I2M2 EQR (original source 2018/2022)

For every original station, take median observed TP **per month** for each calendar month measured in BOTH source years, then equal-weight original monthly `ln(TP2022)-ln(TP2018)` differences. Aggregate original repeated physical stations once within each H7 and relate to original 2018→2022 same-EEA-station **I2M2 EQR change**. Preserve same original HydroATLAS upstream crop/urban/natural modeled flow, H7 area, original site modeled discharge, exact sampled physical-site count, and observed TP sampling-opportunity differences restricted to those common months. Ridge α10, train-only scale, true source 24-H6 parent 5fold and 24-parent LOHO, original H6 bootstrap 2000 descriptive95.

| Same EXACT 263 sources /73 H7 heldout change test | Original annual-TP delta on same source/environment baseline | NEW SAME calendar-month equal-median TP delta |
|---|---:|---:|
| Raw 73-H7 ΔlnTP vs ΔI2M2 EQR Spearman | **−0.126** | **−0.122** |
| True H6-parent5fold ΔTP added EQR-change MSE improvement | −0.245% | **+0.259%**, H6 boot95 **[−3.992%,+4.104%]** |
| Leave EACH H6 parent out (24fold) EQR-change prediction improvement | −1.117% | +0.402%, H6 boot95 [−3.856%,+4.331%] |
| Month-matched ΔTP adjusted descriptive EQR β per +1 SD ΔlnTP | — | **−0.0170**, H6 cluster95 [−0.04135,+0.00735] |

The full original n263 same station-level monthTP–EQR change Spearman is **+0.01772**. Month-matched TP Δ differs from original annual TP Δ (same H7 rho **+0.596**) but neither meaningfully predicts 4-year I2M2 change. Thus **unequal sampled calendar months alone do not explain the spatial-vs-temporal ecological decoupling**. This is a null/uncertain 4-year within-river response, not proof nutrient effects are absent or lagged.

[Main real original 2018–2022 month-balanced TP change/I2M2 three-layer H6 CV SUCCESS #43378917089](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43378917089). Original 263 physical station measured source /73 H7 rows and all signed models saved as downloadable Actions artifacts.

### Actual H7 GBIF terrestrial records in same source study

- Original indexed Plantae speciesKey-rarefied S50 change vs actual ΔTP_month (n73 H7) unadjusted rho +0.0175; source H6 5fold extra source ΔTP predictive gain **−1.389%** (95 [−4.282%,+0.932%]).
- Original Lycaenidae log odds within 5 butterfly-family index occurrences change vs ΔTP_month raw rho−0.0486, H6 5fold extra ΔTP predictive gain **−3.495%** (95 [−6.175%,−1.000%]), strict H6-LOHO −1.721%. **Neither is real flowering/host support/butterfly abundance/visits/pollination**; no ecosystem-service cascade measured.

### Independent numerical + EEA score provenance QA

Separate manual NumPy Ridge code (vs original sklearn SVD) reproduces **seven original benthic MSEs** and both terrestrial observation-index MSEs, original H7 and site-level ranks exactly. The original **2018 source code and 2022 source code BOTH derive analytical EQR from official `resultNormalisedEQRValue`**, so 2018 raw and 2022 normalized EQR were not accidentally mixed, original 263 source EEA station IDs all FR/I2M2 matching. However **original unnormalized 2018 EQR `resultEQRValue` is nonnumeric/missing in 263/263 field sites**, so the national reference-class normalization or scoring calibration *cannot be independently reconstructed* from these raw site values. [Independent source/EEA field lineage and numeric CV QA SUCCESS #43379428285](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43379428285).

### Scientific interpretation and report

**Supported:** the strong 2018 and2022 *spatial* real river TP vs I2M2 EQR negative association and stable watershed rankings from PR71. **Not supported:** proportional 4-year *within-physical-site* EQR change corresponding to measured TP change, including original same-calendar-month correction. **Not identified:** specifically WWTP-derived P causing the observed ambient TP or benthic change (only 4/273 French 2022 TP/EQR sites have original positive matched EEA WWTP P report source); temporal lag, stable habitat context, changing climatic hydrology, or realized biodiversity/pollination services.

[Full exact original sources, monthly support distribution, controls, direct negative/uncertain outcomes and whole-H7 GBIF separate response results](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/fr2018-22-matched-calendar-month-TP-I2M2-20261113/docs/RESULTS_20261113_FR263_SAME_SITE_TP_2018_2022_COMMON_MONTHS_I2M2_THREE_LAYERS.md).

**Keep DRAFT UNMERGED**, do not overwrite older PR #65–71 or `gesui/main`/`chocho`, no eBird.

## NRSA2023–24 PHab original EPA data × measured river TN/TP × standing biofilm quality — SOURCE/NUMERIC COMPLETE (Draft)

A targeted continuation of [PR #75](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/75). Original 2023–24 EPA benthic Count/MMI still HTTP404; **no 2023 benthic community, wastewater-derived effluent nutrient, actual net production, or ecosystem-service cascade invented**.

### Genuine independently validated new EPA original source
- The official EPA [NRSA2324 Physical Habitat Metrics](https://www.epa.gov/system/files/other-files/2026-06/nrsa2324_physicalhabitat_metrics.csv) (SHA256 pinned), together with metadata, was successfully acquired and **1:1 matched to 2,129/2,129 original pre-PHab NRSA native UID surveys** across 1,041 HUC8, 48 states, with 0 duplicate source UIDs.
- [Original source-only success #43459407538](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43459407538). Phenotype/response signs unseen at source selection.
- Pre-fixed two actual field PHab tiers: **broad** XPCAN (canopy presence), XGVEG (riparian ground vegetation), XFC_OHV (overhanging vegetation), XWIDTH (actual wetted width); **dense** adds XCDENMID (midchannel canopy density) and XEMBED (streambed embeddedness). Canopy is NOT measured solar radiation. AFDM is standing organic material, NOT NPP.

### True original 2023–24 measured ambient in-stream nutrients × original periphyton
Strict original n1,828/946 HUC8/48 states source from PR #75 unchanged. The new complete-case **dense** native subset n1,117 /673 HUC8 is source-missingness determined, not response-sign tuned. Same original state/eco9/geography/season/river order/conductivity baseline; same original HUC8-disjoint 5fold Ridge alpha10; adjusted independent HUC8 robust OLS.

| Actual original response: log10(Chla[ug/cm²]/AFDM[mg/cm²]) | Broad PHab, n1,828 | Dense PHab, n1,117 |
|---|---:|---:|
| **+measured TN+TP after PHab**, HUC8 heldout MSE gain | **+1.8365%** | **−0.2596%** |
| HUC8 fixed heldout error-bootstrap 2000 descriptive95 for above | **[+0.252,+3.684]%** | **[−1.524,+1.001]%** |
| Ambient logTP adjusted slope per +1 SD after PHab [HUC8 descriptive95] | **−0.08971 [−0.12928,−0.05014]** | **−0.05632 [−0.10464,−0.00801]** |
| **PHab added after TN+TP**, same HUC8 heldout MSE gain | +0.5713% | **+10.3803%** |
| Fixed heldout cluster bootstrap95 for PHab gain | [−0.606,+1.718]% | **[+5.880,+14.428]%** |

**Within the same dense n1,117 rather than comparing different cohorts**, TP ratio beta shifts −0.08095 before PHab to −0.05632 after PHab; ambient TN+TP added-information +1.3314% before PHab becomes −0.2596% after PHab. The physical env and river nutrients are simultaneously observed; this observational co-gradient does NOT identify shade, sediment or phosphorus causality.

Separate component results:
- Broad AFDM: +N/P after physical **−0.296%** MSE (worsening), TP beta+0.0176 CI spans zero.
- Dense AFDM: +N/P after physical −0.945% (negative predictive value), TP beta+0.0286 CI spans zero.
- Broad areal Chla: +N/P after physical +0.776%, TP beta−0.0721 CI excluding zero; dense Chla: −0.358%, TP beta−0.0277 CI spanning zero.
- Pigment/AFDM is an **algebraic difference** of the original Chla and AFDM responses, originally conceived after prior results, not independent field confirmation.

### Complete actual source and numerical audits
- Original PHab source and pre-outcome 2,129 native UID QA [SUCCESS #43459407538](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43459407538)

All match original within tolerance; not separate field observations.

[Full results, coefficients, missingness and causal boundary](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nrsa2324-phab-confounders-20261114/docs/RESULTS_20261114_NRSA2324_PHAB_NP_AREAL_BIOMASS_PIGMENT.md).

**Interpretation:** The negative instream TP–pigment-per-AFDM spatial gradient survives broad PHab controls, but stronger measured canopy-density and riverbed-embedding environmental information diminishes TP association and removes robust nutrient incremental prediction in the smaller valid subcohort. *This is not a WWTP-driven biotic effect or an ecosystem-service proof.* Preserve #73–75 positives and nulls, no eBird, DRAFT UNMERGED.

## Actual original 2018–19 EPA macro: same river site/visit chemistry × benthic community × periphyton pigment × riverbank/habitat

Extends [PR #76](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/76) with **a genuinely site-matched multi-biota 2018–19 panel**, not a synthetic chain between 2018 EPT and 2023 AFDM. Does NOT upgrade missing 2018/23 reported effluent N/P from [PR #74](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/74).

### New same-survey macro ecological estimates, HUC8-blocked OOS

In the **DENSE field habitat** model (still the SAME n946/603-HUC8 cohort):
- Field PHab added after actual stream TN/TP improves EPT fraction prediction **+11.1375% MSE**, areal Chla **+3.3136%**, taxon-ID richness **+3.2599%** (each a different response/model).

- EPT fraction partial relationship vs Chla after PHab/TN/TP: β **−0.019864 per +1 SD logChla**, HUC8 cluster descriptive95 **[−0.033648,−0.006080]**, while raw Spearman is only **ρ−0.04857**. Adding measured Chla to EPT prediction after actual N/P+PHab is **+1.0857%**, HUC8 OOF descriptive95 **[−0.0507%,+2.2629%]** crosses zero.
- Independently observed Chla conditional on EPT after PHab/TN/TP gives coefficient **−0.05642 [−0.09504,−0.01779]**; reverse model is NOT independent biological replication or evidence of causation.
- EPT vs TN partial β **−0.03402 [−0.05844,−0.00960]**, vs TP near-zero. Native taxon-ID richness vs TP β **−0.03562 [−0.06536,−0.00588]**, explicitly taxon-ID and not taxonomic species count.

[Detailed original-data scientific results and noncausal limitations](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nrsa1819-ept-chla-phab-triad-20261114/docs/RESULTS_20261114_TRUE_SAME_VISIT_EPT_CHLA_TAXON_PHAB_MACRO.md).

**Research result:** a site-matched macro aquatic multi-biota *observational* association / partial decoupling, not demonstrated municipal effluent production subsidy, nutrient→biofilm→insect mechanism, or any measured pollination, emergent insect mass or terrestrial ecosystem service. Official alternate WQX/WQP 2023–24 benthic source endpoint probes are a separate source-only opportunity; report their actual status without inferring missing biology or claiming confirmed recovery.

### New direct ORIGINAL source falsifications (2026-11-14)

[Additional true original 2018/19 EPA physical metric source-range and fixed six-cohort posthoc QA SUCCESS #43530015630](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43530015630):

Original EPA NRSA2023/24 benthic CSV links still inaccessible in #75. Do not invent an expanded source panel.

prs.body:
## EPA NRSA 2018–19 n946 same-visit EPT×Chla×physical habitat: riverbed moderation (DRAFT / exploratory posthoc)

This extends the previously source-verified actual EPA [PR #77](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/77) **946 native UID river visits/603 HUC8/47 states** with true water TN/TP, periphyton areal Chla, BERW counted EPT fraction, and field PHab. Five candidate physical interaction modifiers (XCDENMID canopy density, XEMBED riverbed embeddedness, XPCAN canopy fraction, XGVEG riparian ground vegetation, XWIDTH wetted width) were committed before inspecting the *new* moderator effects in the [protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nrsa1819-ept-chla-context-interactions-20261114/docs/NRSA1819_EPT_CHLA_PHAB_INTERACTION_PRENUMERIC_PROTOCOL_20261114.md). The hypothesis is still **POSTHOC** to original 2018 EPT–Chla known weak negative association and should not be described as confirmatory.

### Original field outcome and genuine site/year support
- Genuine EPA original native EPT counted individual fraction, areal periphyton Chla, true ambient in-stream total N/P, canopy, riverbed embeddedness, riparian ground vegetation and channel width. Not true sewage delivered load, gross primary production, aquatic insect emergence biomass or ecosystem service.
- Complete fixed Q model: original geographic/state/eco/river size/season/cond/TN/TP + physical habitat main effects + areal Chla and its **quadratic**. For each one modifier, add ONLY Chla×that PHab term; whole original HUC8 group heldout fivefold Ridge10 with no test-outcome leakage, report extra MSE vs **same quadratic reference**. Descriptive HUC8 clustered OLS, Holm-adjusted five specified modifiers.

### Original results, all positive and null moderators retained

| PHab moderator × measured Chla | β interaction [HUC8 cluster descriptive 95] | exploratory Holm5 p | Extra heldout geographic MSE gain |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| **Riverbed embeddedness XEMBED** | **+0.01921 [+0.00693,+0.03150]** | **0.01084** | **+0.740%**, group bootstrap95 [−0.695,+2.133] uncertain |
| Midchannel canopy density XCDENMID | −0.00043 [−0.01489,+0.01403] | 1.00 | −0.479% (worse) |
| Canopy presence XPCAN | +0.00109 [−0.01367,+0.01585] | 1.00 | −1.058% (worse) |
| Riparian ground vegetation XGVEG | −0.00241 [−0.01494,+0.01012] | 1.00 | −0.218% (worse) |
| Channel width log XWIDTH | +0.00292 [−0.01065,+0.01648] | 1.00 | −0.995% (worse) |

All five interactions together worsen HUC8 OOS **−1.135%**. The single embeddedness contrast predicts original Chla–EPT fraction slope about **−0.0376 EPT share per +1SD logChla** at low original embeddedness Q1=46.15% vs **−0.0051** at high Q3=89.64%; these are conditioned *cross-site associations*, not effects of increasing chlorophyll or reducing sediment.

- New [original EPA statistical 946/603-HUC8 workflow SUCCESS #43537987013](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43537987013).
- [Independent manual NumPy 5 interaction slopes, Holm, all heldout Ridge model MSEs and 7 source-fixed sensitivities SUCCESS #43538310290](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43538310290). This is independent **code**, not new field data.
- First physical site visit n880 β+0.01997 [+.00745,+.03249]; larval counted ≥250 n775 β+0.02231 [+.00836,+.03625]; original midcanopy>100 removed n945 β+0.01913; 2018-only n487 β+0.02052, 2019-only n459 β+0.01761 **uncertain** [−.00283,+.03806] and OOS −0.288%. Sample signs are not evidence of a temporal trend.
- Full n946 embeddedness interaction incremental geographic prediction itself modest, and original fixed-fold HUC8 resample95 spans zero. No universal out-of-region predictive relevance established.
- Need to distinguish reduced/increased EPT counted *share* from non-EPT increase, and any original reported physical subcohort, rather than call this actual biodiversity loss or adult insect flux.

[Full original-data result, physical units, Holm, OOS uncertainty and 7 sensitivities](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nrsa1819-ept-chla-context-interactions-20261114/docs/RESULTS_20261114_NRSA1819_CHLA_EPT_RIVERBED_MODERATION_AND_QA.md).

**Causal boundary:** neither eutrophication intervention nor wastewater effluent attribution; actual historical dual N/P WWTP source support in [PR #74](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/74) failed originally fixed gates. No insect emergence, water-quality service rate or pollination. Preserve prior positives, nulls, year variability. Keep PR unmerged/DRAFT and do not change gesui/main, no eBird.

### Genuine original BERW community decomposition (new subsequent *posthoc* analysis; nulls retained)

The separate [source-first design](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nrsa1819-ept-chla-context-interactions-20261114/docs/NRSA1819_CHLA_EPT_CHIRONOMID_TAXON_DECOMPOSITION_POSTHOC_FREEZE_20261114.md) fixed exactly 3 original response types before checking them. The same authentic EPA original BERW positive 45,713 taxon-count rows/1,221 source-native UIDs and exact n946/603 original NRSA same-visit cohort were reconstituted; `TOTAL300` source EPT fraction independently matches original #77. [Original source computation success #43538846982](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43538846982).

**The originally observed EPT counted-fraction interaction does NOT directly transfer to taxonomic richness or chironomid replacement:** Chironomidae counted-fraction ×Chla×XEMBED β−0.01162 CI [−0.02451,+0.00127] Holm3 p0.231; EPT unique original taxon-ID richness β−0.01140 CI [−0.05149,+0.02869] Holm p0.577; nonEPT unique taxon-ID richness β−0.02208 CI [−0.04722,+0.00306] Holm p0.231. All 3 incremental source-wide HUC8 predictive 2000 fixed-OOF error bootstrap95 cover zero; taxon-ID richness is not species richness or absolute insect biomass.

**Interpretation restriction:** An embeddedness-dependent **relative EPT counted-fraction** vs periphyton Chla observational relationship does *not* demonstrate true EPT abundance, species richness, Chironomidae replacement, adult insect export, food web/actual ecosystem service change, or sewage-effluent causality. Keep all these negative results alongside the original positive interaction, not merely the favorable coefficient.

[Complete result ledger including all positive and null models](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nrsa1819-ept-chla-context-interactions-20261114/docs/RESULTS_20261114_NRSA1819_CHLA_EPT_RIVERBED_MODERATION_AND_QA.md).

## Genuine independent EPA NRSA2013–14 same-visit benthos × algae × AFDM; independent-spatial-transfer FAIL (Draft)

Extends PR [#78](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/78) as a genuinely **different EPA survey cycle**, not a time split of 2018/19. Explicitly preserves earlier positive EPT–Chla×riverbed association and all new negative/uncertain results. Does not demonstrate WWTP-specific sewage nutrient effects, direct biomass production or ecosystem services.

### Original official sources and unit/UID freeze (ALL PASSED)
- Original six EPA NRSA2013/14 publisher CSVs (SiteInfo, Water Chemistry, BERW/BETB Benthic Count, periphyton Chla, areal AFDM, Physical Habitat). **2,254 same-native-UID six-table opportunities**, n2,255 original count UIDs. [Source SUCCESS #43560419988](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43560419988).
- Primary source cohort **n1,203 source-only original `BERW` wadeable `SITETYPE=PROB` native UIDs**, 754 HUC8, 48 states; BETB boatable not pooled. [Source units/method & flags SUCCESS #43560769667](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43560769667). Original reported TN mg/L, TP ug/L, periphyton Chla ug/cm², AFDM mostly mg/cm² with **60 source rows bulk mg excluded**. Unique true UID+SITE_ID for water, PChla, PBIO and PHab. Original PHab date field blank: cannot independently cross-check its collection *date*, but official unique UID/SITE_ID agree. Invalid source NARS lab flags not assigned zero.
- Method harmonization uses exact 6 common field physical covariates; original 2013 XGV ≠ original 2018 XGVEG, so not falsely crosswalked. Spatial HUC8-disjoint 5fold Ridge10; HUC8 cluster descriptive95 OLS, Chla² nuisance; no outcome-based source selection. Unweighted sample site inferences ≠ nationally weighted river miles.

### Actual independently sampled EPA 2013/14 field-cycle result, and same six-covariate 2018 comparison
- **2013–14 n1,116 BERW same-visit EPT counted individual fraction × real areal Chla × real in-stream N/P × physical habitat**, 706 HUC8 /48 states /1028 unique physical sites: original source `Chla × XEMBED` EPT-fraction interaction **β+0.01128 [+.00024,+.02232]**, p=.0453, HUC8 OOS extra **+0.073%** with fixed-error bootstrap95 **[−.613,+.790]%**, **NOT robust geographic prediction**. [Original EPA field fit SUCCESS #43561068908](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43561068908).
- Original **2018–19 same exact SIX field PHab model n946/603 HUC8** refit β **+0.01957 [+.00718,+.03197]**, HUC8 extra **+0.733%**. Original 2018 PR78 beta+.01921 used extra XGVEG so the newly harmonized coefficient is the honest comparison. [Separate manual NumPy source model + year/count/unique-site sensitivity SUCCESS #43561313134](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43561313134).
- **Critical geographic falsification**: original cohorts share **419 HUC8**, giving 890 union distinct HUC8, NOT 1,309 independent basins. Restricting original **2013/14 to 287 HUC8 absent from all 2018 sampled HUC8 (n384 visits)** yields **β−0.00210 [−.02146,+.01727] and HUC8 OOS −1.192%** (worsens): **new catchments do not reproduce 2018 claim**. The 2018-only 184 HUC8 n229 violates original lower sample gate and is not fitted. [Additional true source independent HUC8 exclusion SUCCESS #43561647073](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43561647073).
- 2013 original 2013-only n563 beta+.01675 but OOS −1.066%; 2014-only n553 beta+.00833 interval overlaps zero and OOS −.379%; original BERW count≥250 n941 beta+.00901 interval overlaps zero. All sensitivities retained.

### Novel actual **same-visit 2013 AFDM × EPT × Chla × nutrients** (not synthetic cross-era pathway)
- Real n**1,094 site-visits /693 HUC8 /47 states** had original **areal AFDM (mg/cm²)**, areal Chla, wadeable counted EPT fraction, water TN/TP and all common PHab.
- Original **AFDM × riverbed embeddedness** on EPT share β **+.00621 [−.00599,+.01842]**, extra out-of-HUC8 MSE gain **−.023%** (null).
- True raw Spearman EPT share vs AFDM **−.197**, AFDM vs Chla **+.573**, but adjusted **EPT~AFDM** per+1SD β **−.01636 [−.03708,+.00437]** includes zero after original measured TN/TP, Chla, PHab and space/season. EPT +source AFDM after background HUC8 MSE gain **+.213%** bootstrap95 [−.534,+.956], +Chla **+.145%** [−.366,+.691], +both **+.042%** [−.687,+.794]. No independent predictive chain.
- Measured ambient N/P does NOT predict real areal AFDM beyond environment: extra HUC8 MSE **−.785%** with descriptive bootstrap95 **[−1.337,−.270]%**; no stable adjusted TN or TP AFDM coefficient. This is source-specific observational predictor performance, not nutrients biologically inert.
- [Original full-source nested three-layer actual model SUCCESS #43561534371](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43561534371); [independent manual NumPy source-reconstructed 1094 same-visit heldout MSE and HUC8 cluster beta/CI and resource outcome QA SUCCESS #43561707451](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43561707451). Same field data, independent implementation only.

### Science and limits
The original PR78 EPT–Chla×riverbed sign was **weakly reproduced as a cycle-level observational association**, but **failed transfer to newly sampled HUC8** and yielded almost zero 2013 geographic OOS gain. The direct measured AFDM→EPT observed ratio/partial models did not yield an independent predictive or inferential biomass-diversity cascade. No documented wastewater-specific load-at-visit was attached (PR #74 original DMR N/P source eligibility fail), and AFDM is standing organic mass rather than net primary production or insect export. Neither ecosystem services nor riparian pollination measured.

[Complete original source metadata, independent positive and negative results and explicit generalization failure](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nrsa1314-independent-ept-chla-embeding-20261114/docs/RESULTS_20261114_NRSA1314_INDEPENDENT_CYCLE_EPT_CHLA_AFDM_SPATIAL_GENERALIZATION.md).

No eBird. Keep DRAFT, unmerged, do not overwrite PRs #73–78 or main.

## Third independent EPA NRSA2008–09 period: RESCUED raw EPT count n1232, observed ambient N/P–EPT taxa strong, habitat prediction, zero invented algae/sewage (DRAFT)

### Real original EPA 2008 field source and rescue of structural data limitation
- [5 real EPA source CSVs + metadata SHA and original native 2,121 UID intersection SUCCESS #43562414140](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43562414140); [wadeable BERWW original / CHEMW original / SiteInfo/PHab/MMI original 1,299 UID, 796 HUC8, 48 states source-only SUCCESS #43562599406](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43562599406). - Found official independently published original taxon list mapping `TAXA_ID`→`ORDER`, **1,323 taxon keys with zero order conflicts**, **98.9328% original positive counted individuals** with verified order, **1,232 source original BERWW primary UID visits** having >=95% known-order counted organisms. [Original source-only taxonomic crosswalk QA SUCCESS #43563239544](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43563239544).
- Independent *real EPA publisher validation* of reconstructed `TOTAL300` counted EPT share vs EPA-published `EPT_PIND` in **279 same original visit IDs**: **median absolute difference 0.00296 percentage points, 0% exceed 1 pp**. Unknown taxon-order specimens remain unknown, report lower and upper EPT share bound. [Fidelity SUCCESS #43563366026](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43563366026). Strahler natural labels 1st→1 to7th→7; ambiguous single `8th+` unresolved, not guessed.

### Actual original 2008 benthic ecological associations

True EPA 2008 same-visit CHEMW and PHab source-strict unalerted and original counted BERWW model [SUCCESS #43563594143](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43563594143). Whole HUC8-disjoint spatial 5fold Ridge10, all actual river bed width/canopy/vegetation/stream-order, spatial state/eco controls and contemporaneous *ambient* log10 TN/TP. Original reported NTL and PTL both µg/L, unit-converted to mg/L correctly. Each response independently eligibility-gated, don't confuse n1299 source with complete cases:

| Original real benthic endpoint | Strict n original sites/ HUC8 | Extra N+P predictive MSE gain AFTER PHab | Fixed HUC8-OOF bootstrap95 | PHab added after N/P |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Original counted EPT fraction (raw TOTAL300; conservative unknown-order bound) | **586 /437** | **+1.925%** | [−0.387,+4.068]% (uncertain) | +8.153% |
| **Published EPT taxon number log1p(EPT_NTAX)** | **457 /357** | **+8.035%** | **[+2.538,+13.152]%** | +14.949% |
| Original publisher MMI_BENT biological integrity score | 586 /437 | +3.102% | [−0.358,+6.308]% (uncertain) | +17.175% |

Original 2008 EPT taxon number source adjusted **TN β−0.1091 [−0.1885,−0.0297], TP β−0.1201 [−0.2009,−0.0393]** per +1SD log nutrient after physical geography. Original MMI vs TP β−2.477 [−4.439,−0.516], MMI vs TN interval crosses zero. EPT counted fraction nutrient coefficients both negative but interval crosses zero. These are **natural stream nutrient co-gradients**, **not sewage effluent attribution or causal species loss**, and published EPT_NTAX has source-specific missingness.

[Independently rebuilt source field data & manual NumPy Ridge/OLS HUC8 cluster + source unknown taxon upper/lower sensitivity SUCCESS #43563980256](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43563980256). The full original original source EPT share lower mean 0.28921 /upper if all unknown EPT 0.29309; upper-bound N+P OOS +1.901% vs conservative lower +1.925%. Near-collinear smaller n457 category design yields ~0.13% CI halfwidth discrepancy under explicitly documented 0.3% relative-CI numerical audit tolerance; all coefficients/MSE match. No independent field sample implied by independent code.

**[Complete result ledger: original source SHA and fidelity, OOS effects, 2008 lacks algae, 3-cycle limits](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nrsa0809-thirdcycle-benthos-physical-np-20261114/docs/RESULTS_20261114_NRSA0809_TAXON_RESCUE_EPT_NP_PHAB_3RESPONSES.md).**

### Scientific boundary and design consequences

### Precommitted robust external generalization
[Source-first protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nrsa-threecycle-ept-crossperiod-huc8-20261114/docs/NRSA_THREE_CYCLE_EPT_AMBIENT_NP_PHAB_HUC8_TRANSPORT_PROTOCOL_20261114.md): for each unknown entire era, train on the other two eras after **excluding all UIDs in ANY HUC8 occurring in the heldout era**, 0 train/test overlap. Original HUC8 native source artifacts normalized only unequivocal 2008 7-digit dropped leading0 and 2013 literal `H` prefix, with noncollapsing ID QA before ecological predictions. Train-only source-specific category vocabulary and train-only scaling, **HUC8-equal Ridge α10 fitting**, HUC8-equal target MSE primary, 2,000 target HUC8 fixed-OOF bootstrap95. Original source variables: B=lat/lon/stream order/field season/conductivity/state/eco9; NP=actual in-stream logTN+logTP (correct original mg/L source conversions); PHab=original XEMBED, XCDENMID, XPCAN, XFC_OHV, W1_HALL and log wetted width. No year/cycle effects calibrated to unseen future era. No sign-based adjustment.

### Observed actual out-of-period, out-of-HUC8 prediction
[Original genuine EPA source rebuilt and model SUCCESS #43566511111](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43566511111); [independent manual NumPy weighted normal-equation categorical/source and HUC8 equal heldout bootstrap **SUCCESS #43566835585**](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43566835585), all external MSE and bootstrap values independently reproduced to fixed tolerances. Not independent field observations, just independent code on real original EPA data.

| Entire target survey cycle / actual test n/HUC8 | Training n/HUC8 after deleting ALL target HUC8 | Additional PHab AFTER measured NP, HUC8-equal MSE gain [fixed heldout HUC8 bootstrap95] | Additional in-stream NP AFTER PHab, gain [bootstrap95] |
|---|---|---|---|
| **2008–09 n586/HUC437** | 1199 /593 | **+7.452% [+1.585,+13.270]%** | **+2.586% [+1.058,+4.024]%** |
| **2013–14 n1116/HUC706** | 444 /324 | **+7.979% [+3.616,+12.495]%** | +0.199% [−2.152,+2.640]% uncertain |
| **2018–19 n946/HUC603** | 675 /427 | **+11.193% [+8.341,+14.129]%** | +0.888% [−0.735,+2.518]% uncertain |

**Stricter entirely novel HUC8 only** (no other period originally ever had those HUC8; same already zero-leak train):
- 2008 original-only **n172/140HUC**: PHab +3.577% [−8.796,+15.437]% uncertain; NP **+4.696% [+1.692,+7.404]%**.
- 2013 original-only **n248/193HUC**: PHab +7.802% [−0.612,+16.101]% uncertain; NP −2.283% [−7.595,+2.824]% uncertain.
- 2018 original-only **n184/147HUC**: PHab **+15.669% [+10.017,+21.086]%**; NP +0.998% [−2.190,+4.009]% uncertain.

**Context within-era HUC-disjoint fivefold**: PHab after N/P improves EPT fraction across 2008 +6.68%, 2013 +9.33%, 2018 +11.16%, with all HUC bootstrap95 above0; NP after PHab within-era weaker, with n2013 point −0.037%.

### Science contract and important limitations
**Important stable macroecological *predictive* result:** six authentic original physical habitat field metrics improve EPT relative fraction transport between complete national survey cycles and nonoverlapping HUC8; full N/P only clearly adds information on original 2008 test sites. No proof all six individual metrics drive ecology; the composite includes human disturbance and channel width. Other-period prediction under 2013 test has only 444 original training visits due strict HUC exclusion, and 2013/18 source panels are original PCHL-eligible subcohorts whereas 2008 lacks Chla (2008 wade BERWW vs later BERW protocols differ). Original survey sites are unweighted; no nationally representative stream-mile prevalence inferred.

No measured wastewater-origin POTW N/P dose: prior actual DMR exact source gate in [PR #74](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/74) failed. No real 2008 algae pigment/AFDM, no aquatic insect emergence dry mass, riparian predation, purification rate or pollination. A prediction MSE gain is neither effect direction nor sewage causal effect. Keep original positives AND all nulls/failures from #73–80. No eBird or TinyFish, Draft/unmerged, leave main unchanged.

[Full true original data, train/test catchment identity, category controls, MSE tables, uncertainty and limitations](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/nrsa-threecycle-ept-crossperiod-huc8-20261114/docs/RESULTS_20261114_NRSA_THREECYCLE_EPT_AMBIENTNP_PHAB_HUC8_EXTERNAL_TRANSPORT.md).

### Additional posthoc PHab mechanism sensitivity: four source-semantic groups, all signs/uncertainties

After the stable full-six-physical results were seen, but **before looking at any individual group response**, fixed exactly four transparent original EPA field-source group blocks: streambed embeddedness (`XEMBED`), canopy/cover (`XCDENMID+XPCAN+XFC_OHV`), original width (`log XWIDTH`), and human disturbance (`W1_HALL`). - **2008–09**: canopy/cover **+3.663%** descriptive95 **[+1.048,+6.369]**; actual channel width **+4.419% [+1.047,+7.829]**. Bed embeddedness +3.187% [−2.910,+9.029] uncertain; W1_HALL −0.315% uncertain.

Width conditional 2018 +1.642% [+.367,+2.911], 2008/2013 uncertain. These are information-added-value diagnostics, not causal component effects and not multiplicity-protected independent hypotheses.

[Original genuine EPA 3-period source ablation SUCCESS #43567292831](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43567292831); **[independent manual NumPy all 3×4 standalone/conditional MSE+bootstrap values SUCCESS #43567482957](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43567482957)**. Other two original cycles train, with **all original HUC8 shared with entire heldout survey period removed**, zero train/test overlapping original HUC8. ### Audits and sensitivity
