prs.body:
## Actual original-data progress (2026-11-14)
A genuinely source-reconstructed **five-family** comparison now uses the *same* original 454 European H7 basin-period records / 232 L7 catchments / 90 authentic L6 hydrological parents. Four original GBIF-family source shards and signed original 454 study cohort from existing Actions artifacts were re-joined; all family denominators and original Lycaenidae log-odds revalidated. A local independent NumPy reanalysis produced the signed H6 out-of-parent results. **The new branch GitHub workflow's success has not yet been verified, and the local result is not a second field study.**

**Primary H6-equal holdout MSE gain when adding modelled HydroWASTE geography after source recording, real flow, method, country, and upstream crop/urban land cover:** Lycaenidae / Pieridae **+0.891%** (H6 bootstrap95 **[-5.189,+5.170]**); Lycaenidae / Nymphalidae **-1.610%** **[-5.333,+1.700]**. Both have **no stable source predictive added-value** and negative or mixed country transfer.

**Secondary all-five-family outcomes:** Lycaenidae vs rest **-2.454%** H6 gain, Nymphalidae +3.867%, Pieridae **+6.361% [1.361,11.208]**, Papilionidae -3.271%, Hesperiidae +0.151%; Pieridae fails six country-equal transfer (**-3.210%**). These are relative GBIF record-composition indices, *not* measured butterfly abundance, puddling or sewage-specific effect. No positive sign-selection or causal claim.

Full originals, fitted summary and limitations: [new source-aligned results ledger](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-butterfly-fivefamily-wastewater-niche-20261114/docs/RESULTS_20261114_EU454_BUTTERFLY_FIVE_FAMILY_WWTP_GEOGRAPHY.md). Source/method framework: [protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-butterfly-fivefamily-wastewater-niche-20261114/docs/SEWAGE_ASSOCIATED_ASSEMBLAGE_FIVE_BUTTERFLY_FAMILIES_PROTOCOL_20261114.md).

## Scientific direction
No general Lycaenidae sewage-family-level hotspot demonstrated at whole-basin period scale. Focus instead on **local observed adult puddling vs host-plant/larval ant interactions vs aquatic insect and predator pathways**, with source-verified outfalls, natural wet and stormwater-only controls, butterfly species/sex/behavior and water Na/N/DON measurements. Do not assume fish carcasses imply sewage. Keep all previously observed positives and nulls, do not merge main or chocho, no eBird/TinyFish.
 
## New assemblage-level original analysis (2026-11-14; after previous five-family contrasts)

New original data-locked reanalysis in exactly the same 454 H7×period / 232 H7 / 90 H6 cohort found a **context-dependent predictive geography** for the 5-family GBIF *recording-composition* Hill-Shannon effective family number: modelled wastewater basin-outlet source index improves H6-parent-disjoint, H6-equal MSE **+10.486% [1.559,18.516]**. Sensitivities to >=100 or >=500 original five-family records retain about +10%, but leave-country-out ROW-WEIGHTED prediction worsens **−7.374%** and result varies by year: 2017–19 **+16.117%** vs 2020–22 **+1.883% (uncertain)**. FR-only **−0.229%**, outside-FR **+17.818%**, strongly heterogeneous. Original W and upstream urban cover correlate **ρ=+0.781**; adjusted positive Hill¹ source coefficient CI spans zero.

Post-result alternative family indices were less certain: Simpson effective family count H6 gain +8.524% [−0.066,+16.243]; rarefied-to-20 observed family expectation +8.047% [−1.152,+16.863]. **These are not independent confirmations, not evidence of actual sewage resource attraction, family functional diversity, or population increase**.

Beyond static source: 222 truly repeated H7 original five-family periods, new family-composition Jensen–Shannon turnover response to static W gives H6 MSE **−2.137% [−7.772,+3.671] (null)**. In 169 exactly repeated EEA physical site/method H7 pairs, adding recorded 5-family turnover **does not improve** true EQR temporal change **−1.366% [−16.571,+10.265]**, nor plant original indexed S50 change **−11.725% [−27.841,+3.132]**. Original 169 Lycaenidae historical Δrecord log-odds exactly reconciled with the five-family source counts. All nulls retained.

- [Complete original-data source provenance, contrasts, sensitivity results and limitations](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-butterfly-fivefamily-wastewater-niche-20261114/docs/RESULTS_20261114_WASTEWATER_FIVEFAMILY_ASSEMBLAGE_HILL1_JSD_BIOTIC_COHANGE.md)
- [Nested patch→reach→catchment field experiment design plus study-level meta-analysis eligibility framework](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-butterfly-fivefamily-wastewater-niche-20261114/docs/PROTOCOL_20261114_WASTEWATER_ASSOCIATED_ECOSYSTEM_FIELD_MACRO_META.md)

**Next scientific interpretation:** use verified site-specific source/flow chemistry (Na, NH4, DON, DO) and local butterfly feeding behavior vs plant hosts/larval reproduction; independent wet-reference controls; aquatic emergent prey and predators. A *sewage-associated ecosystem* may be diagnosed via **replicated resource/stress interaction routes**, not required positive Lycaenidae family share. No global/causal generalization, no new successful workflow run asserted; Draft remains unmerged.

## New larval host interaction dataset, six-family comparison + chocho direct source audit (2026-11-14)

**Real source analysis complete, distinct from wastewater effect tests.** The newly integrated Ferrer-Paris (2014) original 43,645 host records / six butterfly families source Git blob ea93a5c0fdb17e361a9b6a9637a497a12e90493c was parsed; 3,785 strict butterfly binomial-like names with >=1 strict binomial host. Rarefaction to 10 distinct source-known host plants estimates mean host PLANT-family number **Lycaenidae 3.3535 (n41 butterfly spp), Nymphalidae 2.6803 (n100), Pieridae 1.8113 (n35), Papilionidae 2.3954 (n38), Hesperiidae 1.8648 (n34)**; genus bootstrap Lycaenidae vs Pieridae difference **+1.5422 [0.5477,2.4996]**, but vs Nymphalidae **+0.6732 [−0.2654,1.7213]** uncertain. 5-host and no-Wikipedia sensitivities retained. These are *catalogue host records*, heavily ascertained and not species-level local sewage responses.

Exact name overlap with frozen chocho 239 butterfly metrics **228 taxa**, Spearman Ferrer vs chocho host species count **ρ+0.944** and host-family count **ρ+0.657**, but **overlapping historical HOSTS sources mean they are not independent ecological validation**. Ferrer reported host-family count versus chocho modeled host-resource geographic expansion in these 228 species **ρ+0.033** (near zero; not formal equivalence or sewage exposure).

Sources and inspectable outputs:
- [Original provenance, five-family rarefaction, genus bootstrap, cross-catalogue limitations and failure-gate plan](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-butterfly-fivefamily-wastewater-niche-20261114/docs/RESULTS_20261114_SIX_FAMILY_LARVAL_HOST_BREADTH_CHOCHO_CROSSCATALOGUE.md)

Crucial **new source blocker**, retained explicitly: the 454 H7×period plant S50 and five butterfly-family source records have no per-H7 species identities in saved artifacts. Therefore this is **not** a fitted same-watershed butterfly-species × host-plant interaction effect. The next verification must retain original GBIF speciesKey histograms for both taxa, then match sources at exactly same H7×period units, before testing sewage-site effects. No invented empirical interactions, no claim sewage attracts Lycaenidae across continents. Draft, no main/chocho merge.

## Three independently analyzed original endpoints
- Static modelled HydroWASTE basin outlet geography W versus original aquatic benthic EQR: partial β per +1 SD W **−0.0750 [−0.1133,−0.0367]**; H6-out MSE gain **+6.725% [−2.453,+13.968]**.

- Add **plant S50 + aquatic EQR** to HNS model after original W and controls: H6 MSE +7.941% [−0.811,+16.318], not stably transferable. Both within-source conditional HNS associations are NEGATIVE; no positive causal mediation path follows.

- Found and rejected four exactly collinear raw country + assessment-method indicators; refitted all models using fully ranked `country×method` strata, method+country known from source.

Fixed original PR #88 H6-disjoint Ridge10/true H6 equal baseline (country×method, period, EEA/GBIF opportunity, urban/crop/natural and station flow, original W; HNS also host coverage + family indices). Baselines W→HNS +10.0143% and W→EQR +6.7250% reproduced EXACTLY.

## Purpose
Move beyond the PR #90 56/454 original positive upstream reported-N/P source index by attempting **official measured receiver-river TN/TP with exact EEA monitoringSiteIdentifier + monitoringSiteIdentifierScheme and exact 2018 or 2022 observation year**. ## Frozen original support

## Verified network and source compatibility
- [#43676663949](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43676663949) SUCCESS for retrieving original station identities and finding genuine `[WISE_SOE].[latest].[Waterbase_T_WISE6_AggregatedData]` database schema. This is a query access restriction, not ecological result.
- Original source-only same-site total N (`EEA_31615-01-7`) and P (`CAS_7723-14-0`) pilot workflow added. Its actual result must be inspected before claiming TN/TP values or matched-sites coverage.

## Hard gates
- Use exact country+station identifier+scheme and exact calendar year 2018 or 2022; distinguish WQ annual aggregates and dated sample records; no duplicated source years.
- River RW, water matrix, original total N/total P only, native measured units/sample counts/LOQ flags preserved; no nitrate or phosphate substitutions, no coordinate-nearby pseudo-matches.
- As a feasibility rule before biological models: >=30 source-positive H7×period, >=20 unique source-positive H7, >=10 H6 and >=3 countries with original true site-year chemistry. If not met, keep evidence map/source STOP rather than fit predictive or mediation coefficients.
- Never equate no upstream source report with zero sewage, or reported annual t/y / modeled Q with observed TN or TP. No derived SEM cascade without root-zone/larval feeding/emergence/predator data.

**Stacked Draft** on PR #90. No merge to main/chocho, no eBird/TinyFish, no manuscript causal claims.

## 2026-11-15 Original measured chemistry source gate result
- Exact original 2018/2022 EEA EQR native station/year dataset: 3,525 station-years /2,485 distinct stations /454 H7×period. Original genuine positive upstream reported WWTP N/P source at 132 original EEA station-years /56 H7 periods. No reported source is NOT a zero-effluent control.
- Genuine source-selected WQ AggregatedData pilot [run #43677482455](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43677482455): 28 H7 periods /45 site queries, 0 strict same-site same-year both total TN and TP.
- Targeted source-positive exact physical stations [run #43677752344](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43677752344): 24 source-positive original station-years and 8 report-unmatched references; 0 strictly verified same-year TN, 0 TP, 0 both; 29 original WQ source site requests complete, 1 truncated 1,000 records. These values are source-failure/coverage, NOT biological or nutrient zero.
- Independent source-mismatch diagnosis [run #43678020210](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43678020210): among 8 selected actual source-positive historical WQ station IDs, 7 fully retrievable original WQ stations have 35 historical TN and 54 historical TP source rows, but none in exact original biological year 2018/2022. Country/site-year ranges HR 2003–2012, HU 1987–2006/07, IT 2007/08, 2010, 2012. This only describes the source-selected subset; remaining original positive stations are NOT validated absent.
- EEA Water Quality ICM 2026 metadata says annual AggregatedData and per-sample DisaggregatedData contain disjoint original reported observations. A separate individual-sample [source pilot #43678184779](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43678184779) is being inspected; result NOT asserted in this section.

No source-specific nutrient->biotic causal mediation or butterfly/food-web SEM calculated.


## Final source feasibility disposition — 2026-11-15
- Strict original EQR source: 3,525 native EEA monitoring station-years / 2,485 original sites / 454 H7×period. Verified positive reported upstream WWTP N/P only 132 native site-years in 56 basin-periods; remaining reports NOT pristine negative controls.
- AggregatedData pilot #43677752344: 32 station-years, including 24 from actual report-positive monitoring station-years; no strict same-2018/2022 TN and TP pairs verified (29 site source requests complete, one truncated).

This reflects temporal source-matching failure, **not measured zero chemistry**.
- Official DisaggregatedData source table schema accessible but four exact original station-ID source requests yielded no usable record-array response #43678184779; no sample-level absence claim. Official 2026 bulk publisher file inventory #43678478810: WebDAV PROPFIND 301, HEAD/GET returned Nextcloud HTML, not partition listing/binary files.
- Full EEA published 2026 WQ source covers 1900–2025, but the portal warns some older WISE6 Discodata sources have not been updated. No claims on exhaustive 2026 station population, no causal SEM and no numerical concentration model are made.
- **STOP:** Required >=30 positive H7-periods across >=20 H7, >=10 H6, 3 countries with same-station-year measured TNTP was not demonstrated. Preserve prior PR90 positive/negative predictive outcomes unaltered. Next source gate must use source-verified 2026 publisher Part 2 aggregated table before any HNS/EQR mediation claims.

## Scope
Original source-locked **directional negative control**, stacked on Draft PR #91 (EEA 2026 measured water-quality feasibility) and Draft PR #90 (original 2018/2022 annual WWTP N/P report vs HNS, EQR and plant S50). No main/chocho merge. **Not a causal study, meta-analysis, 2026 WISE6 actual same-station TN/TP result, or a fitted mediation SEM.**

## Real source denominators and independent original confirmation
- Original EEA benthic monitoring source: 3,525 real station×year records; 454 H7×periods, 232 H7, 90 authentic H6. Frozen original 2018 and 2022 EEA site data SHA/Git blob checked against published repo source.
- **Upstream annual municipal WWTP N/P positive report**: 132 site×years, 56 H7×periods. **Downstream direction report**: 249 site×years, 61 H7×periods. Both positive in 35 H7×periods. All upstream values reproduced original separate source-only SHA exactly, with field-site flow denominator kept constant.
- A zero is **no matched positive reported source**, not a proven absence of sewage. Downstream is a negative-control *geography* at monitored EEA reaches, not a randomized exposure; weaker still for basin-wide GBIF butterfly observations.
- [Real original source-only Action #43679382449](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43679382449): SUCCESS, 4 original source-gate tests and all frozen source counts; source-only artifact digest sha256:c07815e270f7f48f6b24629490b4827e31c4448ae421afc47f9ff0bf85d65e90.

## Same 454 original H7×period, true H6-disjoint Ridge alpha10; relative MSE gain percentages (not organism effects)
| Outcome | UP positive-report indicator | DOWN indicator | UP-minus-DOWN heldout gain pp [H6 fixed error bootstrap95] |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| EQR | +1.920% | +2.170% | -0.249 [-4.132,+4.003] |
| GBIF plant S50 | -0.339% | -2.200% | +1.861 [+0.033,+4.886] (posthoc multiple checks) |
| Butterfly GBIF-record HNS | +3.276% | -0.093% | +3.369 [-3.152,+9.555] |

With annual reported N intensity (each added separately after fixed common baseline): **EQR UP -0.009% vs DOWN +3.497%** (difference -3.506 pp [-9.153,+2.126]); butterfly HNS **UP +0.530% vs DOWN +0.560%** (difference -0.030 pp [-4.392,+4.491]). Both direction contrasts are zero-consistent; therefore no stable upstream-unique nutrient signal, let alone causal N uptake.

## Reproduction verified on GitHub, not just conversation/local
- [Run #43679925365](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43679925365): SUCCESS on original source-frozen 454 H7 panel, **7/7 tests, 27/27 saved manual H6 MSE-gain model comparisons, 27/27 independent sklearn recalculations**; all original results agree with committed source values at max numerical differences <1e-12 gain percentage points. Recomputed artifact 14147589772, digest sha256:0d239b7844cf3906f270052ccaacec4afe78aa9cbce42635e126d19bb516659f.
- Full source-independent report, 454 H7 derived direction panel, all nine H6 model results for each of 3 responses, Python test/rerun source and original source provenance stored in Git history. Original original EEA third-party station-level records and catalogues **not mirrored** publicly.

## Scientific consequence
Under this falsification, the earlier modelled wastewater geography ↔ EQR / butterfly HNS association is **not identified as wastewater resource delivery**. Both above and below monitored sites' reported nutrient sources can carry similar predictive information, consistent with shared urban/reporting/landscape geography. This does **not** prove an absence of ecological impacts. Observed river TN/TP in original EEA 2018/2022 field sites remains unresolved from the public EEA 2026 Part2 source (PR91). No ecosystem-service cascade can be inferred from H7 aggregation.

[Detailed protocol and numbers](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-np-direction-negativecontrol-20261115/docs/RESULTS_20261115_EEA_WWTP_ANNUAL_UPDOWN_NEGATIVE_CONTROL.md)

prs.body:
## New posthoc directional falsification at exactly the same original geography
Same frozen 454 European H7×periods /232 H7 /90 genuine H6 parents as source-verified PR #92. Both original reported-upstream annual WWTP N/P and original downstream-source placebo indices are included as covariates in nested group-disjoint out-of-sample Ridge10 models. No new ecology sites, current chemistry observations, or biological mediator measurements.

### Original report source 2×2 support, not treatment assignment
`up-only=21`, `down-only=26`, `both=35`, `neither positive reported=372`. Only 4 of the 15 original countries have all four report-status cells; 293/299 French source-periods in the neither-report category. No matched positive report ≠ no sewage.

### Primary truly conditional test (additional H6 equal out-of-fold MSE gain in %, fixed-error H6 resampling 95 interval)
| Outcome | UP indicator after DOWN | DOWN indicator after UP |
|---|---|---|
| EQR | +0.312 [−2.470,+3.112] | +0.565 [−1.795,+2.749] |
| Plant S50 | −0.513 [−1.526,+0.391] | −2.377 [−5.755,−0.170] |
| Butterfly source-record HNS | +1.473 [−2.835,+4.259] | −1.959 [−6.090,+1.546] |

**No incremental UP indicator survives the downstream direction control with a zero-excluding H6 interval.** The plant S50 negative DOWN-after-UP interval is a posthoc predictive-worsening diagnostic among many models, not a downstream sewage-induced loss of plants.

Using log reported N load / model flow, UP-after-DOWN MSE gains EQR −0.365, plant S50 +0.280, HNS +0.317; all descriptive H6 intervals cross zero. The same is true for all three UP-after-DOWN reported P contrasts. Nothing here estimates actual receiving river TN/TP, leaf nitrogen, butterfly abundance or observed resource transfer.

### Reproduction and audit
- Source-frozen PR90 measured annual reporting-source JSON and PR92 original up/down H7 panel are recovered from original Actions (#43222864099 and #43679382449). Fixed HNS/plant/EQR original panel bytes SHA and station-direction source identity rechecked.
- Original source-covariate and method country×assessment interactions, fivefold true-H6 groups, Ridge alpha10 and H6-equal MSE unchanged.
- Locally **5/5 tests PASS**, original **30/30 OOF model comparisons agree with independent sklearn** (largest absolute squared error difference 9.35e-12), and **45/45 conditional nested MSE gains exactly reproduced algebraically from PR92 saved original out-of-fold MSEs**.
- New workflow re-runs the same source-frozen models and audits original 45 and saved results on GitHub. Do not claim this new GH run was successful before its status is inspected.

### Interpretation gate
This adds evidence against a robust *direction-specific source-reporting prediction signal* at basin-period scale. The source is a **reported annual infrastructure index**, not verified effluent fraction at exact biological site or river chemistry. No causal wastewater effect, actual larval use/adult puddling, emergent biomass, pollination, food-web flux, ecological service, meta-analytic combined effect, or causal SEM should be inferred. EEA full 2026 TNTP source remains unresolved in prior PR #91. Keep all prior positives and nulls; Draft/unmerged; no main/chocho edits or eBird/TinyFish.

## Confirmed GitHub Actions rerun — 2026-11-15
- [Original-source conditional nested model run #43681789797](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43681789797): **SUCCESS** on final head `b557e8da768c2ff44eb05fb7ce81a4b02d0a4da8`. 7/7 unit tests, all 30 out-of-H6 crossvalidated Ridge predictions cross-checked with independent sklearn, 45/45 nested MSE-gain tests exactly matching archived original PR92 source errors to maximum 1.32e−13 pp; 454 H7×period /232 H7 /90 H6 unchanged.
- Source-only repeated period diagnostic n222 H7: same four-state upstream/downstream reporting group in **194/222**, changed in 28; 19 changed upstream report flag, 19 changed downstream report flag, 10 changed both. Reporting changes are not WWTP starts/stops.
- Same source Git blob SHA for all 12 initial plus 5 updated/new result/code/report/workflow paths was verified on GitHub. The only new data are derived original-source predictions and report-status group diagnostics, not new independent field observations.
- [Results and code](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/tree/analysis/gesui-updown-conditional-placebo-20261115/analysis/20261115_np_conditional); [scientific ledger](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-updown-conditional-placebo-20261115/docs/RESULTS_20261115_NP_CONDITIONAL_UP_DOWN_NEGATIVE_CONTROL.md).

prs.body:
## Purpose: a genuine new source-locked decomposition, **not** a wastewater causal path fit

Stacked on unmerged Draft PR #93; no changes to main or chocho. Same source-frozen **454 European H7×periods / 232 H7 / 90 authentic H6 / 15 countries** (2017–19 and 2020–22) and original HNS panel SHA256 **1296d1ded7f1ee185854cad6d1ece1dbb1f94b4e2f48856c8c487a3f3d002fca**. No new field observations and no new measured receiver TN/TP.

### New observational result: split larval-host N affinity into between- vs within-butterfly-family species composition

The original record-weighted HNS is exactly **between-family reference HNS + within-family species-composition HNS** for all 454 input rows. H6-equal WLS with country×assessment-method, periods, urban/crop/flow/area and records/host-coverage covariates, 90 H6 cluster descriptive normal 95%:

| Outcome | β_W per +1 SD static modelled W | H6 cluster 95 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Record-weighted HNS | **+0.13284** | [+0.03271,+0.23296] |
| Between-family HNS | **+0.00575** | [+0.00134,+0.01017] |
| Within-family HNS | **+0.12708** | [+0.02827,+0.22590] |
| Species-incidence equal HNS | **+0.06998** | [+0.02911,+0.11085] |
| Record minus incidence HNS | +0.06286 | [−0.02407,+0.14978] |

The within-family term is **95.668% of the total W-slope point estimate**, which is **NOT** a variance-explained proportion, indirect causal effect, or reliably estimated mediation fraction. This is a decomposition of fixed-trait GBIF record composition, **NOT** host plant availability, actual larval feeding, adult puddling, butterfly abundance, or selection.

After controlling four family record shares, W→between-family = 0 **by algebraic design**, not because family turnover is ecologically absent; W→record HNS = W→within HNS = **+0.144823738741** (PR #88 same-model independent numeric replication, cluster95 [+0.06497,+0.22468]). No claim of successful H6-out transfer from the new in-sample decomposition, and old H6 OOS W gains remain uncertain and country-dependent.

### Reproducible source-frozen CI and files

[GitHub Actions #43682762269: SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43682762269) on code+workflow head, original 454 panel SHA and cardinality verified, full rank for 32-column and 36-column designs, additive identities held, independent original PR88 coefficient reproduced. Final [Python script](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-decomposition-20261115/analysis/20261115_hns_family_decomposition/analyse.py), [saved original rerun results JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-decomposition-20261115/results/20261115_hns_family_decomposition/SOURCE_LOCKED_HNS_FAMILY_DECOMPOSITION.json), [flat CSV](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-decomposition-20261115/results/20261115_hns_family_decomposition/SOURCE_LOCKED_HNS_FAMILY_DECOMPOSITION.csv), [Japanese scientific interpretation](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-decomposition-20261115/docs/RESULTS_20261115_HNS_FAMILY_COMPOSITION_DECOMPOSITION.md). Fixed report/status source is not an effluent dose. Multiple results were posthoc and 95 intervals not corrected for multiplicity.

### Biological next step (NOT observed here)

Three *separate* pathways are required: 1) effluent → locally measured root-zone/leaf N and host cover → larvae; 2) Na/organic/carrion substrate → observed adult species×sex puddling (possible lycaenid resource choice, not measured in these basin records); 3) effluent → aquatic productivity/emergent insect biomass → terrestrial predators. PR #88 coresponse and PR #93 upstream/downstream negative-controls did **not** identify those arrows. The between-family/within-family result invites within-family species/taxon reanalysis but should never be presented as SEM mediation.

Draft only. No merge, no eBird, no TinyFish.

### Added TRUE H6-out validation, 2026-11-15 — no transferable positive W gain established
[Original-source GitHub Actions #43683047621: SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43683047621). Same frozen 454 rows, same PR88 deterministic 5fold genuine H6-heldout Ridge alpha10; H6-equal MSE and 2,000 H6 fixed-error resamples. **All ten 95% intervals cross zero.**

| Same-source response | Add W without family shares: H6 MSE gain [95] | Add W with family shares: H6 MSE gain [95] |
|---|---:|---:|
| HNS record | +3.891% [−10.499,+14.327] | +10.014% [−3.446,+20.979] |
| Between family | +2.039% [−6.932,+9.792] | −4.285% [−13.913,+3.403] |
| Within family | +3.501% [−10.813,+13.828] | +10.002% [−3.455,+20.980] |
| Species incidence equal | +3.350% [−5.217,+9.845] | +5.092% [−4.447,+12.300] |
| Record − incidence difference | −1.623% [−12.514,+7.654] | +1.676% [−9.338,+10.618] |

HNS +10.01432378% exactly reproduces frozen PR88; source hash, H6 grouping, method and covariate matrix unchanged. Adding W to family-adjusted between-family HNS is redundant by exact algebra, but Ridge shrinkage can change heldout error; negative gain is not biological negative effect. [CV table](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-decomposition-20261115/results/20261115_hns_family_decomposition/H6_OUT_ADDED_VALUE.csv) and [source-locked full JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-decomposition-20261115/results/20261115_hns_family_decomposition/SOURCE_LOCKED_HNS_FAMILY_DECOMPOSITION.json) now contain the new numerical outputs. New ecological mechanism remains unidentifiable.

prs.body:
## Summary — genuine original species-level data, not literature meta-analysis or causal mediation

Stacked **Draft** on unmerged PR #94. Recovered the original archived GBIF source (Actions #43593227162, artifact 14113695873; extracted JSON SHA256 **251f8514684fe8ea62d94ddc8c6eeefb59976471d84d7389b682aff6637144e4**), fixed 303-taxon host-score source SHA **00c1a36a9237a3d1a6d77334aa8baa5dc8b329a49925c2e31f033fa2d302ecdb**, and identical HNS 454 H7-period panel SHA **1296d1ded7f1ee185854cad6d1ece1dbb1f94b4e2f48856c8c487a3f3d002fca**. Exact genuine 2,808 original GBIF H7×period×family/plant facets, 454 H7×periods, 232 H7, 90 H6, 4,400,147 GBIF index records (4,318,269 with speciesKey), 303 butterfly species keys / 186 scored. No new ecological locations or API rescrape.

### Full-cohort additive five-family within-family W-slope decomposition (same PR94 H6-equal WLS)

PR94 total within-family W slope **+0.127083675**, exactly sum of five source families (max residual 2.8e−17):
- Hesperiidae **+0.00851** [H6 cluster95 +0.00332,+0.01370].
- Lycaenidae **+0.02636** [+0.01037,+0.04235].
- Nymphalidae **+0.05068** [−0.03348,+0.13484].
- Papilionidae **+0.00783** [−0.00067,+0.01634].
- Pieridae **+0.03370** [+0.01543,+0.05197].

This is **arithmetic within an occurrence-weighted fixed-host-trait index**, not a fraction of causal ecosystem services or independent family effect.

### Source-supported within-family HNS means and true H6/country transport

Only basin-periods with **>=10 known-score source records, >=2 scored species, >=70% family raw-record HNS coverage** were analyzed (posthoc support gate). Same source controls, independent genuine H6 held-out Ridge10 and H6 equal MSE; all gain intervals are fixed-error *descriptive* 95.

| Family | supported H7×period | W beta [H6 cluster95] | H6-out MSE gain [fixed-error95] |
|---|---:|---|---|
| **Lycaenidae** | **426** | **+0.1205 [0.0461,0.1949]** | **+14.62% [3.67,23.99]** |
| Nymphalidae | 447 | +0.1423 [0.0265,0.2581] | +4.29% [−6.41,13.02] |
| Pieridae | 364 | +0.0937 [0.0096,0.1778] | +5.44% [−5.41,14.69] |
| Hesperiidae | 404 | +0.2024 [0.0703,0.3345] | +12.78% [−1.55,19.85] |
| Papilionidae | 351 | +0.0660 [−0.0163,0.1482] | −1.04% [−2.13,−0.09] |

**Lycaenidae has a source-conditional positive H6-out gain, but leave-country-out country-equal gain +10.35% [−13.37,+22.07] is uncertain.** No universal all-country transfer.

### Additional genuine post-result falsifications

- **All 47 scored lycaenid leave-one-species-out** fits stay positive: W β range **+0.08764 to +0.17980**, all 47 nominal cluster95 lower bounds >0 (not independent confirmations).
- Further family-level GBIF record/species-effort and score coverage controls: Lycaenidae **β+0.11937 [+0.04317,+0.19556]**, H6-out gain **+13.62% [+2.09,+23.34]**, country-out gain +10.42% [−10.51,+21.00].
- Eligibility stress: 452 rows (1 record/1 species/50% coverage): H6 gain **+12.91% [3.14,21.08]**; core 426: **+14.62% [3.67,23.99]**; strict 394 (20 records/3 species/80%): **+18.72% [7.58,28.44]**. Selected posthoc.
- **Crucial adverse host-score uncertainty**: independently assigning within existing documented-host-score lower/upper bounds to the 47 scored lycaenid species permits W β **−0.08590 to +0.31923** at fixed original design. Not a confidence interval. Original species scoring uncertainty can overturn direction, and non-scored taxa/hosts are still uncovered.
- Source species share examples: Cacyreus marshalli (HNS 6.7) contributes +0.00736 to the full-cohort Lycaenidae W slope, while low-HNS Albulina orbitulus (HNS 2) also contributes +0.00733 via its negative record share gradient. No actual individual abundance or local host utilization inferred.

### Verified provenance, code and new evidence

- [GH original species-family source rerun #43689243163 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43689243163)
- [GH 186-leave-one-out and family effort+trait bounds rerun #43689721779 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43689721779)
- [Japanese scientific results ledger](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/docs/RESULTS_20261115_FAMILY_SPECIES_HNS_MACRO.md)
- [Full original-source family model JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_hns_family_taxon/FAMILY_HNS_ATTRIBUTION_RESULTS.json)
- [All 186 species algebraic coefficient contributions CSV](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_hns_family_taxon/SPECIES_W_SLOPE_ATTRIBUTION.csv)
- [Full stress tests JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_hns_family_taxon/FAMILY_TAXON_EFFORT_SENSITIVITY.json)
- [All 186 single-species deletions CSV](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_hns_family_taxon/ALL_186_TAXON_LEAVE_ONE_OUT.csv)

**Limitations:** No measured effluent fraction at butterfly habitat, no same-reach measured soil/leaf nutrient mediator, no larval feeding, adult puddling, or butterfly abundance. W is modelled geography strongly confounded with urban share (ρ~0.78). Fixed-error 95 intervals are exploratory and not multiplicity-adjusted. Do not convert into causal SEM/path coefficients, meta-analytic effect, nutrient subsidy or sewage-dependence conclusion. Main and chocho unchanged. No eBird/TinyFish.

### FROZEN one-shot local riparian design (2026-11-15) — **NO BIOLOGICAL TEST FIT**
Following review that H7 spatial aggregation cannot identify wastewater-specific terrestrial HNS mediation, one prospective point-level **Lycaenidae-only** HNS contrast is locked in the **existing** PR #95 branch: [FROZEN_PROTOCOL_20261115_WITHIN_H7_RIPARIAN_HNS_ONE_SHOT.md](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/docs/FROZEN_PROTOCOL_20261115_WITHIN_H7_RIPARIAN_HNS_ONE_SHOT.md), original freeze commit **83914998cf3694329f6d8d474d310ab4e67b50da**. One primary source/reference matched **(downstream–upstream) × (near–inland)** HNS contrast, fixed 2022 summer, source and location quality, fixed bands 0–200m and 500–1500m, H6-cluster CI, and hard pre-outcome sample/effort conditions. **The 2022 point-record cohort has not been assembled or verified.** The existing DK 2025 directed source audit has 2 distinct downstream outfalls only (PR #42), DE 2022 source/photo gate fails (PR #36), and original 454 H7 panel lacks individual occurrence coordinates. The source-only opportunity gate is not met by currently verified data; **do not fit the biological endpoint, do not change thresholds after inspection, do not call this a sewage-zero or land-transfer-zero result**. This follows earlier exploratory outcomes and is not an independent retrospective preregistration. No new branch, new PR, merge, or inferential workflow was created.


### Frozen source-only feasibility replay — confirmed STOP (2026-11-15)
The 2022 riparian HNS one-shot protocol remains **unchanged** (Git blob b9ce415c36d398eee77d8318a20aef4873e0bf44). The archived DK source-only 2025 directional panel and original DE 2022 source+photo effort/STOP panels were retrieved at exact prior PR commits with byte-identical original Git blobs, alongside the original 454 H7 HNS-panel SHA. [Source-only QA Github Actions #43691928617 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43691928617). [Machine-readable frozen source gate result](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_riparian_source_only/FROZEN_GATE_SOURCE_ONLY_RESULTS.json); [scientific source feasibility ledger](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/docs/RESULTS_20261115_RIPARIAN_ONE_SHOT_PREOUTCOME_SOURCE_GATE.md).

**STOP_DATA_OPPORTUNITY_NOT_YET_DEMONSTRATED**: DK 2025 butterflies (not the locked 2022 year) comprise 10 strict downstream site candidates but only 2 independent source outfalls. DE's original 2022 5 km pre-butterfly photo-effort frame yielded only 5 spatial four-arm quartets, not the locked eight-arm 0–200/500–1500 m cohort, and original 2022 butterfly outcome requests=0. The original H7 454×period file has no point occurrence coordinates/observer events. A new eligible point-level 2022 eight-cell source/reference matched cohort was **not acquired or assembled**. No new Lycaenidae-HNS biological endpoint was opened, modeled or given a p value. The fixed 24 pair protocol implies at least 192 location/arm cells, 3,840 five-family records and 960 cell observer-date opportunities, plus genuine 12 H6/3-country independence. The registry merely documents no *verified* complete matched pair in these legacy sources; it does **not** prove that no valid pairs exist elsewhere or that wastewater fails to reach land. A separate Swedish public GBIF sampling-event source was identified as a **potential unverified opportunity**, not a study result. No additional analysis branches/PRs or main/chocho merges.


### Original 2022 repeat-visit data lead: Sweden SeBMS v1.13 (SOURCE ONLY, not primary HNS)
We downloaded the **2026-10-16 publisher original SeBMS v1.13** DWCA and froze its archive SHA256 **384a2e5145df29268fe2de79fde9e196fc113e68adfc922a81acd58069437348**. Only Event-core was parsed; NO Occurrence extension, species lists, HNS, source treatment assignments, biological mediation or inferential fit. [Source-locked GH Actions #43693414744 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43693414744).

2022 May–September has **2,440 real survey events**: **1,635 point-count visits** (25m original uncertainty; **264 unique coordinate-stable sites**, **127** sites with >=5 distinct visit dates), plus 805 fixed-route Pollard walk visits (1,000m uncertainty; 178 site centroids, 68 with >=5 dates). The latter cannot meet 100m point-coordinate/river-band criteria. Point-site *center* does not locate an individual butterfly, and each 25m sampling footprint must fit inside frozen river-distance bands. Original 2022 whole-year events=2,677. The all-year source has 39,466 event-core records.

The actual [264 public coordinate-center and source-visit metadata CSV](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_riparian_source_only/SEBMS_2022_POINT_SITE_LOCATIONS_SOURCE_ONLY.csv), [SHA-pinned source-only QA JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_riparian_source_only/SEBMS_2026_V113_EVENT_SOURCE_ONLY.json), [code](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/analysis/20261115_riparian_source_only/audit_sebms_2026_113.py) and [research interpretation](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/docs/RESULTS_20261115_SEBMS_2022_ORIGINAL_POINT_EVENT_SOURCE.md) are archived. This is one source-country only, with **ZERO source/reference eight-cell matched pairs verified**; no river/outfall membership or species-score support assessed. The frozen ≥24 independent source/reference pairs, ≥12 true H6 and ≥3 countries remain unfulfilled. **Primary stage remains STOP**. No threshold or year modification; no new branch/PR.


### Authenticated Swedish 2022 directed river source-only audit — 2026-11-15 (no butterfly outcome)

Continued exact unchanged frozen v1.0 2022 source/reference eight-cell HNS plan on EXISTING Draft #95 branch, no new PR. Official EEA UWWTD 2022 SE369 plant and discharge original layers: 25 Swedish reporter plants with positive original N/P, 430 discharge-point rows, **14** uniquely matched single-FW outfalls, **12** with river snaps <=500m. Verified publisher-original HydroRIVERS EU original ZIP SHA256 **500da7d36ceee0aa4c82dd625f5c53d80ba2f7ac14ad022cd3a6601bf55068e5**, **79,439** native directed reaches in expanded Swedish study extent. Independently recovered original prior PR #21 nearest-outfall distance at 225 previously studied site-geographies: maximum absolute distance difference 0km.

For the authentic 2022 SeBMS **127 sites with >=5 visits**, complete 25m uncertainty-disk nearest-river classes: **13 near 0–200m, 38 inland 500–1500m, 34 intermediate/boundary, 42 no mapped river within 1700m**. Screening source/site proximity <=7.5km found **6 site centers associated with 4 registered source outfalls**, of which 2 were near, 2 inland, 2 intermediate. Native NEXT_DOWN **full-reach approximate** source-to-site 1–5km routing confirmed no eligible directed relation in those six. This cannot show that effluent never reaches land: reach full length can exceed source-to-point distance, some tributaries and geographic connections are unrepresented. No source/reference 8-cell matched pairs or biological responses fitted.

[Official source-only GH Actions #43694358102 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43694358102), [exact artifact archival GH Actions #43694715664 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43694715664). [Full scientific ledger](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/docs/RESULTS_20261115_SWEDEN2022_AUTHENTIC_RIVER_AND_WWTP_SOURCE_GATE.md), [source-only summary JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_riparian_source_only/SW2022_ORIGINAL_RIVER_SOURCE_FEASIBILITY.json), [264-site source-nearest river CSV](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_riparian_source_only/SW2022_ORIGINAL_RIVER_SITE_DISTANCE_SOURCE_ONLY.csv), [six source/site candidate relations](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_riparian_source_only/SW2022_ORIGINAL_RIVER_DIRECTION_SOURCE_RELATIONS.csv). **Frozen biological STOP remains.** Sweden is one country, and the precommitted >=24 source/reference pairs, >=12 true H6 and >=3 countries have not been achieved. No HNS values, mediation, adult puddling or biological significance tested.


### 2022 OTHER COUNTRY ORIGINAL EVENT SOURCE GATE — real DK events, BE public precision FAIL (2026-11-15)

**Original 11 GBIF dataset identities** were checked via official GBIF dataset metadata-only API, [GH Actions #43695886459 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43695886459), and signed outputs saved to [registry JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_riparian_source_only/GBIF_2022_OTHER_COUNTRY_DATASET_REGISTRY_SOURCE_ONLY.json). Crucially, the official Danish eBMS public description says project started 2023, BUT **the original v1.4 Event core genuinely contains 125 events in May–Sep 2022**. Do not claim no 2022 Danish events. All 125 Danish event coordinates have public uncertainty 50 m and approximate 22 coordinate groups /14 groups with >=5 event days, but the source **has no samplingProtocol or samplingEffort fields**, and coordinates are not verified 0–200m riverbank point/section positions. This is NOT 14 eligible frozen source cells.

Flemish Meetnetten priority survey (2026-02-27 registry) original Event core contains **3,491 May–Sep 2022 events**, 59 public coordinate groups (16 with >=5 dates). All report **707m, 3536m or 7071m position uncertainty**, with original informationWithheld/dataGeneralizations fields filled. **0/3,491** pass <=100m precision. Its GBIF metadata temporal range ends 2023 yet Event core includes 2024 and 2025; source metadata alone is insufficient. This is an original PUBLIC COORDINATE failure, not proof 2022 events absent or a negative biological effect. Additionally original sampling intentionally targets priority species, not an unselected 5-family butterfly community.

[Exact publisher-original DK and BE event-core audit SUCCESS #43696277771](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43696277771). [Original numeric source-only gate JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_riparian_source_only/DK_BE_2022_ORIGINAL_EVENT_ONLY_GATE.json), [research report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/docs/RESULTS_20261115_DK_BE_2022_ORIGINAL_EVENT_ONLY_SOURCE_GATE.md). Both source files are original SHA-verified, their Occurrence extensions / taxa / HNS were NOT accessed. All source analyses remain unfit for the frozen 24 pair /12 H6 /3 country eight-arm test.

**Actionable access barrier identified:** [Consent-first eBMS / German TMD / Dutch NDFF data-access request and exact source-only fields](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/docs/20261115_EBMS_2022_SOURCEONLY_DATA_ACCESS_REQUEST_NOT_SENT.md) prepared but **NOT SENT**, signed licence **NOT obtained**. 2022 source-only accurate site/section and visit metadata should be requested first with protected coordinates under licence; do not inspect species HNS until source/opportunity gates pass. No additional PR or branch, no main/chocho merge, no 2022 HNS biological effects computed.


### DATA ACCESS AND SENSITIVE 2022 LOCATIONS — source-only request ready, not sent (2026-11-15)

Verified official [eBMS data request page](https://butterfly-monitoring.net/ebms-data%20access), [data policy](https://butterfly-monitoring.net/sites/default/files/eBMS%20DATA%20REQUEST%20POLICY%20%3D%20Annex%20B%20v2019%2004%2001.pdf), [2022 licence](https://butterfly-monitoring.net/sites/default/files/eBMS%20Licence%20%3D%20Annex%20A%20v%202022%2002%2002.pdf) and [native table format](https://butterfly-monitoring.net/index.php/ja/ebms-database). Precise locations cannot be shared to public GitHub or third parties without permission; research requests need personally signed form and contributing national BMS approvals. Relevant national BMS coordinators are to be involved and offered scientific co-authorship, so ownership/author permissions need agreement before formal application. The network's native tables are (1) original site/section coordinates, (2) all dated visits incl valid zero visits, (3) species counts; **request only (1) and (2) first** for the unmodified 2022, >=24 source-reference pair / >=12 native H6 / >=3-country source-only gate.

The official eBMS public general support contact is **ebms@ceh.ac.uk** on its [My Data](https://butterfly-monitoring.net/mydata) page, while the exact signed-licence submission address must be verified from the protected email link on the official request page. No contact was made and no licence signed. Updated [data request and restricted-data handling memo](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/docs/20261115_EBMS_2022_SOURCEONLY_DATA_ACCESS_REQUEST_NOT_SENT.md).

Ireland is an additional 2022 active national butterfly-monitoring request candidate ([official source](https://biodiversityireland.ie/surveys/butterfly-monitoring-scheme/)); the open Irish BMS portal dataset ends in 2020 and current opportunistic records cannot substitute for 2022 section visit tables. Continue to classify Ireland, Netherlands, Germany and precise Belgium as **access-not-yet-verified**, not eligible third-country study replicates. No HNS effect test or model tuning.


### Adult nutrient puddling hypothesis B — original complete 746 substrate annotations (2026-11-15)

After preserving frozen HNS and 2022 riparian source gates, separately audited original iNaturalist adult resource field definitions and user-entered substrate types. Original field500 **Butterfly Puddling Substrate** has **746 total iNat observations**; full original API 746/746 and each original field-ID value checked, taxonomy linked to iNat accepted families. [Original full 746 census GH Actions #43703011984 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43703011984), [SHA-locked original archive GH Actions #43703509062 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43703509062).

*Source field500 labels only:* **mud/soil/sand 426 (57.1%)**, gravel/rock 73 (9.8%), dung/faeces **46 (6.2%)**, carrion/dead organism regex **3 (0.4%)**, sweat/urine/saline 5, water only 18, **175 (23.5%) mixed/uncategorized**. **204 different free-text values** make exact substrate uncertain (e.g. "animal remains" often uncategorized by fixed regex). Family membership among tagged records: **Lycaenidae 200** (mud137, dung9, carrion regex0), **Nymphalidae 300** (mud143, dung24, carrion2), **Papilionidae115** (mud61,dung6), **Pieridae64** (mud51,dung0), **Hesperiidae48** (mud22,dung5,carrion1), plus Riodinidae6 and other13. These are NOT family-level puddling rates or actual observed nutrient assimilation.

**Massive source-observer bias:** 181 unique observation owners; the single most active contributes **20.64%** of all 746, top5 **50.27%**. User-created field500, user-selected annotations and text coding lack standardized butterfly or wet-substrate opportunities. Former field17428 explicitly mixes aggregation, resting, mud and nectar; cannot identify active intake. Independent 2017 tropical bait experiments support taxonomic albumin/Na preferences but are not replicated/falsified by this platform annotation set. There is **NO wastewater geography, source chemistry, adult intake observation, sex control, or real butterfly abundance** in this 746-source audit. No p-values, meta-causal pooling or claim Lycaenidae specially depends on sewage. Natural fish carcass, faeces and wet mineral sites must remain separate.

[Full science and caveats ledger](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/docs/RESULTS_20261115_ADULT_PUDDLING_SUBSTRATE_B_HYPOTHESIS_SOURCE_AUDIT.md) · [original complete 746 numeric family×substrate-source audit](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_adult_resource_behavior/INAT_ORIGINAL_SUBSTRATE500_FIELD_SOURCE_AUDIT.json) · [97 original user-created field definitions](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_adult_resource_behavior/INAT_ADULT_FIELD_DEFINITIONS_SOURCE_ONLY.json). Keep the former frozen HNS design intact and all preliminary negative site gates; **this is an independent exploratory adult-resource data-availability analysis, not a wastewater effect study**. No new PR/branch, main or chocho merge.


### Photo review-ready iNat field500 v2 source recheck (same 746; 2026-11-15)
iNaturalist v2 sparse original observation records **746/746** reproduce the previous full v1 original family and raw-regex category counts *exactly*; [GitHub Actions source replay #43704447819 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43704447819), [source SHA-receipt artifact archived #43704784922 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43704784922). **Photo-review queue: 78 original public iNat observation links, all 78 have photo URLs, but none has a human-reviewed substrate or visible proboscis confirmation**. [Complete source observer/revised-vocabulary JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_adult_resource_behavior/INAT_FIELD500_V2_OBSERVER_PHOTO_REVIEW_QA.json), [78 original-photo review queue with blank confirmation columns](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_adult_resource_behavior/INAT_FIELD500_ORGANIC_SUBSTRATE_PHOTO_REVIEW_QUEUE.csv), [independent code](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/analysis/20261115_adult_resource_behavior/audit_inat_v2_observer_photo_opportunity.py).

Critical **free-text classification audit**: old "carrion 3" contained plant decay/rotten-fruit misassignments and missed "animal remains"; revised animal-remains candidate **3** includes precisely two literal "animal remains" and one "carcass of amphibian"; the equal three is coincidence, not true validated carcass feeding. Revised non-overlapping raw-text classes: mud/soil/sand443, rock/gravel70, dung46, carrion-candidate3, fruit/sap/decaying plant23, all mixed43, water18, sweat/urine4, unknown96 (total746). All counts are annotated photo-source *descriptions*, not verified feeding or measured resource chemistry.

Original 181 observation owners are concentrated (top5 **50.27%**). Only **18 owner IDs observed both Lycaenidae and Nymphalidae**, of whom just **8** had at least one organic-candidate and one mineral tag among records. Thus observer-matched family substrate-choice inference is unsupported. Illustration conditional only on 746 voluntarily labelled records: Lycaenidae organic candidate 11/200, Nymphalidae 51/300; dropping 5 highest-volume owners Lycaenidae 7/70, Nymphalidae 25/138, not a population prevalence, not standardized source choice. **No HNS or WWTP model changed; NO adult resource-feeding, sewage-dependence or abundance effect claimed.** The preceding frozen source/river gate remains STOP.


### Full original iNat 746 annotation event independence / carcass source QA — 2026-11-15

[Independent complete original source audit SUCCESS #43705857353](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43705857353) and [SHA-verified metadata-only results archived SUCCESS #43706046893](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43706046893). [JSON evidence](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_adult_resource_behavior/INAT_FIELD500_OBSERVER_DAY_PHOTO_DUPLICATE_SOURCE_QA.json) and [full source interpretation](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/docs/RESULTS_20261115_ADULT_PUDDLING_SUBSTRATE_B_HYPOTHESIS_SOURCE_AUDIT.md).

**Three animal remains TEXT annotations are just TWO original observer-day clusters** and 2 original owners: 2015 cases #150764924 and #150764928 same photographer/day, different photo IDs; 2026 amphibian-carcass label #367297297 another observer-day. **No photo pixels were accessed or proboscis visually verified.** Original 746 annotations = **473 observer-day groups** / 181 owners / inverse-Simpson effective owner count **13.965** (concentration measure, not independent ecological n). Organic text-source review set 78 annotations = **62 observer-day groups**. Across original full 746 with secondary photos, **3 shared original photograph IDs occur across 6 separate observations**. This is repeat/photo-source bias, not 3 independent carrion-feeding events.

Only 18 original owners posted both Lycaenidae and Nymphalidae annotations; 8 of those also annotated any organic and mineral class. Within those 18 selected original accounts, the mean equal-owner difference in *share of organic substrate labels* Lycaenidae minus Nymphalidae is **−0.09789** (LOO −0.10365 to −0.07424; 8 negative /10 ties /0 positive), **NOT feeding preference or wastewater causality**: habitat/substrate offered, controls, sex, standardized observation effort and site-specific chemistry are absent. No confirmatory test, no influence on frozen larval HNS test, and no new PR/main/chocho merges. Original publicly linked 78-photo review queue remains **all unreviewed** pending actual image inspection.


### 2026-11-15: Three carrion-labelled iNat cases — true original photo right/geometry source audit

Confirmed from original iNaturalist v2 source: three source field500 animal-remains annotations correspond to **two observer-day units** (2015-08-13 original same observer cases #150764924 and #150764928; independent 2026-06-01 #367297297 labelled amphibian carcass). All **four** original source photograph assets are **CC BY-NC** (not public-domain or unrestricted photo reuse). Metadata [source #43707346799 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43707346799) established correct photo IDs and licences; only 1 of 3 original observations has a separate description.

A *noncommercial transient in-memory* image feature audit of the four original CC BY-NC medium photos, without republishing any image pixels, [RANSAC final source run #43707869730 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43707869730), produced a **0.0000-km distance between the two original 2015 public site coordinates**, and genuine cross-observation photo #260028346 vs secondary photo #260029204 yielded **77 Lowe-ratio ORB feature matches, 75/77 (97.4%) RANSAC inliers** under 5-pixel homography. These different photographs strongly share visual scene features; the **same carcass, same insect, proboscis contact and nutrient intake remain unverified**. Other source photo pairs had <=1 ORB candidate match, which does NOT prove different biological events. These three self-annotated source records cannot be claimed as 3 independent adult carcass-feeding events. First-party original source data do NOT show fish carcass ingestion or wastewater subsidies.

[Exact photo-free numerical source JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_adult_resource_behavior/INAT_3_CARRION_ORIGINAL_TRANSIENT_PHOTO_FEATURE_QA.json), original SHA-verified [archival action #43707976894 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43707976894), [independent source script](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/analysis/20261115_adult_resource_behavior/audit_three_carrion_photo_similarity.py), and [full ecological caveat ledger](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/docs/RESULTS_20261115_ADULT_PUDDLING_SUBSTRATE_B_HYPOTHESIS_SOURCE_AUDIT.md). Prior 746-source observer concentration, old 2022 riparian frozen study, H7 HNS positives and directed nulls remain unchanged. Still no visually confirmed adult feeding, HNS causal mechanism, Na/N assimilation, or sewage effect. Remain Draft; no new PR/branch/main/chocho merge.


### Strict dung 46 original iNat source-owner-day and 2018 matched observation QA (2026-11-15)

On the unchanged 746-source iNaturalist field500 population, source-replayed **46 strict dung/faeces-only annotations** plus three separate mixed dung+mud cases. Original selected records: **46 observations /33 source owners /44 owner-day groups**, inverse-Simpson effective owner number 23.0 (a source concentration metric, NOT ecological event n). Dung annotations: Lycaenidae **9/8 owner-days/7 owners**, Nymphalidae **24/24/20**, Papilionidae **6/5/5**, Hesperiidae **5/5/4**, Pieridae 0; two unclassified. Critically, **only two owners** contributed dung-labelled observations in both Lycaenidae and Nymphalidae. Across 46 records are 113 distinct photo IDs, no exact photo-ID duplicate within the strict dung set. 16 original textual descriptions, only six mention a feeding-related keyword; no original photo proboscis visually validated. Source photo licences (PHOTO counts): CC BY 19, CC BY-NC 62, **missing/null 32**; unlicensed photo pixels were NOT accessed.

[Original complete 46-source QA Actions #43711396724 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43711396724); [original SHA archived #43711586394 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43711586394). SCIENTIFIC QUALITY FIX: initial public 46-case photo review queue labeled uninspected biological fields NO, which could be mistaken for observed no-feeding. A byte-identical numerical source rerun corrected all uninspected photo, proboscis and feeding outcomes to explicit **NOT_REVIEWED**, preserving all 46 count results: [corrected-source run #43712123823 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43712123823), [corrected SHA archive #43712229558 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43712229558). [Original 46 aggregate QA JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_adult_resource_behavior/INAT_DUNG46_ORIGINAL_INDEPENDENCE_QA.json) and [46 original observation review links, each biologically NOT_REVIEWED](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_adult_resource_behavior/INAT_DUNG46_POTENTIAL_PHOTO_REVIEW_QUEUE.csv).

Two source-identical same-original-owner/day 2018 cow manure pairs show why owner-day is not a feeding event: Lycaenidae observations #16195221/#16195223 have **6.12855km public-position separation**, and both photo licences lack permission, so photo pixels were NOT retrieved; Papilionidae #18670197/#18670234 have identical public source coordinates (0km), with 21 independently CC BY-NC licensed photos processed *only in temporary runner memory*, max **63/63 RANSAC-inlier ORB cross-observation feature matches** and 16 cross-photo pairs >=8 inliers. This supports shared visual scene but NOT identical dung patch, butterfly individual, proboscis feeding or nutrient uptake. [Source pair Actions #43711773520 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43711773520), [exact derived numerical archive #43711940555 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43711940555), [photo-free matched source JSON](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/results/20261115_adult_resource_behavior/INAT_2018_LYCA_PAPILIO_COWMANURE_PAIR_SOURCE_QA.json), [full science/caveat ledger](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-hns-family-taxon-attribution-20261115/docs/RESULTS_20261115_ADULT_PUDDLING_SUBSTRATE_B_HYPOTHESIS_SOURCE_AUDIT.md).

**Interpretive STOP:** User-generated annotations and photograph scene features are NOT verified mouthpart contact, biochemical nutrient intake, source-specific wastewater subsidies, family attraction/selection, population growth or ecosystem-service cascades. Frozen 2022 H7 primary HNS source protocol remains unchanged; no new PR/branch or main/chocho merge.
prs.title: Draft: genuine H7 species data finds a conditional Lycaenidae host-N composition signal with trait-score caveat

prs.body:
## Purpose
Integrate the existing same-H7 European aquatic EQR, GBIF plant S50 and butterfly larval-host N-affinity (HNS) at **identical original 454 H7×period / 232 H7 / 90 H6 geography**, by testing **residual H6-level co-response after shared source and reporting controls**. This is **NOT** a structural equation model, causal mediation, wastewater subsidy, or an independent field replication.

## Original-source diagnostic — exploratory POSTHOC
Source SHA256: `1296d1ded7f1ee185854cad6d1ece1dbb1f94b4e2f48856c8c487a3f3d002fca`. Full-rank H6-equal WLS residualization with country×method strata, period, land use, riverflow, record effort, modelled static W, and additional HNS-specific family/trait-source controls. Pearson correlations of true H6 mean residuals. Fixed-residual 1000-draw H6 resampling **descriptive 95% only**, no model-refit or multiple-comparison adjustment.

| Cross-layer residual means | H6 r | Descriptive 95% |
|---|---:|---|
| EQR vs record-weighted HNS | −0.1300 | [−0.3024, +0.0579] |
| Plant S50 vs HNS | −0.1959 | [−0.3832, +0.0371] |
| EQR vs plant S50 | +0.1616 | [−0.0608, +0.3675] |
| EQR vs incidence-weighted HNS | −0.0997 | [−0.2941, +0.0705] |

All fixed-residual H6-mean intervals cross zero; the pre-existing conditional within-source W slopes and 222-H7 temporal cochanges remain unchanged. **Do not convert into any 'water→plant→butterfly' food-web or services mediation.** Subgroup FR/nonFR heterogeneous; the separate USA NRSA TN/TP×Chla×EPT field panel is still a distinct unit.

## Reproduction / state
- New source-locked Python rerun: `analysis/20261115_crosslayer_residuals/recompute.py`.

## Actual outcome — source-authentic EPA2013/14 same-visit observational path analysis (SUCCESS)

**Numerically completed in [original 2013 official-EPA source SHA reconstitution + site-matched path GitHub Actions #43710412210](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43710412210) (SUCCESS).** Run artifact #14160322071 SHA256 `a58d46f9a1b4ecaf966f013353b44947ce042ea9ef94b16ac1e3c4f0d5ae29a3`.

Exactly **n1,094 original EPA native UID visits /693 HUC8/47 states**, same visits with measured *ambient* river TN/TP, areal Chla, areal AFDM, EPT counted fraction and six PHab physical covariates. No source-specific WWTP effluent dose, direct biomass production, or realized ecosystem services observed.

### Critical new **geographically heldout independent-HUC** result

Five HUC8-disjoint Ridge10 folds, same n1094, train-only scaling, group-equal MSE, fixed-error HUC8 2000-replicate **descriptive** uncertainty:

| EPT fraction prediction | HUC8-equal MSE | Additional MSE gain [descriptive95] |
|---|---:|---|
| Geography/season/state/eco/cond + measured TN/TP | 0.0433750 | baseline |
| Plus six actual riverbed/riparian physical habitat metrics | 0.0395339 | **+8.8556% [+4.6536,+12.8124]** |
| Plus real Chla & AFDM measured standing material | 0.0395238 | **+0.0255% [−0.8557,+0.8462]** |

**Physical habitat conveys genuine out-of-HUC predictive value; measured pigment/AFDM do not add stable out-of-region prediction after habitat and nutrient controls.** Not evidence of no trophic nutrient effect.

### Actual *statistical* piecewise path identity (not causal mediation)

Same n1094 HUC8-equal WLS and same physical/season/geographic controls in all four linear equations, TN/TP and both mediator candidates standardized to source SD; EPT fraction unstandardized:
`c_total = c_direct + (a_Chla*b_Chla) + (a_AFDM*b_AFDM)` holds numerically.

- TN → standardized Chla **β+0.21245**, HUC8 robust descriptive95 **[+0.07915,+0.34574]**.
- Chla → EPT after all same controls and AFDM **β+0.00156 [−0.02055,+0.02367]**.
- AFDM → EPT after Chla **β−0.01423 [−0.03749,+0.00904]**.
- TN statistical product sum **−0.000652**, whole-HUC8 500-refit bootstrap95 **[−0.005086,+0.003124]**.
- TP product sum **+0.000380**, 95 **[−0.001058,+0.002458]**.
- Every **statistical association-product uncertainty interval spans zero**, and these products are NOT causal indirect effects.

### Full provenance, scripts and limits

- [Source-verified Japanese numerical and methodological report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-nrsa1314-piecewise-statistical-path-20261115/docs/RESULTS_20261115_NRSA1314_PIECEWISE_PATH_VS_PHAB.md)

## Purpose
Move beyond PR #98 community-weighted mean EPT clinger score associations by modelling the **original genuine EPA native site×TAXA_ID individual-count matrix** in each of 3 real national survey cycles as a conditional multinomial composition. Each training model predicts **all scored EPT taxa simultaneously** and tests whether the within-EPT-order clinger-trait×riverbed embeddedness `XEMBED` interaction improves **unknown HUC8 stream** taxon composition.

## Source and model scope
EPA 2008/2013/2018 authentic SHA-checked BERWW/BERW taxon counts, EPA source taxonomy+HABIT trait map and river TN/TP/PHab restored unchanged from PR #98. Fixed **strict source-support** >=3 scored EPT taxa, >=80% scored EPT records AND taxa, >=10 counted EPT, same original n=377/767/624 visit panel across three survey eras. Only existing genuine values, no invented larval densities.

Model class: **constrained penalized conditional multinomial fourth-corner**, **NOT a latent-variable JSDM**. Taxon-specific train-only baseline prevalence; nuisance ecological order×environment, within-order clinger trait×other environment, spatial/eco×trait interactions; addition tested is *only* XEMBED×within-order-centered clinger. Train-only scaling, fixed L2 penalty 0.025. Four HUC8-disjoint folds in each era. Compare nats/site categorical cross-entropy for (a) counted individual proportions, (b) observed scored taxon equal-incidence proportions. HUC8-equal scores and fixed-error 2000 cluster-resampling descriptive95, all 3 eras reported including worsening/null. No false causal ecology or WWTP-specific attribution.

## Evidence & status

Independent H6-heldout CV and explicit noncausal wording. Never call mediation without measured soil/leaf N, local feeding and exposure flow.

**Authentic taxonomy/EIV quality:** 454 source H7×period (232 H7/90 genuine H6), original GBIF 11,511 Plantae speciesKeys, 4,011 strict exact accepted vascular Tichý (2023) NUTRI matches. **Same H7-period observational models: 451 H7 periods, 90 independent H6**
All effects conditioned on country×method/period, urban/crop and hydrological geography, original survey and trait coverage; static model wastewater proxy W is not measured delivered nitrogen. Beta = per +1SD focal predictor; descriptive H6-cluster 95 and fixed H6-error-bootstrap95 for 5fold geographically disjoint Ridge10 MSE added value.

| Outcome/predictor | conditional beta [H6 cluster95] | H6-out MSE gain % [fixed-error95] |

Yet total versus noncatalogue plant NUTRI correlation r=.994: this is *not independent proof of host-mediated feeding*. ## Verified genuine native H6 and independent prior GBIF count opportunities

**Official HydroBASINS L6/7 GIS, source-only SUCCESS:** [Actions #43723429521](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43723429521). Official HYBAS6 v1c SHA256 6a4d9bcbadacbf6e32936970f84ec77c21809948085d79d1d4388964d607fa (207 invalid L6 polygons repaired explicitly; zero unfixable), HYBAS7 v1c SHA256 b9b810f4db271f0fa6b39fecf01784041b948944b3c3f296a393766388e86b44 (501 official original EEA H7). **All 232 original study H7 native Level6 parents match exactly** by >=95% native polygon area and >50% margin over next candidate. Among 56 originally singleton-H7 H6, **12 distinct genuine H6** have **40 additional EEA-monitored H7**, of which only one H6 has an additional H7 with both EEA monitored periods. Those 30 H7 span **exactly 10 genuine singleton H6**. It is **count-only** geographic opportunity 30+10=**40 H6**, NO ecological/trait qualification or field-season equivalence established.

**Next strict gate (launched, not yet declared complete at this PR update):** froze all 30 count-eligible native H7 (not selected by phenotype or regression) and started exact original GBIF speciesKey facets for Plantae and 5 butterfly families, 2 original periods, **360 source facets** using the same previous source-locked facet function from PR #95. Stacked on unmerged #104. Original source panel SHA256 c0840b1c5c6e85342fea41d57dc40fa5ec295fabf6bcd6908a4072557db9a736, genuine 183 distinct native H7/40 H6. **[GitHub Actions #43727753639 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43727753639)**. Original H6-FE beta independently exactly reproduced: plant equal-species NUTRI → butterfly equal-incidence HNS per full 183-H7 plant-index 1SD β +0.11807615. Previous 9999 H6-blocked residual-label permutation p=0.0001 (posthoc observational).

**Old geography without added 10 H6:** identical 13 source controls and 30 H6 fixed intercepts, 163 distinct old H7: β +0.1191055 [0.0545083,0.1837027], H6-blocked 9999 permutation p=0.0001. Positive sign is NOT solely from ten added H6.

**Model specification stress** on unchanged 183 H7/40 H6: 13 controls H6-equal β +0.11808 [0.05872,0.17744]; same 13 controls H7-equal β +0.10302 [0.04634,0.15970]; W+urban+crop controls β +0.23716 [0.17023,0.30409]; H6 FE only β +0.23354 [0.16848,0.29860]. All posthoc and fully reported. Full design condition 125.0; partial VIF relative to already H6-residualized plant N variance 2.838, versus unconditional total-variance VIF ~16.39 in parent branch: different denominators, not inconsistent.

**External new-10-H6 transfer:** train old 30H6/163H7 H6-FE only; test exactly ten unseen native H6 each with one old H7 and one new H7, comparing new-minus-old trait and covariate differences. FE intercept cancels. Train-only scaling, 10 independent pair losses and 2000 fixed-error pair-bootstrap descriptive intervals.
Primary equal-incidence butterfly HNS: added plant N yields MSE +36.80% [-32.19,+61.28] (uncertain), pair Δ raw correlation +.647 / residual correlation +.428, signs 5/10.
Secondary record-weighted HNS: MSE +26.54% [18.58,35.56] (positive fixed 10-pair descriptive interval); raw r=+.782 / residual r=+.611, sign 6/10. Does NOT rescue uncertain primary, and 10-pair interval excludes model-refit uncertainty.

**Claims not allowed:** true wastewater-N exposure, actual local larval feeding, butterfly individual abundance, production, ecological services or mediation. Separate within-H6 W tests were uncertain: W→plant N β +0.0509 [-0.0183,+0.1202]; W→butterfly HNS after plant N β +0.0331 [-0.0118,+0.0780]. Original temporal nonsynchrony and source-only STOPs unchanged. No main/chocho/ancestor merges.
## Follow-up source-authentic trait-label and genus-decomposition falsification

Original 183-H7 /40-true-H6 EIV community mean fully reconstructed from all 4,011 accepted vascular plant numerical EIV scores and the original two-period GBIF speciesKey incidence facets (old 2808 + extra 360). H7 source original NUTRI max abs error 5.33e-15; independent weighted FWL original primary coefficient +0.1180761519 reproduced to <1e-12. 981 accepted plant genera; 3,562 scored species exchangeable within an already sampled genus.

**Original source global label permutation versus within-genus label permutation** (4999 each, fixed original H6-FE, 13 controls, H6-equal source weights): observed H6 adjusted plant-N vs butterfly equal-incidence HNS partial r=+0.446494. Unrestricted shuffle of all 4011 scored species N labels gives two-sided **p=.0012**, null95 [-.30294,+.30330]; within identical genus only gives **p=.6864**, null95 **[+.39637,+.52210]**. Thus genus-specific trait means and/or genus community turnover remain as strong plausible drivers; independent within-genus N trait sorting is **not** detected. [Original Actions #43728586124 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43728586124).

**Exact algebraic between-genus mean + within-genus deviation** on original same-site 183×4011 source matrix, H6 FE+original controls: butterfly equal-incidence HNS regressed on both components yields between-genus β **+.12971 [.05120,.20822]**, within-genus β **−.01217 [−.08513,+.06078]**. Adding between-genus trait component to control-only H6 FE in-sample source weighted SSE gain +22.736%; adding within-genus component after between adds **only +0.193%** of remaining in-sample SSE. Joint condition no. ~139.9, important multicollinearity caution. Record-weighted secondary between β +.20075 [.00981,.39169], within β +.03728 [−.18117,+.25574]. All source scores and H7 rows preserved, no missing-score imputation. [Actions #43729087692 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43729087692).

**Interpretation downgrade:** robust local within-H6 observational co-response is largely about plant genus-level habitat N-affinity structure, not demonstrated adaptive within-genus nutrient filtering, delivered wastewater N, larval host feeding, butterfly population increase or services. Static model W is itself uncertain within H6 (separate source-original #104 falsification), primary new-10-H6 cross-parent external CV interval crosses zero, original 2017–22 within-H7 temporal cochange remains null. This result does not prove genus identity is causal or that trait is irrelevant; within-genus trait variation/power are limited. Both source observational outcome nulls and positives are retained.
