## First verification after merging previous source-verified positives to main
Parent is the freshly merged main at 8057236370c502e184e9580e8c6e84dc6fc65835 (integrated PR #106). Neither main nor chocho nor historic draft #101–#105 was changed by this follow-up.

**Question:** Is the strong source-verified EU H7 spatial association between W/plant nutrient habitat affinity/larval-host butterfly HNS specifically predicted by *actually reported facility-level upstream annual N/P mass* rather than the downstream reported WWTP geography negative control?

**True original-source opportunity and method:** Original PR #92 same-H7, authentic 454 H7×period / 232 H7 / 90 true H6 directional reported N/P source CSV attached **byte-for-byte as exact original Git blob 702131afc7d1a7bfb15e80357a506754cae7a70a**. Same original EIV numeric 4011 vascular plants, 451 trait-supported H7×period / 90 H6, 56 upstream positive-report rows /31 H6 and 61 downstream positive rows /32 H6. 2x2 report status among eligible: UP-only21, DOWN-only26, both35, no matched positive report369. The latter are **NOT zero-sewage or clean controls**. Source-only pre-outcome support gate explicitly PASS: [original-source 2026-11-16 Actions #43789733828](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43789733828).

Model source original 451 rows W/geography/urban/crop/effort/trait completeness/country×method/period unchanged. **W→equal-species plant NUTRI baseline β+0.2152423804 and plant NUTRI→butterfly equal-species HNS baseline β+0.1955511856 both numerically reproduced exactly**; independent 5fold native-H6-disjoint Ridge10 train-only scaling and 2000 H6 fixed-out-of-fold squared error resampling, with H6-clustered WLS for coefficient CI.

**Primary new placebo test: UP positive-report indicator added AFTER DOWN indicator**
- Plant equal-species NUTRI: UP β **+0.03181 [-0.01155,+0.07517]**, heldout H6 MSE gain **-0.106% [-4.740,+3.896]**.
- Butterfly equal-species HNS after equal-species plant NUTRI and W: UP β **+0.01310 [-0.00106,+0.02727]**, heldout H6 gain **+1.029% [-1.496,+4.357]**.
- In butterfly equal HNS **without** plant-N adjustment, UP coefficient nominally positive +0.03089 [+0.00689,+0.05489] but H6 gain +2.834% [-2.322,+7.752] crosses zero. All downstream-added reverse controls and alternative weighting outcomes retained.

**Original reported-N/P annual mass / model-flow full-delivery intensity** (not measured receptor river water TN/TP): UP N after DOWN N and source reporting flags gives plant equal NUTRI H6 gain **-0.121% [-1.221,+0.750]**, butterfly equal HNS/plant adjusted **-0.322% [-3.727,+2.748]**. UP P corresponding **-0.360% [-1.616,+0.495]** for plant and **-0.216% [-3.647,+3.083]** for butterfly. HNS upstream N coefficient conditional β+0.01611 [+0.00313,+0.02909] is nominally positive but geographically held-out predictive gain is NOT stable. All 5 response variants, three source index types, both directions (30 nested outcomes) are recorded, not cherry picked.

**Verified original Actions**: [full 30-nested H6 source models #43790119834 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43790119834). [Second numerical FWL and augmented-lstsq implementation #43790618831 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43790618831): **12/12 primary nested source betas+H6 MSE gains** reproduced to max absolute coefficient 1.99e-15 and gain percentage 5.48e-12. Both real source run receipts stored in `results/20261116_directional_reported_np/` with full original output artifact in Actions. Full Japanese results/protocol: `docs/RESULTS_20261116_DIRECTIONAL_REPORTED_NP_PLANT_NUTRI_BUTTERFLY_HNS.md` and `docs/PROTOCOL_20261116_DIRECTIONAL_REPORTED_NP_PLANT_NUTRI_BUTTERFLY_HNS.md`.

**Conclusion:** No stable direction-specific *incremental predictive signal* for either primary plant or butterfly trait incidence composition once downstream reporting is controlled, despite robust W/plant/butterfly geographic correlations. This does not show wastewater has zero ecological effects: annual facility report + modeled flow is NOT observed nutrient delivery at the exact riverbank, 2018/2022 reports are imperfectly synchronized to three-year GBIF windows, missing report is not absence, downstream geography is only a weak negative control, and several comparisons are posthoc. No cause of larval feeding, butterfly abundance, trophic subsidy or ecosystem services identified. Main previous positives and nulls remain untouched.

**Status:** Draft / do not merge until the scope of the original reported load negative control and possible matched official 2018/22 receiving-water TN/TP is reviewed. No eBird or TinyFish.

**SUCCESS:** [Actions #43791627657](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43791627657); full derived numerical JSON saved as Actions artifact, source SHA verified. Same-cohort butterfly species-equal HNS β+.1951 [.1425,.2476], H6 predictive gain +33.54% [13.48,45.99]. However full vs noncatalogue plant N r=.994; not independent proof of feeding.
2. **NEW fixed-scored-plant-GBIF-record-depth rarefaction:** 120 authentic multivariate-hypergeometric resamples, depth 20 (451 rows), **primary depth 50 (450 rows)**, 100 (446 rows); 90 genuine H6 each. Butterfly HNS conditional beta medians respectively +.0744/+**.1092**/+.1332; H6-out MSE prediction gain medians +9.01/+**14.01**/+19.05%. All 120 point estimates positive at every depth. Critically the fixed-H6-error prediction bootstrap95 lower bound was >0 in only 26.7%/**65.8%**/93.3% of draws: **direction persists, stringent primary transfer uncertainty remains**. MC quantiles are NOT independent-study confidence intervals.
3. **NEW W versus urban substitution on EXACT 451 original site-period rows and same 90-H6-fold predictions:** modeled W added after urban yields plant N out-H6 gain +18.51% [7.91,28.93]; urban added after W yields +5.29% [-.91,13.77]. Butterfly HNS (without plant-N conditioning): W after urban +7.98% [.60,14.52], urban after W -.35% [-1.67,.51]. Original W/urban Pearson correlation +.667. W includes distinct spatial predictive information **but is NOT actual wastewater nutrient delivery**.
   
All source-original no-imputation gates retained, no new GBIF/EIV data acquisition or raw redistribution; old temporal non-synchrony, within-H6 W null, genus-within permutation null, across-water/land residual null and new-10-H6 external transfer uncertainty preserved. **Scientific decision:** STOP posthoc expansion and start two separate manuscripts: (i) terrestrial plant/butterfly nutrient-habitat-affinity spatial covariation, without causal sewage claim; (ii) aquatic nutrient/load and environmental trait filtering, preserving heterogeneous exposure definitions. Keep draft for review; do not auto-merge or modify chocho.

## Updated 2026-11-16: cross-compartment spatial association, temporal and true WWTP-source falsifiers, independent numerical QA

**Result record:** [Spatial result](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-eu451-aquatic-plantnutri-bridge-20261116/docs/RESULTS_20261116_EU451_WATER_LAND_NUTRI_BRIDGE.md) and **[new complete temporal+up/down WWTP source report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-eu451-aquatic-plantnutri-bridge-20261116/docs/RESULTS_20261116_WATER_LAND_TEMPORAL_AND_NP_DIRECTIONAL_FALSIFIERS.md)**.

### Verified original data only (posthoc, observational; no sewage cause assigned)

- Genuine 451 original EIV NUTRI-supported H7×period /232 distinct H7 /90 true H6. EQR and butterfly HNS from original same 454 source panel SHA256 1296d1ded7f1ee185854cad6d1ece1dbb1f94b4e2f48856c8c487a3f3d002fca; 4011 exact EIV species scored from successful official source v2 Actions #43718069015. Original static W, hydrography, landcover, H6-blocked folds, source opportunities and source assessment-method controls frozen.
- **Spatial primary**: benthic aquatic EQR on plant species-equal EIV nutrient habitat-affinity NUTRI after W/background/EEA/GBIF efforts: β **−0.034457 [−0.059686, −0.009228]**; independent H6-out prediction added gain **+2.838% [−4.698,+9.804] (uncertain)**. After plant NUTRI, EQR adds no butterfly equal-HNS predictive information (original β +.000597 [−.025735,+.026928], H6-out −1.575% [−6.287,+2.901]). Spatial original source run [#43797353381 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43797353381).
- **NEW same-basin temporal falsifier**: original 219 fully paired H7/86 H6; primary 170 genuine paired H7/53 H6 with *identical majority EQR assessment method across early/late periods*. ΔEQR on Δplant NUTRI adjusted for reporting/coverage change: **β +0.012091 [−0.003539,+0.027720]**, genuine H6-out predictive added MSE **−2.030% [−4.317,+0.053]**. No temporal inverse response is supported. Δbutterfly HNS on ΔEQR after Δplant N also uncertain β −.006465 [−.030763,+.017834] and H6-out −2.864% [−5.512,+.059]. Source run [#43803951497 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43803951497).
- **NEW exact original upstream/downstream reported WWTP source controls**: preserved immutable original PR #92/#108 source-derived 454 H7-period directional index **Git blob 702131afc7d1a7bfb15e80357a506754cae7a70a**. On same 451 EIV-supported periods and 90 H6, report cells neither/up-only/down-only/both = **369/21/26/35**; upstream-positive **56** periods in **31 H6**. Unmatched report is NOT confirmed sewage-free. Source annual mass/model flow is NOT actual TN/TP in water/root-zone. When both reporting-status indicators added to the EQR–NUTRI model: β **−0.033912 [−0.060023,−0.007802]**, H6-out +1.379% [−5.468,+7.794] uncertain. Adding reported N intensity: β **−0.033349 [−0.059783,−0.006914]**, H6-out +0.916% [−5.748,+7.415] uncertain. EQR upstream status added beyond downstream and plant NUTRI: gain **−0.431% [−2.203,+1.036]**; similarly upstream reported N intensity added beyond source flags/downstream N/plant NUTRI gain **−1.090% [−4.877,+1.707]**. No direction-specific stable source signal. Source run [#43804222799 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43804222799).
- **NEW independent numerical QA**: four critical coefficients numerically reconstructed with weighted FWL and four H6-blocked prediction improvements with augmented least-squares ridge10 instead of original statsmodels/normal equations. **4/4 PASS**, maximum absolute β error 3.61e−16; maximum H6 MSE improvement difference 2.40e−13 percentage points. Not an independent field study. Source run [#43804468323 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43804468323).

### Interpretive stop boundaries

- Spatial water EQR / land nutrient-affinity inverse association can be described **within the fitted geographic sample**, but does **not** generalize unambiguously to unseen H6 and does **not** recur as a same-H7 two-period cochange. Controlling current positive reporting fields does not reverse the spatial sign but cannot distinguish land-use/biotic geography from true sewer-borne nutrient delivery.
- Earlier independent **2018 & 2022 EEA annual WWTP reported N/P→aquatic EQR ~1% heldout prediction gain** and **USA EPA measured TN→Chla+, riverbed XEMBED→EPT clinger− and tolerance+ three-period filtering** remain different outcomes and exposures. They cannot be pooled as one N treatment effect.
- PR #107 official original 2026 EEA WISE6 same-station/year TN and TP union reached 101 source-station years, only **12 upstream-report-positive station years, nine H7×periods/eight H6**; **strict field-chemistry bridge source gate STOP**. No actual sewage nutrient reaching the GBIF flora, plant N uptake, larvae feeding, aquatic emergence biomass or ecosystem service cascade has been observed.
- All tests exploratory with repeated hypothesis search. Cluster confidence intervals and fixed prediction error H6 bootstrap intervals are descriptive rather than post-selection confirmatory inference.

**Decision:** Main remains intact; this remains a Draft. Scientific umbrella = *parallel compartment-specific ecological trait filtering along human-altered watershed geography, with no demonstrated short-term synchronization or localized sewage-source mediation*. Do NOT merge source-limited cohort negatives as proof wastewater has zero biological effect. Neither main nor chocho changed.

## Completed original-source chemistry-first study (2026-11-16): real source gate PASS, stronger ecology sample gate STOP

**Full source-verified result ledger:** [docs/RESULTS_20261116_EEA_WQ_CHEMISTRY_FIRST_EU232_PART1_PART2_SCIENCE_GATE.md](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-chemistry-first-EU232-watershed/docs/RESULTS_20261116_EEA_WQ_CHEMISTRY_FIRST_EU232_PART1_PART2_SCIENCE_GATE.md).

Original H7 GBIF plant/butterfly data SHA256 1296d1ded7f1ee185854cad6d1ece1dbb1f94b4e2f48856c8c487a3f3d002fca: genuine 454 H7×period, 232 unique H7, 90 original parent H6. The **new source-first population** is not selected on EEA benthic EQR monitoring sites or WWTP positive reports: start with ALL official WQ station coords inside exactly those 232 polygons (official original source SHA verified; source county/site identifier/scheme original).

### Original-source signed successes, not ecological effects

1. **Geometry + annual Part2 original source [Actions #43816554985 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43816554985)**: 69,820 official EEA WQ station keys with valid unambiguous coords; **12,139 genuine WQ station keys inside original 232 H7**, 23,717 candidate original 2018/22 station-year windows. Primary source requires WQ country = original GBIF H7 majority country, yielding 11,540 station keys/21,711 candidate station-years. Strict original official 2026 Part2 annual TN+TP same-site/year, original 6,450,192 rows: only **54 valid WQ station-years, primary 32 station-years, 5 H7×period /3 H7 /2 H6 /1 country**. **Part2 SOURCE STOP** under fixed 30/20/20/3.
2. **Separately pre-frozen 2026 Part1 original [Actions #43817344055 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43817344055)**: full official 1,639,231,716B DEFLATE64 ZIP SHA256 ff779521749b40b952cce35a4671240c3b6c47d87f32a8fef9240a4ac503a082, every **96,597,294 individual sample source rows** streamed; strict river RW/water W, original TN/TP codes and canonical mg elemental/L, LOQ/finite checks, >=3 distinct same-station/year samples per nutrient, sample-id dedup. This raises source completeness to **632 source TNTP-valid WQ station-years, 621 in main country-matched cohort, 37 H7×period /30 H7 /24 original true H6 /5 countries**. **Part1 source-only support gate PASS**, thresholds fixed BEFORE original chemistry values opened, no biology outcome fitted.
3. **Independent original flora/butterfly sample join after source [Actions #43818637326 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43818637326)**: official verified 4,011 plant EIV scored species, original 451 eligible GBIF H7period, valid chemistry source retains exactly **37 rows/30 original H7/24 original H6/5 country groups**, no new joining drops. **Stricter precommitted ecology gate >=100 H7×period/>=40 H6/>=5 countries FAIL**; status **STOP_BIOLOGICAL_SAMPLE_SUPPORT**. The original WQ-to-plant-NUTRI, to-butterfly-HNS slopes and heldout prediction **were not fitted**. Do not relax gates or treat sample-support success as biological effects.

**Corrected nutrient-wise union upper bound independently source-verified [Actions #43819882515 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43819882515):** The full original Part2 6,450,192 rows were checked for **at least one** strict annual total TN or TP value, rather than only complete TNTP station-years. Primary country-matched Part2 ANY-valid contained 33 station-years (TN 33, TP 32), from **5 H7×periods/2 genuine H6**. A correct Part1-first/Part2-fallback same-site-year nutrient-wise union qualifying TNTP must belong to Part1-BOTH geography (37 H7×period/24 H6) OR Part2-ANY geography (5 H7×period/2 H6), even when one source supplies TN and the other TP. Therefore a conservative **upper bound is ≤42 H7×periods and ≤26 H6**, conclusively below the precommitted ecological gate ≥100/≥40. Exact actual nutrient-wise union size is not yet computed, but this bound makes re-extracting 96.6M Part1 rows solely for the old population scientifically unnecessary. No biological coefficient was fitted. [Source protocol and proof](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-chemistry-first-EU232-watershed/docs/PROTOCOL_20261116_WQ_PART1_PART2_CROSS_NUTRIENT_UNION_SOURCE_BOUND.md).

### Meaning and next scientifically separate population

The latest original EEA Part1 access allows genuine source-matched ambient TNTP at 37 original H7×periods; however it cannot establish wastewater-specific nutrient delivery, plant root-zone chemistry or realized butterfly host feeding. The null/positive results for original water EQR, US physical EPT filtering and European plant–butterfly nutrient habitat affinity composition remain unchanged. The next defensible study is **a NEW water-monitor-first H7 population beyond the old 232 EQR-selected H7**, then genuine GBIF plant+five-family-butterfly trait source acquisition in those measured-water H7, fixing source counts and geographic blocks BEFORE biological slopes. This does NOT invalidate the original PR #107 technical source failures.

Source protocols:
- [Part2 first-stage geometry and chemistry source](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-chemistry-first-EU232-watershed/docs/PROTOCOL_20261116_EEA_WQ_CHEMISTRY_FIRST_EU232_H7_SOURCE_GATE.md)
- [Part1 frozen separate source extension](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-chemistry-first-EU232-watershed/docs/PROTOCOL_20261116_EEA_CHEMISTRY_FIRST_PART1_DISAGGREGATED_EXTENSION.md)
- [Ecology model only if BOTH gates passed](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-chemistry-first-EU232-watershed/docs/PROTOCOL_20261116_CHEMISTRY_FIRST_TNTP_EIV_HNS_MODEL_IF_GATE.md).

No new positive/negative organism effect was estimated in this PR. Third-party complete original EEA CSV, original full ZIP and all unscored records were not rehosted. Leave Draft, do not merge to main or modify chocho or prior PRs.

## What this PR fixes
The previous already-merged PR #106 curated 98 original source blobs for 2026-11-15/16 European plant–butterfly and US EPT-fourth-corner analyses but intentionally did not import all earlier Drafts. Critical 2018/2022 measured-reported wastewater N/P -> EEA benthic EQR and the US 2008/2013/2018 NRSA foundations still had code/results outside main. This PR remedies that gap without merging hundreds of unrelated source-only historic workflow commits.

### All real PR evidence register
- `docs/PR_RESEARCH_REGISTER_20261116.csv`: **104 actual PRs (#2–#110, genuine gaps), one row each** with exact 40-character GitHub head commit, source branch, base branch, PR status and creation/update timestamps, project unit, judgment, evidence document link and whether in prior main. GitHub API verified PR #106 merged; other 103 were open at snapshot. Judgments: **10 positive, 17 negative, 13 STOP, 43 mixed, 21 left blank** when not safely classifiable. 39 document references supplied where verified, remaining document fields are blank rather than invented.
- `docs/PR_RESEARCH_REGISTER_20261116.md` explains judgment semantics and PR status separately. SHA alone does NOT indefinitely protect unreferenced Git objects from garbage collection. Original unmerged PRs remain open; no branch deleted.

### Selective original-science files, not broad merge
**218 byte-identical original Git blob files (15,410,864 bytes)**: `provenance/GESUI_20261116_AQUATIC_PR_SOURCE_BLOB_MANIFEST.json` records every source path, original blob SHA1, origin branch and PR anchor, length and original main base.
- **EEA 2022 actual plant-reported WWTP annual N/P facility mass to benthic EQR**: PR14 original river/site numerical EQR and annual load source, PR16 serious EQR reporting attrition/missingness and conditional source-placement falsifiers. On 2475 benthic stations (147 positive reported-upstream source), upstream P and N add heldout regional prediction MSE improvement **+1.10% and +1.40%**, downstream placebo worsens; N-vs-P cannot be identified, phytobenthos tiny, fish source eligibility STOP.
- **EEA 2018 different true reported source year**: PR17 original 2634 benthic EQR sites (202 report-positive), upstream annual WWTP P and N gain **+0.9816% / +1.1902%**; same-year downstream placebo worse. Cross-year overlap **1167 station IDs**, source-missingness and country/method/source covariation remain. Posthoc site-disjoint 2018<->2022 predictions explicitly labeled posthoc. EEA 2020 PR19 source STOP also included.
- **EEA 2016 JRC GREEN**: PR56/57 source-only and outcome/results included separately and labeled **modelled 2014–18 point-source N/P, not the real 2018/2022 measured annual WWTP emission data**. Regional and year robustness uncertainties retained.
- **France river chemistry**: PR70-72 2022 same-monitoring-station measured **river TP** vs I2M2 benthic EQR spatial association plus original 2018–22 same-station temporal change and calendar-month falsifier. This is measured receiving-water concentration, NOT apportionment of WWTP discharge.
- **USA actual EPA NRSA 2008–09 /2013–14 /2018–19**: PR73–83 origin/UID/HUC8/chemical/Chla/AFDM/PHab/EPT code, docs, failure/selection/missingness records. Authentic 2648 original source-eligible survey UID visits and 1030 distinct HUC8; PHab added after measured ambient TN/TP increases untouched-era HUC8-heldout EPT fraction prediction **+7.45% / +7.98% / +11.19%**. Not a municipal wastewater exposure. PR97 N/P -> biofilm -> EPT statistical mediation product has 95% interval including zero; PR99/100 joint-trait and state-transfer caveats retained. PR98 previously source-integrated in main via #106.

### Central ledger, reproducibility and safety
- Existing `docs/EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md` and `README.md` now link to full PR register, new verified results, major positives, contradictory results, and STOPs, with source-run citations. No prior results edited or suppressed.
- **New Actions #43818167946 SUCCESS** on exact copied branch: `python scripts/verify_gesui_pr_registry_aquatic.py` recomputes every Git-blob SHA1/byte length for all 218 entries, checks 104 original PR HEADs/statuses and judgment buckets, confirms key source files and no new original workflow YAML; original migration checks and synthetic source-contract unit tests also pass. Base original main at branching `8057236370c502e184e9580e8c6e84dc6fc65835`; PR branch is ahead 10, behind 0.
- Original third-party EEA/EPA raw ZIPs and signed Actions artifacts are not copied/rehosted; originals are linked in preserved RESULTS files. Reusable scripts remain source-specific and may need original artifacts for numerical rerun; offline success is provenance and schema verification, not new independent ecological inference.

**Research claim guardrail:** Positive detection here is of a small **predictive** contribution from observed and reported WWTP annual mass to a benthic EQR model in two source years, NOT proof of sewage causing a beneficial/increased benthic population. USA ambient TN/TP, EEA receiving-river TP, JRC modelled point-source NP, sewage facility-reported mass and EU W/geographic EIV NUTRI are all different exposure/estimand constructs. No unjustified combined 'sewage meta-effect' or water→plant→butterfly causal mediation.

Explicit request is to merge this verified curated dataset+registry to main first, then open new analyses from the updated main. No other Drafts are merged and chocho is untouched.

## Purpose: one paper, one comparison plane, no false wastewater mediation
Start from integrated main PR #112 (merged), containing audited European measured-reported WWTP N/P→benthic EQR and US NRSA origin, plus prior merged #106 EU plant NUTRI/butterfly HNS. Preserve existing negative/STOP evidence. Cross-compartment EU451 bridge #110 and source-gated chemistry #111 remain separate Draft results, not silently merged.

**One full source-annotated manuscript evidence matrix**: `docs/MANUSCRIPT_20261116_WATER_LAND_UNIFIED_COMPARISON.md`. The same original 451 EU H7×period (90 true H6) supports W→plant NUTRI beta +.2152 (H6 MSE gain +18.51%), plant NUTRI→butterfly equal-incidence HNS beta +.1956 (+36.56% all-record; 50-scored-record source rarefaction beta +.1092/gain +14.01% MC median), water benthic EQR←plantN beta −.03446 (H6 out +2.84% with interval crossing zero), and butterfly HNS←EQR conditional beta ≈+.000597 (null). These are DIFFERENT response scales. Aquatic 2018/2022 annual reported WWTP N/P→benthic EQR MSE +~1–1.4% is a different original EEA station sampling frame, **not** the same 451 source records, and measured-report annual mass is not sampled receiver concentration or local delivered nutrients. Temporal ΔPlantN↔ΔHNS and method-matched ΔEQR↔ΔPlantN remain null.

**Prospective-source but posthoc-study frozen Figure 4**: `docs/PROTOCOL_20261116_FIG4_RIVER_DISTANCE_WATER_LAND_BOUNDARY.md`. Geographic riparian bands 0–250m, 250–1000m, 1000–5000m from true official HydroRIVERS line; per band H7period ≥50 numerically EIV-scored plant GBIF occurrences, ≥10 exact accepted vascular scored species, ≥40% of all original plant observed speciesKeys; paired near/far H7period ≥100, true H6 ≥40, country groups ≥5, ≥80 H7. Require source-sha original individual occurrence longitude, latitude, date and coordinateUncertainty≤100m; original GBIF 2808 facet rows contain only **aggregated speciesKey counts**, no per-observation points. Primary direct attenuation test under same H7 cohort: paired adjusted EQR–PlantN partial-correlation contrast `D = r_far - r_near`; H6-block resampling of D (NOT near significant/far nonsignificant), H6-out paired 5-fold Ridge MSE gain; road proximity, source effort/urban and actual EQR station-reach connection are falsifiers. If source gate fails, STOP and do NOT claim distance attenuation. Source W/EIV/HNS never treated as measured sewage N, local plant foliar N, butterfly host use or a food-web cause.

### Original SHA-verified source-only successes
- [GBIF 8 real H7 × 2 periods pilot #43825788157 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43825788157): 8 real distinct H6, 8 original country holdout groups, 16/16 authentic same-query `occurrence/search` GETs successful, 4,654 **FIRST-PAGE** plant observation rows, all with WGS84 coordinates, 2,991 (64.27%) with explicit uncertainty ≤100m. First pages are not random full GBIF population or full 451-H7period coverage; no EIV/Butterfly/EQR outcomes opened.
- [Official HydroRIVERS EU source #43826262099 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43826262099): official `HydroRIVERS_v10_eu_shp.zip` 67,648,957 bytes SHA256 500da7d36ceee0aa4c82dd625f5c53d80ba2f7ac14ad022cd3a6601bf55068e5, 938,544 genuine native reaches, `HYRIV_ID`, `NEXT_DOWN`, `HYBAS_L12`, river order / original discharge metadata. Network source available but full point-to-river distances not computed. Small tributaries may be omitted by official ~10km² or ~0.1m³/s detection criteria.

Saved code, verified original Actions source summaries and protocols under `analysis/20261116_fig4_river_distance/`, `results/20261116_fig4_river_distance/`, `docs/` respectively. No third-party raw occurrence coordinates or HydroRIVERS line files rehosted. All Draft, no main or chocho changed; biological distance-slope and nutrition flux not claimed until full source support and subsequent model run.

## Completed observational FR73 same-grain river TP → aquatic EQR / plant NUTRI / butterfly HNS test

**Success, original source-authentic [Actions #43831979087](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43831979087) plus independent full-solver QA [#43832303735](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43832303735).** All eight positives and negatives, 4 strict LOHO stresses and manuscript Go/No-Go [in full report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-fr73-measured-TP-EIV-HNS-unification/docs/RESULTS_20261116_FR73_MEASURED_TP_EQR_PLANT_N_BUTTERFLY_HNS_UNIFICATION_DECISION.md). Original preoutcome [fixed protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-fr73-measured-TP-EIV-HNS-unification/docs/PROTOCOL_20261116_FR73_DIRECT_MEASURED_TP_EQR_EIV_HNS_SAME_GRAIN.md).

### SOURCE: exact authentic 2018/2022 same French river TP and benthic I2M2 field sites
- PR #71 original 263 actual physically repeated measured river TP + EEA benthic EQR station pairs within 73 native H7 and 24 genuine H6 hydrological parents in both 2018 and 2022. Original source H7 summary SHA256 **f2ff4e56f245e1aa8f84f5ac099d68ec1c7e27a786c1067439db388b186dd90b**, signed archived [Actions #43373639391](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43373639391).
- The identical original 73 H7 have genuine GBIF plants and butterflies scored from original source-only EIV 4,011 vascular plant species, 451 quality-eligible total EU H7period. Source quality gate **73 H7 × both periods = 146 H7period/24 H6 PASS**, no species or site selection based on fit. Of 146 GBIF H7-majority-country labels, 145 FR and one BE (cross-border basin), all 263 TP/EQR original physical stations French I2M2. This one source geographic mismatch is preserved, not censored by effect sign. Source original 454 panel SHA256 1296d1ded7f1ee185854cad6d1ece1dbb1f94b4e2f48856c8c487a3f3d002fca.
- Source river TP 2018 corresponds to opportunistic GBIF 2017–19 and TP2022 to GBIF 2020–22, **NOT the same exact field plot/date for plants or butterflies**.

### 4 decisive same-cohort H6 equal fivefold prediction comparisons; fixed 2000 true-H6 error bootstrap descriptive95

| Outcome / predictor | Focal β per 1 original SD [H6-cluster descriptive95] | Genuine H6-out MSE improvement [descriptive95] |
|---|---|---|
| **Same-river actual measured logTP → benthic I2M2 EQR** | **−0.084553 [−0.116664,−0.052442]** | **+24.683% [+10.459,+37.911]** |
| Same river logTP → original GBIF plant species-equal NUTRI | +0.020290 [−0.022429,+0.063008] | **−2.979% [−14.721,+2.281]**, uncertain |
| Same river logTP → butterfly reference host-habitat HNS after plant NUTRI | −0.023056 [−0.055584,+0.009472] | **−3.899% [−10.242,+1.621]**, uncertain |
| **Original plant NUTRI → butterfly equal-species HNS after actual river TP** | **+0.149969 [+0.104032,+0.195905]** | **+30.209% [+19.467,+40.433]** |

4 additional original pre-fixed contrasts were also completed and saved, including real river TP without plant-N adjustment (negative predictive gain, not negative causal effect) and paired ΔTP→ΔNUTRI, ΔTP→ΔHNS after ΔNUTRI, ΔplantN→ΔbutterflyHNS. All 3 paired source relationships had 95% slopes crossing zero and failed to improve prediction in new H6, meaning **no detectable four-year source-grain cochange**.

### Independent numerical audit and 24-parent leaving each fully out (source authentic, not new field sample)
- All four core β values independently recovered using weighted FWL and 5fold Ridge10 using augmented least squares, **4/4 to machine precision**, not original statsmodels WLS/manual ridge.
- 24 true-parent LOHO external MSE gains: **actual TP→EQR +24.636% [13.377,36.043]**, TP→plant NUTRI **−3.049% [−14.005,+2.328]**, TP→butterfly HNS after plant **−0.893% [−6.917,+4.013]**, **plant NUTRI→butterfly HNS after real TP +33.678% [20.749,46.072]**. All source-registered.
- These are repeated explorations, fixed-error descriptive intervals not confirmatory independent study p-values.

### Interpretation and MANUSCRIPT GO/NO-GO

**Support:** strong and source-verified actual same physical river TP↔benthic quality observational relationship; within *larger H7 catchment* terrestrial plant N habitat-affinity and larval host HNS species-composition indices align even conditional on river TP.

**NOT support:** measured river TP does not demonstrate generalizable extra predictive information about plant/host nutrient-affinity indices in this fixed 73H7/24H6 sample. These are *no detectable cross-grain associations*, not demonstrated physical barriers or nil river nutrient transport. The plant N/HNS scores partially share a trait source and genus-composition structure, and are NOT observed plant leaf N, butterfly individual counts or actual host feeding.

**Crucial sewage specificity null:** only **4 of the original 273 measured-2022 river site pairs /2 H7 /2 H6** had independently confirmed positive upstream 2022 WWTP reported P mass. Hence actual ambient stream TP cannot identify a wastewater-derived exposure, and there is no local riverbank plant/larval feeding or subsidy field measure. **DO NOT claim a wastewater→water→plants→butterflies causal or ecosystem-service paper** or mix US EPA riverbed embeddedness as the same exposure.

A scientifically possible *descriptive* one-paper target is spatial-domain-specific predictability in the same basin (actual river nutrient+biological quality versus opportunistic terrestrial nutrient-affinity co-composition), but reviewer novelty and shared mechanism remain uncertain. To do a true wastewater ecosystem connectivity paper, use actual outfall-centric hydrologically directed exposure + colocated and temporal riparian field biota or independently validated adult emergence pathways rather than patching the 73 French basins by geographic ID.

Full original and independent signed JSON archived in the new GitHub Actions artifact. No wholesale merging of prior PRs or upstream raw input redistribution. Draft; **main and chocho unchanged**.

## Completed four-stage original source audit for a defensible wastewater aquatic–terrestrial one-paper design

**Status:** Original-source physical geometry YES, original opportunistic local riparian GBIF and year-aligned measured WWTP nutrient exposure NO at the fixed primary scale. **No biological effect or causal mediation coefficient fitted**. The resulting study is source-quality evidence, not proof that nutrients never cross the ecosystem boundary.

**Complete original-source research and manuscript-readiness report:** [RESULTS_20261116_LOCAL_WWTP_AQUATIC_TERRESTRIAL_SOURCE_4STAGE_AND_MANUSCRIPT_GATE.md](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-outfall-local-riparian-trait-source-gate-20261116/docs/RESULTS_20261116_LOCAL_WWTP_AQUATIC_TERRESTRIAL_SOURCE_4STAGE_AND_MANUSCRIPT_GATE.md)

### 1. Original PR3/4 16-outfall×48 GBIF older wide river-centre EIV trait support — verified [Actions #43845610859 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43845610859)
- Original 5,394 true site–speciesKey GBIF facets, 1,402 distinct original source plant species keys. Original authentic 11,511 EIV candidate taxa/4,011 exactly numeric accepted vascular plant species.
- Source-only scoreability: **44/48 sites, 13/16 independent outfalls across 4 countries** pass each U2/U1/D1 >=10 scoreable plants, >=40% scoring coverage, >=20 source EIV-eligible occurrence records.
- However U1→D1 original hydrologic river distance **4.096–16.479km (median 8.076km)**; only **0/16 within 2km, 2/16 within 5km**. Original 2011–24 buffer sites cannot be treated as local/outfall-proximal 2018/2022 ecology. Original annual source-reported measured facility N/P mass field was not available for these 16 (missing ≠ none discharged).

### 2. Correct source-only physical river-path site reposition — verified [Actions #43846527119 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43846527119)
- Restored original 16 source-selected HydroWASTE outlets and original NEXT_DOWN-directed 4-reach U2→U1→outfall→D1 geometry from signed source artifact #42364866919 (original source SHA pinned). Retrieved original SHA-pinned 2026 third-party Europe v1 HydroRIVERS GeoParquet, local AEQD projection, reach endpoint ordering and gaps <=100m and original source outfall snap <=100m.
- Generated NEW local matched stream locations **1,500m upstream and 1,500m downstream from each exact original outfall**, not the original mid-reach centres, with spatially disjoint 250m circle candidates. **16/16 passed physical topology/path gate across 4 original countries**. The US/European mapping is not an officially independent HydroRIVERS byte validation.

### 3. Genuine official near-outfall GBIF 250m site/period support — verified [Actions #43847165094 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43847165094)
- 128/128 source-authentic public count queries completed, 16 outlets × 2 true new locations × 2017–19 /2020–22 × original kingdom Plantae and nonfocal Animalia source/effort.
- Minimum original source opportunity 20 publicly reported GBIF plants in both local upstream/downstream 250m circles: **ZERO of 16 outlets** in 2017–19 and **ZERO of 16** in 2020–22. This is recording scarcity, not biological absence or proof of no sewage effects.

### 4. Pre-frozen separately after 250m failure, 500m/1000m source radius sensitivity — verified [Actions #43847809172 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43847809172)
- New 128/128 original GBIF Plantae count-only queries. All source true original 16 outfalls have up/down horizontal centre spacing >=2,104m so both 500m and 1000m circles are **nonoverlapping**.
- Original separate source gate: >=20 plant records on BOTH sides, minimum 10 distinct outfall IDs across >=3 countries.
- 2017–19: 500m **2/16 (2 countries)**, 1000m **4/16 (3 countries)**.
- 2020–22: 500m **3/16 (2 countries)**, 1000m **10/16 (3 countries)**, so one cross-sectional GBIF source-record opportunity passes at 1km in 2020–22. **Not** a two-year same-source panel and **NOT** a source-specific wastewater effect.
- 2017–19 repeated-source eligibility at 1km is only four original outlets; no near-field repeat-site 2018/2022 river→riparian analysis with ≥10 source systems. A 1000m record radius can include diverse terrestrial landcover rather than confirmed riparian vegetation.

### Scientific decision for one article

A single observational paper pooling original EU FR73 receiving-river TP/EQR, EU451 GBIF plant NUTRI–butterfly HNS, and US EPA XEMBED EPT as if they are one sewage exposure or food-web chain is **NOT** supported. Verified separately: measured French river TP predicts actual same-river benthic EQR; plant habitat NUTRI predicts butterfly larval host habitat HNS across H7; original TP→same H7 terrestrial trait score does not add stable unseen-H6 prediction; source WWTP reported annual nutrient dose linked to these physical field stations is insufficient.

The real single-mechanism hypothesis (still UNTESTED): wastewater-generated resource and pollutant effects cross to terrestrial consumers **conditional on realized nutrient access and an actual connected pathway**, modulated by taxon traits, habitat configuration and contamination. The existing scientific literature already demonstrates transfer of insect emergent biomass and metals (Behrens & Bernhardt 2025 DOI 10.1086/735929), effluent-associated microbial/food-web changes (Diesbourg et al. 2025 DOI 10.1016/j.envpol.2025.125948), and taxon-specific microplastic transfer to spiders (Wardlaw et al. 2026 DOI 10.1016/j.envpol.2026.129116). Thus "wastewater affects both ecosystems" is not novel enough; identifying **which trait/pathway predicts propagation** is the unique test.

**GO design for an independent causal water–land paper**: outfall-level source-verified measured annual N/P and water flow, hydrologically directed actual upstream/downstream receiver nutrient concentrations, a comparable river without source interposition, same-year +/-1.5km near-bank STANDARDIZED vegetation or actual insect emergence–spider resource response, outfall/river and season random effects, effort and land-cover QA; choose one terrestrial transmission route as primary. Butterfly host preference HNS and adult puddling are different phenomena, and neither can be asserted from generic GBIF proximity. Need multiple independent positive source systems before a confirmation model.

Original original result/test code and the signed Action artifacts retained on this new Draft; do not merge automatically. Leave main and chocho unchanged.
prs.title: Outfall-anchored 1.5km river-path riparian source redesign: 16/16 geometry, EIV opportunity, true local GBIF gate

## Completed (2026-11-16): actual 2022 EEA measured N/P outfalls × true riverbank sites × genuine Sentinel pixels × actual aquatic station support

**Full signed source-only evidence and manuscript readiness:** [RESULTS_20261116_ALL282_SOURCE_FRAMES_S2_TP_BQE_WISA_NEXT_GATE.md](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-measured-uwwtd-sentinel-riparian-sourcefirst/docs/RESULTS_20261116_ALL282_SOURCE_FRAMES_S2_TP_BQE_WISA_NEXT_GATE.md).

### What now works, from original public data (no biological effect model)
- [Actual authentic 2022 EEA UWWTD measured N+P facility reported source #43850677284 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43850677284): 1,156 original one-FW-outfall source systems, DE630/AT526; strict HydroRIVERS actual NEXT_DOWN ±1,500m outfall-connected riverline source geometry qualifies **282 systems**, DE137/AT145. Original source- and response-blind separated pilot **48**, 24 each country. Original reporting tonnes/year is not actual instream TNTP concentration nor source-year 2018 mass.
- [Full 282 same-source qualified geo artifact #43856642187 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43856642187): preserve every 282 derived true source outlet GIS coordinate independently of selecting 48 for satellite scene queries; retains 2022 true reported source signatures and completely unchanged original 48 sampled sites.
- [2018 & 2022 genuine legacy Sentinel-2 L2A STAC scene metadata #43851791936 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43851791936): same collection both years, 48/48 original sources have ≥3 dates each; original 2022 Sentinel-2 Collection1 STAC 2022 source archive gives 0/48 so not used for time comparison. 2018 original red/nir scale 0.0001 offset0, 2022 source band scale0.0001 offset−0.1; actual reflectance correction applied before any NDVI.
- [Original fixed 12-source two-year actual 10m red/NIR & 20m SCL pixel QA #43853111036 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43853111036): upstream and downstream 250m circles, ≥100 SCL4/5/cloudfree/physical redNIR pixels each in ≥2 same months across June/July/Aug in 2018 and 2022: **6/12** AT3/DE3, below fixed **8/12 STOP**. 55 technical scene passes/37 source-local quality fails, no COG file read failures. Prior fixed 12-case STOP must NOT be retroactively removed.
- [Separately frozen post-12 full48 original pixel availability #43854317398 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43854317398): exact same source mask, radiometric correction and per-site minimum, **26/48** independent original outlets (AT14/DE12) have ≥2 valid SAME Jun–Aug calendar months in 2018 AND 2022, source-only fixed >=24/48 and >=8/country PASSES. Monthly 2018 pass 47/45/44 and 2022 28/26/28. This is a source-feasibility result, not independent confirmation of the 12 pilot or evidence of vegetation growing due to sewage.

### Crucial NEW adversarial source audit: same 2022 outfalls must have actual aquatic field monitoring
**Authentic EEA2022 Biology original 2,475 benthic EQR field stations in current source are AT68 / DE0.** Zero *German EEA source rows* does NOT mean zero German rivers or aquatic animals. Separately source-verified WISE6 2022 actual river TP date-eligible national station registry has 342 original sampling stations, of which **301** have unique confirmed public coordinates (AT87, DE214), from immutable PR30; numerical river TP concentrations and EQR responses were NOT opened here.
- [Original 48 outfall pilot source locality #43856384574 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43856384574): at **≤2km from actual discharge outlet**, 5/48 have real 2022 WQ TP monitor nearby, 1/48 has BQE monitor, 1/48 both nearby. BQE site actually on same outfall native river reach or immediate NEXT_DOWN D1: **0/48**.
- **Critical control for 48 pilot selection bias:** [ALL 282 original true-source/flow-path qualified outfalls #43857491196 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43857491196): at **≤2km** 9/282 with actual 2022 TP monitor, 1/282 with EEA benthic, 1/282 with both nearby, **0/282 benthic sites** on same outfall or immediate D1 river reach. At **≤5km** 31/282 with TP monitor, 15/282 with benthic, 14/282 both; but this broader physical distance does NOT establish receiving-reach hydraulic downstream pathway or common biological source. Full 282 include shared drainages; these are source counts, not independent experiments.
- The preregistered ≥12 same-year same-outfall water chem/benthic/riparian independent systems in ≥2 countries with true network delivery is **HARD STOP** in current EEA public source. Stop numerical water-to-riparian mediation analysis and do not impute missing WQ, BQE or original 2018 outfall nutrient load.

### Next source identity discovery, with independently official national provenance

**Austria WISA/H2O cross-domain source** (official national Ministry of Water) explicitly supports thematic join of same monitoring stations for (i) chemical/physicochemical water quality, (ii) macrozoobenthos/phytobenthos/fish/aquatic macrophytes and (iii) EmReg-OW **emission loads aggregated to receiving river monitoring stations**: https://www.bmluk.gv.at/themen/wasser/wisa/daten/daten.html and https://wasser.umweltbundesamt.at/h2odb/ . This is an actual existing multi-source provider, NOT a demonstrated eligible 2022 data extraction for our exact 145 source systems; must test original site IDs/country/year/coords and dates before estimating effects.
**Germany Hessian HLNUG** openly identifies an XLSX river macrozoobenthos monitoring result set **2004–2022**: https://www.hlnug.de/themen/wasser/fliessgewaesser/fliessgewaesser-biologie/ueberwachungsergebnisse/fischnaehrtiere . Geographic station coordinates and 2022 original IDs/country source join are not yet verified. Do not assert that these national data already deliver full DE/AT source coverage.

### Status / interpretation

- **Source technical advances:** correct same measured 2022 outfall N/P source, real directed up/down river points, source-original two-year same-month satellite pixels possible for 26 original outfalls, true water station source opportunities audited on full 282 denominator.
- **Still NOT measured or fitted:** sewage-specific chemical input actually received by the riparian vegetation, concurrent river TNTP and EQR at those same original outfalls, actual aquatic adult emergence, butterfly larval host use or adult puddling, independent control-reach counterfactual, or ecosystem services. Satellite NDVI is optical land-green index, not biomass/richness. No pooled France TP/I2M2 vs DE/AT satellite mediation.
- **Manuscript:** a causal wastewater-mediated cross-boundary ecosystem paper is **NO-GO** from this fixed EEA sample alone. Next verify actual same-station 2022 Austria WISA cross-domain monitoring and/or German national BQE as a new independent source population. Previous positive EU terrestrial nutrient-habitat trait covariance and FR2022 actual river TP-benthic status retain their genuine, separate evidence.

All code/source gates and positive/null feasibility results in this Draft; no change to main or chocho, no raw satellite COGs or external bulk WQ rehosted.

## Original Austrian WISA/GZÜV 2022 site-source interoperability: real official geo PASS, 2022 joint chemistry and MZB sample source unverified

**Full source-verified ledger and study STOP/GO:** [Original Austrian GZÜV 3,788 monitoring stations, EEA2022 68/68 PKINT source join](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-wisa-gzuev-water-benthos-2022-source-access/docs/RESULTS_20261116_AUSTRIA_GZUEV_OFFICIAL_STATION_PKINT_AT145_EEA2022_SOURCE_DECISION.md). [Prior source protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-wisa-gzuev-water-benthos-2022-source-access/docs/PROTOCOL_20261116_WISA_GZUEV_OFFICIAL_2022_COMMON_STATION_SOURCE_GATE.md).

### Authentic official national source (NOT a 2022 occurrence table)
- Original BMLUK government public dataset **GZÜV Messnetz Fließgewässer**, Austrian data.gv.at via documented official EU catalogue source, ID **b054ce75-f0b1-449e-b11c-9603a629c9c5**, original distribution at Austrian Environment Agency Nextcloud public share https://docs.umweltbundesamt.at/s/SNJqq7TEprxJtpJ . Public original FWMST.gpkg is a direct real SQLite GeoPackage binary, not ZIP despite public menu URL; no internal/private APIs used.
- Official source authentic original GPKG **SHA256 4b87a495cd71bf2c413494b80158e8cfc91bb0de3e6e2559c186298388986fcf**, 675,840 bytes, native EPSG:31287 **3,788 source station POINT records**, original unique `PK` identifier and unique EEA-interoperable `PKINT` identifier. Original all-station `BEGIN_DAT` uniformly **2025-12-09** and hence NOT a 2022 field sample date. No original bulk GPKG redistributed.
- Provenance/metadata source-only runs SUCCESS: [official public search #43861131035](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43861131035), [real original BMLUK distribution #43861576087](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43861576087), [authorized public file share #43861925144](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43861925144), [original ZIP/GPKG byte/CRS/station geometry #43863117767](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43863117767).

### Original AT145 measured-N+P annual UWWTD source outfalls: authentic national station geometry opportunity
- Exactly source-preselected 2022 EEA annual N and P positive reported freshwater one-outfall facilities with strict river/source physical geometry, **145 Austria outlets** from previous PR116 #43856642187 (original annual mass tonnes/year not actual delivered receiving water concentration).
- Number of distinct source-positive outfalls within 500m / 1000m / **2000m** / 5000m of any national historical GZÜV station = **41 / 77 / 117 / 144**, of exactly 145. Unique official GZÜV station IDs within 2km = **225**. Geographic opportunity, not same-year station water/biotic monitoring, nor confirmed downstream river routing.
- Original in-main **68 genuine Austrian EEA 2022 benthic field site IDs** in original 2,475-site source directly match official BMLUK `PKINT` station identifiers **68/68 exact ID crosswalk**; **67/68 EEA-national source coordinate pairs within5m**, median **0.643m**. One national/source ID **ATFW54110117** differs **954.614m**, retaining this original location conflict instead of incorrectly declaring the entire set physically identical. [Real independent source station crosswalk #43864306874 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43864306874).
- Matching only official station points known to be among these EEA2022 68 benthic source IDs yields 2/145 facilities within2km on national original coords, but only 1/145 on earlier EEA actual 2022 source coords, **without confirmed same receiving/downstream river path**. Therefore a GZÜV map cannot be substituted for a 2022 sampled benthic/TP source.

### NEW immediately usable official 2022 source-outfall × historical station identity table
- [Original signed source CSV build **Actions #43865663130 SUCCESS**](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43865663130) produced a compact 225-record source list: **117 authentic 2022 EEA both-N/P-annual-measured river outfalls** and **225 distinct public BMLUK GZÜV source PKINT monitoring station IDs**, original great-circle distance <=2000m; each row includes true original facility ID, source PK, source PKINT, geographic separation and original 2022 annual reported N/P load. File SHA256 **040d610b6172d165787775406ea50c0f73f34db1db3fcb6c8576898736146dde**; full original third-party GeoPackage not rehosted. A geographically nearby PKINT ID is NOT a 2022 actual TNTP/MZB observation or a downstream receiving stream. The source list supports an exact bounded public H2O/WISA 2022 station-year query or original public-source assistance request without invented IDs.
- [Source evidence and data-request contract](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-wisa-gzuev-water-benthos-2022-source-access/docs/RESULTS_20261116_AUSTRIA_GZUEV_OFFICIAL_STATION_PKINT_AT145_EEA2022_SOURCE_DECISION.md).

### Source STOP / paper guardrails
- Official public [H2O five-step query](https://wasser.umweltbundesamt.at/h2odb/fivestep/abfrageQdPublic.xhtml) and [national WISA crossdomain](https://www.bmluk.gv.at/themen/wasser/wisa/daten/daten.html) describe 2022-capable station-date water chemistry, MZB, phytobenthos and EmReg station-aggregated loads, but **original genuine per-PKINT×2022 TN+TP + MZB original sample sources are not yet obtained/verified** by these source-only scripts. JS interactive query is not automatically an authenticated/bulk public export. EmReg monitor-aggregate loads ≠ particular WWTP delivered dose.
- Consequently no aquatic→terrestrial wastewater/vegetation/biomass/butterfly or ecosystem services causal effect was fitted. Earlier source-valid separate France TP/EQR and EU H7 plant NUTRI/butterfly HNS effects cannot become one wastewater mediation chain merely by common labels or national station map.
- Next scientifically bounded source task: actual same-PKINT×2022 station observation metadata (TN+TP source date/method + macrozoobenthos source date + EmReg upstream link) for the **225 original station IDs** in 2km buffers around 117 original AT source-positive outlets; then hydrologically directed river reach/independent no-outfall control-source gate, **before opening numeric effects**. If official public export is interactive-only or requires authorization, mark source access blocked and request privacy-safe original record COUNT from official UBA data steward, without sending anything automatically.

All code/receipts/documentation on independent review-only branch, no main/chocho modifications and no third-party full source rehosting.

### 2026-11-16 continuation: actual EEA2026 Part1 same-PKINT 2022 TNTP sample coverage

- [Source-only pre-frozen contract](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-wisa-gzuev-water-benthos-2022-source-access/docs/PROTOCOL_20261116_EEA_WISE6_PART1_AT225_PKINT_2022_STRICT_TNTP_SOURCE.md) specifies 225 independently verified Austrian national official station PKINT identities and original 117 nearby 2022 annual measured-report N/P outfalls (derived crosswalk SHA256 040d610b6172d165787775406ea50c0f73f34db1db3fcb6c8576898736146dde).
- Actual EEA Waterbase Water Quality July2026 publicly published Part1 original ZIP 1,639,231,716 bytes SHA256 ff779521749b40b952cce35a4671240c3b6c47d87f32a8fef9240a4ac503a082, 96,597,294 original water sampling rows. Original exact PKINT country+scheme+year=2022, analyte genuine total-N / total-P, correct elemental unit and >=3 unique actual sampling dates and samples for BOTH analytes. Invalid LOQ/duplicate samples excluded; all source dataset denominator tracked. **No numeric concentrations are exported and no ecological regression is fit**. Geographic radius2km remains a proximity-only candidate, not proven downstream exposure.
- [Signed original EEA full Part1 source scan Actions #43868531447](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43868531447) launched. Do not assume any chemistry-site support until run completes and archived results are verified.
- [German UNSENT data request to official H2O helpdesk](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-wisa-gzuev-water-benthos-2022-source-access/docs/UNSENT_REQUEST_20261116_H2O_WISA_AT225_2022_TNTP_MZB.md) is ready to inquire about 2022 observed MZB and TNTP sample dates and public export for the exact original 225 PKINT. Published official helpdesk: h2o-helpdesk@umweltbundesamt.at. **No external email sent.**


### NEW national independent 2022 river TP–benthic field replication and non-sewage source rejection (2026-11-16)

**[Full same-station 68-site report with all 5 geographic test losses](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-wisa-gzuev-water-benthos-2022-source-access/docs/RESULTS_20261116_BMLUK_FW11_NATIONAL_AT68_TP_EQR_BLOCKED_REPLICATION_AND_SOURCE_STOP.md)**. Source original authenticated by [official BMLUK FW1 2022 annual workbook Actions #43872894930 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43872894930). Government original 2020–22 archive SHA256 6a0db0d0b8360c11f580333e5eabc3479c68fe8a5d623b87ef61f0185e5bd31a; FW1 annual workbook SHA256 17de22544e9d043f83a928154847fb3fcd938894ce7007cfd06c000444b6eeb2, **100 true original 2022 river annual TP means**, but **NO total nitrogen TN in this source**.
- Independent exact site-ID join government PK vs EEA2022 international PKINT: **68/68 genuine Austria 2022 benthic EQR sites match real annual mean unfiltered TP mg P/L**; 5 original 3-degree geographic regions sized 9,15,21,13,10, one MI-RW-AT source method. Original EEA BQE source gitblob SHA1 325f199e985d9862ffee5b0edb205c61a7be3833. Never substitute the 2022 yearbook NO3-N percentile as total N or the national FW2 2019–21 operative list as 2022 benthic observation.
- Source-frozen exploratory Austria TP→actual same-site benthic EQR raw Spearman **rho −0.5862**, Pearson lnTP–EQR **r −0.6277**; full adjusted for original river log flow/area and coordinates, β **−0.09948 EQR per 1-SD lnTP**. In **5 original region-block disjoint heldout folds** using fixed Ridge10 train-only standardization, adding TP cuts block-equal average MSE **33.90%**, with all blocks positive (+29.4,+25.2,+44.0,+39.4,+36.9%). Independent normal-equation and augmented-least-squares reproductions give same outcome to machine precision. FIVE geographic blocks insufficient for reliable conventional cluster-inference claims; exploratory post-source discovery.
- Within the original preselected 225 GZÜV stations ≤2km of 117 genuinely reported annual N/P 2022 positive outlets, only **3** are FW1 2022 TP-sampled stations, of which only **2** had genuine EEA2022 benthic site ID; one national-vs-EEA coordinate discrepancy **954.614m**. Genuine original directed HydroRIVERS graph [Actions #43874361627 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43874361627) proves **both** benthic sites lie **UPSTREAM** of their source-positive WWTP outlet river reaches. Hence **zero** verified SAME-outfall downstream field 2022 TP+benthic cases here; upstream pairs may be references but are NOT sewage-impacted test reaches.
- Prior national 225-original-station 2022 Part1 **96,597,294** EEA individual rows and separate Part2 **6,450,192** annual rows yielded **zero matching original target site IDs**, but that's EEA record coverage, not verified national H2O absence. Independent EEA WQ source spatial point crosswalk [Actions #43871930876 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43871930876): 10/225 target stations match distinct EEA WQ station within 10m, all have SAME government PKINT IDs already subject to 2022 zero-record original source checks. Remaining 100m neighbors are NOT assumed station identity.

**Decision:** cross-country **within-water** observational nutrient/assemblage relation is now strengthened by a genuinely independent Austrian source vs French TP–I2M2. But direct causal WWTP nutrient subsidy/stress propagating into downstream benthos, riparian vegetation or butterflies is **not** supported: original Austrian wastewater source 0 downstream co-observed study units. Don't pool national 68 aquatic stations into the previously unrelated France/Europe terrestrial coefficient as a single mechanistic wastewater source. Next independent original field availability must be real source 2022 H2O/WISA TNTP+MZB at actual receiving sites, with matched upstream/reference reaches. Original 225-station [UNSENT helpdesk request](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-wisa-gzuev-water-benthos-2022-source-access/docs/UNSENT_REQUEST_20261116_H2O_WISA_AT225_2022_TNTP_MZB.md) remains a draft, no email sent. Main and chocho untouched.


## NEW original 2022 same-Austrian-68-site wastewater source → actually measured P → benthic quality (2026-11-16)

[Full original source, model and adversarial results](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-wisa-gzuev-water-benthos-2022-source-access/docs/RESULTS_20261116_AUSTRIA68_WWTP_P_TO_ACTUAL_TP_EQR_GEOBLOCK_AND_PLACEBO.md) | [first signed run #43882137861](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43882137861) | [independent numerical QA and symmetric downstream source placebo #43883032442](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43883032442).

- Same **68 original 2022 official Austrian river monitoring sites** have both national BMLUK FW1 unfiltered TP mg P/L and EEA benthic normalized EQR, AND the previously original-source-locked EEA2022 reported eligible WWTP P tonnes/year within **50km source-model directed upstream** / hydrologically downstream placebo: 53 upstream-positive of 68; no reports ≠ sewage absent. Genuine source regional blocks n9,15,21,13,10. Annual report is not actual receiving WWTP P fraction and 2022 stream TP is from all sources, not same-day aquatic sample.
- In fixed five genuinely disjoint original geographic regional-heldout Ridge10, adding **raw upstream reported annual P** improves observed lnTP prediction **+5.292%** (4/5 blocks), versus downstream reported mass +1.065%. Stream lnTP added to benthic EQR background improves EQR **+33.896%** (5/5).
- Physical dilution index **0.03170979×reported P tonnes/year / source river Q m³/s** (potential maximum mg P/L if all P delivered, NOT measured source concentration): added upstream P/Q predicts actual observed stream lnTP **+16.302% (5/5 blocks)** and benthic EQR **+19.269% (5/5)**. Added after actually measured 2022 stream TP still predicts EQR +6.722% (4/5), but this is NOT a causal mediation or wastewater effect. Top3 source P/Q magnitude-excluded n65 sensitivity: stream TP +26.14%, EQR +18.85%; full68 primary kept.
- **Symmetrically Q-normalized DOWNSTREAM placebo** does not transfer: observed stream TP −45.994% MSE gain, EQR −16.422%; however one region had a very large −236% stream TP gain, so the placebo is numerically unstable and cannot be taken as standalone proof of causal upstream exposure. Controlling both normalized directions together also transfers poorly. Using *un-normalized* annual source load, downstream P nevertheless predicts EQR +13.295% (more than upstream raw P +0.467%), warning of area/urban/flow confounding. Original temporal exposure, farm/industrial P, river network false assignments and source reporting process not controlled.
- Official observed source relationships are consistent with **river nutrient variation and aquatic biotic condition** along an upstream-source geography, but **not yet a true wastewater nutrient transfer chain, not a causal downstream freshwater effect, and not an aquatic–riparian trophic linkage**. Original outfall-centered 117/225 separate frame had only 3 monitored 2022 near-outfall TP stations and 2 corresponding EEA same-year benthic site IDs, both were hydrologically UPSTREAM of source outfall, so that subcohort remains NO-GO for downstream attribution.
- This is substantially stronger than a generic land-use W proxy on the *aquatic side* because reported source P, actually measured in-stream TP, and actual EQR now share the exact physical station/year. But existing EU broad plant-NUTRI/butterfly HNS is separate geography/scale. A single mechanistic wastewater aquatic–terrestrial article still requires same 2022 local riverbank vegetation or consumers plus actual directed source exposure and reference stream design; DO NOT merge a causal SEM from these separate populations.

All new original source scientific tests are exploratory with only five geographic source blocks. Numeric solver check 4/4. Leave this PR in Draft; do not merge main or chocho.

## Experimental cross-system common-grain source study — genuine same 2022 Austrian river water TP/EQR station × satellite landscape greenness

**Source-only results completed and scientifically interpretable as an observation-feasibility STOP, NOT biological null.**

**Why this study:** PR #117 first aligned original 2022 EEA source model reported upstream WWTP P (n53/68 positive), actual 2022 national Austrian river total P annual mean (68/68 genuine physical same stations), EEA2022 benthic normalized EQR (68/68) and real 5 geographical region-block heldout predictive tests. It did not measure SAME-site terrestrial vegetation. The old whole-EU H7 GBIF plant NUTRI and butterfly larval-host affinity scores were a different scale/population and cannot be pasted into a causal WWTP path. This new source stage takes the original Austrian river biology **physical monitoring points themselves** as the center of the new terrestrial satellite observations. Site source selected before NDVI outcome.

**Source-locked exact geography:** Original official GZÜV EEA2022 station ID crosswalk 68/68, one material 954.614m coordinate disagreement (ATFW54110117), excluded BEFORE opening 2022 satellite data. Remaining **67** original true same-2022 river TP/EQR field monitoring points in five source 3-degree spatial regions (9/14/21/13/10). No exposure/TP/EQR sign selected.

**Genuine Sentinel-2 satellite source acquisition [Actions #43884504952 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43884504952):** all **67/67 original 2022 field station sites** have genuine June–August original legacy Earth Search S2 L2A B04/red, B08/nir, SCL COG scenes, preselected max two lower tile-cloud scenes per original month, total **394 scene metadata records**, footprint covers 500m circle. This is scene metadata source support only, not real cloud-free green pixels.

**Predeclared WorldCover/S2 true pixel source SMOKE [Actions #43885473411 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43885473411):** exactly **10 original sites (2 SHA-selected site IDs per each original 5 geographic regions)**, actual Sentinel-2 original reflectance scale/offset, cloud/SCL masks and **2021 ESA WorldCover v200 natural classes tree/shrub/grass/wetland**, exclude water/cropland/built. Compare original 250m circle centered at true field river station against original 250–500m annulus in common natural landcover class, source ≥100/200 SCL4/5 clear pixels and ≥40/100 class-eligible clear pixels near/outer and min 10 common-class pixels, at least 2 months of June/July/August. **ONLY 5/10** sites pass >=2 original months, across 4 source regions (15_3:1,15_5:1,16_4:2,16_5:1); predeclared smoke was **≥6/10 across ≥4 regions, therefore FAIL**. 31 scene attempts failed proper naturally covered clear land pixel support, not provider download. The original source gate stays STOP; full67 pixel model and all source→NDVI and EQR→NDVI regressions are **NOT run**. Do NOT rescue by posthoc increasing circular radius, expanding months, including crops or choosing favorable stations.

**Scientific meaning:** genuine same-location 2022 optical scene opportunity exists, but landcover-matched 250m near-water and outer reference source-quality is limited in original randomized smoke subset. A vegetated riverbed observation is NOT actual leaf nutrient uptake, riparian plant biomass, species richness, butterfly larval resource or an ecosystem service. The metadata and pixel-eligibility NO-GO constrains how confidently the real aquatic nutrient/biotic observations can be compared with nearby land in a current single wastewater causal ecosystem paper.

Full source:
- [Pre-pixel source/frame protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-AT67-same-riverbank-S2-landgreenness/docs/PROTOCOL_20261116_AUSTRIA67_SAME_MONITOR_STATION_S2_2022_RIPARIAN_SOURCE_GATE.md)
- [Cloud/cloudless natural WorldCover pixel/10-site smoke preregistered rules](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-AT67-same-riverbank-S2-landgreenness/docs/PROTOCOL_20261116_AT67_S2_2022_WORLD_COVER_LAND_PIXELS_SMOKE.md)
- [Full results, all source-negative support and manuscript GO/STOP decision](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-20261116-AT67-same-riverbank-S2-landgreenness/docs/RESULTS_20261116_AT67_2022_S2_WORLDCOVER_GENUINE_SAME_WATER_SITE_SMOKE_STOP.md)

Parent PR #117 upstream reported WWTP P to measured river TP and EQR cross-site results remain observational, n68 source; current child branch n67 is the independently coordinate-QA-passed **terrestrial target frame** only. No causal aquatic–terrestrial or butterfly inference, no 2022 terrestrial effect estimated. Leave Draft, no main or chocho changes.

Adding upstream actual EEA reported annual P/Q source-mass-equivalent after landcover predicts river lnTP **+4.5822%** (only 3/5 regions positive, fixed 5-region uncertainty includes zero), and EQR **+15.0307%**. Untested mixed loads, habitat morphology, catchment management, co-pollutants and source reporting selection remain.

**All these are post hoc stress tests on the same 67 source field sites, NOT independent replicate studies.** Original report P/Q is a source-mass/mean-Q potential concentration-equivalent, not true measured WWTP fraction delivered to river. Only near-station WorldCover2021 prior landcover (1km), not entire upstream 50km, is adjusted. EQR is a normalized ecological-status score, not invertebrate biomass or richness. Existing S2 2022 near250-vs-outer500 naturally class-matched 10-site smoke n5<prelocked n6 technical FAIL remains **STOP**, so **NO 2022 riparian vegetation outcome, aquatic-to-land ecological regression or butterfly food-web response is justified**. **Most defensible STRICT same-host N/F community comparison:** [real original 162 strict source butterflies × 447 H7×period/89 H6 × same-scored plant N/F EIV×same-H7 EEA EQR #43901046421 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/43901046421). ## 論文の主問と改訂内容

下水処理に伴う栄養負荷は、水域と陸域の生物群集にどのように対応し、その対応は植物―植食者関係を通じてどこまでつながるのか。

既存結果を、水域の化学環境 → 下水関連地理と植物 → 植物と蝶5科 → シジミチョウ科への探索的焦点化 → フランス共通標本での水陸接続、の順に本文へ統合した。今回の改訂では新しい解析・モデル推定・データ取得を行っていない。過去の解析コードや出所監査は履歴・補足資料に保持している。

## 主な変更

- #135：英国591地点・5,000生物分析で、実測水質がEDFに追加する予測情報と、水質後にEDFの追加予測力がない結果を本文へ。
- #134：W→植物の属内種構成の支持と国外予測の不確実性を追加。植物→蝶の属内不確実性（#105）とは区別。
- 蝶5科比較を先に示し、シジミへの焦点化を事後探索と明記。科別置換のBH補正後に有意科がない結果、国外・種均等予測の限界を保持。
- フランス139 H7×期間を接続の主検証として保持。TP→植物と全係数積の不確実性を他標本の支持で埋めない。
- #132：同一処理場の水・農地への源記録を考察へ。施用区画と生物は未接続、閉鎖物質収支・生物同化は未実証。
- #133：米国の年代・流域外転送が一貫しない結果を一般化の限界として保持。

## 本文・図・証拠表

- [本文](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/docs/wastewater-riparian-interactions-outline/docs/manuscript_riparian_interactions/MANUSCRIPT_FULL_20261119.md)
- [図1 A–D・要旨](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/docs/wastewater-riparian-interactions-outline/docs/manuscript_riparian_interactions/README.md)
- [表1：経路別スケールと支持状態](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/docs/wastewater-riparian-interactions-outline/docs/manuscript_riparian_interactions/PATH_EVIDENCE_SCALES_20261120.md)
- [日英図説明](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/docs/wastewater-riparian-interactions-outline/docs/manuscript_riparian_interactions/FIGURE1_LEGEND_AND_BOUNDARIES_20261119.md)

図は標本ごとに区切り、統計的支持／源の数量記録／不確実な関連／未観測機構／品質不足で未推定を文字と線で区別する。H7群集は河岸限定ではなく、HNSは現地幼虫摂食や成虫タンパク質利用の測定ではない。別標本の係数を連鎖の因果効果へ合成しない。

## 確認

文書差分、内部参照、外部の固定コミット出所6件を確認。新しい生物解析は実行していない。Draftを維持し、mainへはマージしない。

## 新規：水×陸の共通生物地理SOURCEゲート（暫定03M、STOP）

**[成功したsource-onlyジョブ #44295975185](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44295975185)** で、EEA2018底生元サイトと2017–19植物EIV品質合格H7を元WKT流域ポリゴンで合わせた。共通JRC源269 NUTS2→**生物と地理的に一致25 NUTS2・6か国・44 H6**。国内源変動2か国、独立H6–NUTS2成分16、地理5fold各成分数1/1/5/4/5。事前閾値40 NUTS2・8か国・30 H6・変動5国・20成分・全fold各4成分のうちH6のみ適合。**生物効果・2×2モデルは未計算**。

**ただし正式な1:100万GISCO境界の取得が403で停止したため、Eurostat由来2016年1:300万境界による暫定診断であり、01M正式判定ではない。** [暫定結果・制約を明示した保存台帳](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-jrc-point-diffuse-source-gate-20261118/docs/manuscript_riparian_interactions/BIOTIC_2X2_GEOGRAPHIC_PROVISIONAL_SOURCE_STOP_20261118.md)。元草稿とmainには反映しない。

---
## 審査対象：水陸2×2を生物結果の共通照合より先に凍結

**SOURCE-onlyで確認済み：** JRC公式モデルの水への点源N/P＋陸へのN投入4種類について、269 NUTS2地域／28か国に値がそろう。水へのモデル点源Nと陸N投入のNUTS2単純相関は、大気N沈着 r=+0.051、鉱質N施肥+0.069、有機N施肥+0.011、N固定+0.166。これらは生物効果ではない。

- [2×2生物比較の凍結プロトコル](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-jrc-point-diffuse-source-gate-20261118/docs/manuscript_riparian_interactions/POINT_DIFFUSE_BIOTIC_2X2_FROZEN_20261118.md)
- [機械可読の凍結設定](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-jrc-point-diffuse-source-gate-20261118/analysis/20261118_point_diffuse_source/BIOTIC_2X2_FROZEN_CONFIG_20261118.json)
- [既存のSOURCE-only結果と制約](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-jrc-point-diffuse-source-gate-20261118/docs/manuscript_riparian_interactions/JRC_NUTS2_SOILN_POINTN_SOURCE_GATE_RESULT_20261118.md)
- [公開ソース照合の成功Action](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44290036470)

### 固定した2×2
同じ2016 NUTS2地域にEEA2018底生EQRとGBIF2017–19植物NUTRIが両方ある地域を共通主標本とする。水へのモデル点源N（家庭＋産業）対陸へのモデルN投入3変数（大気沈着、鉱質/有機施肥）について、B0、BP、BD、BPDの4モデルを同一地理foldで比較する。蝶HNSは消費者の副次結果。

生物SOURCEゲート：共通40 NUTS2、8か国、30 H6、5か国で各3 NUTS2以上と国内源変動、分割可能連結地理成分20以上。地理・元EQR方法・観測努力・背景共変量と各源の実値/欠測を生物数値の閲覧前に固定。満たさなければSOURCE-STOP。

主検定：水域C_W=U_P−U_D、陸域C_L=U_D−U_Pがともに正か。対角の固有MSE改善各1%以上かつ95%区間下限>0、地理再標本化片側p<0.05。非対角が有意でないだけでは効果なしと主張しない。地域内予測は国固定効果、国をまたぐ検証は固定効果なしの別モデルとし区別する。

### 絶対に主張しないこと
地理の単純相関が弱いことを点源と面源の物理的分離と呼ばない。陸域に点源予測力があっても「WWTPのNが蝶へ到達した」とは言わない。EQRは耐性形質そのものではなく、植物EIV/蝶HNSは実際の摂食や資源フラックスではない。新しい生物2×2のモデルは未実行。草稿PR #124 と main を未変更のまま、検証後にのみ論文の主張を更新する。

**本PRはDraftを維持し、mainへ一括マージしない。**

prs.body:
## 2026-11-19｜陸域単独SOURCEゲートも停止（新規数値EIVモデル未実行）

[Action #44437691189](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44437691189)はsource-onlyの真正H7 WKTポリゴン（元GBIFリクエスト・SHA一致）、元451/454 EIV品質可否、公式GISCO2016 01M、JRC269地域モデル源を照合し成功。2017–19の品質適格植物H7 **226**、厳格NUTS2とモデル源が揃うH7は**111**。独立**25 NUTS2・6か国・43 H6**、国内源の変動2国、独立連結成分16、5分割1/1/4/5/5。固定閾値（55地域・8国・40H6・変動5国・20成分・各fold4成分）のうちH6のみ達成、**SOURCE-STOP**。

[独立した陸域単独SOURCE-STOPの監査記録](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-point-land-source-adversarial-20261119/docs/TERRESTRIAL_ONLY_POINT_LANDN_SOURCE_STOP_RESULTS_20261119.md) ／ [原結果artifact](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44437691189/artifacts/14489605752)。

**最終科学判定：** 269地域の源構造には異なる地理情報があるが、国内有機N施肥との負相関があり完全独立とは言えない。2016河川の点源N相対優位は方向のみで95%CIはゼロ横断。陸側EIVは生物結果以前のsource support不足でSTOP。水陸共通2×2のSOURCE-STOPも保持し、「水は点源、陸は面源」という生物の因果的分離は未実証。元論文草稿/main/前PR #125は変更していない。

---

## 2026-11-19 結果：点源と陸域N投入の識別は部分的／水域では点源が有望だが不確実

**SOURCE-only 269 NUTS2 / 28か国：** 公式GISCO面積補正＋国内国等重みで、水へのモデル点源N密度と陸への大気N沈着 r+0.084、鉱質施肥+0.025、有機施肥**−0.268**、生物N固定−0.021。陸主3源を同時に調整した源構造のpartial R²=0.111、点源VIF=1.125。有機施肥の国ブート95%区間［−0.471,−0.029］が事前の弱相関相当区間±0.30から外れるため、**完全に地理的独立とする強い判定は不合格**。[元SOURCE-only run #44434558903](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44434558903)

**別の2016河川底生だけの源ゲート：** 73 NUTS2・12か国でGO、元EQRの数値有効地域とのID照合で共通**67 NUTS2・11か国**（EEA2016底生有効2,276site）に確定。最初の数値コードは地域ID非一致で**モデル実行前にSTOP**、別の数値可否ID監査により元の55地域/8か国/地理fold基準を保持してGO。元の事前地理fold14/13/13/13/14。[元SOURCE-only #44435431608](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44435431608)・[新しいID監査＋数値4モデル #44436814968](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44436814968)。

**2016年のEQR地域平均の国等重みheld-out MSE：** B0背景0.030124、BP＋点源N0.028660（+4.86%改善）、BD＋陸N3源0.039379（−30.72%悪化）、BPD両方0.037780。点源Nの固有改善U_P=**+4.06%［−3.21,+7.66］**、陸Nの固有改善U_D=**−31.82%［−65.75,+14.03］**、点源相対優位C_W=**+35.88［−15.55,+71.10］**（すべて固定OOF国ブートの記述区間）。**強い点源優位の基準は95%区間ゼロ横断のため不合格。** 元2016年EQRは既に探索済のデータで、新しい独立再現年ではない。

[数値・計算・限界の統合レポート](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-point-land-source-adversarial-20261119/docs/POINT_LAND_N_SOURCE_AND_2016_AQUATIC_EQR_RESULTS_20261119.md)

**厳守：** 2018年河川×2017–19年陸域の共通2×2は25 NUTS2・6か国の**SOURCE-STOPのまま**で、いずれの新しい水側結果も陸域の面源効果や下水→蝶の実移行を実証しない。main・草稿PR #124・以前の解析PR #125は変更していない。

---

## 目的
既存の269 NUTS2・28か国の点源N対陸N投入の単純相関が低い（r=+0.01〜+0.17）というSOURCE-only結果を、地理・面積・国内差の観点から厳しく検証する。

**既知の水域×陸域生物共通2×2はSOURCE STOP（25地域・6か国）。停止基準は変更しない。このPRでは生物アウトカム/EQR/NUTRI/HNSは開かない。**

### 事後探索として固定した分析
同じJRC公式269 NUTS2×6源＋GISCO2016公式1:100万原境界を用い、点源Nを地域面積で正規化した相関・国内中心化・国等重み・国全体を再標本化する3999ブートストラップ区間・28か国leave-one-country-out・国/面積/緯度経度を調整したpartial rを全4陸源で評価。陸3源の多変量追加説明率とVIFも計算し、単純相関の弱さをそのまま独立性と呼ばない。

[凍結した事後反証仕様](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-point-land-source-adversarial-20261119/docs/POINT_LAND_N_WITHINCOUNTRY_AREA_ADVERSARIAL_PROTOCOL_20261119.md)

元源データは前の[成功したsource-only run #44290036470](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44290036470)と公式GISCO原GPKGからSHA照合して再利用。全結果はActions artifactに保存、無都合な結果も残す。元論文草稿PR #124/解析PR #125/mainは未変更。
