prs.body:
## 2026-11-19追補：元H7のSOURCE被覆はPASS、しかしsource空間解像度は不足

[JRC-native流域×真正2017–19 H7 植物SOURCE-only pilot12 #44442417933](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44442417933)では、元EIV品質適格226 H7からハッシュ固定選択した12 H7に対し、JRC source Polygon union の被覆率80%以上が**12/12 PASS**。ただし大きいnative流域が複数H7を丸ごと含む可能性を発見し、**post-pilot厳格解像度診断（独立の事前登録ではない）**を実施。[追試SOURCE #44442798020](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44442798020)では、H7面積の4倍以内のsource-native Polygonだけで面積80%以上被覆できるのは**2/12 H7**のみ。優占するJRC流域面積/H7面積の中央値約**18.49倍**、最大159.40倍。二つの異なるH7が元の優占source BasinID=129487を共有する事例も明示。

**判定：最初の技術的なソース取得・被覆はPASSだが、H7に対する独立・局所的なsource曝露としての解像度は不十分（2/12）**。このデータでH7生物側の新しい点源対面源数値モデルを進めることはしない。

[完全なpost-pilot診断・欠点・出所](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-riverbasin-n-inputs-native-gate-20261119/docs/JRC_NATIVE_TO_H7_GEO_RESOLUTION_PILOT12_RESULTS_20261119.md)。

---

## 新規SOURCE-only検証（2026-11-19）：流域約1万候補の地理対応

**JRC公式河川流域レイヤー** 土壌N投入（大気沈着・鉱質/有機肥料）を原HydroIDで照合し数値が揃ったのは**9,740**。水へのモデル点源NのBasinIDと面積も一致した候補は**9,739**。元5レイヤーの全ObjectID、属性、欠測数、HASHを実際に照合。[元取得Action #44440277477](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44440277477)。

HydroIDとBasinIDの数字だけで結論を出さないため、元Polygonを独立に取得して**固定30流域の双方の面積重複100%（30/30）**を確認。[固定30ジオメトリAction #44441131398](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44441131398)。ただし全9,739流域の独立性・親子関係は未検証。

元9,739候補のlog1p点源Nモデルt/km² 対 陸Nモデル平均の記述的Pearson r：大気沈着**+0.089**、鉱質施肥**−0.0035**、有機施肥**−0.0168**、N固定**+0.0438**。点源Nが正7,761、元ゼロ1,978、候補流域面積中央値17.94 km²。大気沈着とのSpearmanは+0.265なので「独立」とは断定不可。[source地理の全結果 #44441591484](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44441591484)。

[結果と科学的な厳密な解釈](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-riverbasin-n-inputs-native-gate-20261119/docs/JRC_NATIVE_RIVERBASIN_SOIL_POINTN_SOURCE_RESULTS_20261119.md)。

**本検証は生物EQR、植物NUTRI、蝶HNSを一切使用しない。** 元の2018河川×2017–19植物のNUTS2共同2×2は25地域・6か国でSOURCE-STOPのまま。次の独立STEPは原植物H7（品質適格226）⇄JRC native polygonの厳格な空間対応を、植物数値を見る前に監査すること。元のmain/論文草稿PR#124/旧SOURCE PR#125/#126は未変更。

---

新しい独立SOURCE-only検証。JRC公式の河川流域単位の大気N沈着/施肥/固定レイヤー（Inputs to soil #5/#10/#15/#20）と、水へ排出されるGREENモデル点源N（Losses to water #5）のネイティブ地理単位を監査。JRCの土壌HydroIDと点源BasinID、既存研究H7のHYBAS_IDは**異なるキー**なのでIDの直接一致結合を禁止する。公式5レイヤーのschema、feature count、全OBJECTID、元属性25例とSHAだけを取得し、データを開く前に固定したSOURCEサポートゲートを確認する。[仕様](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-riverbasin-n-inputs-native-gate-20261119/docs/JRC_RIVERBASIN_POINT_VS_SOILN_NATIVE_SOURCE_GATE_20261119.md)。元の水域2018×植物2017–19の2×2は25 NUTS2/6か国のSOURCE-STOP、2016水域EQRの点源優位も95%CIがゼロをまたぐという履歴は維持。今回は一切生物効果を推定せず、source-only適格性だけを判定。`main`/草稿PR#124/探索PR#126を変更しない。
prs.title: JRC river-basin point/soil N: 9,739 source candidates; H7 local-resolution pilot 2/12 STOP

prs.body:
## 2026-11-19｜全226 H7 × JRC native5源を完走 — 本解析はSOURCE-STOP

**最終RUN： [全12分割・統合SOURCE-only #44449479977](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44449479977)（12シャード＋統合の13ジョブすべてSUCCESS）**。元226 H7 × 大気N・鉱質N・有機N・N固定・点源N＝**1130/1130ソースセルの公式API・EsriJSON幾何を取得**、生物EQR/NUTRI/HNS数値は未使用。 [全226 H7のGIS・独立ネイティブ源判定artifact](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44449479977/artifacts/14495587154)。

**90%カバーの定義を厳格に区別：**
- 複数JRC元ポリゴンの和集合で4主要源が90%以上：**221/226 H7**
- 各主要源を単一元JRCポリゴンで90%以上、かつ土壌3源native HydroID同一：**204/226 H7**
- 元Esri ringの大きな修復を未検証として除いた**保守的GIS品質適格：19/226 H7**

保守的な19 H7の独立soil native basinは**12**、真正H6=**11**、元source国ラベル=**6**、十分な国内変動=**1国**、独立H6–soil–point連結成分=**11**（地理5fold 1/2/3/3/2）。凍結基準（独立ネイティブsource 100・100 H7・40 H6・8国・5国内変動・各fold4成分）は満たさない。元JRC Esri ringsの修復に大きく依存するH7は192あり、sourceの実在と強いGIS根拠を混同しない。

**決定的な反証：形状修復が全件正しいと最大限楽観的に仮定してもSTOP。** [別の上限監査成功run #44451436297](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44451436297)、[artifact #14495333532](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44451436297/artifacts/14495333532)：単一sourceポリゴン条件を満たす最大**204 H7**は、独立した土壌側JRC native basinでは**35単位**、真正H6は75、元source国ラベル14、国内勾配支持5国、連結地理成分34にとどまる。**元の独立source100単位下限に達せず、ジオメトリを全修復しても源の独立比較を許可できない。**

**今回の発見は空間支持の識別上の限界：** 元グリッドが10km・1kmでも、JRCが集約した流域モデル値を元H7へ割り当てると、H7の多数が同じモデル負荷源単位を共有する。H7レコード数を独立曝露数とみなせば擬似反復になる。点源と陸投入の地理的情報は別だが、**水は点源・陸は面源で生物が動くという機構は未検定**。2018水×2017–19植物の元NUTS2 2×2 SOURCE-STOPは継続。新規のEIV・蝶HNS・EQR数値回帰は実行せず、元の閾値も変更していない。

詳細実装：[元226 H7・単一native sourceと和集合を分ける凍結仕様](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-2015-griddedN-basin-source-audit-20261119/docs/JRC_226H7_NATIVE_POINT_SOILN_SOURCE_ONLY_IMPLEMENTATION_LOCK_20261119.md)。モデル源は元格子のH7直接ピクセル集計ではなく、JRC集計済み元river basinモデル平均の面積重み付けであり、下水由来の実到達Nではない。

**本PRはDraft、main・草稿PR124・前段PR125/126は未変更。**

---

## 2026-11-19｜元226 H7・12分割SOURCE-only全数監査

[全数GIS照合のActions #44449479977](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44449479977)。元の植物EIV品質適格226 H7を固定し、公式JRC native EsriJSONの5源（大気N、鉱質/有機肥料N、N固定、水点源N）を元source H7 WKTと照合する。**unionで90%以上のカバー**と**単一native source polygonが90%以上**を厳格に区別、元JRC ring修復依存・真H6・元source国・独立JRC source basin・geo foldを完全保存する。

[実装とゲート仕様](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-2015-griddedN-basin-source-audit-20261119/docs/JRC_226H7_NATIVE_POINT_SOILN_SOURCE_ONLY_IMPLEMENTATION_LOCK_20261119.md)。元H7×5source全件収録・100独立soil native source・100適格H7・40H6・8国・国内変動5国・地理5分割各4独立成分を、**生物応答の値を開かず**一度のsource-only GO/STOPとして判定する。各source basinとH7の面積構成・モデル年・単位・ID名前空間が異なることを保持。

元NUTS2の2×2停止を解除せず、結果が肯定でも陰性でも本PRのみ記録。追加の生物モデルを自動実行しない。main・草稿PR124・点面PR125/126に変更なし。

---

## 2026-11-19 SOURCE-only成果・地理品質チェック

**[元12 H7 × JRC native point/soil 5レイヤーの空間検索・属性・SHA検証 #44445917915 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44445917915)**：60/60 source queryを完走。元227 H7のうち2017–19のEIV品質合格226 H7からsource-onlyで12選択（FR8/HR1/NO1/NL1/HU1）。修復後は大気沈着＋鉱質/有機施肥の元モデル値が12/12でH7面積90%以上をカバー。ただし**10/12で元JRC GeoJSONポリゴンの無効形状がH7面積5%以上に影響する**ため、これを直ちに生物曝露の強いGOとしない。[全元pilot/品質フラグ](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-2015-griddedN-basin-source-audit-20261119/docs/JRC_NATIVE_BASIN_H7_PILOT_GEOMETRY_SOURCE_QA_20261119.md)

**[3 H7 × 3 sourceの独立なネイティブEsriJSON・GeoJSON検証 #44446973908 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44446973908)**：形状修復不要1H7・修復依存2H7についてEsriJSON rings, make_valid, buffer(0)の3方法が**9/9で1ポイント以内のH7面積一致**、元JRC公表native areaとの差最大0.004%。ただし**3流域は事後選択の技術診断で、他9H7の独立GIS QAは未実施**。[詳細と元のSRC署名](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-2015-griddedN-basin-source-audit-20261119/docs/JRC_ESRIJSON_GEOJSON_3H7_GEOMETRY_ADVERSARIAL_QA_20261119.md)。

結果の意味：行政区に集計せずに元のH7にモデル曝露を割り当てる**実装は一部実証済み**。source-only全226H7/真正H6/国/地理foldの条件は未評価で、**生物EQR・植物NUTRI・蝶HNSの新しい点面効果は未推定**。従来のNUTS2 2×2 SOURCE-STOPも継続。原稿やmainに肯定結果として一括導入しない。

---

## 2026-11-19｜公式API元件数を取得済み（生物アウトカム未使用）

[GitHub Actions #44445257924・全5レイヤーの元スキーマ/件数と数値サンプル検証 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44445257924)

- 大気N沈着2015・JRC川流域 **74,016**（native Basin_3035_HydroID）
- 鉱質施肥2010–19・JRC川流域 **12,338**（同名native ID）
- 有機施肥 **12,338**、N固定 **12,338**
- 水へのGREENモデル点源N **71,779**（別のnative BasinID）
- 元ラスターlayer21–24はRaster Layer。公式ArcGISの表示だけでは元ピクセルの数値ダウンロードを保証しない。

元の全件属性取り込みは74,016>技術的安全上限50,000件で**一度STOP**し、その記録も残した。以後は元SOURCE-only H7ポリゴンへのGIS空間クエリを利用。元の11〜12 H7等の小標本は生物の検定に使わず、面積カバー率・モデル欠測・幾何形状修復の技術監査のみ。JRC soil HydroIDとGREEN point BasinIDは文字列一致で結合しない。

追加の[H7×JRC元native basinの元WKTポリゴン検証コード](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-2015-griddedN-basin-source-audit-20261119/analysis/20261119_JRC_native_basin_N_source/jrc_12h7_native_basin_geometry_pilot.py)は最初のH7で5源ともほぼ全域が元モデル地理と重なることを確認。JRCの無効ポリゴンを検出して中断した初回試行も残し、修復が面積の5%超を占める場合の感度フラグを加えて再実行中。

**2018水×2017–19植物の共通NUTS2 2×2 SOURCE-STOPは解除していない。** 生物形質・下水の因果効果は未推定。

---

## 狙い
行政区NUTS2の点面2×2は共通25地域・6か国で事前SOURCE STOPになった。基準は緩めず、**別の地理単位の新しい探索的資料**が利用できるかを生物結果を開く前に監査。

[JRC公式Inputs to soil](https://water.jrc.ec.europa.eu/arcgis/rest/services/inmap/MIS_Inputs_to_soil/MapServer) はEMEP2015大気N沈着0.1°元Raster（layer21）とDAYCENT2010–19施肥/固定N1km元Raster（layer22–24）を公表し、river basin levelの公開feature layerは沈着5・鉱質施肥10・有機施肥15・N固定20。水へのモデル点源Nは別JRC GREEN Losses to Water layer5。

### 新規コミット
- [追加SOURCE-only原地理・出所の凍結仕様](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-2015-griddedN-basin-source-audit-20261119/docs/JRC_GRID2015_AND_NATIVE_BASIN_SOURCE_GATE_FROZEN_20261119.md)
- [公式Feature Layer元スキーマ・OBJECTID全件・数値属性監査コード](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-2015-griddedN-basin-source-audit-20261119/analysis/20261119_JRC_native_basin_N_source/jrc_native_soilN_layers_source_gate.py)
- 単体テスト4件・GitHub Actions artifactによるSHA保存。**水点源のBasinIDと土壌側HydroIDは未クロスウォーク。**同じ番号でも一致として結合せず、ロング形式で別ネームスペース保存。

### STOP条件
大気/鉱質/有機N源が一意な同じJRC native soil basinで100以上揃うか、元数値正値に十分な変動があるかをsource-onlyで確認。通ってもJRC basinと植物H7のポリゴン面積90%重複を示せなければ生態モデルGOにしない。レンダリングRasterの表示だけで元数値グリッドがダウンロード可能とは断定しない。

**元の2018水×2017–19植物2×2 SOURCE STOP、PR #124原稿、PR #125/126とmainは変更しない。Draftでレビュー。**
prs.title: SOURCE-STOP: all 226 H7 crossed, but only 35 independent native JRC N-source basins even optimistically

prs.body:
## 2026-11-19 Further update: 43 realized sludge application rows independently reconciled

- Official Feurs 2018 [agronomic application register](https://www.auvergne-rhone-alpes.developpement-durable.gouv.fr/IMG/pdf/10_step_feurs_cas_par-cas_annexe9_epandage_2018bilan.pdf) **Table 7** has **43 actual field-application log rows** across **8 communes**. Anonymized source audit reproduces annual **161.53 ha / 1,918 wet tonnes** exactly. The **monthly 761/50/613/214/208/72 wet tonnes (March/April/July/September/October/November)** independently reproduces official **Table 6** in all six months.
- There are **20 commune×month** source-opportunity cells; March+July **1,374 t (71.64%)**. These are **real applications**, not a planned spreading perimeter, but **not 43 independent fields or 20 independent H6s**: all come from **one STEU `0442094S0002`×2018 source cluster**. The anonymous CSV excludes farmer names, parcel identifiers and exact dates.
- [Full source methods and municipality/month results](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-sludge-fr-spreading-source-gate-20261119/docs/FR_FEURS_2018_43_REAL_SPREADING_EVENTS_MONTH_COMMUNE_RESULTS_20261119.md); [CI independently reconciled all 43 rows](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44518305078) **SUCCESS** with offline tests. Source PDF binary hash/pixel render unavailable because original host returned 403 on screenshot; source text index and independent Table 6/7 numeric agreement are recorded.
- No true **field point coordinates**, no month-specific field N/P assays, no **Feurs 2018 measured river TN/TP mass** yet. No new NUTRI, HNS or EQR fits. **Source-only event timing = confirmed; coupled water-land nutrient mass and biological pathway = STOP.** Older NUTS2/JRC SOURCE gates unchanged.
- A **separate** [Draft PR #130](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/130) explores German Saarland official sludge-spreading GIS metadata for independent geographic replication; it must pass real-year/field-use/STEU identification before treating it as exposure.

---

## 2026-11-19 Update: independently confirmed Feurs actual spreading; two-outlet SOURCE audit

- **Independent field-spreading source:** Feurs STEU SANDRE `0442094S0002`, 2018: 8 real application communes, 161.53 ha, 481.31 t dry sludge incl. lime; all 8 communes absent from ROSEAU 2017–22 candidate union. **Eight communes are one STEU×2018 SOURCE cluster, not eight independent replicates.** [Independent SOURCE receipt and detailed audit](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-sludge-fr-spreading-source-gate-20261119/docs/FR_FEURS_2018_PERFORMED_SPREADING_HELDOUT_SOURCE_20261119.md). [Original ROSEAU held-out verification CI SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44510603860).
- **N/P land-side screening:** 2018 actual spreading × mean dry composition gives **22.910356 t total N, 14.246776 t P₂O₅ = 6.217675 t elemental-P equivalent**, screening estimates only, not directly assayed annual total nor plant uptake. Independent agronomic mean N/ha gives 23.58338 t N (+2.94%). Important **P₂O₅≠elemental P** and leachate N/P unresolved.
- **Water-side independent source:** 2018 Loire prefectural authorization identifies exact **Lambert93 effluent outfall (794216, 6516746)**, distinct from plant (794449, 6516744). This is permit location/design, **not measured N/P discharge**. SISPEA 2019 and 2021 give treated annual water volume and outlet NTK/PT means; inferred NTK/PT×volume are **screening indices, not flow-weighted annual loads; NTK≠TN**, and cannot be paired with 2018 land application. [SOURCE year-locked mass-screen report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-sludge-fr-spreading-source-gate-20261119/docs/FR_FEURS_2018TO21_DUAL_OUTLET_NP_SOURCE_SCREEN_RESULTS_20261119.md).
- **Independent audits:** [8-commune source coverage pass](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44510603860); [Feurs dual-outlet SOURCE gate with outfall-test pass](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44512529122). **Source-year pairs with both actual water N/P mass and actually applied sludge nutrient mass: ZERO. Strict biotic response and causal mediation: STOP**.
- This is SOURCE discovery only; the prior **14 H7 / 6 H6** opportunity areas are **not proven field applications**. NUTRI/HNS/EQR outcomes were not read for this new branch. Do not use absence in ROSEAU as a verified unspread negative control. main and manuscript PR #124 unchanged; retain Draft status until source gates and primary PDF checks are completed.

---

## 2026-11-19 最新のSOURCE-only進展：6年間130自治体候補→2018年H7候補14流域・6 H6

- **[2017–2022元政府CSV＋各年の歴史INSEE COG照合 #44465289468](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44465289468)**：6年計8,405の分析行（非独立）から、**130の異なる歴史COGコード・地名が一致する施用先候補自治体**。2017–19は109コード、2020–22は107、両期間86。処理場の「農業施用総量が正」＋その処理場の元候補リストであり、実施用の畑130件の証明ではない。[元source報告](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-sludge-fr-spreading-source-gate-20261119/docs/FR_ROSEAU_2017TO22_HISTORIC_COG_CANDIDATES_RESULTS_20261119.md)。
- **[2018年の72候補自治体と元H7 WKTを2018年の歴史Etalab境界で照合 #44473793536](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44473793536)**：72/72の歴史的自治体ポリゴンを確認。植物EIV品質適格のフランス151 H7（2017–19年、**河川と共通の139行・72 H7とは別標本**）に対し、面積10 ha以上の交差は**71自治体候補、14 H7、6真正H6**。98の正面積交差（10ha以上は94ペア）を確認したが、これらは汚泥施用面積ではない。2つの候補H7に各24自治体の地理的重なりがあり、両者は**同じH6親流域**なので独立曝露反復に数えない。[GIS SOURCE-only結果と14 H7候補表](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-sludge-fr-spreading-source-gate-20261119/docs/FR_ROSEAU_2018_CANDIDATE_COMMUNES_X_H7_OPPORTUNITY_RESULTS_20261119.md)。
- **[実施用圃場の台帳データへのフランス語照会案](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-sludge-fr-spreading-source-gate-20261119/docs/FR_SILLAGE_REQUEST_REAL_SPREADING_FIELD_DATA_2017TO22_FR.md)**：DDT(M) / police de l'eau / SILLAGEの「bilan d'épandage」（**実施済み**、圃場位置・日付・量・元STEU）を求める。**未送信**、連絡先は未指定。処理場・農家の個人情報は不要、匿名化提案。
- **研究の現在の判定：FIELD EXPOSURE NOT IDENTIFIED / BIOLOGICAL MODEL STOP**。自治体レベルの記録は野外調査候補地の絞込みに利用できるが、GBIF寄主の汚泥N曝露、幼虫摂食、A/Cの同位体源分離や独立した汚泥施用の効果を示さない。旧NUTS2水陸2×2とJRC native H7のSOURCE-STOPは継続。植物NUTRI・蝶HNS・EQRの新規数値モデルは未実行。main/原稿PR124/旧PR125,126,128は未変更。

---

## SOURCE結果（2026-11-19）

- **[政府公開フォームに2017–22年すべての選択肢と、CSV/GeoJSON等の公式入力があることをGETで実証 #44455724925](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44455724925)**。元公表JSのSHAを固定し、真正な public handler /controllers/GetDataExportBoueHandler.php の入力6項目を確認。
- **[初回2018年CSV取得 #44456283313](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44456283313) は公式wwwへのHTTPS接続タイムアウトでACCESS-STOP**。実施用記録がゼロとは解釈しない。元2018年CSVの行数・年次・施用先自治体コード/圃場位置・N投入量は**未確認**。
- 以前の元GET監査でHTTP200を確認した www / 無印 / www2 の政府3公式ホストのみで、**同じ2018年・同じform fields・同じ政府JS SHA**の再試行をコードに追加。[再試行Action #44456996236](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44456996236) は確認時点ではキュー中。完了前に元CSV取得・生物H7照合の成功を主張しない。
- [政府フォーム・SOURCEアクセスの正式な監査記録](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-sludge-fr-spreading-source-gate-20261119/docs/FR_ROSEAU_SILLAGE_FORM_2017TO22_SOURCE_ACCESS_20261119.md)。

**重要：生物EQR/NUTRI/HNSの値は一切使っていない。原水域×陸域SOURCE-STOPとJRC 226 H7の独立源不足は維持。main・原稿PR124・SOURCE PR125/126/128は変更なし。**

---

## 2026-11-19 公開元フォーム取得・公式Controllerの固定

[GET-only公式フォームSOURCE監査 #44455724925](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44455724925) SUCCESS。公式ドメイン3系統ともHTTP200、元HTMLで**2017–2022年の6年すべてが選択可能**と確認。元ページで処理場規模・河川流域・出力形式CSV/GeoJSONの選択肢を確認した。**公開年の選択肢は、その年の実施用レコードの存在を意味しない。**

公開されている政府自身のJavaScript exportbasededonneeBoue_min.js（原SHA256 f4cf1e2fe84e0ccf608ece6c5d363426960e2b730e21900d48265eba4a78f0e5）から**正式な処理先 /controllers/GetDataExportBoueHandler.php**と6つのフォーム名（bassin,region,annee,format,tranche,departement）を検証済み。URL/パラメータを推測・総当たりせず、公開フォームの正式な操作に限定する。

2018年の全国CSVを1年だけ取得し、元列・行数・年次・施用先コードの収録を確認するSOURCE-only workflow [#44456283313](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44456283313) を追加・起動。原CSVはGitHubに再配布せず、元ファイルSHA/列名/行数/原施用関連フィールドの非空割合だけを監査する。**結果がまだない段階で汚泥施用自治体数やH7の有効標本数は報告しない。**

**元NUTS2およびJRC native H7のSTOPは変えていない。植物NUTRI/蝶HNS/EQR数値は使っていない。**

---

## 目的
論文1では未検証の経路C「下水汚泥→実際の施用農地→寄主植物→幼虫」の広域SOURCE可否を確認する。フランス政府ROSEAU/SILLAGEの公開汚泥施用自治体CSV/GeoJSONについて、**本当の年次と施用先地理の有無を取得・監査**する。

### SOURCE先行のゲート
[出現結果を読む前に固定したSOURCE仕様](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-sludge-fr-spreading-source-gate-20261119/docs/FR_SILLAGE_BIOSOLIDS_COMMUNE_SOURCE_FIRST_20261119.md)。
STEP0は政府公表の汚泥輸出ページの元HTML/年選択/必須選択/公開JS/GET only metadata取得。正式なPOST/CSVダウンロード先は実際のフォームを特定した後に限る。ログイン/認証回避、推測API連続アクセスなし。
STEP1元CSVが取得できる場合は、2017–22双方の期間、施用実績と単なる計画、INSEE施用先コードの品質、独立自治体数と県数を生物を見る前に判定。**処理場住所は施用圃場ではない。** 元自治体に汚泥使用の記載がない場合を「未施用」と同義にしない。

### 非変更
既存の行政区2×2 SOURCE-STOP（25 NUTS2/6国）、JRC native 226H7 SOURCE-STOP（元曝露35単位）を解除しない。EQR、NUTRI、蝶HNSの値を本PRで一切開かない。mainと論文草稿PR #124は未変更。Draftとして監査結果を検討。

## Final actual WFS schema verdict: nine fields, no year/STEU/application mass

[Official source WFS DescribeFeatureType CI #44523503343: SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44523503343). The **complete 9 fields** of the official `Abfallbeseitigung:Klaerschlamm_Verfahren` layer are `Klaerschlamm_Verfahren`, `SCHLAGNR`, `SCHLAGNAM`, `FLAECHE_HA`, `OIDEXT`, `OBJECTID`, `Shape`, `Shape_Length`, `Shape_Area`. **No actual application year/date, realized-vs-planned status, originating STEU ID, dry mass or N/P quantity field.** This is a **structural SOURCE STOP for reconstructing 2017–2022 realized field exposure from this GIS alone**, not a negative claim that no sludge was spread.

[Full schema and original XML SHA receipt](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-de-saarland-spreading-ogc-source-20261119/docs/DE_SAARLAND_WFS_DESCRIBE_VERDICT_20261119.md). Neither GetFeature nor biotic outcomes used. Existing Germany 2016–22 annual sludge routing remains a **WWTP-origin disposal trend**, not receiving-field exposure. Keep this as Draft; no new spatial biotic fit is authorized.

---

## 2026-11-19 original source result: 7-year Germany vs Saarland WWTP-origin disposal allocation

- Official DESTatis [GENESIS 32214-0001](https://genesis.destatis.de/datenbank/online/statistic/32214/table/32214-0001) and [Saarland Statistical Yearbook 2023, p.143](https://www.statistischebibliothek.de/mir/servlets/MCRFileNodeServlet/SLHeft_derivate_00012170/SL%20Jahrbuch%202023.pdf) were transcribed by year 2016–2022 and **all annual dry-matter disposal categories close exactly to official totals**.
- From 2017 to 2022, **Germany agricultural sludge 306,230→233,065 t dry (−23.892%)**, Saarland **2,140→3,502 t (+63.645%)**. The national sum INCLUDES Saarland; descriptive comparison uses **Saarland vs Rest Germany**: 2017→22 change in agriculture disposal share differs by **+12.374 percentage points**. This is a **WWTP-origin routing trend**, NOT located actual exposed farmland, independent state experiments, or an aquatic N/P discharge mass effect. [Full annual-source report](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-de-saarland-spreading-ogc-source-20261119/docs/DE_SLUDGE_SOURCE_ROUTING_2016TO22_NATIONAL_SAARLAND_RESULTS_20261119.md).
- [Independent 8-test mass-closure reproducibility PASS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44523101243). Source data, standard-library analysis code and CI are committed to this Draft branch. No EQR/NUTRI/HNS outcomes accessed.
- [Saarland official sludge WFS layer metadata independently verified](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44522249816): HTTP200 XML, exact published `Abfallbeseitigung:Klaerschlamm_Verfahren` FeatureType. **Actual field-year, realized-vs-planned, STEU ID and nutrient mass NOT YET VERIFIED**. [WFS source receipt and limitations](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-de-saarland-spreading-ogc-source-20261119/docs/DE_SAARLAND_SLUDGE_WFS_METADATA_VERIFIED_20261119.md). Follow-up DescribeFeatureType job is schema-only, no GetFeature.
- **Strict biological/water-to-land nitrogen balance SOURCE gate remains STOP**: Germany annual source origin totals must not be mapped as receiving-field exposure; French Feurs PR #129 and existing manuscript PR #124 remain separate, main unchanged.

---

## Source-only pilot for expanding beyond France's single Feurs WWTP

An official [German GovData sewage-sludge spreading GIS entry](https://data.gov.de/suche/daten/klarschlammverfahren-sl-klarschlammrichtlinie-86-278-eg) and its [MetaVer Saarland OGC API Features record](https://md.umwelt.info/dataset/metaver-sl/222f0723-3436-aaca-5f7d-778779f1d407) describe mapped agricultural areas associated with sewage sludge (CC BY 4.0).

**Do not call these 2017–2022 actual exposed fields or a matched WWTP×water source yet.** The source's observation year, whether geometry is *actually used* versus *approved/permitted*, plant IDs, application date and N/P quantities must first be confirmed in source data.

This Draft PR contains:
- A strictly bounded GET-only probe of **two official geoportal metadata endpoints** (WFS GetCapabilities and OGC Features collection) with status, SHA-256 and feature-type names;
- Offline tests that reject unexpected origins and do not infer field applications or biological results from a layer title;
- An Actions job saving only metadata/QA receipts, never downloading field polygons or opening EQR/NUTRI/HNS.

[Detailed SOURCE protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-de-saarland-spreading-ogc-source-20261119/docs/DE_SAARLAND_SLUDGE_SPREADING_GIS_SOURCE_FIRST_20261119.md)

**Decision**: Source discovery only. Spatial year, realized application, and facility attribution **NOT VERIFIED**. Independent H6 count for cross-compartment inference **0**. Biological model **STOP**. France PR #129, manuscript PR #124, main unchanged.

## 2026-11-19 key new result: 2022 same-WWTP dual aquatic–land nutrient-source magnitude quantified

**For the first time, a SAME 2022 CALENDAR YEAR and SAME Seine Aval WWTP (SANDRE 037800501000) now has BOTH source-backed nutrient magnitudes:**

- **Water A4 (treated effluent)**: official AESN validated monthly 2022 flux indicators (12 × kg with `Etat_calcul=VALIDE` for each SANDRE 1551 NGL and 1350 PT) summed to **10,553.52352 t NGL; 562.48824 t elemental PT**; treated-water volume **460,734,000 m³**. Separate **A5 bypass**: 1,078.71622 t NGL and 100.04508 t PT, never silently merged into A4. - **Actual farmland sludge**: official 2022 realization of 81,195.15 t wet spreading. **Applied**, not produced, sludge BTF/BTC lot-tonnage-weighted agronomic composition gives estimated **704.35879 t Kjeldahl N/NTK**, **3,402.411135 t P2O5**, or **1,484.903463 t elemental P equivalent**. These are compositional source estimates, not parcel-specific measures/plant uptake. [Independent land 9 tests SUCCESS #44538061031](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44538061031).
- **Independent exact-source integration PASS**: separate CI artifacts from the two runs were fetched by [integrated verification #44539547750](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44539547750), 9 further tests, exact 12-month reconstruction, same origin/year, P2O5 conversion, A3/A4/A5 separation and FAIL-CLOSED biology/causality gates. **Applied elemental P mass ~2.64× A4 treated-water PT mass is only a SOURCE magnitude ratio, not a same-2022 production partition nor biologically absorbed ratio.** Some sludge applied in 2022 came from 2021; NTK ≠ NGL; A4 ≠ all aqueous discharges.
- The 2022 NGL A3-to-A4 load difference is **60.7705%** and PT **80.3490%**, close to the independently published SIAAP 2022 compliance self-evaluation **NGL 61.6% / PT 80.0%**; definitions and atypical-operation exclusions differ. This is a posthoc source QA check, not a statistical validation of ecology.
- **[Complete 2022 matched water–land source results, methods, data and biological non-inference](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-fr-siaap-2022-real-spreading-source-20261119/docs/FR_SEINEAVAL_2022_WATER_A4_VS_ACTUAL_SLUDGE_NP_MATCHED_SOURCE_RESULTS_20261119.md)**.

**GO:** same source and application-year aquatic A4 flux vs land-applied sludge constituent magnitude. **STOP:** closed mass balance, actual receiving field positions, plant/butterfly uptake or cross-biotic causal mediation. No EQR/NUTRI/HNS opened in this branch; keep **Draft**. main/Manuscript PR #124 and existing France PR #129, Germany PR #130, France 2018 PR #131 remain unchanged.

---

## 2022 actual spreading: independent third French wastewater origin SOURCE (not biological exposure)

Official SIAAP [Seine Aval 2022 agricultural biosolids campaign bilan](https://www.siaap.fr/fileadmin/user_upload/Siaap/3_Equipements/Les_usines/Seine_aval/Bilan_boues_Seine_Aval/Bilan_de_campagne_2022.pdf) shows **actually realized application** to **1,092 parcels over 13 departments**, total **81,195.15 t wet / 35,102.66 t dry** across **10,860.49 ha**. Parcel counts and departments are **NOT 1,092/13 independent WWTPs**; they originate from one Seine Aval WWTP. The [current Ministry station listing](https://assainissement.developpement-durable.gouv.fr/pages/data/fiche-037800501000) uses SANDRE `037800501000`, but the 2022 report's own historical ID remains unverified.

**Independent numerical audit:** original 2022 **Table 2 BTF/BTC product subtotals** and original **Table 3 13-department subtotals** each independently reconstruct all 3 printed totals exactly; 13 departmental parcel counts sum **1,092**. [10 anti-contamination tests / source audit success](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44528409515). **Timing caution:** the realized 2022 spring and summer/autumn application windows are March 23–May 10 and July 11–Nov 14, while delivery began November **2021**: delivery/production year is not application year.

**Not identified:** individual actual field coordinates, field-specific product N/P, validated 2022 same-site effluent annual TN/PT discharged mass, independently matched H6/H7, negative controls. No EQR/NUTRI/HNS read; biological or cross-outlet causal mass balance **SOURCE STOP**. Two other independent WWTPs in **2018** were audited separately [Draft PR #131](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/pull/131), but this does not license combining 2018/2022 biotic outcomes without same-year source exposure. Keep Draft; main and manuscript PR #124 unchanged.

## Verified result (2026-11-19) — original data and new tests succeeded

**[Genuine source reconstruction + new analysis Actions #44536643949: SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44536643949)**. Result artifact **14535503984** (`AMBIENT_TP_TRAIT_FALSIFIER.json`). Original 2,648 NRSA survey UIDs and fixed 2,209 rare200 site cohort validated, along with prior original four-corner trait count & taxon-identity source QA. No new wild-data cohort or confirmatory pre-registration.

### Measured in-stream TP vs PTV, strict site trait-coverage cohort
| heldout era | strict n/HUC8 | TP beta incidence-CWM [descriptive95] | within-EPT-order 999-label-shuffle p | TP after PHab+TN improves incidence-CWM MSE in fully unseen era + HUC8 [fixed-OOF descriptive95] |
|---|---:|---|---:|---|
| 2008–09 | 352/296 | +0.0893 [+0.0065,+0.1721] | **0.178 (not passed)** | +0.032% [−2.858,+2.813] |
| 2013–14 | 679/483 | +0.1057 [+0.0424,+0.1689] | **0.013 (passed)** | +0.745% [−0.802,+2.313] |
| 2018–19 | 567/397 | +0.0901 [+0.0107,+0.1695] | **0.079 (not passed)** | +0.696% [−2.025,+3.402] |

The THREE positive spatial slopes were already present in prior original-source Action #43711833767 (not presented as new discoveries). Novel TP label-null and fully disjoint-era/HUC8 prediction extensions were successful computationally but **do not support universal transferable nutrient-driven taxon filtering**. Strict PTV incidence nominal BH12 q (across PTV & clinger, count/incidence, 3 cycles): **.0830 / .00695 / .0786**. All clinger-incidence TP slopes cross zero and TP-label nulls p=.600/.995/.512.

The only positive fixed-error interval for TP *predictive* addition was 2013 **PTV count-CWM** +1.183% [+0.404,+2.023]; count-CWM elsewhere uncertain or negative. Therefore, observed-count dominance may contribute in one survey cycle without establishing population changes. As before, PHab-added clinger-incidence out-of-era predictive gains were positive 3/3, but this is a different (physical-habitat) predictor and trait response.

### Scientific consequence
- Retain **conditional cross-sectional habitat-nutrient affinity of the recorded EPT community**.
- Downgrade the proposed **universal ambient TP trait-sorting rule**: TP label alignment only 1/3 eras and incidence TP additional external prediction 0/3.
- Do not rebrand this as a WWTP-specific phosphorus response, local extinction/colonization, true demographic replacement, experimental resource loading, or independent meta-analysis.

## Scientific aim
Close the missing **W→plant NUTRI** genus-level null in the cross-compartment trait-filtering evidence table. Do NOT substitute the earlier plant-NUTRI→butterfly-HNS within-genus null for this distinct exposure/response.

## Authentic source and verified execution
[Actions #44540055631 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44540055631); [country+H6 stress #44540900730 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44540900730). Derived complete JSON artifact **14539375104**. Genuine 451 H7×period, 232 H7, 90 H6, original 2,808 GBIF species facets, 4,011 strict EIV species, 981 accepted genera, all source-v2 175 hybrids unscored. Both original species-equal / GBIF-record-weighted CWM NUTRI values independently reconstructed with max error 2.2e−14; published W effect and H6-out prediction reproduce exactly.

### Result 1: W→plant genus-between and genus-within are BOTH positive
Original W (+1 SD) vs species-equal plant NUTRI CWM, same full P_GEOG/geography/effort/country×method controls, H6-weighted WLS:
- **Total** +0.21524 [0.11712,0.31336].
- **Between-genus** +0.16055 [0.09282,0.22827].
- **Within-genus species deviation** **+0.05470 [0.02168,0.08772]**.
- Original genus decomposition identity and WLS Frisch–Waugh label coefficients exact to 1e−9. Genus means from original scored species.
- Novel 4,999 label permutations: global score shuffle for total p=.0002; **within-accepted-genus score shuffle for the within component p=.0002** (null95 [−.01222,.01189]). GBIF-record-weighted sensitivity within +.06012 [.01808,.10216], within-genus shuffle p=.0002.

True H6-out predictive W-added MSE improvements (species-equal):
total +18.51% [7.28,28.17], between +20.76% [8.88,30.64], within **+11.23% [2.06,19.17]**. These response-specific percentages cannot be summed into causal weights.

### Result 2: strict external-country generality of equal-species components is NOT confirmed
With heldout country **and every matching true H6 removed from training**, source-only thresholds passed for six countries (FR/HR/IT/LT/NL/NO). Country-equal W-added MSE improvement:
- species-equal total +18.66% [−11.74,+26.98], 3/6 countries improved;
- between +20.90% [−6.40,+28.92], 3/6;
- **within +8.14% [−15.95,+18.80], 4/6**.
All primary equal-species country intervals cross 0. Record-weighted secondary total and between are positive but do NOT override the primary. Only **33 genuine H6 parents** have ≥2 distinct H7 in original 451 set, below legacy 40-H6 inside-parent gate: SOURCE STOP; no invalid repeated-period pseudo-replication.

### Strict limitations and manuscript verdict
This supports **cross-sectional nonrandom plant nutrient-habitat-affinity species composition within genera**, not confirmed universal cross-country selection. W is **static modelled wastewater-associated geography**, not measured delivered sewage N/plant N uptake; plant EIV is a published habitat-affinity score, not actual leaf N or biomass. Taxon-score shuffles are genus-constrained, not a phylogenetic causal null. Existing 183H7/40H6 plant-N→butterfly-HNS within-genus permutation p=.6864 pertains to a DIFFERENT arrow; the results are compatible. All tests are posthoc observational.

### Source files and logs

## 2026-11-20 completed source-authentic ecology, source and adversarial results

**Primary novel comparative result (not causal): in the same English ChemPop benthic assemblages, observed water-quality nutrient-associated chemistry predicts BMWP family-composition in unseen regions better than static modelled sewage-effluent share EDF.**

### Same-original-biological-date nutrient vs EDF, strictly matched and source-gated
- Genuine EIDC ChemPop v2 2010–18: 7,836 original source-eligible benthic analyses/707 sites; **three simultaneously available original water-chemistry window means** — orthophosphate (NOT TP), nitrate (NOT TN), ammoniacal N — on **5,000 original analyses, 591 sites, 2,624 site×year, all 7 English regions**. Entire exact original site/date join source gate passed. **Source #44670909657** and [primary model #44671514429 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44671514429), artifact 14599583276.
- On identical paired cohort, site-cluster adjusted EDF coefficient **before chemistry −0.08842 [−0.13747,−0.03938]**, **after chemistry +0.00709 [−0.04545,+0.05963]**. Source-fixed EDF VIF2.27, nitrate4.18, orthophosphate1.85, ammoniacalN1.53 (no major collinearity).
- Seven **entire-region + site-disjoint** holdouts with fixed loss bootstrap: adding EDF after geography +3.55% [−1.16,+7.83], adding 3 chemistry after geography **+14.18% [4.83,20.32] (6/7 regions)**, adding chemistry *after EDF* **+10.56% [5.06,14.29] (6/7)**. Adding **EDF after 3 chemistry** **−0.519% [−0.761,−0.253] (0/7 regions)**. No result-selected source or fit threshold relaxations.
- **Robustness [#44672086690 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44672086690)**, artifact 14599769060: all 5,000 original samples support 3 LOQ variants. EDF-after-chemistry coefficient in LOQ1 +0.00168 (95 crosses0), LOQ2 +0.00709 (95 crosses0), LOQ3 +0.00478 (95 crosses0). EDF additional out-region MSE −0.461/−0.519/−0.499%, no clear positive benefit. **One row per original site** (n591) β+0.0234 [−0.0351,+0.0819]; EDF-after-chemistry region gain −0.873% [−1.183,−0.601], 0/7 regions improved; chemistry-after-EDF +14.25% [6.27,19.68].
  
### Family/order trait and real-count-only source stress
- **[Original BMWP-EDF #44548177752 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44548177752)**: 3,884 site-years/707 sites, equal-family BMWP β−0.09111 [−0.13360,−0.04861], EDF-added regional MSE +4.52% [0.59,8.35]. The original within-order taxon label shuffle **p=0.206** (no specific family-score null support).
- **[Source-verified order + actual-count-only #44669989917 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44669989917)**: original EDF slope decomposes **−0.06857 between-order (75.27% of slope)** + **−0.02253 within-order family deviation (24.73%)**, point-only coefficient partition, NOT causal variance or evolutionary selection. Leave any 1/7 English regions out → slopes all negative. 707-site one-record beta−0.09467 [−0.13968,−0.04966].
- Of 7,836 source-eligible biological samples, **6,166 are estimated log-abundance**, not actual count; only 1,641 explicitly `Actual abundance of taxa in the sample`. Real-count-only supported 314 distinct sites/948 site-years: equal-family BMWP β−0.09864; recorded-count-weighted β−0.26717; difference β−0.16854 [−0.30420,−0.03287], but independent region transfer is uncertain for both. NEVER describe all log-code-weighted results as observed individual abundance.

### Scientific claim ceiling
**Supported:** an observational EDF/BMWP geographic association, largely higher-taxon compositional; in precisely matched river sample-date windows, orthophosphate+nitrate+ammoniacal N provide robust extra regional predictive information and EDF does **not** after these chemistry summaries. The contrast is stable under LOQ and site aggregation sensitivity. **Not supported:** demonstrated sewage-origin measured N/P, the WWTP→river chemical→organism causal mediation, independent same-day P/N field measurements, actual colonization/extinction/demographic change, butterfly resource transfer or ecosystem-service flux. The English observation network is **one country**, not seven independent studies.

### Reports in this Draft

## Earlier source-only audits (retained for full provenance)

## Purpose: source-backed European benthic **taxon-level** analysis, not EEA EQR re-interpretation

The previously reproduced EEA Waterbase Biology 2018/2022 *reported upstream WWTP N/P→benthic EQR* predictive gain (~1%) is **not** a species composition or pollution-tolerance trait result. EEA numeric EQR alone cannot reconstruct taxon×sample records. This Draft verifies genuine independent UK/European survey sources to enable source-defined taxon-incidence vs abundance-weighted trait analyses.

### Completed genuine original sources (no new biological slope)
- **[Official EA Biosys full ZIP and schema #44543020599 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44543020599):** authentic 62,373,479-byte `INV_OPEN_DATA.zip` includes SITE, METRICS, TAXA tables and official 825,708-byte Taxon Info. Keys SITE_ID, SAMPLE_ID, ANALYSIS_ID, TAXON_LIST_ITEM_KEY; sample-index BMWP_ASPT is NOT a taxon score.
- **[Full original EA site×analysis×taxon join #44544801464 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44544801464):** 30,752 site keys, 281,255 unique ANALYSIS_ID, **7,590,163** taxon rows (3,069 taxon keys, 614 catchments), 100% native analysis/site/sample joins; 6,786,884 recorded positive numeric TOTAL_ABUNDANCE rows; surveys 1965–2026. This is source QA, not an independent treatment study.
- **[Authentic ChemPop v2 original 326-file ZIP and published BMWP family-score dictionary #44544328596 SUCCESS](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/actions/runs/44544328596):** 7 region-specific **source taxon abundance CSVs** with BIO_SITE_ID/BIO_SAMPLE_DATE/BIO_ANALYSIS_ID/BIO_ORD_NAME/BIO_FAM_NAME/BIO_ABUNDANCE; 7 site-variable CSVs include EDF_MEAN (modelled sewage effluent proxy), LC_ARABLE_PER/LC_URBAN_PER and physical habitats; 287 water-quality analyte-date tables. The published UK `biotic` RData reference has 92 BMWP-scored taxon entries, 88 exact official EA nomenclature family-name matches; **not** 88/1793 ecological score coverage.
- **[Pan-European taxon abundance Zenodo original record](https://zenodo.org/records/15268354)** source metadata is available, but 2010–2015 source populations are not the same 2018/22 effluent sampling frame and may overlap English monitoring data.

### Quality barriers and next test
1. [Frozen source-only → incidence/count/null/transfer protocol](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-europe-benthic-taxa-source-gate-20261119/docs/PROTOCOL_20261119_EU_BENTHIC_TAXON_SOURCE_ONLY.md).
2. [Original source audit result](https://github.com/zuizui0223/gesui/blob/analysis/gesui-europe-benthic-taxa-source-gate-20261119/docs/RESULTS_20261119_EU_BENTHIC_TAXON_SOURCE_GATE.md).
3. Source-only ChemPop v2 same sample×family score coverage/EDF site variation census added. Do **not** fit biological models unless source quality gates pass and EDF orientation/time applicability, score mapping, and recorded count semantics are inspected.
4. Future response: independently published BMWP family score **incidence CWM** vs estimated site effluent exposure, compare recorded abundance weighting only if genuine numeric counts, control agricultural/urban land cover, flow, geography and monitoring era; taxon score label shuffles and region/site-disjoint prediction must retain nulls. No direct WWTP N/P mass causal attribution or cross-population meta-analysis.

**Draft/unmerged**, no modifications to gesui/main/other existing evidence PRs; EA and EIDC original row files are not copied into public Git history.
